<file path="BL/Pacs/PacsConfigBL.cs">
using Management.Models;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs
{
    public class PacsConfigBL
    {
        private readonly LABContext _context;

        // Tránh nhiều request Test Connection ghi đè/chồng log cùng lúc.
        private static readonly SemaphoreSlim _connectionLogLock = new SemaphoreSlim(1, 1);

        public PacsConfigBL(LABContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        public async Task<List<PacsConfig>> GetAllAsync()
        {
            return await _context.PacsConfigs
                .OrderByDescending(x => x.IsDefault)
                .ThenByDescending(x => x.IsActive)
                .ThenBy(x => x.Name)
                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<PacsConfig> GetByIdAsync(int id)
        {
            return await _context.PacsConfigs
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);
        }

        public async Task<PacsConfig> GetDefaultAsync()
        {
            return await _context.PacsConfigs
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.IsDefault == true && x.IsActive == true);
        }

        public async Task<object> SaveAsync(PacsConfig model, int? userId = null)
        {
            if (model == null)
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Dữ liệu cấu hình PACS không hợp lệ."
                };
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Code))
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Vui lòng nhập mã PACS server."
                };
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.Name))
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Vui lòng nhập tên PACS server."
                };
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.BaseUrl))
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Vui lòng nhập Base URL Orthanc."
                };
            }

            model.Code = model.Code.Trim();
            model.Name = model.Name.Trim();
            model.ServerType = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.ServerType)
                ? "Orthanc"
                : model.ServerType.Trim();

            model.BaseUrl = NormalizeBaseUrl(model.BaseUrl);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(model.DicomWebRoot))
            {
                model.DicomWebRoot = NormalizeDicomWebRoot(model.DicomWebRoot);
            }
            else
            {
                model.DicomWebRoot = "/dicom-web/";
            }

            if (model.DicomPort == null || model.DicomPort <= 0)
            {
                model.DicomPort = 4242;
            }

            if (model.SyncIntervalSeconds <= 0)
            {
                model.SyncIntervalSeconds = 60;
            }

            var isDuplicateCode = await _context.PacsConfigs
                .AnyAsync(x => x.Code == model.Code && x.Id != model.Id);

            if (isDuplicateCode)
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Mã PACS server đã tồn tại."
                };
            }

            PacsConfig entity;

            if (model.Id > 0)
            {
                entity = await _context.PacsConfigs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == model.Id);

                if (entity == null)
                {
                    return new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message = "Không tìm thấy cấu hình PACS cần cập nhật."
                    };
                }

                entity.UpdatedOn = DateTime.Now;
                entity.UpdatedBy = userId;
            }
            else
            {
                entity = new PacsConfig
                {
                    CreatedOn = DateTime.Now,
                    CreatedBy = userId,
                    LastStatus = "Unknown"
                };

                await _context.PacsConfigs.AddAsync(entity);
            }

            entity.Code = model.Code;
            entity.Name = model.Name;
            entity.ServerType = model.ServerType;

            entity.BaseUrl = model.BaseUrl;
            entity.ApiUsername = model.ApiUsername;
            entity.ApiPassword = model.ApiPassword;

            entity.DicomAETitle = model.DicomAETitle;
            entity.DicomHost = model.DicomHost;
            entity.DicomPort = model.DicomPort;

            entity.DicomWebRoot = model.DicomWebRoot;
            entity.OhifViewerUrl = model.OhifViewerUrl;

            entity.SyncEnabled = model.SyncEnabled;
            entity.SyncIntervalSeconds = model.SyncIntervalSeconds;

            entity.IsDefault = model.IsDefault;
            entity.IsActive = model.IsActive;

            if (entity.IsDefault)
            {
                var otherDefaults = await _context.PacsConfigs
                    .Where(x => x.Id != entity.Id && x.IsDefault)
                    .ToListAsync();

                foreach (var item in otherDefaults)
                {
                    item.IsDefault = false;
                    item.UpdatedOn = DateTime.Now;
                    item.UpdatedBy = userId;
                }
            }

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return new
            {
                success = true,
                message = "Lưu cấu hình PACS thành công.",
                data = entity
            };
        }

        public async Task<object> DeleteAsync(int id)
        {
            var entity = await _context.PacsConfigs.FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);

            if (entity == null)
            {
                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = "Không tìm thấy cấu hình PACS cần xóa."
                };
            }

            _context.PacsConfigs.Remove(entity);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            return new
            {
                success = true,
                message = "Xóa cấu hình PACS thành công."
            };
        }

        public async Task<object> TestConnectionAsync(int id)
        {
            var requestId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8);

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                $"START TestConnection | PacsConfigId={id}"
            );

            try
            {
                var config = await _context.PacsConfigs
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == id);

                if (config == null)
                {
                    await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                        requestId,
                        $"STOP TestConnection | Không tìm thấy PacsConfigId={id}"
                    );

                    return new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        status = "Offline",
                        message = "Không tìm thấy cấu hình PACS.",
                        requestId
                    };
                }

                return await TestConnectionAsync(config, requestId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                    requestId,
                    $"FATAL TestConnection | PacsConfigId={id}",
                    ex
                );

                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    status = "Offline",
                    message = "Test kết nối PACS thất bại. Xem file log để biết chi tiết.",
                    requestId,
                    lastError = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        public async Task<object> TestDefaultConnectionAsync()
        {
            var requestId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8);

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                "START TestDefaultConnection"
            );

            try
            {
                var config = await GetDefaultAsync();

                if (config == null)
                {
                    await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                        requestId,
                        "STOP TestDefaultConnection | Chưa có PACS mặc định đang active."
                    );

                    return new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        status = "Disabled",
                        message = "Chưa cấu hình PACS server mặc định.",
                        requestId
                    };
                }

                return await TestConnectionAsync(config, requestId);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                    requestId,
                    "FATAL TestDefaultConnection",
                    ex
                );

                return new
                {
                    success = false,
                    status = "Offline",
                    message = "Không kiểm tra được trạng thái PACS. Xem file log để biết chi tiết.",
                    requestId,
                    lastError = ex.Message
                };
            }
        }

        private async Task<object> TestConnectionAsync(PacsConfig config, string requestId)
        {
            var checkedAt = DateTime.Now;

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                $"CONFIG | Id={config.Id} | Code={config.Code} | Name={config.Name} | " +
                $"BaseUrl={config.BaseUrl} | DicomWebRoot={config.DicomWebRoot} | " +
                $"DicomHost={config.DicomHost} | DicomPort={config.DicomPort} | " +
                $"AuthEnabled={!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.ApiUsername)}"
            );

            // Không log ApiPassword / Authorization header.
            var apiResult = await CheckOrthancEndpointAsync(config, "/system");
            await LogHttpCheckResultAsync(requestId, "ORTHANC API /system", apiResult);

            var studiesResult = await CheckOrthancEndpointAsync(config, "/studies");
            await LogHttpCheckResultAsync(requestId, "ORTHANC API /studies", studiesResult);

            var dicomWebRoot = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.DicomWebRoot)
                ? "/dicom-web/"
                : NormalizeDicomWebRoot(config.DicomWebRoot);

            var dicomWebEndpoint = dicomWebRoot.TrimEnd('/') + "/studies";

            var dicomWebResult = await CheckOrthancEndpointAsync(
                config,
                dicomWebEndpoint
            );

            await LogHttpCheckResultAsync(
                requestId,
                $"DICOM WEB {dicomWebEndpoint}",
                dicomWebResult
            );

            var host = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.DicomHost)
                ? GetHostFromBaseUrl(config.BaseUrl)
                : config.DicomHost.Trim();

            var port = config.DicomPort ?? 4242;

            var dicomPortResult = await CheckTcpPortAsync(host, port, 3000);

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                $"DICOM TCP | Target={dicomPortResult.Target} | " +
                $"Success={dicomPortResult.Success} | ElapsedMs={dicomPortResult.ElapsedMs} | " +
                $"Error={dicomPortResult.Error ?? "(none)"}"
            );

            bool apiReady = apiResult.Success;
            bool studiesReady = studiesResult.Success;
            bool dicomWebReady = dicomWebResult.Success;
            bool dicomPortReady = dicomPortResult.Success;

            var failedServices = new List<string>();
            var errors = new List<string>();

            AddFailure("Orthanc /system", apiResult, failedServices, errors);
            AddFailure("Orthanc /studies", studiesResult, failedServices, errors);
            AddFailure("DICOMweb /studies", dicomWebResult, failedServices, errors);
            AddFailure("DICOM TCP Port", dicomPortResult, failedServices, errors);

            string lastError = errors.Count > 0
                ? string.Join(" | ", errors)
                : null;

            string status;
            string message;
            bool success;

            if (apiReady && studiesReady && dicomWebReady && dicomPortReady)
            {
                success = true;
                status = "Ready";
                message = "PACS Server is ready";
            }
            else if (apiReady || studiesReady || dicomWebReady || dicomPortReady)
            {
                success = false;
                status = "Warning";
                message = failedServices.Count > 0
                    ? "PACS Server warning. Chưa sẵn sàng: " + string.Join(", ", failedServices)
                    : "PACS Server warning. Một số dịch vụ chưa sẵn sàng.";
            }
            else
            {
                success = false;
                status = "Offline";
                message = "PACS Server is offline";
            }

            config.LastStatus = status;
            config.LastApiStatus = apiReady;
            config.LastStudiesStatus = studiesReady;
            config.LastDicomWebStatus = dicomWebReady;
            config.LastDicomPortStatus = dicomPortReady;
            config.LastCheckedAt = checkedAt;
            config.LastError = lastError;

            try
            {
                await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                    requestId,
                    "DATABASE ERROR | Không lưu được trạng thái Test Connection vào PacsConfig.",
                    ex
                );

                throw;
            }

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                $"SUMMARY | Status={status} | Success={success} | " +
                $"ApiReady={apiReady} | StudiesReady={studiesReady} | " +
                $"DicomWebReady={dicomWebReady} | DicomPortReady={dicomPortReady} | " +
                $"LastError={lastError ?? "(none)"}"
            );

            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                "END TestConnection"
            );

            return new
            {
                success,
                status,
                message,
                requestId,
                pacsConfigId = config.Id,
                apiReady,
                studiesReady,
                dicomWebReady,
                dicomPortReady,
                lastCheckedAt = checkedAt.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss"),
                lastError,

                // Trả thêm chi tiết để F12 > Network có thể xem ngay.
                details = new
                {
                    api = ToResponseDetail(apiResult),
                    studies = ToResponseDetail(studiesResult),
                    dicomWeb = ToResponseDetail(dicomWebResult),
                    dicomPort = ToResponseDetail(dicomPortResult)
                }
            };
        }

        private async Task<ConnectionCheckResult> CheckOrthancEndpointAsync(
            PacsConfig config,
            string endpoint)
        {
            var watch = Stopwatch.StartNew();

            var baseUrl = NormalizeBaseUrl(config.BaseUrl);
            var target = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(baseUrl)
                ? endpoint
                : baseUrl + (endpoint.StartsWith("/") ? endpoint : "/" + endpoint);

            try
            {
                using var client = new HttpClient();

                client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5);
                client.BaseAddress = new Uri(baseUrl);

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.ApiUsername))
                {
                    var rawAuth = $"{config.ApiUsername}:{config.ApiPassword}";
                    var token = Convert.ToBase64String(
                        Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(rawAuth)
                    );

                    client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization =
                        new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Basic", token);
                }

                using var response = await client.GetAsync(endpoint);

                var responseBody = response.Content == null
                    ? null
                    : await response.Content.ReadAsStringAsync();

                watch.Stop();

                return new ConnectionCheckResult
                {
                    Success = response.IsSuccessStatusCode,
                    Target = target,
                    StatusCode = (int)response.StatusCode,
                    ReasonPhrase = response.ReasonPhrase,
                    ResponseBody = LimitText(responseBody, 3000),
                    ElapsedMs = watch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                    Error = response.IsSuccessStatusCode
                        ? null
                        : $"HTTP {(int)response.StatusCode} {response.ReasonPhrase}"
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                watch.Stop();

                return new ConnectionCheckResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Target = target,
                    ElapsedMs = watch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                    Error = ex.Message,
                    ExceptionDetail = ex.ToString()
                };
            }
        }

        private async Task<ConnectionCheckResult> CheckTcpPortAsync(
            string host,
            int port,
            int timeoutMs)
        {
            var watch = Stopwatch.StartNew();
            var target = $"{host}:{port}";

            try
            {
                using var client = new TcpClient();

                var connectTask = client.ConnectAsync(host, port);
                var timeoutTask = Task.Delay(timeoutMs);

                var completedTask = await Task.WhenAny(connectTask, timeoutTask);

                if (completedTask != connectTask)
                {
                    watch.Stop();

                    return new ConnectionCheckResult
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        Target = target,
                        ElapsedMs = watch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                        Error = $"Timeout sau {timeoutMs} ms."
                    };
                }

                // Nếu ConnectAsync hoàn thành ở trạng thái faulted,
                // await ở đây sẽ ném đúng exception để log được nguyên nhân.
                await connectTask;

                watch.Stop();

                return new ConnectionCheckResult
                {
                    Success = client.Connected,
                    Target = target,
                    ElapsedMs = watch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                    Error = client.Connected
                        ? null
                        : "TCP connect hoàn thành nhưng socket chưa Connected."
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                watch.Stop();

                return new ConnectionCheckResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    Target = target,
                    ElapsedMs = watch.ElapsedMilliseconds,
                    Error = ex.Message,
                    ExceptionDetail = ex.ToString()
                };
            }
        }

        private void AddFailure(
            string serviceName,
            ConnectionCheckResult result,
            List<string> failedServices,
            List<string> errors)
        {
            if (result.Success)
            {
                return;
            }

            failedServices.Add(serviceName);

            var detail = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.Error)
                ? result.Error
                : "Không nhận được trạng thái thành công.";

            errors.Add($"{serviceName}: {detail}");
        }

        private object ToResponseDetail(ConnectionCheckResult result)
        {
            return new
            {
                success = result.Success,
                target = result.Target,
                statusCode = result.StatusCode,
                reasonPhrase = result.ReasonPhrase,
                elapsedMs = result.ElapsedMs,
                responsePreview = result.ResponseBody,
                error = result.Error
            };
        }

        private async Task LogHttpCheckResultAsync(
            string requestId,
            string checkName,
            ConnectionCheckResult result)
        {
            await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                requestId,
                $"{checkName} | Target={result.Target} | Success={result.Success} | " +
                $"StatusCode={result.StatusCode?.ToString() ?? "(none)"} | " +
                $"Reason={result.ReasonPhrase ?? "(none)"} | " +
                $"ElapsedMs={result.ElapsedMs} | Error={result.Error ?? "(none)"}"
            );

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.ResponseBody))
            {
                await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                    requestId,
                    $"{checkName} RESPONSE | {MakeSingleLine(result.ResponseBody)}"
                );
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(result.ExceptionDetail))
            {
                await WriteConnectionLogAsync(
                    requestId,
                    $"{checkName} EXCEPTION | {MakeSingleLine(result.ExceptionDetail)}"
                );
            }
        }

        private async Task WriteConnectionLogAsync(
            string requestId,
            string message,
            Exception exception = null)
        {
            try
            {
                // AppContext.BaseDirectory trên IIS trỏ về thư mục publish của ứng dụng,
                // ví dụ: C:\inetpub\wwwroot\lis-live\
                // => log sẽ nằm tại: C:\inetpub\wwwroot\lis-live\Logs\PacsConnection
                var rootPath = AppContext.BaseDirectory;

                var logFolder = Path.Combine(
                    rootPath,
                    "Logs",
                    "PacsConnection"
                );

                Directory.CreateDirectory(logFolder);

                var logFile = Path.Combine(
                    logFolder,
                    $"pacs-connection-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd}.log"
                );

                var builder = new StringBuilder();

                builder.Append('[')
                    .Append(DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff"))
                    .Append("] [")
                    .Append(requestId)
                    .Append("] ")
                    .AppendLine(message);

                if (exception != null)
                {
                    builder.Append('[')
                        .Append(DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff"))
                        .Append("] [")
                        .Append(requestId)
                        .Append("] EXCEPTION DETAIL | ")
                        .AppendLine(MakeSingleLine(exception.ToString()));
                }

                await _connectionLogLock.WaitAsync();

                try
                {
                    await File.AppendAllTextAsync(
                        logFile,
                        builder.ToString(),
                        Encoding.UTF8
                    );
                }
                finally
                {
                    _connectionLogLock.Release();
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // Tuyệt đối không để lỗi ghi log làm hỏng chức năng Test Connection.
            }
        }

        private string LimitText(string value, int maxLength)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
            {
                return value;
            }

            if (value.Length <= maxLength)
            {
                return value;
            }

            return value.Substring(0, maxLength)
                   + $" ... [TRUNCATED, total={value.Length} chars]";
        }

        private string MakeSingleLine(string value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            {
                return value;
            }

            return value
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Trim();
        }

        private sealed class ConnectionCheckResult
        {
            public bool Success { get; set; }
            public string Target { get; set; }
            public int? StatusCode { get; set; }
            public string ReasonPhrase { get; set; }
            public string ResponseBody { get; set; }
            public long ElapsedMs { get; set; }
            public string Error { get; set; }
            public string ExceptionDetail { get; set; }
        }

        private string NormalizeBaseUrl(string url)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url))
            {
                return url;
            }

            return url.Trim().TrimEnd('/');
        }

        private string NormalizeDicomWebRoot(string root)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(root))
            {
                return "/dicom-web/";
            }

            root = root.Trim();

            if (!root.StartsWith("/"))
            {
                root = "/" + root;
            }

            if (!root.EndsWith("/"))
            {
                root += "/";
            }

            return root;
        }

        private string GetHostFromBaseUrl(string baseUrl)
        {
            try
            {
                var uri = new Uri(baseUrl);
                return uri.Host;
            }
            catch
            {
                return "localhost";
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs;

/// <summary>
/// Temporary, explicitly gated development/UAT test for IIS -> encrypted SMB -> Orthanc MWL.
/// No SQL, no patient data, no appsettings changes, no clinical worklist activation.
/// C-FIND must be verified SEPARATELY from Ubuntu: this service only proves
/// synthetic publish, remote readback and safe cleanup from IIS.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PacsIisMwlSyntheticHostedService : BackgroundService
{
    private const string GatePath = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\MWL-E2E-ARM.txt";
    private const string FixturePath = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\Fixtures\TEST03C00001.wl";
    private const string ReceiptDirectory = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\Results";
    private const string GateText = "RUN-IIS-MWL-SYNTHETIC-ONCE";
    private const string ExpectedShare = @"\\192.168.10.106\pacs-worklists";
    private const string ExpectedAccession = "TEST03C00001";
    private const string FixtureHash = "A838825A23CF4E62971714CAE000466ED9A867C84729EBB019D7AD4C5DC18A8E";
    private const int FixtureLength = 424;
    private static readonly TimeSpan VisibilityWindow = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(150);

    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<PacsIisMwlSyntheticHostedService> _logger;

    public PacsIisMwlSyntheticHostedService(
        IConfiguration configuration, ILogger<PacsIisMwlSyntheticHostedService> logger)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows() || !File.Exists(GatePath)) return;
        // A receipt directory must already exist, with a restricted IIS APPPOOL\LIS ACL.
        if (!Directory.Exists(ReceiptDirectory))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("PACS_B1_MWL STOP RECEIPT_DIRECTORY_MISSING");
            return;
        }

        var runId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var receiptPath = Path.Combine(ReceiptDirectory, "MWL-E2E-" + runId + ".json");
        var startedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var stage = "GATE_VALIDATE";
        var status = "STOP";
        var exceptionType = "NONE";
        var hresult = 0;
        var receiptCreated = false;
        byte[] fixture = Array.Empty<byte>();

        try
        {
            var gate = new FileInfo(GatePath);
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (gate.Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) ||
                now - gate.LastWriteTimeUtc > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) ||
                gate.LastWriteTimeUtc > now.AddMinutes(1) ||
                (await File.ReadAllTextAsync(GatePath, stoppingToken)).Trim() != GateText)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("PACS_B1_MWL STOP GATE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED");
                return;
            }

            // Fail closed when the IIS identity cannot create the first receipt.
            await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, "RUNNING", "GATE_VALIDATED", "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
            receiptCreated = true;
            stage = "GATE_CONSUME";
            File.Delete(GatePath); // Consumed before any remote operation, so a recycle cannot replay it.
            await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, "RUNNING", "GATE_CONSUMED", "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);

            stage = "CONFIG_VALIDATE";
            foreach (var key in new[] { "WorklistFolder", "WorklistStagingFolder", "WorklistQuarantineFolder" })
                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_configuration["Pacs:" + key]))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("Patient Worklist configuration must remain disabled.");
            if (bool.TryParse(_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"], out var liveEnabled) && liveEnabled)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Patient Worklist SMB flag must remain disabled.");
            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"]) &&
                !bool.TryParse(_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"], out _))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Patient Worklist SMB flag is invalid.");

            var share = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] ?? "").Trim().TrimEnd('\\');
            var username = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] ?? "").Trim();
            var secret = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] ?? "").Trim();
            if (!string.Equals(share, ExpectedShare, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("SMB configuration incomplete or unexpected.");

            stage = "FIXTURE_VALIDATE";
            if (!File.Exists(FixturePath) || new FileInfo(FixturePath).Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint))
                throw new FileNotFoundException("Verified synthetic fixture is absent.");
            if (new FileInfo(FixturePath).Length != FixtureLength)
                throw new InvalidDataException("Synthetic fixture length mismatch.");
            fixture = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(FixturePath, stoppingToken);
            if (!string.Equals(Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(fixture)), FixtureHash, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidDataException("Synthetic fixture hash mismatch.");

            var isolated = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(
                new Dictionary<string, string?>
                {
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"] = "true", // only for this scoped synthetic operation
                    ["Pacs:WorklistFolder"] = ExpectedShare,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] = ExpectedShare,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] = username,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] = secret
                }).Build();

            var publishing = Path.Combine(ExpectedShare, ExpectedAccession + ".publishing");
            var final = Path.Combine(ExpectedShare, ExpectedAccession + ".wl");
            stage = "SMB_CONNECT";
            await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
            await using (var scope = await PacsSmbConnectionScope.OpenAsync(isolated, stoppingToken))
            {
                // Exactly one frozen synthetic filename. Never overwrite, rename or delete pre-existing files.
                stage = "REMOTE_COLLISION_CHECK";
                if (File.Exists(publishing) || File.Exists(final))
                    throw new IOException("Synthetic file collision; refusing to touch existing remote file.");

                var createdPublishing = false;
                var createdFinal = false;
                try
                {
                    stage = "SMB_WRITE_PUBLISHING";
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                    await using (var stream = new FileStream(publishing, FileMode.CreateNew, FileAccess.Write,
                        FileShare.None, 4096, FileOptions.Asynchronous))
                    {
                        createdPublishing = true;
                        await stream.WriteAsync(fixture, stoppingToken);
                        await stream.FlushAsync(stoppingToken);
                    }

                    stage = "REMOTE_SHA256_READBACK";
                    await ConfirmHashAsync(publishing, stoppingToken);
                    stage = "ATOMIC_PUBLISH";
                    File.Move(publishing, final); // same SMB share/directory, no overwrite
                    createdPublishing = false;
                    createdFinal = true;
                    await ConfirmHashAsync(final, stoppingToken);

                    // This receipt means 'published', NOT 'Orthanc C-FIND PASS'.
                    stage = "VISIBLE_FOR_ORTHANC_CFIND";
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                    await Task.Delay(VisibilityWindow, stoppingToken);
                }
                finally
                {
                    // Any process crash/forced kill can bypass finally. Operator must verify
                    // and clean up TEST03C00001.wl by SHA256 before any retry.
                    var priorStage = stage;
                    try
                    {
                        if (createdFinal) await DeleteOwnedAndVerifiedAsync(final);
                        if (createdPublishing) await DeleteOwnedAndVerifiedAsync(publishing);
                        if (createdFinal && File.Exists(final)) throw new IOException("Synthetic final file cleanup incomplete.");
                        if (createdPublishing && File.Exists(publishing)) throw new IOException("Synthetic partial file cleanup incomplete.");
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        stage = "REMOTE_CLEANUP";
                        throw;
                    }
                    stage = priorStage;
                }
            }
            status = "PASS";
            stage = "PUBLISH_AND_CLEANUP_COMPLETE";
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            status = "STOP";
            exceptionType = "OperationCanceledException";
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            status = "STOP";
            exceptionType = ex.GetType().Name;
            hresult = ex.HResult;
            _logger.LogWarning("PACS_B1_MWL STOP Stage={Stage} Type={Type} HResult={HResult}",
                stage, exceptionType, hresult);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (fixture.Length > 0) CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(fixture);
            if (receiptCreated)
            {
                try
                {
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receiptPath, startedUtc, status, stage,
                        exceptionType, hresult, CancellationToken.None);
                }
                catch { _logger.LogError("PACS_B1_MWL RESULT_WRITE_FAILED"); }
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task ConfirmHashAsync(string path, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        if (new FileInfo(path).Attributes.HasFlag(FileAttributes.ReparsePoint))
            throw new IOException("Unexpected reparse point in synthetic file path.");
        var readback = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(path, ct);
        try
        {
            if (readback.Length != FixtureLength ||
                !string.Equals(Convert.ToHexString(SHA256.HashData(readback)), FixtureHash, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidDataException("Remote synthetic file SHA256 mismatch.");
        }
        finally { CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(readback); }
    }

    private static async Task DeleteOwnedAndVerifiedAsync(string path)
    {
        if (!File.Exists(path)) return;
        await ConfirmHashAsync(path, CancellationToken.None); // preserve suspicious files for manual review
        File.Delete(path);
    }

    private static async Task WriteReceiptAsync(string path, DateTime startedUtc, string status,
        string stage, string exceptionType, int hresult, CancellationToken ct)
    {
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(new
        {
            Checkpoint = "PACS-B1-IIS-MWL-SYNTHETIC-PUBLISH",
            Status = status,
            Stage = stage,
            ExceptionType = exceptionType,
            HResult = hresult,
            Accession = ExpectedAccession, // synthetic identifier only
            FixtureSHA256 = FixtureHash,
            StartedUtc = startedUtc.ToString("O"),
            UpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O")
        });
        var temp = path + ".writing";
        try
        {
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(temp, json, new UTF8Encoding(false), ct);
            File.Move(temp, path, true);
        }
        finally { try { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); } catch { } }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="BL/Pacs/PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService.cs">
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs;

/// <summary>
/// Gated one-shot SMB probe hosted inside LIS IIS. This class never reads patient data,
/// touches SQL or creates a DICOM .wl file. Keep Worklist production flags disabled.
/// Operator must prepare a restricted gate and a separate, restricted receipt folder.
/// </summary>
public sealed class PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService : BackgroundService
{
    private const string GatePath = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\SMB-ONE-SHOT-ARM.txt";
    private const string ReceiptDirectory = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\Results";
    private const string GateText = "RUN-IIS-SMB-ONCE-20261029";
    private const string ExpectedShare = @"\\192.168.10.106\pacs-worklists";

    private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;
    private readonly ILogger<PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService> _logger;

    public PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService(
        IConfiguration configuration,
        ILogger<PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService> logger)
    {
        _configuration = configuration;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
    {
        if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows() || !File.Exists(GatePath)) return;

        // The JSON receipt is written before the gate is consumed. If the IIS identity
        // cannot write results, the probe is not run. The receipt contains no secrets.
        if (!Directory.Exists(ReceiptDirectory))
        {
            _logger.LogWarning("PACS_IIS_SMB_ONESHOT STOP RECEIPT_DIRECTORY_MISSING");
            return;
        }

        var runId = Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N");
        var receipt = Path.Combine(ReceiptDirectory, "SMB-ONESHOT-" + runId + ".json");
        var startedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow;
        var stage = "GATE_VALIDATE";
        var status = "STOP";
        var exceptionType = "NONE";
        var hresult = 0;
        var receiptStarted = false;
        try
        {
            var gate = new FileInfo(GatePath);
            var now = DateTime.UtcNow;
            if (now - gate.LastWriteTimeUtc > TimeSpan.FromMinutes(5) ||
                gate.LastWriteTimeUtc > now.AddMinutes(1) ||
                (await File.ReadAllTextAsync(GatePath, stoppingToken)).Trim() != GateText)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("PACS_IIS_SMB_ONESHOT STOP GATE_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED");
                return;
            }

            // Create the first receipt before deleting the gate: fail closed if no write ACL.
            await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", "GATE_VALIDATED", "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
            receiptStarted = true;
            stage = "GATE_CONSUME";
            File.Delete(GatePath);
            await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", "GATE_CONSUMED", "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);

            stage = "CONFIG_VALIDATE";
            var share = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] ?? "").Trim().TrimEnd('\\');
            var username = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] ?? "").Trim();
            var secret = (_configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] ?? "").Trim();
            if (!string.Equals(share, ExpectedShare, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secret))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("SMB configuration is incomplete or points to an unexpected share.");

            var isolated = new ConfigurationBuilder().AddInMemoryCollection(
                new Dictionary<string, string?>
                {
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"] = "true",
                    ["Pacs:WorklistFolder"] = ExpectedShare,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] = ExpectedShare,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] = username,
                    ["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] = secret
                }).Build();

            var name = "__pacs_iis_probe_" + runId;
            var temporary = Path.Combine(ExpectedShare, name + ".tmp");
            var renamed = Path.Combine(ExpectedShare, name + ".checked.tmp");
            var payload = Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("PACS-ONESHOT-" + runId);
            try
            {
                stage = "SMB_CONNECT";
                await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                await using (var session = await PacsSmbConnectionScope.OpenAsync(isolated, stoppingToken))
                {
                    stage = "SMB_WRITE";
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                    await using (var stream = new FileStream(temporary, FileMode.CreateNew,
                        FileAccess.Write, FileShare.None, 4096, FileOptions.Asynchronous))
                    {
                        await stream.WriteAsync(payload, stoppingToken);
                        await stream.FlushAsync(stoppingToken);
                    }
                    stage = "SMB_RENAME_READBACK";
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                    File.Move(temporary, renamed);
                    var observed = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(renamed, stoppingToken);
                    try
                    {
                        if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(payload, observed))
                            throw new InvalidDataException("Probe readback failed.");
                    }
                    finally { CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(observed); }
                    stage = "SMB_CLEANUP";
                    File.Delete(renamed);
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, "RUNNING", stage, "NONE", 0, stoppingToken);
                    stage = "SMB_DISCONNECT";
                }
                status = "PASS";
                stage = "COMPLETE";
            }
            finally
            {
                CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(payload);
                foreach (var path in new[] { temporary, renamed })
                {
                    try { if (File.Exists(path)) File.Delete(path); }
                    catch { _logger.LogWarning("PACS_IIS_SMB_ONESHOT CLEANUP_INCOMPLETE"); }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
        {
            status = "STOP";
            exceptionType = "OperationCanceledException";
        }
        catch (Exception error)
        {
            status = "STOP";
            exceptionType = error.GetType().Name;
            hresult = error.HResult;
            // No exception message, stack trace, password, token or patient data is logged.
            _logger.LogWarning("PACS_IIS_SMB_ONESHOT STOP Stage={Stage} Type={Type} HResult={HResult}",
                stage, exceptionType, hresult);
        }
        finally
        {
            if (receiptStarted)
            {
                try
                {
                    await WriteReceiptAsync(receipt, startedUtc, status, stage,
                        exceptionType, hresult, CancellationToken.None);
                }
                catch
                {
                    _logger.LogError("PACS_IIS_SMB_ONESHOT RESULT_WRITE_FAILED");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static async Task WriteReceiptAsync(
        string receipt, DateTime startedUtc, string status, string stage,
        string exceptionType, int hresult, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var value = new
        {
            Checkpoint = "PACS-IIS-SMB-ONESHOT",
            Status = status,
            Stage = stage,
            ExceptionType = exceptionType,
            HResult = hresult,
            StartedUtc = startedUtc.ToString("O"),
            UpdatedUtc = DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("O")
        };
        var json = JsonSerializer.Serialize(value);
        var temp = receipt + ".writing";
        try
        {
            // No directory creation. Restricted directory must be prepared by operator.
            await File.WriteAllTextAsync(temp, json, new UTF8Encoding(false), token);
            File.Move(temp, receipt, true);
        }
        finally
        {
            try { if (File.Exists(temp)) File.Delete(temp); } catch { }
        }
    }
}

<file path="BL/Pacs/PacsReliabilityBL.cs">
using Management.Models;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Management.Services.Pacs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Reliability safety-net around the canonical PACS pipeline.
    ///
    /// PREPROD reliability currently provides:
    /// - 01B-02: read-only Missing Study Recovery preview;
    /// - 01B-03: manual Recovery for exactly one validated Worklist;
    /// - 01B-04: bounded batch Recovery with anti-starvation scheduling;
    /// - 01C-02: read-only Completed Study Reconciliation preview;
    /// - 01C-03: manual ReconcileCompletedStudy through canonical PacsStudyBL;
    /// - 01C-05: bounded batch Reconciliation with anti-starvation scheduling.
    ///
    /// PacsReliabilityBL never owns PacsSyncState checkpoint. Actual Study /
    /// Series / Instance mutation is delegated to the canonical PacsStudyBL.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsReliabilityBL
    {
        private const int DefaultBatchSize = 50;
        private const int MaxBatchSize = 200;
        private const int DefaultMinAgeMinutes = 2;
        private const int MaxMinAgeMinutes = 1440;

        private const int DefaultReconciliationBatchSize = 20;
        private const int DefaultReconciliationMinAgeMinutes = 10;

        // Prevent two manual/automatic Recovery batches from competing for
        // the same anti-starvation candidate set. This lock does NOT own
        // PacsSyncState checkpoint and does NOT block normal FAST PATH reads.
        private static readonly SemaphoreSlim
            _recoveryBatchLock = new(1, 1);

        // Prevent two manual/automatic Reconciliation batches from competing
        // for the same completed Worklist candidate set. This lock is
        // completely separate from the Recovery batch lock and from
        // PacsSyncState checkpoint ownership.
        private static readonly SemaphoreSlim
            _reconciliationBatchLock = new(1, 1);

        private readonly LABContext _context;
        private readonly PacsConfigBL _pacsConfigBL;
        private readonly OrthancClient _orthancClient;
        private readonly PacsStudyBL _pacsStudyBL;
        private readonly IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncRecoveryOptions>
            _recoveryOptions;

        private readonly IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncReconciliationOptions>
            _reconciliationOptions;

        public PacsReliabilityBL(
            LABContext context,
            PacsConfigBL pacsConfigBL,
            OrthancClient orthancClient,
            PacsStudyBL pacsStudyBL,
            IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncRecoveryOptions> recoveryOptions,
            IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncReconciliationOptions> reconciliationOptions)
        {
            _context = context;
            _pacsConfigBL = pacsConfigBL;
            _orthancClient = orthancClient;
            _pacsStudyBL = pacsStudyBL;
            _recoveryOptions = recoveryOptions;
            _reconciliationOptions = reconciliationOptions;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C-02
        ///
        /// Read-only preview for Completed Study Reconciliation.
        ///
        /// Candidate:
        /// - Project A Worklist Status=3 only;
        /// - CreatedOn >= configured Reconciliation StartDate;
        /// - CompletedOn must exist and be older than MinAgeMinutes;
        /// - OrthancStudyId must already be persisted by the canonical sync.
        ///
        /// Safety:
        /// - StartDate is mandatory and fail-closed;
        /// - no SaveChangesAsync;
        /// - no SyncSingleStudy/TrySyncSingleStudy call;
        /// - no LastReconciliationCheckedOn mutation;
        /// - no PacsSyncState/checkpoint mutation.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<PacsReconciliationPreviewResult>
            PreviewReconciliationAsync(
                int? requestedBatchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                new PacsReconciliationPreviewResult();

            var options =
                _reconciliationOptions.CurrentValue
                ?? new PacsSyncReconciliationOptions();

            if (!TryParseReconciliationStartDate(
                    options.StartDate,
                    out var reconciliationFrom))
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.ConfigInvalid;
                result.Message =
                    "PacsSyncReconciliation:StartDate bắt buộc có định dạng yyyy-MM-dd. " +
                    "Reconciliation fail-closed để không quét nhầm dữ liệu lịch sử.";

                return result;
            }

            var minAgeMinutes =
                NormalizeReconciliationMinAgeMinutes(
                    options.MinAgeMinutes);

            var batchSize =
                NormalizeReconciliationBatchSize(
                    requestedBatchSize,
                    options.BatchSize);

            var reconciliationTo =
                DateTime.Now.AddMinutes(
                    -minAgeMinutes);

            result.ReconciliationFrom =
                reconciliationFrom;

            result.ReconciliationTo =
                reconciliationTo;

            result.MinAgeMinutes =
                minAgeMinutes;

            result.BatchSize =
                batchSize;

            var config =
                await _pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

            if (config == null ||
                !config.IsActive ||
                !config.IsDefault)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.PacsConfigNotFound;
                result.Message =
                    "Chưa có PACS Server mặc định đang hoạt động.";

                return result;
            }

            _orthancClient.Configure(config);

            /*
             * READ ONLY candidate scan.
             *
             * Anti-starvation order is already frozen for the later batch:
             * 1. never checked first;
             * 2. oldest LastReconciliationCheckedOn;
             * 3. oldest CompletedOn;
             * 4. smallest Id.
             *
             * Preview intentionally DOES NOT update
             * LastReconciliationCheckedOn.
             */
            var candidates =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.Status == 3 &&
                        x.CreatedOn >= reconciliationFrom &&
                        x.CompletedOn.HasValue &&
                        x.CompletedOn.Value <= reconciliationTo &&
                        x.OrthancStudyId != null &&
                        x.OrthancStudyId != "")
                    .OrderBy(x =>
                        x.LastReconciliationCheckedOn.HasValue
                            ? 1
                            : 0)
                    .ThenBy(x =>
                        x.LastReconciliationCheckedOn)
                    .ThenBy(x =>
                        x.CompletedOn)
                    .ThenBy(x =>
                        x.Id)
                    .Take(batchSize)
                    .Select(x => new
                    {
                        x.Id,
                        x.ResultCDHAId,
                        x.AccessionNumber,
                        x.Status,
                        x.CreatedOn,
                        x.CompletedOn,
                        x.LastReconciliationCheckedOn,
                        x.OrthancStudyId,
                        x.StudyInstanceUID
                    })
                    .ToListAsync(
                        cancellationToken);

            result.CandidateCount =
                candidates.Count;

            foreach (var candidate in candidates)
            {
                cancellationToken
                    .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                var item =
                    new PacsReconciliationPreviewItem
                    {
                        WorklistId =
                            candidate.Id,

                        ResultCDHAId =
                            candidate.ResultCDHAId,

                        AccessionNumber =
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                candidate.AccessionNumber),

                        CreatedOn =
                            candidate.CreatedOn,

                        CompletedOn =
                            candidate.CompletedOn,

                        LastReconciliationCheckedOn =
                            candidate.LastReconciliationCheckedOn,

                        WorklistOrthancStudyId =
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                candidate.OrthancStudyId),

                        WorklistStudyInstanceUID =
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                candidate.StudyInstanceUID)
                    };

                try
                {
                    var worklistOrthancStudyId =
                        item.WorklistOrthancStudyId;

                    if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            worklistOrthancStudyId))
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.IdentityMismatch;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Completed Worklist không có OrthancStudyId hợp lệ.";

                        result.IdentityMismatchCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    /*
                     * Resolve the LIS PacsStudy by immutable Orthanc identity.
                     * Defensive fallback by StudyInstanceUID is read-only only.
                     */
                    var pacsStudy =
                        await _context.PacsStudies
                            .AsNoTracking()
                            .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                                x =>
                                    x.OrthancStudyId ==
                                    worklistOrthancStudyId,
                                cancellationToken);

                    if (pacsStudy == null &&
                        !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            item.WorklistStudyInstanceUID))
                    {
                        var worklistStudyInstanceUid =
                            item.WorklistStudyInstanceUID;

                        pacsStudy =
                            await _context.PacsStudies
                                .AsNoTracking()
                                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                                    x =>
                                        x.StudyInstanceUID ==
                                        worklistStudyInstanceUid,
                                    cancellationToken);
                    }

                    if (pacsStudy == null)
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.Error;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Worklist đã Completed nhưng không resolve được PacsStudy trong LIS.";
                        item.ErrorMessage =
                            "LIS_PACS_STUDY_METADATA_MISSING";

                        result.ErrorCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    item.PacsStudyId =
                        pacsStudy.Id;

                    item.PacsStudyStatus =
                        pacsStudy.Status;

                    item.LisRecordedSeriesCount =
                        pacsStudy.SeriesCount;

                    item.LisRecordedInstanceCount =
                        pacsStudy.InstanceCount;

                    /*
                     * Validate persisted LIS identity before querying Orthanc.
                     * Reconciliation is not allowed to guess across identities.
                     */
                    if (pacsStudy.ResultCDHAId !=
                            candidate.ResultCDHAId
                        ||
                        !string.Equals(
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                pacsStudy.OrthancStudyId),
                            worklistOrthancStudyId,
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                        ||
                        !IdentityMatchesRequired(
                            item.WorklistStudyInstanceUID,
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                pacsStudy.StudyInstanceUID))
                        ||
                        !IdentityMatchesRequired(
                            item.AccessionNumber,
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                pacsStudy.AccessionNumber)))
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.IdentityMismatch;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Identity giữa Completed Worklist và PacsStudy trong LIS không khớp.";

                        result.IdentityMismatchCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    item.LisActualSeriesCount =
                        await _context.PacsSeries
                            .AsNoTracking()
                            .CountAsync(
                                x =>
                                    x.PacsStudyId ==
                                    pacsStudy.Id,
                                cancellationToken);

                    item.LisActualInstanceCount =
                        await _context.PacsInstances
                            .AsNoTracking()
                            .CountAsync(
                                x =>
                                    x.PacsStudyId ==
                                    pacsStudy.Id,
                                cancellationToken);

                    string studyJson;

                    try
                    {
                        studyJson =
                            await _orthancClient
                                .GetStudyJsonAsync(
                                    worklistOrthancStudyId,
                                    cancellationToken);
                    }
                    catch (HttpRequestException ex)
                        when (
                            ex.StatusCode ==
                            HttpStatusCode.NotFound)
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.PacsStudyNotFound;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Completed Worklist tham chiếu Orthanc Study không còn tồn tại.";
                        item.ErrorMessage =
                            ex.GetBaseException().Message;

                        result.PacsStudyNotFoundCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    using var studyDocument =
                        JsonDocument.Parse(
                            studyJson);

                    var studyRoot =
                        studyDocument.RootElement;

                    var mainTags =
                        GetObject(
                            studyRoot,
                            "MainDicomTags");

                    item.OrthancAccessionNumber =
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            GetString(
                                mainTags,
                                "AccessionNumber"));

                    item.OrthancStudyInstanceUID =
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            GetString(
                                mainTags,
                                "StudyInstanceUID"));

                    item.IsStable =
                        GetNullableBoolean(
                            studyRoot,
                            "IsStable");

                    if (item.IsStable != true)
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.NotStable;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Study Orthanc hiện chưa Stable. Chưa được Reconcile.";

                        result.NotStableCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    /*
                     * End-to-end identity must agree:
                     * Worklist == PacsStudy == current Orthanc metadata.
                     */
                    if (!IdentityMatchesRequired(
                            item.AccessionNumber,
                            item.OrthancAccessionNumber)
                        ||
                        !IdentityMatchesRequired(
                            item.WorklistStudyInstanceUID,
                            item.OrthancStudyInstanceUID)
                        ||
                        !IdentityMatchesRequired(
                            NormalizeIdentity(
                                pacsStudy.StudyInstanceUID),
                            item.OrthancStudyInstanceUID))
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.IdentityMismatch;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "Identity giữa Worklist/PacsStudy và Orthanc không khớp.";

                        result.IdentityMismatchCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    var orthancSeriesIds =
                        GetStringArray(
                            studyRoot,
                            "Series");

                    item.OrthancSeriesCount =
                        orthancSeriesIds.Count;

                    item.OrthancInstanceCount =
                        await ReadOrthancInstanceCountAsync(
                            worklistOrthancStudyId,
                            item.OrthancSeriesCount,
                            cancellationToken);

                    item.SeriesDelta =
                        item.OrthancSeriesCount -
                        item.LisActualSeriesCount;

                    item.InstanceDelta =
                        item.OrthancInstanceCount -
                        item.LisActualInstanceCount;

                    var actualSeriesMatch =
                        item.LisActualSeriesCount ==
                        item.OrthancSeriesCount;

                    var actualInstanceMatch =
                        item.LisActualInstanceCount ==
                        item.OrthancInstanceCount;

                    var recordedCountsMatchActual =
                        item.LisRecordedSeriesCount ==
                            item.LisActualSeriesCount
                        &&
                        item.LisRecordedInstanceCount ==
                            item.LisActualInstanceCount;

                    if (actualSeriesMatch &&
                        actualInstanceMatch &&
                        recordedCountsMatchActual)
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.Match;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            "LIS và Orthanc đang khớp.";

                        result.MatchCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    /*
                     * Child rows already match Orthanc. Only PacsStudy's
                     * metadata counts are stale.
                     */
                    if (actualSeriesMatch &&
                        actualInstanceMatch)
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.MetadataCountMismatch;
                        item.CanReconcile = true;
                        item.Message =
                            "Child Series/Instances trong LIS đã đủ nhưng " +
                            "SeriesCount/InstanceCount trên PacsStudy đang stale.";

                        result.MetadataMismatchCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    /*
                     * Orthanc has equal-or-more data in both dimensions and
                     * at least one dimension is greater: safe candidate for
                     * later canonical re-sync.
                     */
                    if (item.SeriesDelta >= 0 &&
                        item.InstanceDelta >= 0 &&
                        (item.SeriesDelta > 0 ||
                         item.InstanceDelta > 0))
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.LisMissingData;
                        item.CanReconcile = true;
                        item.Message =
                            $"LIS thiếu dữ liệu so với Orthanc. " +
                            $"SeriesDelta={item.SeriesDelta}, " +
                            $"InstanceDelta={item.InstanceDelta}.";

                        result.MissingDataCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    /*
                     * Project A safety rule:
                     * canonical Study sync can remove stale hierarchy rows.
                     * Never auto-reconcile when LIS is currently the superset.
                     */
                    if (item.SeriesDelta <= 0 &&
                        item.InstanceDelta <= 0 &&
                        (item.SeriesDelta < 0 ||
                         item.InstanceDelta < 0))
                    {
                        item.ReconciliationStatus =
                            PacsReconciliationStatuses.LisHasExtraData;
                        item.CanReconcile = false;
                        item.Message =
                            $"LIS đang có nhiều dữ liệu hơn Orthanc. " +
                            $"SeriesDelta={item.SeriesDelta}, " +
                            $"InstanceDelta={item.InstanceDelta}. " +
                            "Không được tự Reconcile.";

                        result.ExtraDataCount++;
                        result.Items.Add(item);
                        continue;
                    }

                    item.ReconciliationStatus =
                        PacsReconciliationStatuses.CountMismatchComplex;
                    item.CanReconcile = false;
                    item.Message =
                        $"Count mismatch không đơn giản. " +
                        $"SeriesDelta={item.SeriesDelta}, " +
                        $"InstanceDelta={item.InstanceDelta}. " +
                        "Cần kiểm tra thủ công.";

                    result.ComplexMismatchCount++;
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (
                        cancellationToken
                            .IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    throw;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    item.ReconciliationStatus =
                        PacsReconciliationStatuses.Error;
                    item.CanReconcile = false;
                    item.Message =
                        "Lỗi khi Preview Reconciliation.";
                    item.ErrorMessage =
                        ex.GetBaseException().Message;

                    result.ErrorCount++;
                }

                result.Items.Add(item);
            }

            result.Success =
                true;

            result.Status =
                result.CandidateCount == 0
                    ? PacsReconciliationStatuses.NoCandidates
                    : result.ErrorCount == 0
                        ? PacsReconciliationStatuses.Completed
                        : PacsReconciliationStatuses.CompletedWithErrors;

            result.Message =
                $"Reconciliation Preview hoàn tất. " +
                $"Candidates={result.CandidateCount}, " +
                $"Match={result.MatchCount}, " +
                $"MissingData={result.MissingDataCount}, " +
                $"MetadataMismatch={result.MetadataMismatchCount}, " +
                $"ExtraData={result.ExtraDataCount}, " +
                $"ComplexMismatch={result.ComplexMismatchCount}, " +
                $"PacsStudyNotFound={result.PacsStudyNotFoundCount}, " +
                $"NotStable={result.NotStableCount}, " +
                $"IdentityMismatch={result.IdentityMismatchCount}, " +
                $"Errors={result.ErrorCount}.";

            return result;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C-03
        ///
        /// Manual Reconciliation for exactly one Completed Worklist.
        ///
        /// Mutation is allowed ONLY when the fresh targeted inspection is:
        /// - LIS_MISSING_DATA, or
        /// - METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH.
        ///
        /// All Study/Series/Instance writes are delegated to
        /// PacsStudyBL.TrySyncSingleStudyAsync(). This method never owns or
        /// updates PacsSyncState checkpoint and never rewrites CompletedOn.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<PacsReconciliationManualResult>
            ReconcileCompletedStudyAsync(
                long pacsWorklistItemId,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default,
                bool orthancAlreadyConfigured = false)
        {
            var result =
                new PacsReconciliationManualResult
                {
                    WorklistId =
                        pacsWorklistItemId
                };

            if (pacsWorklistItemId <= 0)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.InvalidWorklistId;
                result.Message =
                    "PacsWorklistItemId không hợp lệ.";

                return result;
            }

            var options =
                _reconciliationOptions.CurrentValue
                ?? new PacsSyncReconciliationOptions();

            if (!TryParseReconciliationStartDate(
                    options.StartDate,
                    out var reconciliationFrom))
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.ConfigInvalid;
                result.Message =
                    "PacsSyncReconciliation:StartDate bắt buộc có định dạng yyyy-MM-dd. " +
                    "Reconciliation fail-closed.";

                return result;
            }

            var minAgeMinutes =
                NormalizeReconciliationMinAgeMinutes(
                    options.MinAgeMinutes);

            var reconciliationTo =
                DateTime.Now.AddMinutes(
                    -minAgeMinutes);

            var worklist =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                        x =>
                            x.Id ==
                            pacsWorklistItemId,
                        cancellationToken);

            if (worklist == null)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.WorklistNotFound;
                result.Message =
                    "Không tìm thấy PacsWorklistItem.";

                return result;
            }

            result.ResultCDHAId =
                worklist.ResultCDHAId;

            result.AccessionNumber =
                NormalizeIdentity(
                    worklist.AccessionNumber);

            result.OrthancStudyId =
                NormalizeIdentity(
                    worklist.OrthancStudyId);

            result.StudyInstanceUID =
                NormalizeIdentity(
                    worklist.StudyInstanceUID);

            result.CompletedOnBefore =
                worklist.CompletedOn;

            if (worklist.Status != 3)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.InvalidWorklistStatus;
                result.Message =
                    $"Worklist phải Status=3 để Reconcile. Actual={worklist.Status}.";

                return result;
            }

            if (worklist.CreatedOn <
                    reconciliationFrom
                ||
                !worklist.CompletedOn.HasValue
                ||
                worklist.CompletedOn.Value >
                    reconciliationTo)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.OutsideReconciliationWindow;
                result.Message =
                    "Worklist nằm ngoài Reconciliation window hoặc chưa đủ MinAgeMinutes.";

                return result;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    result.OrthancStudyId))
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.MissingOrthancStudyId;
                result.Message =
                    "Completed Worklist không có OrthancStudyId.";

                return result;
            }

            var config =
                await _pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

            if (config == null ||
                !config.IsActive ||
                !config.IsDefault)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.PacsConfigNotFound;
                result.Message =
                    "Chưa có PACS Server mặc định đang hoạt động.";

                return result;
            }

            /*
             * Direct/manual endpoint owns initial OrthancClient configuration.
             *
             * PREPROD-01C-05 batch already configured this exact
             * PacsReliabilityBL OrthancClient before its first inspection.
             * HttpClient BaseAddress/Timeout cannot be assigned again after
             * the first request has started, so nested batch Reconciliation
             * must reuse the already-configured client.
             */
            if (!orthancAlreadyConfigured)
            {
                _orthancClient.Configure(config);
            }

            /*
             * Fresh targeted inspection immediately before mutation.
             * This does NOT depend on Preview batch ordering.
             */
            var inspection =
                await InspectCompletedWorklistAsync(
                    worklist,
                    cancellationToken);

            CopyInspectionToManualBefore(
                result,
                inspection);

            if (string.Equals(
                    inspection.ReconciliationStatus,
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.Match,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                result.Success = true;
                result.Status =
                    PacsReconciliationStatuses.AlreadyMatched;
                result.Message =
                    "LIS và Orthanc hiện đã khớp. Không cần Reconcile.";
                result.CompletedOnAfter =
                    result.CompletedOnBefore;
