                        orthancAccessionNumber,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "ACCESSION_MISMATCH";
                    result.Message =
                        $"AccessionNumber Worklist={accessionNumber}, " +
                        $"Orthanc={orthancAccessionNumber ?? "<empty>"}.";

                    return result;
                }

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        studyInstanceUid))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "STUDY_UID_MISSING";
                    result.Message =
                        "Orthanc Study không có StudyInstanceUID hợp lệ.";

                    return result;
                }

                if (result.IsStable != true)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "NOT_STABLE";
                    result.Message =
                        result.IsStable == false
                            ? "Study hiện chưa Stable. Không Recovery."
                            : "Orthanc không trả trạng thái IsStable hợp lệ. Không Recovery.";

                    return result;
                }

                result.OrthancInstanceCount =
                    await ReadOrthancInstanceCountAsync(
                        orthancStudyId,
                        seriesIds.Count,
                        cancellationToken);

                /*
                 * Defensive identity guard immediately before mutation.
                 */
                var existingByIdentity =
                    await _context.PacsStudies
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.OrthancStudyId ==
                                orthancStudyId ||
                            x.StudyInstanceUID ==
                                studyInstanceUid)
                        .OrderBy(x => x.Id)
                        .Take(2)
                        .Select(x => new
                        {
                            x.Id,
                            x.ResultCDHAId,
                            x.AccessionNumber
                        })
                        .ToListAsync(
                            cancellationToken);

                if (existingByIdentity.Count > 0)
                {
                    result.PacsStudyId =
                        existingByIdentity[0].Id;

                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        existingByIdentity.Count > 1
                            ? "LIS_STUDY_AMBIGUOUS"
                            : "PACS_STUDY_EXISTS";
                    result.Message =
                        existingByIdentity.Count > 1
                            ? "OrthancStudyId/StudyInstanceUID đang trỏ tới nhiều PacsStudy. " +
                              "Không được tự Recovery."
                            : "Study đã tồn tại trong PacsStudies theo Orthanc identity. " +
                              "Không chạy Missing Study Recovery.";

                    return result;
                }

                /*
                 * This is the ONLY mutation call in Manual Recovery.
                 * It is non-blocking: FAST PATH/manual study sync wins the gate,
                 * Recovery simply returns SYNC_BUSY and can be retried later.
                 */
                var syncResult =
                    await _pacsStudyBL
                        .TrySyncSingleStudyAsync(
                            orthancStudyId,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (!syncResult.Success)
                {
                    result.Success = false;

                    if (string.Equals(
                            syncResult.ErrorCode,
                            "STUDY_SYNC_BUSY",
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        result.Status =
                            "SYNC_BUSY";
                        result.Message =
                            syncResult.Message;

                        return result;
                    }

                    result.Status =
                        "STUDY_SYNC_FAILED";
                    result.ErrorMessage =
                        $"{syncResult.ErrorCode}: {syncResult.Message}";
                    result.Message =
                        "Canonical Study sync thất bại. Recovery không được đánh dấu thành công.";

                    return result;
                }

                result.PacsStudyId =
                    syncResult.PacsStudyId;
                result.SeriesCount =
                    syncResult.SeriesCount;
                result.InstanceCount =
                    syncResult.InstanceCount;
                result.MappedResultCDHA =
                    syncResult.MappedResultCDHA;

                if (!syncResult.PacsStudyId.HasValue)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_PACS_STUDY_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        "Sync báo thành công nhưng không trả PacsStudyId.";

                    return result;
                }

                /*
                 * Post-sync verification. All reads are AsNoTracking so the
                 * verification reflects committed DB state, not tracked values.
                 */
                var updatedWorklist =
                    await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                            x =>
                                x.Id ==
                                pacsWorklistItemId,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (updatedWorklist == null)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_WORKLIST_NOT_FOUND";
                    result.Message =
                        "Sync đã chạy nhưng không đọc lại được Worklist.";

                    return result;
                }

                result.WorklistStatusAfter =
                    updatedWorklist.Status;
                result.WorklistCompleted =
                    updatedWorklist.Status == 3 &&
                    updatedWorklist.CompletedOn.HasValue;
                result.CompletedOn =
                    updatedWorklist.CompletedOn;

                if (!result.WorklistCompleted)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_WORKLIST_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        "Study đã sync nhưng Worklist chưa ở Status=3 với CompletedOn hợp lệ.";

                    return result;
                }

                if (!string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            updatedWorklist.AccessionNumber),
                        accessionNumber,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            updatedWorklist.OrthancStudyId),
                        orthancStudyId,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            updatedWorklist.StudyInstanceUID),
                        studyInstanceUid,
                        StringComparison.Ordinal))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_WORKLIST_IDENTITY_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        "Worklist đã Completed nhưng PACS identity sau Recovery không khớp.";

                    return result;
                }

                var pacsStudy =
                    await _context.PacsStudies
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                            x =>
                                x.Id ==
                                syncResult.PacsStudyId.Value,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (pacsStudy == null ||
                    pacsStudy.ResultCDHAId !=
                        worklist.ResultCDHAId ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            pacsStudy.AccessionNumber),
                        accessionNumber,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        pacsStudy.OrthancStudyId,
                        orthancStudyId,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        pacsStudy.StudyInstanceUID,
                        studyInstanceUid,
                        StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        pacsStudy.Status,
                        "MAPPED",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_PACS_STUDY_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        "PacsStudy sau Recovery không khớp ResultCDHA/Orthanc identity hoặc chưa MAPPED.";

                    return result;
                }

                var resultCdha =
                    await _context.ResultCDHAs
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                            x =>
                                x.Id ==
                                worklist.ResultCDHAId,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (resultCdha == null ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            resultCdha.AccessionNumber),
                        accessionNumber,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            resultCdha.OrthancStudyId),
                        orthancStudyId,
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        NormalizeIdentity(
                            resultCdha.StudyInstanceUID),
                        studyInstanceUid,
                        StringComparison.Ordinal) ||
                    !string.Equals(
                        resultCdha.PacsStatus,
                        "SYNCED",
                        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_RESULT_CDHA_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        "ResultCDHA sau Recovery không có PACS identity/SYNCED status hợp lệ.";

                    return result;
                }

                var actualSeriesCount =
                    await _context.PacsSeries
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .CountAsync(
                            x =>
                                x.PacsStudyId ==
                                pacsStudy.Id,
                            cancellationToken);

                var actualInstanceCount =
                    await _context.PacsInstances
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .CountAsync(
                            x =>
                                x.PacsStudyId ==
                                pacsStudy.Id,
                            cancellationToken);

                if (actualSeriesCount !=
                        syncResult.SeriesCount ||
                    actualInstanceCount !=
                        syncResult.InstanceCount ||
                    pacsStudy.SeriesCount !=
                        actualSeriesCount ||
                    pacsStudy.InstanceCount !=
                        actualInstanceCount)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "VERIFY_HIERARCHY_FAILED";
                    result.Message =
                        $"Hierarchy count sau Recovery không khớp. " +
                        $"Sync={syncResult.SeriesCount}/{syncResult.InstanceCount}, " +
                        $"DB={actualSeriesCount}/{actualInstanceCount}, " +
                        $"PacsStudy={pacsStudy.SeriesCount}/{pacsStudy.InstanceCount}.";

                    return result;
                }

                result.SeriesCount =
                    actualSeriesCount;
                result.InstanceCount =
                    actualInstanceCount;
                result.MappedResultCDHA =
                    true;

                result.Success = true;
                result.Status =
                    "RECOVERED";
                result.Message =
                    $"Recovery thành công. " +
                    $"Accession={accessionNumber}, " +
                    $"PacsStudyId={pacsStudy.Id}, " +
                    $"Series={actualSeriesCount}, " +
                    $"Instances={actualInstanceCount}.";

                return result;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
                when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    "RECOVERY_ERROR";
                result.ErrorMessage =
                    ex.GetBaseException().Message;
                result.Message =
                    "Manual Recovery thất bại.";

                return result;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01B-04
        ///
        /// Batch Missing Study Recovery with anti-starvation scheduling.
        ///
        /// IMPORTANT:
        /// - Project A candidates are Worklist Status=1 only;
        /// - StartDate is mandatory and fail-closed;
        /// - no PacsSyncRecovery:Enabled check here. Enabled is reserved for
        ///   automatic Background integration in PREPROD-01D;
        /// - candidate order: never checked -> oldest checked -> oldest created -> Id;
        /// - every item is fully revalidated by RecoverWorklistAsync();
        /// - one item failure never aborts the remaining batch;
        /// - SYNC_BUSY is NOT marked checked so it can retry soon;
        /// - this method never reads/writes PacsSyncState checkpoint as owner.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<PacsRecoveryBatchResult>
            RecoverPendingAsync(
                int? requestedBatchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                new PacsRecoveryBatchResult();

            var batchLockAcquired = false;

            try
            {
                batchLockAcquired =
                    await _recoveryBatchLock.WaitAsync(
                        0,
                        cancellationToken);

                if (!batchLockAcquired)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "RECOVERY_BATCH_BUSY";
                    result.Message =
                        "Đang có một Recovery Batch khác chạy.";

                    return result;
                }

                var options =
                    _recoveryOptions.CurrentValue
                    ?? new PacsSyncRecoveryOptions();

                if (!TryParseRecoveryStartDate(
                        options.StartDate,
                        out var recoveryFrom))
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "RECOVERY_CONFIG_INVALID";
                    result.Message =
                        "PacsSyncRecovery:StartDate bắt buộc có định dạng yyyy-MM-dd. " +
                        "Recovery fail-closed để không quét nhầm dữ liệu lịch sử.";

                    return result;
                }

                var minAgeMinutes =
                    NormalizeMinAgeMinutes(
                        options.MinAgeMinutes);

                var batchSize =
                    NormalizeBatchSize(
                        requestedBatchSize,
                        options.BatchSize);

                var recoveryTo =
                    DateTime.Now.AddMinutes(
                        -minAgeMinutes);

                result.RecoveryFrom =
                    recoveryFrom;
                result.RecoveryTo =
                    recoveryTo;
                result.MinAgeMinutes =
                    minAgeMinutes;
                result.BatchSize =
                    batchSize;

                // Configure Orthanc once for the whole batch. Individual item
                // recovery receives orthancAlreadyConfigured=true.
                var config =
                    await _pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

                if (config == null ||
                    !config.IsActive ||
                    !config.IsDefault)
                {
                    result.Success = false;
                    result.Status =
                        "PACS_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND";
                    result.Message =
                        "Chưa có PACS Server mặc định đang hoạt động.";

                    return result;
                }

                _orthancClient.Configure(config);

                // Load IDs only. Each item is reloaded and revalidated by the
                // manual Recovery path immediately before any mutation.
                var candidateIds =
                    await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.Status == 1 &&
                            x.CreatedOn >= recoveryFrom &&
                            x.CreatedOn <= recoveryTo &&
                            x.AccessionNumber != null &&
                            x.AccessionNumber != "")
                        .OrderBy(x =>
                            x.LastRecoveryCheckedOn.HasValue
                                ? 1
                                : 0)
                        .ThenBy(x =>
                            x.LastRecoveryCheckedOn)
                        .ThenBy(x =>
                            x.CreatedOn)
                        .ThenBy(x =>
                            x.Id)
                        .Take(batchSize)
                        .Select(x => x.Id)
                        .ToListAsync(
                            cancellationToken);

                result.CandidateCount =
                    candidateIds.Count;

                foreach (var worklistId in
                         candidateIds)
                {
                    cancellationToken
                        .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

                    PacsRecoveryManualResult item;

                    try
                    {
                        item =
                            await RecoverWorklistAsync(
                                worklistId,
                                cancellationToken,
                                orthancAlreadyConfigured: true);
                    }
                    catch (OperationCanceledException)
                        when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                    {
                        throw;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        item =
                            new PacsRecoveryManualResult
                            {
                                PacsWorklistItemId =
                                    worklistId,
                                Success = false,
                                Status =
                                    "RECOVERY_ERROR",
                                Message =
                                    "Recovery Worklist phát sinh lỗi.",
                                ErrorMessage =
                                    ex.GetBaseException().Message
                            };
                    }

                    // SYNC_BUSY means FAST PATH or another study sync currently
                    // owns the mutation gate. Do not push this item to the back
                    // of the anti-starvation queue before it was truly checked.
                    if (!string.Equals(
                            item.Status,
                            "SYNC_BUSY",
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        try
                        {
                            await MarkRecoveryCheckedAsync(
                                worklistId,
                                cancellationToken);
                        }
                        catch (OperationCanceledException)
                            when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                        {
                            throw;
                        }
                        catch (Exception ex)
                        {
                            item.Success = false;
                            item.Status =
                                "RECOVERY_SCHEDULER_UPDATE_ERROR";
                            item.ErrorMessage =
                                ex.GetBaseException().Message;
                            item.Message =
                                "Recovery đã kiểm tra Worklist nhưng không cập nhật được LastRecoveryCheckedOn.";
                        }
                    }

                    result.Items.Add(item);

                    if (item.Success &&
                        string.Equals(
                            item.Status,
                            "RECOVERED",
                            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        result.RecoveredCount++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    switch (item.Status)
                    {
                        case "ORTHANC_NOT_FOUND":
                            result.NotFoundCount++;
                            break;

                        case "NOT_STABLE":
                            result.NotStableCount++;
                            break;

                        case "ALREADY_COMPLETED":
                        case "PACS_STUDY_EXISTS":
                            result.AlreadyHandledCount++;
                            break;

                        case "AMBIGUOUS":
                            result.AmbiguousCount++;
                            break;

                        case "IDENTITY_MISMATCH":
                        case "LIS_STUDY_AMBIGUOUS":
                        case "ACCESSION_MISMATCH":
                        case "STUDY_UID_MISSING":
                            result.IdentityMismatchCount++;
                            break;

                        case "SYNC_BUSY":
                            result.SyncBusyCount++;
                            break;

                        case "OUTSIDE_RECOVERY_WINDOW":
                        case "WORKLIST_TOO_NEW":
                        case "INVALID_WORKLIST_STATUS":
                        case "MISSING_ACCESSION":
                        case "WORKLIST_NOT_FOUND":
                            result.SkippedCount++;
                            break;

                        default:
                            result.ErrorCount++;
                            break;
                    }
                }

                result.Success =
                    result.ErrorCount == 0;

                result.Status =
                    result.Success
                        ? candidateIds.Count == 0
                            ? "NO_CANDIDATES"
                            : "COMPLETED"
                        : "COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS";

                result.Message =
                    $"Recovery Batch hoàn tất. " +
                    $"Candidates={result.CandidateCount}, " +
                    $"Recovered={result.RecoveredCount}, " +
                    $"NotFound={result.NotFoundCount}, " +
                    $"NotStable={result.NotStableCount}, " +
                    $"AlreadyHandled={result.AlreadyHandledCount}, " +
                    $"Ambiguous={result.AmbiguousCount}, " +
                    $"IdentityMismatch={result.IdentityMismatchCount}, " +
                    $"SyncBusy={result.SyncBusyCount}, " +
                    $"Skipped={result.SkippedCount}, " +
                    $"Errors={result.ErrorCount}.";

                return result;
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
                when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                throw;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                result.Success = false;
                result.Status =
                    "BATCH_ERROR";
                result.ErrorMessage =
                    ex.GetBaseException().Message;
                result.Message =
                    "Recovery Batch thất bại.";

                return result;
            }
            finally
            {
                if (batchLockAcquired)
                {
                    _recoveryBatchLock.Release();
                }
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Store anti-starvation scheduler state.
        ///
        /// If an item was recovered successfully it is already Status=3 and no
        /// longer participates in future Recovery scans, so no timestamp write
        /// is needed. Pending Status=1 items receive LastRecoveryCheckedOn.
        /// </summary>
        private async Task MarkRecoveryCheckedAsync(
            long pacsWorklistItemId,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var worklist =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                        x =>
                            x.Id ==
                            pacsWorklistItemId,
                        cancellationToken);

            if (worklist == null ||
                worklist.Status != 1)
            {
                return;
            }

            worklist.LastRecoveryCheckedOn =
                DateTime.Now;

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(
                cancellationToken);
        }

        private static void ApplyExistingStudy(
            PacsRecoveryPreviewItem item,
            long pacsStudyId,
            int seriesCount,
            int instanceCount,
            string? status)
        {
            item.PacsStudyExists = true;
            item.PacsStudyId =
                pacsStudyId;
            item.PacsStudySeriesCount =
                seriesCount;
            item.PacsStudyInstanceCount =
                instanceCount;
            item.PacsStudyStatus =
                status;
        }

        private async Task<int>
            ReadOrthancInstanceCountAsync(
                string orthancStudyId,
                int expectedSeriesCount,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            var seriesJson =
                await _orthancClient
                    .GetStudySeriesJsonAsync(
                        orthancStudyId,
                        cancellationToken);

            using var document =
                JsonDocument.Parse(
                    seriesJson);

            if (document.RootElement.ValueKind !=
                JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "GET /studies/{id}/series không trả JSON array.");
            }

            var seriesElements =
                document.RootElement
                    .EnumerateArray()
                    .ToList();

            if (seriesElements.Count !=
                expectedSeriesCount)
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    $"Orthanc Study Series count không ổn định khi Preview. " +
                    $"Study={orthancStudyId}, " +
                    $"Expected={expectedSeriesCount}, " +
                    $"Bulk={seriesElements.Count}.");
            }

            var instanceCount = 0;

            foreach (var seriesElement in
                     seriesElements)
            {
                if (seriesElement.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.Object)
                {
                    throw new Exception(
                        "Orthanc Study Series chứa phần tử không phải JSON object.");
                }

                if (!seriesElement.TryGetProperty(
                        "Instances",
                        out var instancesElement) ||
                    instancesElement.ValueKind !=
                        JsonValueKind.Array)
                {
                    throw new Exception(
                        "Orthanc Series không có mảng Instances hợp lệ.");
                }

                instanceCount +=
                    instancesElement
                        .GetArrayLength();
            }

            return instanceCount;
        }

        private static bool TryParseReconciliationStartDate(
            string? rawValue,
            out DateTime reconciliationFrom)
        {
            reconciliationFrom = default;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    rawValue))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                rawValue.Trim(),
                "yyyy-MM-dd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out reconciliationFrom);
        }

        private static int NormalizeReconciliationBatchSize(
            int? requestedBatchSize,
            int configuredBatchSize)
        {
            var value =
                requestedBatchSize.HasValue &&
                requestedBatchSize.Value > 0
                    ? requestedBatchSize.Value
                    : configuredBatchSize > 0
                        ? configuredBatchSize
                        : DefaultReconciliationBatchSize;

            return Math.Clamp(
                value,
                1,
                MaxBatchSize);
        }

        private static int NormalizeReconciliationMinAgeMinutes(
            int configuredValue)
        {
            var value =
                configuredValue > 0
                    ? configuredValue
                    : DefaultReconciliationMinAgeMinutes;

            return Math.Clamp(
                value,
                1,
                MaxMinAgeMinutes);
        }

        private static bool IdentityMatchesRequired(
            string? left,
            string? right)
        {
            var normalizedLeft =
                NormalizeIdentity(left);

            var normalizedRight =
                NormalizeIdentity(right);

            if (normalizedLeft == null ||
                normalizedRight == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return string.Equals(
                normalizedLeft,
                normalizedRight,
                StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        }

        private static bool TryParseRecoveryStartDate(
            string? rawValue,
            out DateTime recoveryFrom)
        {
            recoveryFrom = default;

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    rawValue))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                rawValue.Trim(),
                "yyyy-MM-dd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out recoveryFrom);
        }

        private static int NormalizeBatchSize(
            int? requestedBatchSize,
            int configuredBatchSize)
        {
            var value =
                requestedBatchSize.HasValue &&
                requestedBatchSize.Value > 0
                    ? requestedBatchSize.Value
                    : configuredBatchSize > 0
                        ? configuredBatchSize
                        : DefaultBatchSize;

            return Math.Clamp(
                value,
                1,
                MaxBatchSize);
        }

        private static int NormalizeMinAgeMinutes(
            int configuredValue)
        {
            var value =
                configuredValue > 0
                    ? configuredValue
                    : DefaultMinAgeMinutes;

            return Math.Clamp(
                value,
                1,
                MaxMinAgeMinutes);
        }

        private static JsonElement? GetObject(
            JsonElement root,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (root.ValueKind ==
                    JsonValueKind.Object &&
                root.TryGetProperty(
                    propertyName,
                    out var value) &&
                value.ValueKind ==
                    JsonValueKind.Object)
            {
                return value;
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string? GetString(
            JsonElement? source,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (!source.HasValue ||
                source.Value.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.Object ||
                !source.Value.TryGetProperty(
                    propertyName,
                    out var value))
            {
                return null;
            }

            return value.ValueKind ==
                    JsonValueKind.String
                ? value.GetString()
                : value.ToString();
        }

        private static List<string> GetStringArray(
            JsonElement source,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (source.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.Object ||
                !source.TryGetProperty(
                    propertyName,
                    out var value) ||
                value.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.Array)
            {
                return new List<string>();
            }

            return value
                .EnumerateArray()
                .Where(x =>
                    x.ValueKind ==
                        JsonValueKind.String)
                .Select(x =>
                    x.GetString())
                .Where(x =>
                    !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Select(x =>
                    x!.Trim())
                .Distinct(
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
        }

        private static bool? GetNullableBoolean(
            JsonElement source,
            string propertyName)
        {
            if (source.ValueKind !=
                    JsonValueKind.Object ||
                !source.TryGetProperty(
                    propertyName,
                    out var value))
            {
                return null;
            }

            if (value.ValueKind ==
                JsonValueKind.True)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (value.ValueKind ==
                JsonValueKind.False)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string? NormalizeIdentity(
            string? value)
        {
            return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value)
                ? null
                : value.Trim();
        }
    }
}

<file path="BL/Pacs/PacsSmbConnectionScope.cs">
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Scoped SMB session for IIS -> Ubuntu PACS MWL. Does not change AppPool identity,
    /// create drive mappings, or write outside the already-configured worklist share.
    /// Machine-scoped DPAPI is decoded through the OS crypt32 API, avoiding a runtime
    /// dependency on System.Security.Cryptography.ProtectedData for this operation.
    /// </summary>
    internal sealed class PacsSmbConnectionScope : IAsyncDisposable
    {
        private const int ResourceTypeDisk = 1;
        private const int ErrorCredentialConflict = 1219;
        private const int CryptprotectUiForbidden = 0x1;
        private const int MaxSecretBytes = 16384;
        private static readonly SemaphoreSlim ConnectionGate = new(1, 1);

        private readonly string? _remoteShare;
        private readonly bool _ownsGate;
        private bool _disposed;

        private PacsSmbConnectionScope(string? remoteShare, bool ownsGate)
        {
            _remoteShare = remoteShare;
            _ownsGate = ownsGate;
        }

        public static async Task<PacsSmbConnectionScope> OpenAsync(
            IConfiguration configuration,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var published = (configuration["Pacs:WorklistFolder"] ?? "").Trim();
            var enabled = bool.TryParse(
                configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"], out var isEnabled)
                && isEnabled;
            var remoteFolder = published.StartsWith(@"\\", StringComparison.Ordinal);

            if (!enabled)
            {
                if (remoteFolder)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "PACS_SMB_CONFIG_DISABLED_UNC: WorklistFolder UNC requires WorklistSmbEnabled.");

                return new PacsSmbConnectionScope(null, false);
            }

            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows())
                throw new PlatformNotSupportedException("PACS_SMB_WINDOWS_ONLY");

            var share = (configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] ?? "").Trim().TrimEnd('\\');
            var username = (configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] ?? "").Trim();
            var secretFile = (configuration["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] ?? "").Trim();

            if (!share.StartsWith(@"\\", StringComparison.Ordinal)
                || share.Split('\\', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries).Length != 2
                || !published.Equals(share, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_CONFIG_SHARE_MISMATCH");

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(username) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(secretFile))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_CONFIG_CREDENTIAL_MISSING");

            if (!Path.IsPathFullyQualified(secretFile)
                || secretFile.StartsWith(@"\\", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_SECRET_PATH_NOT_LOCAL");

            var secretFullPath = Path.GetFullPath(secretFile);
            var siteRoot = Path.GetFullPath(AppContext.BaseDirectory)
                .TrimEnd(Path.DirectorySeparatorChar) + Path.DirectorySeparatorChar;
            if (secretFullPath.StartsWith(siteRoot, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_SECRET_INSIDE_WEBROOT");

            if (!File.Exists(secretFullPath))
                throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_SECRET_NOT_FOUND_OR_UNREADABLE");

            await ConnectionGate.WaitAsync(cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            try
            {
                byte[] protectedBytes = Array.Empty<byte>();
                byte[] plainBytes = Array.Empty<byte>();
                try
                {
                    try
                    {
                        protectedBytes = await File.ReadAllBytesAsync(secretFullPath, cancellationToken)
                            .ConfigureAwait(false);
                    }
                    catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw StageError("SECRET_READ", ex);
                    }

                    if (protectedBytes.Length == 0 || protectedBytes.Length > MaxSecretBytes)
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_SECRET_INVALID_LENGTH");

                    // Win32 DPAPI uses the SAME LocalMachine machine keys and blob format
                    // as ProtectedData.Unprotect(..., DataProtectionScope.LocalMachine).
                    // This does not migrate or re-encrypt the existing secret.
                    plainBytes = UnprotectViaWin32(protectedBytes);
                    string password;
                    try
                    {
                        password = new UTF8Encoding(false, true).GetString(plainBytes);
                    }
                    catch (DecoderFallbackException ex)
                    {
                        throw StageError("SECRET_UTF8", ex);
                    }
                    if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(password))
                        throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_SECRET_EMPTY");

                    var remote = new NetResource
                    {
                        Type = ResourceTypeDisk,
                        RemoteName = share,
                        LocalName = null
                    };
                    int rc;
                    try
                    {
                        rc = WNetAddConnection2(ref remote, password, username, 0);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw StageError("CONNECT_API", ex);
                    }
                    finally
                    {
                        // WNet* requires a string. Avoid retaining it beyond the call.
                        password = string.Empty;
                    }

                    if (rc == ErrorCredentialConflict)
                        throw new IOException("PACS_SMB_CONNECT_WIN32_1219: credentials conflict; do not disconnect other sessions.");
                    if (rc != 0)
                        throw new IOException($"PACS_SMB_CONNECT_WIN32_{rc}");

                    return new PacsSmbConnectionScope(share, true);
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (protectedBytes.Length != 0)
                        CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(protectedBytes);
                    if (plainBytes.Length != 0)
                        CryptographicOperations.ZeroMemory(plainBytes);
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                ConnectionGate.Release();
                throw;
            }
        }

        private static byte[] UnprotectViaWin32(byte[] encrypted)
        {
            GCHandle inputHandle = default;
            DataBlob output = default;
            try
            {
                inputHandle = GCHandle.Alloc(encrypted, GCHandleType.Pinned);
                var input = new DataBlob
                {
                    Length = encrypted.Length,
                    Data = inputHandle.AddrOfPinnedObject()
                };

                if (!CryptUnprotectData(
                    ref input, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero,
                    CryptprotectUiForbidden, out output))
                {
                    int lastError = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
                    throw new IOException($"PACS_SMB_DPAPI_WIN32_{lastError}");
                }

                if (output.Data == IntPtr.Zero || output.Length <= 0 || output.Length > MaxSecretBytes)
                    throw new InvalidOperationException("PACS_SMB_DPAPI_INVALID_OUTPUT_LENGTH");

                var result = new byte[output.Length];
                Marshal.Copy(output.Data, result, 0, output.Length);
                return result;
            }
            catch (IOException) { throw; }
            catch (InvalidOperationException) { throw; }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw StageError("DPAPI_NATIVE", ex);
            }
            finally
            {
                if (output.Data != IntPtr.Zero)
                {
                    // CryptUnprotectData allocates with LocalAlloc. Clear memory BEFORE LocalFree.
                    if (output.Length > 0 && output.Length <= MaxSecretBytes)
                        Marshal.Copy(new byte[output.Length], 0, output.Data, output.Length);
                    LocalFree(output.Data);
                }
                if (inputHandle.IsAllocated)
                    inputHandle.Free();
            }
        }

        private static IOException StageError(string stage, Exception exception)
        {
            // Deliberately excludes file paths, passwords, UNC credentials, and inner exceptions.
            return new IOException(
                $"PACS_SMB_{stage}_FAILED type={exception.GetType().Name} " +
                $"hresult=0x{unchecked((uint)exception.HResult):X8}");
        }

        public ValueTask DisposeAsync()
        {
            if (_disposed) return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
            _disposed = true;
            if (!_ownsGate) return ValueTask.CompletedTask;

            try
            {
                int rc = WNetCancelConnection2(_remoteShare!, 0, false);
                if (rc != 0)
                    throw new IOException($"PACS_SMB_DISCONNECT_WIN32_{rc}");
            }
            finally
            {
                ConnectionGate.Release();
            }
            return ValueTask.CompletedTask;
        }

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential)]
        private struct DataBlob
        {
            public int Length;
            public IntPtr Data;
        }

        [DllImport("crypt32.dll", EntryPoint = "CryptUnprotectData", SetLastError = true)]
        [return: MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)]
        private static extern bool CryptUnprotectData(
            ref DataBlob encrypted, IntPtr description, IntPtr entropy,
            IntPtr reserved, IntPtr prompt, int flags, out DataBlob decrypted);

        [DllImport("kernel32.dll", EntryPoint = "LocalFree", SetLastError = false)]
        private static extern IntPtr LocalFree(IntPtr memory);

        [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        private struct NetResource
        {
            public int Scope;
            public int Type;
            public int DisplayType;
            public int Usage;
            [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string? LocalName;
            [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string? RemoteName;
            [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string? Comment;
            [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] public string? Provider;
        }

        [DllImport("mpr.dll", EntryPoint = "WNetAddConnection2W", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        private static extern int WNetAddConnection2(
            ref NetResource netResource, string password, string username, int flags);

        [DllImport("mpr.dll", EntryPoint = "WNetCancelConnection2W", CharSet = CharSet.Unicode)]
        private static extern int WNetCancelConnection2(
            string name, int flags, [MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.Bool)] bool force);
    }
}
