<file path="BL/Pacs/PacsWorklistBL.cs">
using Management.Models;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using System.Data;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Text;

namespace Management.BL.Pacs
{
    public class PacsWorklistBL
    {
        private const int AccessionSuffixLength = 8;
        private const int AccessionSuffixMax = 99999999;

        private readonly LABContext _context;
        private readonly IConfiguration _configuration;

        public PacsWorklistBL(
            LABContext context,
            IConfiguration configuration)
        {
            _context = context;
            _configuration = configuration;
        }

        public async Task<PacsAccessionEnsureResult>
            EnsureAccessionNumberAsync(
                long resultCDHAId,
                string categoryCode)
        {
            var response = new PacsAccessionEnsureResult
            {
                Success = false,
                ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                CategoryCode = NormalizeCategoryCode(categoryCode)
            };

            if (resultCDHAId <= 0)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_RESULT_ID";
                response.Message = "ResultCDHAId không hợp lệ.";
                return response;
            }

            string prefix;

            try
            {
                prefix = ResolveAccessionPrefix(response.CategoryCode);
                response.Prefix = prefix;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "UNSUPPORTED_CATEGORY";
                response.Message = ex.Message;
                return response;
            }

            try
            {
                var resultCDHA = await _context.ResultCDHAs
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == resultCDHAId);

                if (resultCDHA == null)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode = "RESULT_NOT_FOUND";
                    response.Message =
                        $"Không tìm thấy ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId}.";
                    return response;
                }

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resultCDHA.AccessionNumber))
                {
                    var existing = resultCDHA.AccessionNumber.Trim();

                    var conflict =
                        await FindAccessionConflictAsync(
                            resultCDHAId,
                            existing);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(conflict))
                    {
                        response.ErrorCode = "ACCESSION_CONFLICT";
                        response.AccessionNumber = existing;
                        response.Message = conflict;
                        return response;
                    }

                    if (resultCDHA.AccessionNumber != existing)
                    {
                        resultCDHA.AccessionNumber = existing;
                        await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    }

                    response.Success = true;
                    response.Existing = true;
                    response.Generated = false;
                    response.AccessionNumber = existing;
                    response.CanonicalFormat =
                        IsCanonicalAccession(existing, prefix);
                    response.Message =
                        response.CanonicalFormat
                            ? "ResultCDHA đã có AccessionNumber canonical, giữ nguyên."
                            : "ResultCDHA đã có AccessionNumber legacy/non-canonical, giữ nguyên để không phá liên kết DICOM hiện hữu.";

                    return response;
                }

                await using var transaction =
                    await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync(
                        IsolationLevel.Serializable);

                try
                {
                    await AcquireAccessionLockAsync(prefix);

                    // HOTFIX-01:
                    // The entity was already tracked by the initial query.
                    // A normal LINQ query after waiting for sp_getapplock can
                    // return that stale tracked instance. Force a database
                    // reload after the lock so this request sees an accession
                    // generated by the request that acquired the lock first.
                    await _context.Entry(resultCDHA).ReloadAsync();

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        resultCDHA.AccessionNumber))
                    {
                        var existingAfterLock =
                            resultCDHA.AccessionNumber.Trim();

                        var conflictAfterLock =
                            await FindAccessionConflictAsync(
                                resultCDHAId,
                                existingAfterLock);

                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(conflictAfterLock))
                        {
                            await transaction.RollbackAsync();

                            response.ErrorCode = "ACCESSION_CONFLICT";
                            response.AccessionNumber = existingAfterLock;
                            response.Message = conflictAfterLock;
                            return response;
                        }

                        await transaction.CommitAsync();

                        response.Success = true;
                        response.Existing = true;
                        response.Generated = false;
                        response.AccessionNumber = existingAfterLock;
                        response.CanonicalFormat =
                            IsCanonicalAccession(
                                existingAfterLock,
                                prefix);
                        response.Message =
                            "AccessionNumber đã được request khác tạo trước, dùng lại giá trị hiện có.";

                        return response;
                    }

                    var nextAccession =
                        await GenerateNextAccessionNumberAsync(prefix);

                    var generatedConflict =
                        await FindAccessionConflictAsync(
                            resultCDHAId,
                            nextAccession);

                    if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(generatedConflict))
                    {
                        await transaction.RollbackAsync();

                        response.ErrorCode = "ACCESSION_CONFLICT";
                        response.AccessionNumber = nextAccession;
                        response.Message = generatedConflict;
                        return response;
                    }

                    resultCDHA.AccessionNumber = nextAccession;

                    await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
                    await transaction.CommitAsync();

                    response.Success = true;
                    response.Existing = false;
                    response.Generated = true;
                    response.CanonicalFormat = true;
                    response.AccessionNumber = nextAccession;
                    response.Message =
                        $"Đã tạo AccessionNumber canonical: {nextAccession}";

                    return response;
                }
                catch
                {
                    await transaction.RollbackAsync();
                    throw;
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "ACCESSION_GENERATION_ERROR";
                response.Message = "Không thể đảm bảo AccessionNumber.";
                response.ErrorMessage = ex.ToString();
                return response;
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // PACS-XQ-03-05
        // DICOM MWL generation + DCMTK validation
        // ============================================================

        public async Task<PacsMwlValidationResult>
            GenerateMwlValidationFixtureAsync(
                long resultCDHAId,
                string categoryCode,
                DateTime? scheduledAt = null)
        {
            var response = new PacsMwlValidationResult
            {
                Success = false,
                ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                CategoryCode = NormalizeCategoryCode(categoryCode)
            };

            if (resultCDHAId <= 0)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_RESULT_ID";
                response.Message = "ResultCDHAId không hợp lệ.";
                return response;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(response.CategoryCode))
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_CATEGORY";
                response.Message = "CategoryCode không được rỗng.";
                return response;
            }

            try
            {
                // 1. Accession must already follow the 03-04 contract.
                // This method is allowed to ensure it if still missing.
                var accessionResult =
                    await EnsureAccessionNumberAsync(
                        resultCDHAId,
                        response.CategoryCode);

                if (!accessionResult.Success)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        accessionResult.ErrorCode;

                    response.Message =
                        accessionResult.Message;

                    response.ErrorMessage =
                        accessionResult.ErrorMessage;

                    return response;
                }

                response.AccessionNumber =
                    accessionResult.AccessionNumber;

                // 2. Read the clinical source data.
                var resultCDHA =
                    await _context.ResultCDHAs
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Include(x => x.Patient)
                        .Include(x => x.Service)
                            .ThenInclude(x => x.Category)
                        .Include(x => x.Doctor)
                        .FirstOrDefaultAsync(
                            x => x.Id == resultCDHAId);

                if (resultCDHA == null)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "RESULT_NOT_FOUND";

                    response.Message =
                        $"Không tìm thấy ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId}.";

                    return response;
                }

                if (resultCDHA.Patient == null)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "PATIENT_NOT_FOUND";

                    response.Message =
                        $"ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId} không có Patient.";

                    return response;
                }

                if (resultCDHA.Service == null)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "SERVICE_NOT_FOUND";

                    response.Message =
                        $"ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId} không có Service.";

                    return response;
                }

                var actualCategoryCode =
                    NormalizeCategoryCode(
                        resultCDHA.Service.Category?.Code);

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        actualCategoryCode) &&
                    actualCategoryCode !=
                        response.CategoryCode)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "CATEGORY_MISMATCH";

                    response.Message =
                        $"CategoryCode request={response.CategoryCode} " +
                        $"không khớp Service.Category.Code={actualCategoryCode}.";

                    return response;
                }

                // 3. Build a pure draft.
                // No PacsWorklistItems row is created in 03-05.
                var modality =
                    ResolveDicomModality(
                        response.CategoryCode);

                var stationAe =
                    ResolveScheduledStationAETitle(
                        response.CategoryCode,
                        modality);

                var stationName =
                    ResolveScheduledStationName(
                        response.CategoryCode,
                        modality);

                var location =
                    ResolveScheduledProcedureStepLocation(
                        response.CategoryCode,
                        modality);

                var procedureStatus =
                    ResolveScheduledProcedureStepStatus();

                var scheduledDateTime =
                    scheduledAt
                    ?? ResolveScheduledDateTime(
                        resultCDHA,
                        response.CategoryCode)
                    ?? DateTime.Now;

                var patient =
                    resultCDHA.Patient;

                var service =
                    resultCDHA.Service;

                var draft =
                    new PacsMwlDraft
                    {
                        ResultCDHAId =
                            resultCDHA.Id,

                        AccessionNumber =
                            accessionResult.AccessionNumber,

                        StudyInstanceUID =
                            GenerateStableStudyInstanceUid(
                                accessionResult.AccessionNumber),

                        PatientCode =
                            patient.PatientId?.Trim()
                            ?? "",

                        PatientName =
                            patient.PatientName?.Trim()
                            ?? "",

                        // Project A currently has Patient.Age (DateTime?)
                        // but no explicit BirthDate property. A previous
                        // PACS baseline already documented that Age must
                        // not be interpreted as DOB. Therefore 03-05
                        // deliberately leaves PatientBirthDate empty.
                        PatientBirthDate = null,

                        PatientSex =
                            NormalizeSex(
                                patient.Sex),

                        ReferringPhysicianName =
                            resultCDHA.Doctor?.Name
                            ?? "",

                        InstitutionName =
                            _configuration[
                                "Pacs:InstitutionName"]
                            ?? "",

                        ServiceCode =
                            service.Code
                            ?? "",

                        ServiceName =
                            service.Name
                            ?? "",

                        CategoryCode =
                            response.CategoryCode,

                        Modality =
                            modality,

                        RequestedProcedureId =
                            accessionResult.AccessionNumber,

                        RequestedProcedureDescription =
                            service.Name
                            ?? "",

                        ScheduledStationAETitle =
                            stationAe,

                        ScheduledStationName =
                            stationName,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepLocation =
                            location,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepStatus =
                            procedureStatus,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepId =
                            accessionResult.AccessionNumber,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepStartDate =
                            scheduledDateTime.Date,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepStartTime =
                            scheduledDateTime.TimeOfDay,

                        ScheduledProcedureStepDescription =
                            service.Name
                            ?? "",

                        ScheduledPerformingPhysicianName =
                            "",

                        StudyDescription =
                            service.Name
                            ?? ""
                    };

                response.Modality =
                    draft.Modality;

                response.ScheduledStationAETitle =
                    draft.ScheduledStationAETitle;

                response.StudyInstanceUID =
                    draft.StudyInstanceUID;

                // 4. Work strictly in staging.
                var stagingFolder =
                    GetWorklistStagingFolder();

                Directory.CreateDirectory(
                    stagingFolder);

                var safeAccession =
                    MakeSafeFileName(
                        draft.AccessionNumber);

                var dumpFileName =
                    $"VALIDATE_{safeAccession}.dump";

                var wlFileName =
                    $"VALIDATE_{safeAccession}.wl";

                var dumpFilePath =
                    Path.Combine(
                        stagingFolder,
                        dumpFileName);

                var wlFilePath =
                    Path.Combine(
                        stagingFolder,
                        wlFileName);

                response.DumpFilePath =
                    dumpFilePath;

                response.WorklistFilePath =
                    wlFilePath;

                // idempotent validation run
                TryDeleteFile(dumpFilePath);
                TryDeleteFile(wlFilePath);

                var dumpContent =
                    BuildWorklistDump(draft);

                await File.WriteAllTextAsync(
                    dumpFilePath,
                    dumpContent,
                    new UTF8Encoding(false));

                // 5. dump2dcm
                var convert =
                    await RunProcessAsync(
                        GetDump2DcmPath(),
                        new[]
                        {
                            dumpFilePath,
                            wlFilePath
                        },
                        stagingFolder,
                        timeoutMilliseconds: 15000);

                response.Dump2DcmExitCode =
                    convert.ExitCode;

                response.Dump2DcmOutput =
                    CombineProcessOutput(
                        convert.StdOut,
                        convert.StdErr);

                if (!convert.Success ||
                    !File.Exists(wlFilePath))
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "DUMP2DCM_FAILED";

                    response.Message =
                        "dump2dcm không tạo được Worklist DICOM hợp lệ.";

                    return response;
                }

                // 6. dcmdump
                var dumpCheck =
                    await RunProcessAsync(
                        GetDcmDumpPath(),
                        new[]
                        {
                            "+L",
                            wlFilePath
                        },
                        stagingFolder,
                        timeoutMilliseconds: 15000);

                response.DcmDumpExitCode =
                    dumpCheck.ExitCode;

                response.DcmDumpOutput =
                    CombineProcessOutput(
                        dumpCheck.StdOut,
                        dumpCheck.StdErr);

                if (!dumpCheck.Success)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "DCMDUMP_FAILED";

                    response.Message =
                        "dcmdump không đọc được file Worklist.";

                    return response;
                }

                // 7. Validate the exact values that matter for
                // MWL identity and modality filtering.
                var validations =
                    BuildMwlValidationChecks(
                        response.DcmDumpOutput,
                        draft);

                response.Validations =
                    validations;

                response.ValidationPassed =
                    validations.All(x => x.Passed);

                if (!response.ValidationPassed)
                {
                    response.ErrorCode =
                        "MWL_TAG_VALIDATION_FAILED";

                    response.Message =
                        "File .wl đã được tạo nhưng thiếu hoặc sai tag bắt buộc.";

                    return response;
                }

                // Deliberately no copy to WorklistFolder here.
                // 03-06 owns DB row + publish semantics.
                response.Success = true;
                response.Message =
                    "Tạo và validate DICOM MWL trong staging thành công. Chưa publish sang Orthanc.";

                return response;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                response.ErrorCode =
                    "MWL_VALIDATION_ERROR";

                response.Message =
                    "Không thể tạo MWL validation fixture.";

                response.ErrorMessage =
                    ex.ToString();

                return response;
            }
        }


        // ============================================================
        // PACS-XQ-03-06
        // Result-level Worklist API + controlled publish
        // ============================================================

        public async Task<PacsWorklistCreateResult>
    CreateWorklistForResultCDHAAsync(
        long resultCDHAId,
        string categoryCode,
        DateTime? scheduledAt = null,
        long? userId = null)
        {
            if (resultCDHAId <= 0)
            {
                return new PacsWorklistCreateResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                    ErrorCode = "INVALID_RESULT_ID",
                    Message = "ResultCDHAId không hợp lệ."
                };
            }

            // ============================================================
            // HOTFIX:
            // AccessionNumber là identity của ResultCDHA.
            // Phải được đảm bảo trước khi phụ thuộc filesystem MWL.
            //
            // Nhờ vậy:
            // - Ubuntu/PACS chưa sẵn sàng vẫn tạo AccessionNumber.
            // - Worklist publish có thể fail theo best-effort.
            // - Không làm mất identity đã tạo.
            // ============================================================
            var accessionResult =
                await EnsureAccessionNumberAsync(
                    resultCDHAId,
                    categoryCode);

            if (!accessionResult.Success)
            {
                return new PacsWorklistCreateResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                    AccessionNumber =
                        accessionResult.AccessionNumber ?? string.Empty,
                    ErrorCode =
                        accessionResult.ErrorCode,
                    Message =
                        accessionResult.Message,
                    ErrorMessage =
                        accessionResult.ErrorMessage
                };
            }

            FileStream? createLock = null;

            try
            {
                createLock =
                    await AcquireWorklistCreateLockAsync(
                        resultCDHAId,
                        timeoutSeconds: 60);

                // PACS-PROD-05B-03A: scope SMB access to this publish.
                // Staging and quarantine remain on the local Windows volume.
                await using var remoteShare =
                    await PacsSmbConnectionScope.OpenAsync(_configuration);

                return await CreateWorklistForResultCDHACoreAsync(
                    resultCDHAId,
                    categoryCode,
                    scheduledAt,
                    userId);
            }
            catch (TimeoutException ex)
            {
                return new PacsWorklistCreateResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                    AccessionNumber =
                        accessionResult.AccessionNumber ?? string.Empty,
                    ErrorCode = "CREATE_LOCK_TIMEOUT",
                    Message =
                        "Worklist đang được request khác xử lý. " +
                        "Không lấy được lock trong thời gian cho phép.",
                    ErrorMessage = ex.Message
                };
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return new PacsWorklistCreateResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                    AccessionNumber =
                        accessionResult.AccessionNumber ?? string.Empty,
                    ErrorCode = "CREATE_WORKLIST_ERROR",
                    Message =
                        "Đã đảm bảo AccessionNumber nhưng chưa tạo/publish được PACS Worklist.",
                    ErrorMessage = ex.ToString()
                };
            }
            finally
            {
                if (createLock != null)
                {
                    await createLock.DisposeAsync();
                }
            }
        }

        private async Task<PacsWorklistCreateResult>
            CreateWorklistForResultCDHACoreAsync(
                long resultCDHAId,
                string categoryCode,
                DateTime? scheduledAt,
                long? userId)
        {
            var response = new PacsWorklistCreateResult
            {
                Success = false,
                ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId
            };

            categoryCode = NormalizeCategoryCode(categoryCode);

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(categoryCode))
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_CATEGORY";
                response.Message = "CategoryCode không được rỗng.";
                return response;
            }

            var resultCDHA =
                await _context.ResultCDHAs
                    .Include(x => x.Patient)
                    .Include(x => x.Service)
                        .ThenInclude(x => x.Category)
                    .Include(x => x.Doctor)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync(x => x.Id == resultCDHAId);

            if (resultCDHA == null)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "RESULT_NOT_FOUND";
                response.Message =
                    $"Không tìm thấy ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId}.";
                return response;
            }

            if (resultCDHA.Patient == null)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "PATIENT_NOT_FOUND";
                response.Message =
                    $"ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId} không có Patient.";
                return response;
            }

            if (resultCDHA.Service == null)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "SERVICE_NOT_FOUND";
                response.Message =
                    $"ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId} không có Service.";
                return response;
            }

            var actualCategoryCode =
                NormalizeCategoryCode(
                    resultCDHA.Service.Category?.Code);

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(actualCategoryCode) &&
                actualCategoryCode != categoryCode)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "CATEGORY_MISMATCH";
                response.Message =
                    $"CategoryCode request={categoryCode} không khớp " +
                    $"Service.Category.Code={actualCategoryCode}.";
                return response;
            }

            var accessionResult =
                await EnsureAccessionNumberAsync(
                    resultCDHAId,
                    categoryCode);

            if (!accessionResult.Success)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = accessionResult.ErrorCode;
                response.Message = accessionResult.Message;
                response.ErrorMessage = accessionResult.ErrorMessage;
                return response;
            }

            var accessionNumber =
                accessionResult.AccessionNumber;

            response.AccessionNumber = accessionNumber;

            var modality =
                ResolveDicomModality(categoryCode);

            var stationAe =
                ResolveScheduledStationAETitle(
                    categoryCode,
                    modality);

            var stationName =
                ResolveScheduledStationName(
                    categoryCode,
                    modality);

            var location =
                ResolveScheduledProcedureStepLocation(
                    categoryCode,
                    modality);

            var procedureStatus =
                ResolveScheduledProcedureStepStatus();

            var scheduledDateTime =
                scheduledAt
                ?? ResolveScheduledDateTime(
                    resultCDHA,
                    categoryCode)
                ?? DateTime.Now;

            var patient = resultCDHA.Patient;
            var service = resultCDHA.Service;

            var draft =
                new PacsMwlDraft
                {
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHA.Id,
                    AccessionNumber = accessionNumber,
                    StudyInstanceUID =
                        GenerateStableStudyInstanceUid(accessionNumber),

                    PatientCode =
                        patient.PatientId?.Trim() ?? "",
                    PatientName =
                        patient.PatientName?.Trim() ?? "",
                    PatientBirthDate = null,
                    PatientSex =
                        NormalizeSex(patient.Sex),

                    ReferringPhysicianName =
                        resultCDHA.Doctor?.Name ?? "",
                    InstitutionName =
                        _configuration["Pacs:InstitutionName"] ?? "",

                    ServiceCode = service.Code ?? "",
                    ServiceName = service.Name ?? "",
                    CategoryCode = categoryCode,
                    Modality = modality,

                    RequestedProcedureId = accessionNumber,
                    RequestedProcedureDescription =
                        service.Name ?? "",

                    ScheduledStationAETitle = stationAe,
                    ScheduledStationName = stationName,
                    ScheduledProcedureStepLocation = location,
                    ScheduledProcedureStepStatus = procedureStatus,

                    ScheduledProcedureStepId = accessionNumber,
                    ScheduledProcedureStepStartDate =
                        scheduledDateTime.Date,
                    ScheduledProcedureStepStartTime =
                        scheduledDateTime.TimeOfDay,
                    ScheduledProcedureStepDescription =
                        service.Name ?? "",
                    ScheduledPerformingPhysicianName = "",

                    StudyDescription = service.Name ?? ""
                };

            response.Modality = draft.Modality;
            response.ScheduledStationAETitle =
                draft.ScheduledStationAETitle;
            response.StudyInstanceUID =
                draft.StudyInstanceUID;

            var existingRows =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .Where(x => x.ResultCDHAId == resultCDHAId)
                    .OrderBy(x => x.Id)
                    .ToListAsync();

            if (existingRows.Count > 1)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "DUPLICATE_WORKLIST_ROWS";
                response.Message =
                    $"ResultCDHAId={resultCDHAId} có " +
                    $"{existingRows.Count} PacsWorklistItems. " +
                    "Dừng publish để tránh lấy nhầm Worklist.";
                return response;
            }

            var item =
                existingRows.FirstOrDefault();

            if (item != null &&
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(item.AccessionNumber) &&
                !string.Equals(
                    item.AccessionNumber.Trim(),
                    accessionNumber,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
            {
                response.ErrorCode =
                    "WORKLIST_ACCESSION_CONFLICT";

                response.Message =
                    $"PacsWorklistItem.Id={item.Id} đang có " +
                    $"AccessionNumber={item.AccessionNumber}, " +
                    $"không khớp ResultCDHA={accessionNumber}.";
                return response;
            }

            var worklistFolder =
                GetWorklistFolder();

            Directory.CreateDirectory(worklistFolder);

            var safeAccession =
                MakeSafeFileName(accessionNumber);

            var finalWorklistPath =
                Path.Combine(
                    worklistFolder,
                    $"{safeAccession}.wl");

            // DB says published is not enough. Verify the live file.
            if (item != null &&
                item.Status == 1 &&
                item.PublishedOn.HasValue &&
                File.Exists(finalWorklistPath))
            {
                var existingFileValidation =
                    await ValidatePublishedWorklistAsync(
                        finalWorklistPath,
                        draft);

                if (existingFileValidation.Success)
                {
                    response.Success = true;
                    response.Skipped = true;
                    response.PacsWorklistItemId = item.Id;
                    response.DumpFilePath =
                        item.DumpFilePath ?? "";
                    response.WorklistFilePath =
                        finalWorklistPath;
                    response.Message =
                        "Worklist đã publish hợp lệ trước đó, giữ nguyên và bỏ qua tạo lại.";
                    return response;
                }
            }

            var now = DateTime.Now;

            if (item == null)
            {
                item = new PacsWorklistItem
                {
                    ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                    CreatedOn = now,
                    CreatedBy = userId,
                    Status = 0
                };

                _context.PacsWorklistItems.Add(item);
            }
            else
            {
                item.UpdatedOn = now;
                item.UpdatedBy = userId;
            }

            PopulateWorklistItem(
                item,
                resultCDHA,
                draft);

            item.DumpFileName = null;
            item.DumpFilePath = null;
            item.WorklistFileName = null;
            item.WorklistFilePath = null;
            item.PublishedOn = null;
            item.Status = 0;
            item.ErrorMessage = null;

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            response.PacsWorklistItemId = item.Id;

            var publishResult =
                await CreateValidateAndPublishWorklistAsync(
                    draft);

            item.DumpFileName =
                publishResult.DumpFileName;
            item.DumpFilePath =
                publishResult.DumpFilePath;
            item.WorklistFileName =
                publishResult.WorklistFileName;
            item.WorklistFilePath =
                publishResult.WorklistFilePath;

            response.DumpFilePath =
                publishResult.DumpFilePath;
            response.WorklistFilePath =
                publishResult.WorklistFilePath;
            response.QuarantineDumpPath =
                publishResult.QuarantineDumpPath;
            response.QuarantineWorklistPath =
                publishResult.QuarantineWorklistPath;

            if (!publishResult.Success)
            {
                item.Status = 9;
                item.ErrorMessage =
                    publishResult.Message;
                item.UpdatedOn = DateTime.Now;
                item.UpdatedBy = userId;

                await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

                response.Success = false;
                response.ErrorCode = "PUBLISH_FAILED";
                response.Message =
                    publishResult.Message;
                return response;
            }

            item.Status = 1;
            item.ErrorMessage = null;
            item.PublishedOn = DateTime.Now;
            item.UpdatedOn = DateTime.Now;
            item.UpdatedBy = userId;

            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

            response.Success = true;
            response.Skipped = false;
            response.Message =
                "Tạo, validate và publish Result-level PACS Worklist thành công.";

            return response;
        }


        // ============================================================
        // PACS-XQ-03-07
        // Patient-level Worklist orchestration
        // ============================================================

        public async Task<PacsPatientWorklistCreateResult>
            CreateWorklistForPatientAsync(
                long patientId,
                string categoryCode,
                DateTime? scheduledAt = null,
                long? userId = null)
        {
            var response =
                new PacsPatientWorklistCreateResult
                {
                    Success = false,
                    PatientId = patientId,
                    CategoryCode =
                        NormalizeCategoryCode(categoryCode)
                };

            if (patientId <= 0)
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_PATIENT_ID";
                response.Message = "PatientId không hợp lệ.";
                return response;
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    response.CategoryCode))
            {
                response.ErrorCode = "INVALID_CATEGORY";
                response.Message =
                    "CategoryCode không được rỗng.";
                return response;
            }

            try
            {
                // Query IDs only and do not track the ResultCDHA entities.
                // Each item is reloaded inside the already-tested 03-06
                // result-level pipeline after its per-result file lock.
                var resultIds =
                    await _context.ResultCDHAs
                        .AsNoTracking()
                        .Where(x =>
                            x.PatientId == patientId &&
                            x.Service != null &&
                            x.Service.Category != null &&
                            x.Service.Category.Code != null &&
                            x.Service.Category.Code.ToUpper() ==
                                response.CategoryCode)
                        .OrderBy(x => x.Id)
                        .Select(x => x.Id)
                        .ToListAsync();

                response.TotalResultCDHA =
                    resultIds.Count;

                if (resultIds.Count == 0)
                {
                    response.Success = true;
                    response.Message =
                        $"Không có ResultCDHA nào của PatientId={patientId} " +
                        $"thuộc CategoryCode={response.CategoryCode} để tạo Worklist.";
                    return response;
                }

                foreach (var resultCDHAId in resultIds)
                {
                    PacsWorklistCreateResult itemResult;

                    try
                    {
                        itemResult =
                            await CreateWorklistForResultCDHAAsync(
                                resultCDHAId,
                                response.CategoryCode,
                                scheduledAt,
                                userId);
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        // Keep the batch observable and continue with the
                        // remaining ResultCDHA records. The result-level method
                        // normally converts exceptions into a failure result,
                        // so this is only a last-resort isolation guard.
                        itemResult =
                            new PacsWorklistCreateResult
                            {
                                Success = false,
                                Skipped = false,
                                ResultCDHAId = resultCDHAId,
                                ErrorCode =
                                    "PATIENT_BATCH_ITEM_ERROR",
                                Message =
                                    "Có lỗi ngoài dự kiến khi tạo Worklist cho ResultCDHA trong patient batch.",
                                ErrorMessage =
                                    ex.ToString()
                            };
                    }

                    response.Items.Add(itemResult);

                    if (!itemResult.Success)
                    {
                        response.TotalFailed++;
                    }
                    else if (itemResult.Skipped)
                    {
                        response.TotalSkipped++;
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        response.TotalCreated++;
                    }
                }

                response.Success =
                    response.TotalFailed == 0;

                response.ErrorCode =
                    response.Success
                        ? string.Empty
                        : "PATIENT_BATCH_PARTIAL_FAILURE";

                response.Message =
                    response.Success
                        ? $"Tạo Worklist cho PatientId={patientId}, " +
                          $"CategoryCode={response.CategoryCode} hoàn tất. " +
                          $"Created={response.TotalCreated}, " +
                          $"Skipped={response.TotalSkipped}, " +
                          $"Failed={response.TotalFailed}."
                        : $"Tạo Worklist cho PatientId={patientId}, " +
                          $"CategoryCode={response.CategoryCode} có lỗi một phần. " +
                          $"Created={response.TotalCreated}, " +
                          $"Skipped={response.TotalSkipped}, " +
                          $"Failed={response.TotalFailed}.";

                return response;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                response.Success = false;
                response.ErrorCode =
                    "PATIENT_WORKLIST_ORCHESTRATION_ERROR";
                response.Message =
                    "Không thể orchestration PACS Worklist theo Patient.";
                response.ErrorMessage =
                    ex.ToString();
                return response;
            }
        }

        private async Task AcquireAccessionLockAsync(string prefix)
        {
            var resource = $"PACS_ACCESSION_{prefix}";

            await _context.Database.ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync(
                $@"
DECLARE @lockResult int;

EXEC @lockResult = sys.sp_getapplock
    @Resource = {resource},
    @LockMode = 'Exclusive',
    @LockOwner = 'Transaction',
    @LockTimeout = 10000;

IF @lockResult < 0
BEGIN
    THROW 51001,
          'Không lấy được PACS Accession application lock.',
          1;
END;
");
        }

        private async Task<string>
            GenerateNextAccessionNumberAsync(string prefix)
        {
            var expectedLength = prefix.Length + AccessionSuffixLength;

            var resultValues =
                await _context.ResultCDHAs
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.AccessionNumber != null &&
                        x.AccessionNumber.StartsWith(prefix) &&
                        x.AccessionNumber.Length == expectedLength)
                    .Select(x => x.AccessionNumber)
                    .ToListAsync();

            var worklistValues =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.AccessionNumber != null &&
                        x.AccessionNumber.StartsWith(prefix) &&
                        x.AccessionNumber.Length == expectedLength)
                    .Select(x => x.AccessionNumber)
                    .ToListAsync();

            var currentMax = 0;

            foreach (var accession in resultValues.Concat(worklistValues))
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(accession))
                    continue;

                var value = accession.Trim();

                if (value.Length != expectedLength)
                    continue;

                var suffix = value.Substring(prefix.Length);

                if (suffix.Length != AccessionSuffixLength)
                    continue;

                if (!suffix.All(char.IsDigit))
                    continue;

                if (IsOldDateBasedAccessionSuffix(suffix))
                    continue;

                if (int.TryParse(
                        suffix,
                        NumberStyles.None,
                        CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                        out var number) &&
                    number > currentMax)
                {
                    currentMax = number;
                }
            }

            var nextNumber = currentMax + 1;

            if (nextNumber <= 0 ||
                nextNumber > AccessionSuffixMax)
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"Không thể tạo AccessionNumber prefix={prefix}. " +
                    $"Đã vượt quá {AccessionSuffixMax:N0} số.");
            }

            return $"{prefix}{nextNumber:D8}";
        }

        private async Task<string?>
            FindAccessionConflictAsync(
                long resultCDHAId,
                string accessionNumber)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(accessionNumber))
                return null;

            var resultConflict =
                await _context.ResultCDHAs
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.Id != resultCDHAId &&
                        x.AccessionNumber == accessionNumber)
                    .Select(x => (long?)x.Id)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

            if (resultConflict.HasValue)
            {
                return
                    $"AccessionNumber={accessionNumber} đã thuộc " +
                    $"ResultCDHAId={resultConflict.Value}.";
            }

            var worklistConflict =
                await _context.PacsWorklistItems
                    .AsNoTracking()
                    .Where(x =>
                        x.ResultCDHAId != resultCDHAId &&
                        x.AccessionNumber == accessionNumber)
                    .Select(x => (long?)x.ResultCDHAId)
                    .FirstOrDefaultAsync();

            if (worklistConflict.HasValue)
            {
                return
                    $"AccessionNumber={accessionNumber} đã thuộc " +
                    $"PacsWorklistItem của ResultCDHAId=" +
                    $"{worklistConflict.Value}.";
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static string ResolveAccessionPrefix(string categoryCode)
        {
            categoryCode = NormalizeCategoryCode(categoryCode);

            return categoryCode switch
            {
                "XQ" => "CR",
                "CR" => "CR",
                "DX" => "CR",
                "CT" => "CT",
                "MRI" => "MR",
                "MR" => "MR",
                "SA" => "US",
                "SAT" => "US",
                "US" => "US",
                "ECG" => "ECG",
                "MG" => "MG",
                _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"CategoryCode={categoryCode} chưa được cấu hình PACS Accession prefix.")
            };
        }

        private static string NormalizeCategoryCode(string? categoryCode)
        {
            return (categoryCode ?? "").Trim().ToUpperInvariant();
        }

        private static bool IsCanonicalAccession(
            string accessionNumber,
            string prefix)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(accessionNumber))
                return false;

            accessionNumber =
                accessionNumber.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();

            prefix =
                prefix.Trim().ToUpperInvariant();

            if (!accessionNumber.StartsWith(
                    prefix,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                return false;
            }

            if (accessionNumber.Length !=
                prefix.Length + AccessionSuffixLength)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var suffix =
                accessionNumber.Substring(prefix.Length);

            if (suffix.Length != AccessionSuffixLength ||
                !suffix.All(char.IsDigit))
            {
                return false;
            }

            return !IsOldDateBasedAccessionSuffix(suffix);
        }

        private static bool IsOldDateBasedAccessionSuffix(string suffix)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(suffix) ||
                suffix.Length != AccessionSuffixLength)
            {
                return false;
            }

            var datePart = suffix.Substring(0, 6);

            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                datePart,
                "yyMMdd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out _);
        }


        private static string
            ResolveDicomModality(
                string categoryCode)
        {
            categoryCode =
                NormalizeCategoryCode(
                    categoryCode);

            return categoryCode switch
            {
                "XQ" => "CR",
                "CR" => "CR",
                "DX" => "DX",
                "CT" => "CT",
                "MRI" => "MR",
                "MR" => "MR",
                "SA" => "US",
                "SAT" => "US",
                "US" => "US",
                "ECG" => "ECG",
                "MG" => "MG",
                _ => throw new InvalidOperationException(
                    $"CategoryCode={categoryCode} chưa được map DICOM Modality.")
            };
        }

        private string
            ResolveScheduledStationAETitle(
                string categoryCode,
                string modality)
        {
            return ResolveRequiredPacsSetting(
                "ScheduledStationAETitle",
                categoryCode,
                modality,
                fallbackKey:
                    "DefaultScheduledStationAETitle");
        }

        private string
            ResolveScheduledStationName(
                string categoryCode,
                string modality)
        {
            return ResolveRequiredPacsSetting(
                "ScheduledStationName",
                categoryCode,
                modality);
        }

        private string
            ResolveScheduledProcedureStepLocation(
                string categoryCode,
                string modality)
        {
            return ResolveRequiredPacsSetting(
                "ScheduledProcedureStepLocation",
                categoryCode,
                modality);
        }

        private string
            ResolveScheduledProcedureStepStatus()
        {
            var value =
                _configuration[
                    "Pacs:ScheduledProcedureStepStatus"];

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
            {
                return "SCHEDULED";
            }

            return value
                .Trim()
                .ToUpperInvariant();
        }

        private string
            ResolveRequiredPacsSetting(
                string baseKey,
                string categoryCode,
                string modality,
                string? fallbackKey = null)
        {
            categoryCode =
                NormalizeCategoryCode(
                    categoryCode);

            modality =
                (modality ?? "")
                    .Trim()
                    .ToUpperInvariant();

            var byModality =
                _configuration[
                    $"Pacs:{baseKey}_{modality}"];

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    byModality))
            {
                return byModality.Trim();
            }

            var byCategory =
                _configuration[
                    $"Pacs:{baseKey}_{categoryCode}"];

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    byCategory))
            {
                return byCategory.Trim();
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    fallbackKey))
            {
                var fallback =
                    _configuration[
                        $"Pacs:{fallbackKey}"];

                if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                        fallback))
                {
                    return fallback.Trim();
                }
            }

            throw new InvalidOperationException(
                $"Thiếu cấu hình PACS: {baseKey} cho CategoryCode={categoryCode}, Modality={modality}.");
        }

        private static DateTime?
            ResolveScheduledDateTime(
                ResultCDHA resultCDHA,
                string categoryCode)
        {
            var patient =
                resultCDHA.Patient;

            if (patient == null)
                return resultCDHA.InsertTime;

            return NormalizeCategoryCode(
                categoryCode) switch
            {
                "XQ" =>
                    patient.GetSampleTimeXQ
                    ?? resultCDHA.InsertTime,

                "SA" =>
                    patient.GetSampleTimeSA
                    ?? resultCDHA.InsertTime,

                "SAT" =>
                    patient.GetSampleTimeSAT
                    ?? resultCDHA.InsertTime,

                _ =>
                    resultCDHA.InsertTime
            };
        }

        private string
            BuildWorklistDump(
                PacsMwlDraft item)
        {
            var patientName =
                ToDicomPersonName(
                    item.PatientName);

            var patientCode =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.PatientCode);

            var accessionNumber =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.AccessionNumber);

            var modality =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.Modality);

            var stationAe =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledStationAETitle);

            var stationName =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledStationName);

            var location =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledProcedureStepLocation);

            var status =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledProcedureStepStatus);

            var institutionName =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.InstitutionName);

            var studyInstanceUid =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.StudyInstanceUID);

            var birthDate =
                item.PatientBirthDate.HasValue
                    ? item.PatientBirthDate.Value
                        .ToString("yyyyMMdd")
                    : "";

            var sex =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.PatientSex);

            var scheduledDate =
                item.ScheduledProcedureStepStartDate
                    .ToString("yyyyMMdd");

            var scheduledTime =
                DateTime.Today
                    .Add(
                        item.ScheduledProcedureStepStartTime)
                    .ToString("HHmmss");

            var requestedProcedureId =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.RequestedProcedureId);

            var requestedProcedureDescription =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.RequestedProcedureDescription);

            var scheduledProcedureStepId =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledProcedureStepId);

            var scheduledProcedureStepDescription =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.ScheduledProcedureStepDescription);

            var referringPhysicianName =
                ToDicomPersonName(
                    item.ReferringPhysicianName);

            var scheduledPerformingPhysicianName =
                ToDicomPersonName(
                    item.ScheduledPerformingPhysicianName);

            var studyDescription =
                SafeDicomValue(
                    item.StudyDescription);

            var sb =
                new StringBuilder();

            sb.AppendLine(
                "(0008,0005) CS [ISO_IR 192]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0008,0050) SH [{accessionNumber}]");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    institutionName))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"(0008,0080) LO [{institutionName}]");
            }

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0020,000D) UI [{studyInstanceUid}]");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    referringPhysicianName))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"(0008,0090) PN [{referringPhysicianName}]");
            }

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0010,0010) PN [{patientName}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0010,0020) LO [{patientCode}]");

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    birthDate))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"(0010,0030) DA [{birthDate}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    sex))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"(0010,0040) CS [{sex}]");
            }

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    studyDescription))
            {
                sb.AppendLine(
                    $"(0008,1030) LO [{studyDescription}]");
            }

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0040,1001) SH [{requestedProcedureId}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"(0032,1060) LO [{requestedProcedureDescription}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                "(0040,0100) SQ (Sequence with explicit length #=1)");

            sb.AppendLine(
                "  (fffe,e000) na (Item with explicit length #=10)");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0008,0060) CS [{modality}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0001) AE [{stationAe}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0002) DA [{scheduledDate}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0003) TM [{scheduledTime}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0006) PN [{scheduledPerformingPhysicianName}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0010) SH [{stationName}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0011) SH [{location}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0020) CS [{status}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0007) LO [{scheduledProcedureStepDescription}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                $"    (0040,0009) SH [{scheduledProcedureStepId}]");

            sb.AppendLine(
                "  (fffe,e00d) na (ItemDelimitationItem)");

            sb.AppendLine(
                "(fffe,e0dd) na (SequenceDelimitationItem)");

            return sb.ToString();
        }

        private static List<PacsMwlTagValidation>
            BuildMwlValidationChecks(
                string dcmDumpOutput,
                PacsMwlDraft draft)
        {
            var checks =
                new List<PacsMwlTagValidation>();

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "AccessionNumber",
                draft.AccessionNumber);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "StudyInstanceUID",
                draft.StudyInstanceUID);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "PatientID",
                SafeDicomValue(
                    draft.PatientCode));

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "PatientName",
                ToDicomPersonName(
                    draft.PatientName));

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "Modality",
                draft.Modality);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "ScheduledStationAETitle",
                draft.ScheduledStationAETitle);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "ScheduledStationName",
                draft.ScheduledStationName);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "ScheduledProcedureStepLocation",
                draft.ScheduledProcedureStepLocation);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "ScheduledProcedureStepStatus",
                draft.ScheduledProcedureStepStatus);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "RequestedProcedureID",
                draft.RequestedProcedureId);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "ScheduledProcedureStepID",
                draft.ScheduledProcedureStepId);

            AddValidation(
                checks,
                dcmDumpOutput,
                "RequestedProcedureDescription",
                SafeDicomValue(
                    draft.RequestedProcedureDescription));

            return checks;
        }

        private static void
            AddValidation(
                List<PacsMwlTagValidation> checks,
                string output,
                string name,
                string expectedValue)
        {
            expectedValue ??= "";

            var passed =
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    expectedValue)
                &&
                output.Contains(
                    $"[{expectedValue}]",
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            checks.Add(
                new PacsMwlTagValidation
                {
                    TagName = name,
                    ExpectedValue =
                        expectedValue,
                    Passed = passed
                });
        }

        private static async Task<PacsProcessResult>
            RunProcessAsync(
                string executablePath,
                IReadOnlyList<string> arguments,
                string workingDirectory,
                int timeoutMilliseconds)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    executablePath))
            {
                return PacsProcessResult.Fail(
                    -1,
                    "",
                    "Executable path rỗng.");
            }

            if (!File.Exists(
                    executablePath))
            {
                return PacsProcessResult.Fail(
                    -1,
                    "",
                    $"Không tìm thấy executable: {executablePath}");
            }

            var psi =
                new ProcessStartInfo
                {
                    FileName =
                        executablePath,

                    WorkingDirectory =
                        workingDirectory,

                    UseShellExecute =
                        false,

                    RedirectStandardOutput =
                        true,

                    RedirectStandardError =
                        true,

                    CreateNoWindow =
                        true
                };

            foreach (var argument in arguments)
            {
                psi.ArgumentList.Add(
                    argument);
            }

            using var process =
                new Process
                {
                    StartInfo = psi
                };

            process.Start();

            var stdoutTask =
                process.StandardOutput
                    .ReadToEndAsync();

            var stderrTask =
                process.StandardError
                    .ReadToEndAsync();

            using var cts =
                new CancellationTokenSource(
                    timeoutMilliseconds);

            try
            {
                await process.WaitForExitAsync(
                    cts.Token);
            }
            catch (OperationCanceledException)
            {
                try
                {
                    process.Kill(
                        entireProcessTree: true);
                }
                catch
                {
                    // Best-effort cleanup.
                }

                return PacsProcessResult.Fail(
                    -1,
                    await stdoutTask,
                    "Process timeout.");
            }

            var stdout =
                await stdoutTask;

            var stderr =
                await stderrTask;

            return new PacsProcessResult
            {
                Success =
                    process.ExitCode == 0,

                ExitCode =
                    process.ExitCode,

                StdOut =
                    stdout,

                StdErr =
                    stderr
            };
        }

        private static string
            CombineProcessOutput(
                string? stdout,
                string? stderr)
        {
            return string.Join(
                Environment.NewLine,
                new[]
                {
                    stdout?.Trim(),
                    stderr?.Trim()
                }
                .Where(
                    x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)));
        }

        private static string
            GenerateStableStudyInstanceUid(
                string accessionNumber)
        {
            var input =
                Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(
                    "LIS-PACS-STUDY|" +
                    accessionNumber.Trim());

            var hash =
                SHA256.HashData(input);

            // DICOM's registered UUID-derived UID root is 2.25.
            // Use 128 deterministic bits from SHA-256.
            var bytes =
                hash.Take(16).ToArray();

            var number =
                new BigInteger(
                    bytes,
                    isUnsigned: true,
                    isBigEndian: true);

            return
                $"2.25.{number}";
        }

        private static string
            NormalizeSex(
                string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return "";
            }

            value =
                value.Trim()
                    .ToUpperInvariant();

            if (value == "NAM" ||
                value == "MALE" ||
                value == "M" ||
                value == "1")
            {
                return "M";
            }

            if (value == "NỮ" ||
                value == "NU" ||
                value == "FEMALE" ||
                value == "F" ||
                value == "0" ||
                value == "2")
            {
                return "F";
            }

            return "";
        }

        private static string
            ToDicomPersonName(
                string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return "";
            }

            return SafeDicomValue(
                    value)
                .Replace(" ", "^");
        }

        private static string
            SafeDicomValue(
                string? value)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    value))
            {
                return "";
            }

            return RemoveInvalidDicomChars(
                RemoveVietnameseDiacritics(
                    value.Trim()));
        }

        private static string
            RemoveVietnameseDiacritics(
                string value)
        {
            value =
                value
                    .Replace('đ', 'd')
                    .Replace('Đ', 'D');

            var normalized =
                value.Normalize(
                    NormalizationForm.FormD);

            var sb =
                new StringBuilder();

            foreach (var character in normalized)
            {
                if (CharUnicodeInfo
                    .GetUnicodeCategory(character)
                    != UnicodeCategory.NonSpacingMark)
                {
                    sb.Append(character);
                }
            }

            return sb
                .ToString()
                .Normalize(
                    NormalizationForm.FormC);
        }

        private static string
            RemoveInvalidDicomChars(
                string value)
        {
            return value
                .Replace("[", "(")
                .Replace("]", ")")
                .Replace("\r", " ")
                .Replace("\n", " ")
                .Trim();
        }

        private static string
            MakeSafeFileName(
                string value)
        {
            foreach (var character in
                Path.GetInvalidFileNameChars())
            {
                value =
                    value.Replace(
                        character,
                        '_');
            }

            return value.Trim();
        }

        private static void
            TryDeleteFile(
                string path)
        {
            if (File.Exists(path))
            {
                File.Delete(path);
            }
        }
