using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using System;
using System.Linq;
using System.Security.Claims;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    public class PacsConfigController : Controller
    {
        private readonly PacsConfigBL _pacsConfigBL;

        public PacsConfigController(
            PacsConfigBL pacsConfigBL)
        {
            _pacsConfigBL = pacsConfigBL;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Trang cấu hình PACS.
        ///
        /// View sẽ được port ở step frontend/config sau.
        /// </summary>
        public IActionResult Index()
        {
            return View();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lấy toàn bộ cấu hình PACS.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetAll()
        {
            try
            {
                var data =
                    await _pacsConfigBL.GetAllAsync();

                var result =
                    data.Select(x => new
                    {
                        x.Id,
                        x.Code,
                        x.Name,
                        x.ServerType,

                        x.BaseUrl,

                        x.ApiUsername,
                        x.ApiPassword,

                        x.DicomAETitle,
                        x.DicomHost,
                        x.DicomPort,

                        x.DicomWebRoot,
                        x.OhifViewerUrl,

                        x.SyncEnabled,
                        x.SyncIntervalSeconds,

                        x.IsDefault,
                        x.IsActive,

                        x.LastStatus,
                        x.LastApiStatus,
                        x.LastStudiesStatus,
                        x.LastDicomWebStatus,
                        x.LastDicomPortStatus,

                        LastCheckedAt =
                            x.LastCheckedAt.HasValue
                                ? x.LastCheckedAt.Value
                                    .ToString(
                                        "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss")
                                : "",

                        x.LastError
                    })
                    .ToList();

                return Json(new
                {
                    success = true,
                    data = result
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lấy một cấu hình PACS theo Id.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetById(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var item =
                    await _pacsConfigBL.GetByIdAsync(id);

                if (item == null)
                {
                    return Json(new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không tìm thấy cấu hình PACS."
                    });
                }

                return Json(new
                {
                    success = true,

                    data = new
                    {
                        item.Id,
                        item.Code,
                        item.Name,
                        item.ServerType,

                        item.BaseUrl,

                        item.ApiUsername,
                        item.ApiPassword,

                        item.DicomAETitle,
                        item.DicomHost,
                        item.DicomPort,

                        item.DicomWebRoot,
                        item.OhifViewerUrl,

                        item.SyncEnabled,
                        item.SyncIntervalSeconds,

                        item.IsDefault,
                        item.IsActive,

                        item.LastStatus,
                        item.LastApiStatus,
                        item.LastStudiesStatus,
                        item.LastDicomWebStatus,
                        item.LastDicomPortStatus,

                        LastCheckedAt =
                            item.LastCheckedAt.HasValue
                                ? item.LastCheckedAt.Value
                                    .ToString(
                                        "dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss")
                                : "",

                        item.LastError
                    }
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Thêm mới hoặc cập nhật cấu hình PACS.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Save(
            [FromBody] PacsConfig model)
        {
            try
            {
                var userId =
                    GetCurrentUserId();

                var result =
                    await _pacsConfigBL.SaveAsync(
                        model,
                        userId);

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Xóa một cấu hình PACS.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Delete(int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsConfigBL.DeleteAsync(id);

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Kiểm tra một cấu hình PACS cụ thể.
        ///
        /// Test:
        /// - Orthanc /system
        /// - Orthanc /studies
        /// - DICOMweb /studies
        /// - DICOM TCP Port
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> TestConnection(
            int id)
        {
            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsConfigBL
                        .TestConnectionAsync(id);

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    status = "Offline",
                    message =
                        "Test kết nối PACS thất bại.",
                    error = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Kiểm tra PACS mặc định đang Active.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetStatus()
        {
            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsConfigBL
                        .TestDefaultConnectionAsync();

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    status = "Offline",
                    message =
                        "Không kiểm tra được trạng thái PACS.",
                    error = ex.Message
                });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Project A lưu UserId bằng Claim.
        ///
        /// Ưu tiên Claim.
        /// Fallback Session để giữ compatibility
        /// nếu sau này có flow cũ vẫn lưu Session.
        /// </summary>
        private int? GetCurrentUserId()
        {
            try
            {
                // ---------------------------------------------
                // 1. Project A authentication baseline:
                //    UserId được lưu trong Claim.
                // ---------------------------------------------

                var userIdText =
                    User?.Claims?
                        .FirstOrDefault(
                            x => x.Type == "UserId")
                        ?.Value;

                if (int.TryParse(
                    userIdText,
                    out var userId))
                {
                    return userId;
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------
                // 2. Compatibility fallback
                // ---------------------------------------------

                userIdText =
                    HttpContext.Session
                        .GetString("UserId");

                if (int.TryParse(
                    userIdText,
                    out userId))
                {
                    return userId;
                }

                return null;
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Controllers/Pacs/PacsSmbRuntimeDiagnosticController.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using System.Net;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using System.Security.Principal;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    // PACS-PROD-05B-03C-04D-02A
    // TEMPORARY diagnostic endpoint. Remove from source after its test is complete.
    // Disabled unless the short-lived, NTFS-protected guard file is created by an operator.
    [ApiController]
    [Authorize]
    [ApiExplorerSettings(IgnoreApi = true)]
    [Route("internal/pacs/04d02")]
    public sealed class PacsSmbRuntimeDiagnosticController : ControllerBase
    {
        private const string GateFile = @"F:\LAB\PACS\RuntimeDiag\04D-02-enable.json";
        private const string SmbShare = @"\\192.168.10.106\pacs-worklists";
        private const string CredentialFile = @"F:\LAB\PACS\Secrets\pacs-worklist-smb.dpapi";
        private static readonly SemaphoreSlim TestGate = new(1, 1);
        private readonly ILogger<PacsSmbRuntimeDiagnosticController> _logger;

        public PacsSmbRuntimeDiagnosticController(ILogger<PacsSmbRuntimeDiagnosticController> logger)
        {
            _logger = logger;
        }

        private sealed class DiagnosticGate
        {
            public string? Checkpoint { get; set; }
            public string? TokenSha256 { get; set; }
            public DateTimeOffset ExpiresUtc { get; set; }
        }

        [HttpPost("verify")]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Verify(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            // This endpoint must not be used for patient information or clinical workflows.
            if (!OperatingSystem.IsWindows() || !System.IO.File.Exists(GateFile))
                return NotFound();

            // This is defense-in-depth, not a replacement for [Authorize] + token.
            // Do not trust forwarded client IP headers for this check.
            var remoteIp = HttpContext.Connection.RemoteIpAddress;
            if (remoteIp == null || !IPAddress.IsLoopback(remoteIp))
                return NotFound();

            var supplied = Request.Headers["X-Pacs-Diagnostic-Token"].ToString();
            if (supplied.Length < 40 || supplied.Length > 200)
                return NotFound();

            try
            {
                var gateFileInfo = new FileInfo(GateFile);
                if ((gateFileInfo.Attributes & FileAttributes.ReparsePoint) != 0 ||
                    gateFileInfo.Length < 70 || gateFileInfo.Length > 4096)
                    return NotFound();

                DiagnosticGate? gate;
                await using (var stream = new FileStream(GateFile, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read,
                    FileShare.Read, 4096, FileOptions.Asynchronous))
                {
                    gate = await JsonSerializer.DeserializeAsync<DiagnosticGate>(stream,
                        new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true },
                        cancellationToken);
                }

                var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                if (gate == null ||
                    gate.Checkpoint != "PACS-PROD-05B-03C-04D-02" ||
                    gate.ExpiresUtc <= now || gate.ExpiresUtc > now.AddMinutes(15) ||
                    string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gate.TokenSha256) ||
                    gate.TokenSha256.Length != 64)
                    return NotFound();

                byte[] expected;
                try { expected = Convert.FromHexString(gate.TokenSha256); }
                catch (FormatException) { return NotFound(); }

                var actual = SHA256.HashData(Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(supplied));
                if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(actual, expected))
                    return NotFound();

                // Prevent concurrent diagnostics within this IIS worker process.
                if (!await TestGate.WaitAsync(0, cancellationToken))
                    return StatusCode(409, new { checkpoint = "04D-02", result = "BUSY" });

                try
                {
                    var identity = WindowsIdentity.GetCurrent().Name;
                    if (!identity.Equals(@"IIS APPPOOL\LIS", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    {
                        return StatusCode(503, new {
                            checkpoint = "04D-02", result = "STOP",
                            identityMatch = false,
                            dpapiSmbLogin = "NOT_ATTEMPTED"
                        });
                    }

                    // Never modify real appsettings or enable production Worklist publishing.
                    var values = new Dictionary<string, string?>
                    {
                        ["Pacs:WorklistFolder"] = SmbShare,
                        ["Pacs:WorklistSmbEnabled"] = "true",
                        ["Pacs:WorklistSmbShare"] = SmbShare,
                        ["Pacs:WorklistSmbUsername"] = "lis_pacs_mwl",
                        ["Pacs:WorklistSmbSecretFile"] = CredentialFile
                    };
                    IConfiguration testConfig = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                        .AddInMemoryCollection(values)
                        .Build();

                    await using (var scope = await PacsSmbConnectionScope.OpenAsync(testConfig, cancellationToken))
                    {
                        // Forces an actual SMB directory query. Do not return names or content.
                        if (!Directory.Exists(SmbShare))
                            throw new IOException("SMB_SHARE_NOT_ACCESSIBLE");
                        _ = Directory.EnumerateFileSystemEntries(SmbShare).Take(1).ToArray();
                    }

                    return Ok(new {
                        checkpoint = "PACS-PROD-05B-03C-04D-02",
                        result = "PASS",
                        identityMatch = true,
                        dpapiSmbLogin = "PASS",
                        smbReadOnly = "PASS",
                        smbDisconnected = "PASS",
                        remoteFileWrites = 0,
                        worklistPublishing = "NOT_ENABLED_BY_TEST"
                    });
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException) when (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    return StatusCode(503, new { checkpoint = "04D-02", result = "CANCELLED" });
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    // Log only error class and HRESULT. Never log the token or password.
                    _logger.LogWarning("PACS 04D-02 diagnostic stopped: {ErrorType} HResult={HResult}",
                        ex.GetType().Name, ex.HResult);
                    return StatusCode(503, new {
                        checkpoint = "04D-02", result = "STOP",
                        failureType = ex.GetType().Name,
                        errorHResult = ex.HResult,
                        remoteFileWrites = 0
                    });
                }
                finally
                {
                    TestGate.Release();
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("PACS 04D-02 gate failure: {ErrorType}", ex.GetType().Name);
                return NotFound();
            }
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Controllers/Pacs/PacsStudyController.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-04-03:
    /// Narrow manual endpoint chỉ để runtime-test Single Study Sync Core.
    ///
    /// Các API changes/checkpoint/background đầy đủ thuộc 04-06/07/08.
    /// </summary>
    [Authorize]
    public class PacsStudyController : Controller
    {
        private readonly PacsStudyBL _pacsStudyBL;

        public PacsStudyController(
            PacsStudyBL pacsStudyBL)
        {
            _pacsStudyBL = pacsStudyBL;
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SyncSingleStudy(
            [FromBody] PacsSingleStudySyncRequest request,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            if (request == null ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    request.OrthancStudyId))
            {
                return Json(
                    new PacsSingleStudySyncResult
                    {
                        Success = false,
                        ErrorCode =
                            "INVALID_ORTHANC_STUDY_ID",
                        Message =
                            "OrthancStudyId là bắt buộc."
                    });
            }

            var result =
                await _pacsStudyBL
                    .SyncSingleStudyAsync(
                        request.OrthancStudyId,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }
    }
}

<file path="Controllers/Pacs/PacsSyncController.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PACS operational endpoints.
    ///
    /// Checkpoint ownership remains in PacsChangeSyncBL.
    /// PREPROD reliability preview/recovery/reconciliation is delegated to
    /// PacsReliabilityBL and must not mutate PacsSyncState checkpoint unless
    /// explicitly owned by a future checkpoint operation.
    /// </summary>
    [Authorize]
    public class PacsSyncController : Controller
    {
        private readonly PacsChangeSyncBL
            _pacsChangeSyncBL;

        private readonly PacsReliabilityBL
            _pacsReliabilityBL;

        public PacsSyncController(
            PacsChangeSyncBL pacsChangeSyncBL,
            PacsReliabilityBL pacsReliabilityBL)
        {
            _pacsChangeSyncBL =
                pacsChangeSyncBL;

            _pacsReliabilityBL =
                pacsReliabilityBL;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            PreviewChanges(
                long since = 0,
                int limit = 100,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsChangeSyncBL
                    .PreviewChangesAsync(
                        since,
                        limit,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            GetCheckpointStatus(
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsChangeSyncBL
                    .GetCheckpointStatusAsync(
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            SyncManualRange(
                [FromBody]
                PacsManualSyncRequest request,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsChangeSyncBL
                    .SyncManualRangeAsync(
                        request,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            InitializeCheckpointToTail(
                [FromBody]
                PacsCheckpointInitializeRequest request,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsChangeSyncBL
                    .InitializeCheckpointToTailAsync(
                        request,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            SyncFromCheckpoint(
                [FromBody]
                PacsSyncCheckpointRequest request,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsChangeSyncBL
                    .SyncFromCheckpointAsync(
                        request,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C-02
        ///
        /// Read-only Completed Study Reconciliation preview.
        /// - only completed Worklists (Status=3);
        /// - mandatory StartDate / fail-closed;
        /// - compares PacsStudy metadata + actual child counts + Orthanc;
        /// - never calls canonical Study sync;
        /// - never updates LastReconciliationCheckedOn;
        /// - never updates PacsSyncState checkpoint.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            PreviewReconciliation(
                int? batchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .PreviewReconciliationAsync(
                        batchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C-03
        ///
        /// Manual Reconciliation for one Completed Study.
        /// Only safe mismatch statuses may reach the canonical Study mutation.
        /// CompletedOn and PacsSyncState checkpoint must remain unchanged.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            ReconcileCompletedStudy(
                [FromBody]
                PacsReconciliationWorklistRequest request,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            request ??=
                new PacsReconciliationWorklistRequest();

            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .ReconcileCompletedStudyAsync(
                        request.PacsWorklistItemId,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C-05
        ///
        /// Manual batch Reconciliation for completed Worklists.
        /// This endpoint does not check PacsSyncReconciliation:Enabled;
        /// that switch is reserved for automatic background integration in
        /// PREPROD-01D.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            ReconcilePending(
                int? batchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .ReconcilePendingAsync(
                        batchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01B-02
        ///
        /// Read-only Recovery preview.
        /// - only Published Worklists (Status=1);
        /// - Recovery StartDate is mandatory and fail-closed;
        /// - respects MinAgeMinutes + anti-starvation ordering;
        /// - reads Orthanc by AccessionNumber;
        /// - never calls Study sync;
        /// - never updates Worklist/PacsStudy/PacsSyncState.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            PreviewRecovery(
                int? batchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .PreviewRecoveryAsync(
                        batchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01B-03
        ///
        /// Manual Missing Study Recovery for one Worklist.
        /// The method revalidates the candidate immediately before mutation and
        /// delegates the only hierarchy write to PacsStudyBL.TrySyncSingleStudyAsync().
        /// It does not own or update PacsSyncState checkpoint.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            RecoverWorklist(
                [FromBody]
                PacsRecoveryWorklistRequest request,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            request ??=
                new PacsRecoveryWorklistRequest();

            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .RecoverWorklistAsync(
                        request.PacsWorklistItemId,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01B-04
        ///
        /// Manual batch Recovery for pending Worklists. This endpoint does not
        /// check PacsSyncRecovery:Enabled; that switch is reserved for the
        /// automatic Background lane in PREPROD-01D.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            RecoverPending(
                int? batchSize = null,
                CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            var result =
                await _pacsReliabilityBL
                    .RecoverPendingAsync(
                        batchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            return Json(result);
        }
    }
}

<file path="Controllers/Pacs/PacsViewerController.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    [Authorize]
    public class PacsViewerController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ILogger<PacsViewerController>
            _logger;

        private readonly PacsViewerBL
            _pacsViewerBL;

        public PacsViewerController(
            ILogger<PacsViewerController> logger,
            PacsViewerBL pacsViewerBL)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _pacsViewerBL = pacsViewerBL;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            GetOhifViewerUrl(
                long resultCDHAId)
        {
            if (resultCDHAId <= 0)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "Thiếu ResultCDHAId."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var url =
                    await _pacsViewerBL
                        .GetOhifViewerUrlByResultCDHAIdAsync(
                            resultCDHAId);

                if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    url))
                {
                    return Json(new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Dịch vụ này chưa có ảnh PACS hoặc chưa sync StudyInstanceUID."
                    });
                }

                return Json(new
                {
                    success = true,
                    viewerUrl = url
                });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "GetOhifViewerUrl failed. ResultCDHAId: {ResultCDHAId}",
                    resultCDHAId);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể lấy link OHIF Viewer. Vui lòng kiểm tra PACS."
                    });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            GetPacsSeriesThumbnails(
                long resultCDHAId)
        {
            if (resultCDHAId <= 0)
            {
                return Json(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "Thiếu ResultCDHAId."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsViewerBL
                        .GetSeriesThumbnailsByResultCDHAIdAsync(
                            resultCDHAId);

                if (result.Items != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in
                        result.Items)
                    {
                        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                            item.OrthancInstanceId))
                        {
                            /*
                             * Dùng relative URL để luôn
                             * same-origin với Project A.
                             */
                            item.ThumbnailUrl =
                                Url.Action(
                                    action:
                                        nameof(
                                            GetPacsThumbnail),
                                    controller:
                                        "PacsViewer",
                                    values:
                                        new
                                        {
                                            orthancInstanceId =
                                                item.OrthancInstanceId
                                        }
                                );
                        }
                    }
                }

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "GetPacsSeriesThumbnails failed. ResultCDHAId: {ResultCDHAId}",
                    resultCDHAId);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể lấy danh sách Series PACS."
                    });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            GetPacsThumbnail(
                string orthancInstanceId)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orthancInstanceId))
            {
                return NotFound();
            }

            try
            {
                var bytes =
                    await _pacsViewerBL
                        .GetOrthancInstancePreviewAsync(
                            orthancInstanceId);

                if (bytes == null ||
                    bytes.Length == 0)
                {
                    return NotFound();
                }

                return File(
                    bytes,
                    "image/jpeg"
                );
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "GetPacsThumbnail failed. OrthancInstanceId: {OrthancInstanceId}",
                    orthancInstanceId);

                return NotFound();
            }
        }
    }
}

<file path="Controllers/Pacs/PacsWorklistController.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

namespace Management.Controllers.Pacs
{
    [Authorize]
    public class PacsWorklistController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ILogger<PacsWorklistController>
            _logger;

        private readonly PacsWorklistBL
            _pacsWorklistBL;

        public PacsWorklistController(
            ILogger<PacsWorklistController> logger,
            PacsWorklistBL pacsWorklistBL)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _pacsWorklistBL = pacsWorklistBL;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-03-04 validation endpoint.
        ///
        /// Ensures ResultCDHA has a canonical AccessionNumber.
        /// Does not create PacsWorklistItems and does not publish MWL.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            EnsureAccessionNumber(
                [FromBody] PacsEnsureAccessionRequest request)
        {
            if (request == null ||
                request.ResultCDHAId <= 0 ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    request.CategoryCode))
            {
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "ResultCDHAId và CategoryCode là bắt buộc."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsWorklistBL
                        .EnsureAccessionNumberAsync(
                            request.ResultCDHAId,
                            request.CategoryCode);

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "EnsureAccessionNumber failed. ResultCDHAId={ResultCDHAId}, CategoryCode={CategoryCode}",
                    request.ResultCDHAId,
                    request.CategoryCode);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể đảm bảo AccessionNumber PACS."
                    });
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-03-05 validation endpoint.
        ///
        /// Generates .dump and .wl in staging only, runs dump2dcm
        /// and dcmdump, validates required MWL tags, but does not
        /// publish the file to Orthanc and does not create
        /// PacsWorklistItems.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            GenerateMwlValidationFixture(
                [FromBody] PacsGenerateMwlValidationRequest request)
        {
            if (request == null ||
                request.ResultCDHAId <= 0 ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    request.CategoryCode))
            {
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "ResultCDHAId và CategoryCode là bắt buộc."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsWorklistBL
                        .GenerateMwlValidationFixtureAsync(
                            request.ResultCDHAId,
                            request.CategoryCode,
                            request.ScheduledAt);

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "GenerateMwlValidationFixture failed. ResultCDHAId={ResultCDHAId}, CategoryCode={CategoryCode}",
                    request.ResultCDHAId,
                    request.CategoryCode);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể tạo MWL validation fixture."
                    });
            }
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-03-06.
        /// Creates and controlled-publishes exactly one ResultCDHA Worklist.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            CreateForResultCDHA(
                [FromBody] PacsCreateResultWorklistRequest request)
        {
            if (request == null ||
                request.ResultCDHAId <= 0 ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    request.CategoryCode))
            {
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "ResultCDHAId và CategoryCode là bắt buộc."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsWorklistBL
                        .CreateWorklistForResultCDHAAsync(
                            request.ResultCDHAId,
                            request.CategoryCode,
                            request.ScheduledAt,
                            GetCurrentUserId());

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "CreateForResultCDHA failed. ResultCDHAId={ResultCDHAId}, CategoryCode={CategoryCode}",
                    request.ResultCDHAId,
                    request.CategoryCode);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể tạo Result-level PACS Worklist."
                    });
            }
        }



        /// <summary>
        /// PACS-XQ-03-07.
        /// Creates/reuses Worklists for all ResultCDHA rows of one patient
        /// in the requested CategoryCode. Does not hook XQ workflow yet.
        /// </summary>
        [HttpPost]
        public async Task<IActionResult>
            CreateForPatient(
                [FromBody] PacsCreatePatientWorklistRequest request)
        {
            if (request == null ||
                request.PatientId <= 0 ||
                string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    request.CategoryCode))
            {
                return BadRequest(new
                {
                    success = false,
                    message =
                        "PatientId và CategoryCode là bắt buộc."
                });
            }

            try
            {
                var result =
                    await _pacsWorklistBL
                        .CreateWorklistForPatientAsync(
                            request.PatientId,
                            request.CategoryCode,
                            request.ScheduledAt,
                            GetCurrentUserId());

                return Json(result);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(
                    ex,
                    "CreateForPatient failed. PatientId={PatientId}, CategoryCode={CategoryCode}",
                    request.PatientId,
                    request.CategoryCode);

                return StatusCode(
                    500,
                    new
                    {
                        success = false,
                        message =
                            "Không thể tạo Patient-level PACS Worklist."
                    });
            }
        }

        private long? GetCurrentUserId()
        {
            try
            {
                var userIdText =
                    User?.Claims?
                        .FirstOrDefault(
                            x => x.Type == "UserId")
                        ?.Value;

                if (long.TryParse(
                    userIdText,
                    out var userId))
                {
                    return userId;
                }

                userIdText =
                    HttpContext.Session
                        .GetString("UserId");

                if (long.TryParse(
                    userIdText,
                    out userId))
                {
                    return userId;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                // CreatedBy/UpdatedBy are optional audit fields.
            }

            return null;
        }

    }

    public class PacsEnsureAccessionRequest
    {
        public long ResultCDHAId { get; set; }

        public string CategoryCode { get; set; } =
            string.Empty;
    }

    public class PacsGenerateMwlValidationRequest
    {
        public long ResultCDHAId { get; set; }

        public string CategoryCode { get; set; } =
            string.Empty;

        public DateTime? ScheduledAt { get; set; }
    }



    public class PacsCreateResultWorklistRequest
    {
        public long ResultCDHAId { get; set; }

        public string CategoryCode { get; set; } =
            string.Empty;

        public DateTime? ScheduledAt { get; set; }
    }



    public class PacsCreatePatientWorklistRequest
    {
        public long PatientId { get; set; }

        public string CategoryCode { get; set; } =
            string.Empty;

        public DateTime? ScheduledAt { get; set; }
    }

}

                                              UserBL userBL, ServiceBL serviceBL, ResultXNBL resultXNBL, ReportBL reportBL, HospitalBL hospitalBL, IWebHostEnvironment environment)
        {

            _userBL = userBL;
            _serviceBL = serviceBL;

        [HttpGet]

        {
            ViewData["lstUser"] = await _userBL.GetListUser();
            ViewData["lstHospital"] = await _hospitalBL.GetListHospital();
            return View();
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Search(DateTime from, DateTime to, string type, string location, long userid, string hospitalId)
        {
            var fromtime = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var totime = new DateTime(to.Year, to.Month, to.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            var user = await _userBL.GetUser(userid);
            var hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
            long? hospitalGuiMau = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hospitalId) || hospitalId == "null") ? null : long.Parse(hospitalId);
            return PartialView("_ReportGuiMauXN");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Export_Pdf(DateTime from, DateTime to, string type, string location, long userid, string hospitalId)
        {
            var fromtime = new DateTime(from.Year, from.Month, from.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var totime = new DateTime(to.Year, to.Month, to.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            var user = await _userBL.GetUser(userid);
            var hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
            long? hospitalGuiMau = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(hospitalId) || hospitalId == "null") ? null : long.Parse(hospitalId);

            if (type == "1")
            {
                var lstReportResult = await _reportBL.GetReportByService(fromtime, totime, location, user.Name, hospitalGuiMau);
                if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        ViewData["lstReportResult"] = lstReportResult;
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Service_Content", hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Service_Header", hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Service_Footer", hospital);
                        var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "report");
                        var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, Guid.NewGuid() + ".pdf");
                        var fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Report(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                        return Content(fileBase64);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return Content(string.Empty);
            }
            else if (type == "2")
            {
                var lstReportResult = await _reportBL.GetReportByPatient(fromtime, totime, location, user.Name, hospitalGuiMau);
                if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        ViewData["lstReportResult"] = lstReportResult;
                        var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Patient_Content", hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Patient_Header", hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Patient_Footer", hospital);
                        var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "report");
                        var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, Guid.NewGuid() + ".pdf");
                        var fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Report(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                        return Content(fileBase64);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return Content(string.Empty);
            }
            else if (type == "3")
            {
                var lstReportResult = await _reportBL.GetReportByProcess(fromtime, totime, location, user.Name, hospitalGuiMau);
                if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        ViewData["lstReportResult"] = lstReportResult;
                        var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Process_Content", hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Process_Header", hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Process_Footer", hospital);
                        var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "report");
                        var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, Guid.NewGuid() + ".pdf");
                        var fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Report(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                        return Content(fileBase64);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return Content(string.Empty);
            }
            else if (type == "4")
            {
                var lstReportResult = await _reportBL.GetReportByTestCovid(fromtime, totime, user.Name, hospitalGuiMau);
                if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
                {
                    try
                    {

                        var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Covid_Content", hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Covid_Header", hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("_Covid_Footer", hospital);

                        var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, Guid.NewGuid() + ".pdf");
                        var fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Report_Landscape(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                        return Content(fileBase64);
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
                return Content(string.Empty);
            }
            return Content(string.Empty);
        }

using Management.BL;
using Management.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.RazorPages;
using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Object = Management.Models.Object;

namespace Management.Controllers
{
    public class SA_GetSampleController : Controller
    {
        public readonly ILogger<SA_GetSampleController> _logger;
        public readonly PatientCDHABL _patientCDHABL;
        public readonly ObjectBL _objectBL;
        public readonly LocationBL _locationBL;
        public readonly DoctorBL _doctorBL;
        public readonly UserBL _userBL;
        public readonly CategoryBL _categoryBL;
        public readonly ServiceBL _serviceBL;
        public readonly ResultCDHABL _resultCDHABL;
        public readonly SettingBL _settingBL;
        public readonly GroupBL _groupBL;
        public readonly string _SA = "SA";

        public SA_GetSampleController(ILogger<SA_GetSampleController> logger, PatientCDHABL patientCDHABL, ObjectBL objectBL, LocationBL locationBL,
                            DoctorBL doctorBL, UserBL userBL, CategoryBL categoryBL, ServiceBL serviceBL, ResultCDHABL resultCDHABL, SettingBL settingBL, GroupBL groupBL)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _patientCDHABL = patientCDHABL;
            _objectBL = objectBL;
            _locationBL = locationBL;
            _doctorBL = doctorBL;
            _userBL = userBL;
            _categoryBL = categoryBL;
            _serviceBL = serviceBL;
            _resultCDHABL = resultCDHABL;
            _settingBL = settingBL;
            _groupBL = groupBL;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSample()
        {
            var dateTimeNow = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeletePatientAndService(long id)
        {
            var _status = string.Empty;
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            if (await _resultCDHABL.DeleteByPatientId(id, _userLogin.Value))
            {
                _status = await _patientCDHABL.DeleteById(id, _SA) ? "/SA_GetSample/Refresh/" : string.Empty;
            }

            return Content(_status);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSID(string seq)
        {
            var _sid = string.Empty;
            if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seq))
            {
                var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
                _sid = _dateTime.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Year.ToString().Substring(2, 2) + "-" + seq;
            }
            return Content(_sid);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SavePatient(string id, string patientId, string seq, string sid, string patientName, DateTime age, 
                                                               string sex, string obj, string type, string location, string doctor, DateTime getSampleTime, 
                                                               string address, string diagnostic, string service)
        {
            var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(seq) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(sid))
            {
                seq = await _settingBL.GetSeq();
                sid = _dateTime.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Year.ToString().Substring(2, 2) + "-" + seq;
            }
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();            
            long? _id = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? null : long.Parse(id);
            var _patient = await _patientCDHABL.SaveOrUpdate(_id, patientId, seq, sid, patientName, age, sex, obj, type, location, doctor, getSampleTime, address, diagnostic, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, true, false, false, _SA);
            
            return Content(_patient == null ? string.Empty : _patient.Id.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> AddServiceForPatient(long patientId, long serviceId, long doctorId)
        {
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var _save = await _resultCDHABL.SaveService(patientId, serviceId, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, doctorId, _SA.ToLower());

            return Content(_save.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteServiceForPatient(long id)
        {
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            var _delete = await _resultCDHABL.DeleteById(id, _userLogin.Value);
            return Content(_delete.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ProcessResult(long id, DateTime getSampleTime)
        {
            var _exitResultCDHA = await _resultCDHABL.ExitResultXN_Update_GetSampleTime(id, getSampleTime, _SA);
            var _getSample = false;
            if (_exitResultCDHA)
            {
                var _userLogin =  this.GetUserLogin();
                _getSample = await _patientCDHABL.GetSample_ProcessResult_ReturnResult(id, false, true, false, _userLogin.Value, _SA);
            }          
            return Content(_getSample.ToString());
        }


        public long? GetUserLogin()
        {
            long? userId = null;
            try
            {
                userId = long.Parse(HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserId")?.Value);
            }
            catch { }
            return userId;
        }
    }
}

using Management.BL;
using Management.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;

using System.IO;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using IHostingEnvironment = Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting.IHostingEnvironment;

namespace Management.Controllers
{
    public class SA_ProcessController : Controller
    {
        private readonly ILogger<SA_ProcessController> _logger;
        private readonly PatientCDHABL _patientCDHABL;
        private readonly ObjectBL _objectBL;
        private readonly LocationBL _locationBL;
        private readonly DoctorBL _doctorBL;
        private readonly UserBL _userBL;

        private readonly SampleBL _sampleBL;

        public readonly DeviceBL _deviceBL;
        public readonly string _SA = "SA";

        public SA_ProcessController(ILogger<SA_ProcessController> logger, PatientCDHABL patientCDHABL, ObjectBL objectBL, LocationBL locationBL,
                            DoctorBL doctorBL, UserBL userBL, CategoryBL categoryBL, ServiceBL serviceBL, ResultCDHABL resultCDHABL,
                            SettingBL settingBL, GroupBL groupBL, IWebHostEnvironment environment, ToolBL toolBL, HospitalBL hospitalBL, SampleBL sampleBL, DeviceBL deviceBL)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _patientCDHABL = patientCDHABL;
            _objectBL = objectBL;
            _locationBL = locationBL;
            _doctorBL = doctorBL;
            _userBL = userBL;
            _categoryBL = categoryBL;
            _serviceBL = serviceBL;
            _resultCDHABL = resultCDHABL;
            _settingBL = settingBL;
            _groupBL = groupBL;
            _environment = environment;
            _toolBL = toolBL;
            _hospitalBL = hospitalBL;
            _sampleBL = sampleBL;
            _deviceBL = deviceBL;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]

        {
            var dateTimeNow = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);

        }

        {

            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);

            var countProcess = await _patientCDHABL.Get_CountPatient(from, to, false, true, false, _SA);
            var countReturnResult = await _patientCDHABL.Get_CountPatient(from, to, false, false, true, _SA);
            ViewData["countGetSample"] = countGetSample;

            return PartialView("_SA_Process_ListService");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetImageForService(long id)
        {
            var _resultCDHA = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHA(id);
            if (_resultCDHA != null)
            {
                var _lstItem = new List<object>();
                if (_resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs.Count > 0)
                {
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        _lstItem.Add(new { Id = item.Id, Name = item.ImagePath, Description = item.ResultCDHA.Description, Result = item.ResultCDHA.Result, Suggest = item.ResultCDHA.Suggest });
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    _lstItem.Add(new { Description = _resultCDHA.Description, Result = _resultCDHA.Result, Suggest = _resultCDHA.Suggest });

                }
                return Json(_lstItem);
            }
            else
            {
                return Json(null);
            }
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSampleForService(long id)
        {
            var _sample = await _sampleBL.GetSample(id);
            var _item = new { Description = _sample.Description, Result = _sample.Result, Suggest = _sample.Suggest };
            return Json(_item);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveImageCDHA([FromBody] ImageModel imageObj)
        {
            var guid = Guid.NewGuid();
            var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "images", "result", "sa");
            var _imagePath1 = Path.Combine(_folder, imageObj.resultCDHAId + "-" + guid + ".png");
            var _image = _toolBL.Base64ToImage(imageObj.imageString);
            var _saveImage = _toolBL.SaveImage(_folder, _imagePath1, _image);

            if (_saveImage)
            {
                var _imagePath = "/images/result/sa/" + imageObj.resultCDHAId + "-" + guid + ".png";
                _saveImage = await _resultCDHABL.SaveImage(long.Parse(imageObj.resultCDHAId), _imagePath, _imagePath1);
            }
            return Content(_saveImage.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteImageCDHA(long imageCDHAId)
        {
            var _imagePath1_resultCDHAId = await _resultCDHABL.DeleteImage(imageCDHAId);
            var _imagePath1 = string.Empty;
            var _resultCDHAId = string.Empty;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_imagePath1_resultCDHAId))
            {
                _imagePath1 = _imagePath1_resultCDHAId.Split(';')[0];
                var _delete = _toolBL.DeleteImage(_imagePath1);
                if (_delete) _resultCDHAId = _imagePath1_resultCDHAId.Split(';')[1];
            }
            return Content(_resultCDHAId);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveResult([FromBody] ResultCDHAModel resultCDHA)
        {
            var _saveResult = false;
            if (resultCDHA != null)
            {
                var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
                var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
                var _device = this.GetSession_Device();
                await _patientCDHABL.Update(resultCDHA.patientId, resultCDHA.returnResultTime, resultCDHA.userReturnResult, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, _SA);
                _saveResult = await _resultCDHABL.Update(resultCDHA, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, _device);
            }
            return Content(_saveResult.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ValidPrint([FromBody] ResultCDHAModel resultCDHA)
        {
            if (resultCDHA != null)
            {
                var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
                var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
                var _device = this.GetSession_Device();
                if (await _resultCDHABL.Update(resultCDHA, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, _device))
                {
                    if (await _patientCDHABL.Update(resultCDHA.patientId, resultCDHA.returnResultTime, resultCDHA.userReturnResult, false, false, true, _userLogin.Value, _SA))
                    {
                        var _result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHAByPatientId_ForValidPrint(resultCDHA.resultCDHAId);
                        if (_result != null)
                        {
                            try
                            {
                                ViewData["ResultCDHA"] = _result;
                                var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                                var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("Content", _hospital);
                                var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("Header", _hospital);
                                var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("Footer", _hospital);
                                var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "sa");
                                var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, _result?.KeyResultForHis + ".pdf");
                                var fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Result(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                                return Content(fileBase64);
                            }
                            catch { }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return Content(string.Empty);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Check_SelectDevice()
        {
            var _device = GetSession_Device();
            var _selectDevice = _device == null ? false : true;
            return Content(_selectDevice.ToString());
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SelectDevice(long deviceId)
        {
            var _status = false;
            try
            {
                var _device = await _deviceBL.Get(deviceId);
                if (_device != null)
                {
                    var device = new Device() { Id = _device.Id, Code = _device.Code, Name = _device.Name, CodeBHYT = _device.CodeBHYT };
                    CookieOptions cookieOptions = new CookieOptions() { Expires = new DateTimeOffset(DateTime.Now.AddDays(1)) };
                    string value = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(device, Formatting.Indented,
                                   new JsonSerializerSettings() { ReferenceLoopHandling = ReferenceLoopHandling.Ignore });
                    HttpContext.Response.Cookies.Append(SessionKeyModel._sessionDeviceSA, value, cookieOptions);
                    _status = true;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return Content(_status.ToString());
        }

        public long? GetUserLogin()
        {
            long? userId = null;
            try
            {
                userId = long.Parse(HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserId")?.Value);
            }
            catch { }
            return userId;
        }

        public Device GetSession_Device()
        {
            string _value = HttpContext.Request.Cookies[SessionKeyModel._sessionDeviceSA];
            Device _device = null;
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(_value))
            {
                _device = JsonConvert.DeserializeObject<Device>(_value);
            }
            return _device;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetUserInfo(long userId)
        {
            var u = await _userBL.GetUser(userId);
            if (u == null) return Json(null);

            // Trả về các field bạn cần dùng ở UI/PDF
            return Json(new
            {
                u.Name,
                u.Active,
                u.MaBHYT,
                u.Cccd
            });
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SaveSignStoreIdForResultCDHA(long resultCDHAId, long signStoreId)
        {
            var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();

            if (resultCDHAId <= 0 || signStoreId < 0)
                return BadRequest("resultCDHAId hoặc signStoreId không hợp lệ.");

            try
            {
                // Gọi BL để lưu (giả định chữ ký: UpdateSignStoreId_CKS(long id, string signStoreId))
                var ok = await _resultCDHABL.UpdateSignStoreId_CKS(resultCDHAId, signStoreId, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime);
                if (ok == true)
                {
                    var _resultCDHA = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHA(resultCDHAId);
                    var _keyResult = _resultCDHA.KeyResultForHis;
                    return Json(new { success = true, keyResult = _keyResult });
                }
                else
                {
                    return Json(new { success = false, message = "Lỗi lưu signStoreId." });

                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _logger.LogError(ex, "SaveSignStoreIdForResultCDHA failed");
                return StatusCode(500, "Lỗi lưu signStoreId.");
            }
        }


        [HttpGet]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public async Task<IActionResult> TestAutoPushUpdateStatusHis()
        {
            try
            {
                var apiBL = new APIBL();
                await apiBL.Auto_PushResultBHYT();
                return Json(new { success = true, message = "Auto_PushResultBHYT executed successfully" });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
            }
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [AllowAnonymous]
        public async Task<IActionResult> TestAutoGetPatientAndService()
        {
            try
            {
                var apiBL = new APIBL();
                await apiBL.Auto_GetPatientAndService();
                return Json(new { success = true, message = "Auto_GetPatientAndService executed successfully" });
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                return Json(new { success = false, message = ex.Message });
            }
        }

    }
}

            if (_resultCDHA != null)
            {
                var _lstItem = new List<object>();
                if (_resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs.Count > 0)
                {
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        _lstItem.Add(new { Id = item.Id, Name = item.ImagePath, Description = item.ResultCDHA.Description, Result = item.ResultCDHA.Result, Suggest = item.ResultCDHA.Suggest });
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    _lstItem.Add(new { Description = _resultCDHA.Description, Result = _resultCDHA.Result, Suggest = _resultCDHA.Suggest });

                }
                return Json(_lstItem);
            }
            else
            {
                return Json(null);
            }
        }

        {

            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            var _process = await _patientCDHABL.GetSample_ProcessResult_ReturnResult(id, false, true, false, _userLogin.Value, _SA);
            return Content(_process.ToString());
        }


        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Print(long resultCDHAId)
        {
            var _result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHAByPatientId_ForValidPrint(resultCDHAId);
            var fileBase64 = string.Empty;
            if (_result != null)
            {
                var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "sa");
                var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, _result?.KeyResultForHis + ".pdf");
                try
                {
                    if (System.IO.File.Exists(_file))
                    {
                        fileBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(_file));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ViewData["ResultCDHA"] = _result;
                        var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("Content", _hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("Header", _hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("Footer", _hospital);
                        fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Result(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
            return Content(fileBase64);
        }

        //[HttpGet]
        //public async Task<IActionResult> Print()
        //{
        //    var _result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHAByPatientId_ForValidPrint(45);
        //    ViewData["ResultCDHA"] = _result;
        //    var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
        //    return View(_hospital);
        //}


        public long? GetUserLogin()
        {
            long? userId = null;
            try
            {
                userId = long.Parse(HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserId")?.Value);
            }
            catch { }
            return userId;
        }


        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSignStoreId(long resultId)
        {
            if (resultId <= 0)
                return Json(new { signStoreId = (string?)null });

            // Tận dụng BL hiện có để lấy record kết quả rồi đọc SignStoreId
            var result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHA(resultId);
            var id = result?.SignStoreId;          // tên property đúng với cột DB của bạn

            // Trả JSON để JS dùng trực tiếp
            return Json(new { signStoreId = id });
        }
    }
}

using Management.BL;
using Management.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authorization;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc;

using Newtonsoft.Json;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Net;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Security.Cryptography;
using Object = Management.Models.Object;

namespace Management.Controllers
{
    public class SA_TIM_GetSampleController : Controller
    {
        public readonly ILogger<SA_GetSampleController> _logger;
        public readonly PatientCDHABL _patientCDHABL;

        public readonly DoctorBL _doctorBL;

        public SA_TIM_GetSampleController(ILogger<SA_GetSampleController> logger, PatientCDHABL patientCDHABL, ObjectBL objectBL, LocationBL locationBL,
                            DoctorBL doctorBL, UserBL userBL, CategoryBL categoryBL, ServiceBL serviceBL, ResultCDHABL resultCDHABL, SettingBL settingBL, GroupBL groupBL, DeviceBL deviceBL)
        {
            _logger = logger;
            _patientCDHABL = patientCDHABL;
            _objectBL = objectBL;
            _locationBL = locationBL;
            _doctorBL = doctorBL;
            _userBL = userBL;
            _categoryBL = categoryBL;
            _serviceBL = serviceBL;

            _groupBL = groupBL;
            _deviceBL = deviceBL;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSample()
        {
            var dateTimeNow = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);

            ViewData["lstPatient"] = await _patientCDHABL.Get_ListPatient(from, to, true, false, false, _SAT);
            ViewData["lstObject"] = await _objectBL.GetListObject();
            ViewData["lstLocation"] = await _locationBL.GetListLocation();
            ViewData["lstDoctor"] = await _doctorBL.GetList();
            ViewData["lstSexModel"] = await SexModel.GetListSexModel();
            ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] = await BenhAnModel.GetListBenhAnModel();

        {

            if (await _resultCDHABL.DeleteByPatientId(id, _userLogin.Value))
            {
                _status = await _patientCDHABL.DeleteById(id, _SAT) ? "/SA_GetSample/Refresh/" : string.Empty;
            }

            return Content(_status);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSID(string seq)
        {
            var _sid = string.Empty;
            if(!string.IsNullOrEmpty(seq))
            {
                var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
                _sid = _dateTime.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Year.ToString().Substring(2, 2) + "-" + seq;
            }
            return Content(_sid);
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SavePatient(string id, string patientId, string seq, string sid, string patientName, DateTime age, 
                                                               string sex, string obj, string type, string location, string doctor, DateTime getSampleTime, 
                                                               string address, string diagnostic, string service)
        {
            var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(seq) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(sid))
            {
                seq = await _settingBL.GetSeq();
                sid = _dateTime.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + _dateTime.Year.ToString().Substring(2, 2) + "-" + seq;
            }
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();            
            long? _id = string.IsNullOrEmpty(id) ? null : long.Parse(id);
            var _patient = await _patientCDHABL.SaveOrUpdate(_id, patientId, seq, sid, patientName, age, sex, obj, type, location, doctor, getSampleTime, address, diagnostic, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, true, false, false, _SAT);
            
            return Content(_patient == null ? string.Empty : _patient.Id.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> AddServiceForPatient(long patientId, long serviceId, long doctorId)
        {
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            var _dateTime = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var _save = await _resultCDHABL.SaveService(patientId, serviceId, _userLogin.Value, _dateTime, doctorId, _SAT.ToLower());

            return Content(_save.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> DeleteServiceForPatient(long id)
        {
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            var _delete = await _resultCDHABL.DeleteById(id, _userLogin.Value);
            return Content(_delete.ToString());
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> ProcessResult(long id, DateTime getSampleTime)
        {
            var _exitResultCDHA = await _resultCDHABL.ExitResultXN_Update_GetSampleTime(id, getSampleTime, _SAT);
            var _getSample = false;
            if (_exitResultCDHA)
            {
                var _userLogin =  this.GetUserLogin();
                _getSample = await _patientCDHABL.GetSample_ProcessResult_ReturnResult(id, false, true, false, _userLogin.Value, _SAT);
            }          
            return Content(_getSample.ToString());
        }


        public long? GetUserLogin()
        {
            long? userId = null;
            try
            {
                userId = long.Parse(HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserId")?.Value);
            }
            catch { }
            return userId;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> SelectDevice(long deviceId)
        {
            var _status = false;
            try
            {
                var _device = await _deviceBL.Get(deviceId);
                if (_device != null)
                {
                    var device = new Device() { Id = _device.Id, Code = _device.Code, Name = _device.Name, CodeBHYT = _device.CodeBHYT };
                    CookieOptions cookieOptions = new CookieOptions() { Expires = new DateTimeOffset(DateTime.Now.AddHours(4)) };
                    string value = JsonConvert.SerializeObject(device, Formatting.Indented,
                                   new JsonSerializerSettings() { ReferenceLoopHandling = ReferenceLoopHandling.Ignore });
                    HttpContext.Response.Cookies.Append(SessionKeyModel._sessionDeviceSA, value, cookieOptions);
                    _status = true;
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return Content(_status.ToString());
        }
    }
}

        [HttpGet]
