            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            var countGetSample = await _patientCDHABL.Get_CountPatient(from, to, true, false, false, _XQ);
            var countProcess = await _patientCDHABL.Get_CountPatient(from, to, false, true, false, _XQ);
            var countReturnResult = await _patientCDHABL.Get_CountPatient(from, to, false, false, true, _XQ);
            ViewData["countGetSample"] = countGetSample;
            ViewData["countProcess"] = countProcess;
            ViewData["countReturnResult"] = countReturnResult;

            return Content(countGetSample + ";" + countProcess + ";" + countReturnResult);
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Refresh()
        {
            var dateTimeNow = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            ViewData["lstPatient"] = await _patientCDHABL.Get_ListPatientByPidOrSid(from, to, false, false, true, null, _XQ);

            return PartialView("_XQ_ReturnResult_ListPatient");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Search(string pidorseq, DateTime timeSearchFrom, DateTime timeSearchTo)
        {
            var from = new DateTime(timeSearchFrom.Year, timeSearchFrom.Month, timeSearchFrom.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(timeSearchTo.Year, timeSearchTo.Month, timeSearchTo.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            ViewData["lstPatient"] = await _patientCDHABL.Get_ListPatientByPidOrSid(from, to, false, false, true, pidorseq, _XQ);

            return PartialView("_XQ_ReturnResult_ListPatient");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetPatientInfo(long id)
        {
            ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] = await BenhAnModel.GetListBenhAnModel();
            ViewData["patientInfo"] = await _patientCDHABL.Get_PatientBySid(id);

            return PartialView("_XQ_ReturnResult_PatientInfo");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetServiceForPatient(long patientId)
        {
            ViewData["lstResultCDHAs"] = await _resultCDHABL.GetListResultCDHAByPatientId(patientId, _XQ);
            return PartialView("_XQ_ReturnResult_ListService");
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Get_Description_Result_Suggest_ForService(long id)
        {
            var _resultCDHA = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHA(id);
            if (_resultCDHA != null)
            {
                var _lstItem = new List<object>() { new { Description = _resultCDHA.Description, Result = _resultCDHA.Result, Suggest = _resultCDHA.Suggest } };
                return Json(_lstItem);
            }
            else
            {
                return Json(null);
            }
        }

        [HttpPost]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Invalid(long id)
        {
            var _userLogin = this.GetUserLogin();
            var dateTimeNow = ToolBL.Get_DateNow();
            var from = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59).AddDays(-1);
            var to = new DateTime(dateTimeNow.Year, dateTimeNow.Month, dateTimeNow.Day, 23, 59, 59);
            var _process = await _patientCDHABL.GetSample_ProcessResult_ReturnResult(id, false, true, false, _userLogin.Value, _XQ);
            return Content(_process.ToString());
        }


        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> Print(long resultCDHAId)
        {
            var _result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHAByPatientId_ForValidPrint(resultCDHAId);
            var fileBase64 = string.Empty;
            if (_result != null)
            {
                var _folder = Path.Combine(_environment.WebRootPath, "pdf", "xq");
                var _file = Path.Combine(_folder, _result?.KeyResultForHis + ".pdf");
                try
                {
                    if (System.IO.File.Exists(_file))
                    {
                        fileBase64 = Convert.ToBase64String(System.IO.File.ReadAllBytes(_file));
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        ViewData["ResultCDHA"] = _result;
                        var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
                        var content = await this.RenderViewAsync("Content", _hospital);
                        var header = await this.RenderViewAsync("Header", _hospital);
                        var footer = await this.RenderViewAsync("Footer", _hospital);
                        fileBase64 = await _toolBL.ExportPdf_Result(_folder, _file, header, content, footer);
                    }
                }
                catch { }
            }
            return Content(fileBase64);
        }

        //[HttpGet]
        //public async Task<IActionResult> Print()
        //{
        //    var _result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHAByPatientId_ForValidPrint(45);
        //    ViewData["ResultCDHA"] = _result;
        //    var _hospital = await _hospitalBL.GetHospital();
        //    return View(_hospital);
        //}


        public long? GetUserLogin()
        {
            long? userId = null;
            try
            {
                userId = long.Parse(HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserId")?.Value);
            }
            catch { }
            return userId;
        }

        [HttpGet]
        [Authorize]
        public async Task<IActionResult> GetSignStoreId(long resultId)
        {
            if (resultId <= 0)
                return Json(new { signStoreId = (string?)null });

            // Tận dụng BL hiện có để lấy record kết quả rồi đọc SignStoreId
            var result = await _resultCDHABL.GetResultCDHA(resultId);
            var id = result?.SignStoreId;          // tên property đúng với cột DB của bạn

            // Trả JSON để JS dùng trực tiếp
            return Json(new { signStoreId = id });
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-01.5-01-PRECHECK.sql">
/* =====================================================================
   FILE:
   PACS-XQ-01.5-01-PRECHECK.sql

   PURPOSE:
   - Kiểm tra trạng thái database TRƯỚC khi tích hợp PACS.
   - KHÔNG tạo table.
   - KHÔNG ALTER table.
   - KHÔNG INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE dữ liệu.

   PACS architecture:
   - Shared PACS subsystem.
   - XQ chỉ là consumer đầu tiên.
   - Có thể reuse cho CT / MRI / MG / SA / ... sau này.

   EXPECTED BEFORE FIRST MIGRATION:
   - ResultCDHA PACS columns : chưa tồn tại
   - PACS tables             : chưa tồn tại
   - PacsSyncStates index    : chưa tồn tại
   ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @CurrentDatabase sysname = DB_NAME();

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS DATABASE PRECHECK';
PRINT N' Database : ' + ISNULL(@CurrentDatabase, N'<NULL>');
PRINT N' Time     : ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(30), SYSDATETIME(), 121);
PRINT N'============================================================';

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SAFETY GUARD
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @CurrentDatabase IN (N'master', N'model', N'msdb', N'tempdb')
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(
        N'PACS PRECHECK: Không được chạy script trên system database.',
        16,
        1
    );

    RETURN;
END;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A. DATABASE INFORMATION
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
    DB_NAME() AS CurrentDatabase,
    SUSER_SNAME() AS LoginName,
    @@SERVERNAME AS SqlServerName,
    SYSDATETIME() AS CheckedAt;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B. KIỂM TRA TABLE ResultCDHA
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- B. CHECK ResultCDHA -------------------------------------';

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'ERROR' AS Status,
        N'dbo.ResultCDHA' AS ObjectName,
        N'Không tìm thấy table dbo.ResultCDHA.' AS Message;
END
ELSE
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'OK' AS Status,
        N'dbo.ResultCDHA' AS ObjectName,
        N'Table tồn tại.' AS Message;
END;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- C. KIỂM TRA 4 COLUMN PACS TRONG ResultCDHA
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- C. CHECK ResultCDHA PACS COLUMNS ------------------------';

;WITH ExpectedColumns AS
(
    SELECT N'AccessionNumber' AS ColumnName
    UNION ALL SELECT N'StudyInstanceUID'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'OrthancStudyId'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStatus'
)
SELECT
    e.ColumnName AS ExpectedColumn,
    c.COLUMN_NAME AS ActualColumn,
    c.DATA_TYPE AS DataType,
    c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS MaxLength,
    c.IS_NULLABLE AS IsNullable,
    CASE
        WHEN c.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL
            THEN N'NOT_EXISTS'
        ELSE N'EXISTS'
    END AS Status
FROM ExpectedColumns e
LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
    ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
   AND c.TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
   AND c.COLUMN_NAME = e.ColumnName
ORDER BY e.ColumnName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D. KIỂM TRA 6 TABLE PACS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- D. CHECK PACS TABLES ------------------------------------';

;WITH ExpectedTables AS
(
    SELECT N'PacsConfigs' AS TableName
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSeries'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems'
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSyncStates'
)
SELECT
    e.TableName,
    CASE
        WHEN t.object_id IS NULL
            THEN N'NOT_EXISTS'
        ELSE N'EXISTS'
    END AS Status
FROM ExpectedTables e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
   AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
ORDER BY e.TableName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- E. HIỂN THỊ COLUMN CỦA CÁC TABLE PACS NẾU ĐÃ TỒN TẠI
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- E. EXISTING PACS TABLE SCHEMA ----------------------------';

SELECT
    c.TABLE_NAME,
    c.ORDINAL_POSITION,
    c.COLUMN_NAME,
    c.DATA_TYPE,
    c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
    c.IS_NULLABLE,
    c.COLUMN_DEFAULT
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
WHERE c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
  AND c.TABLE_NAME IN
  (
      N'PacsConfigs',
      N'PacsStudies',
      N'PacsSeries',
      N'PacsInstances',
      N'PacsWorklistItems',
      N'PacsSyncStates'
  )
ORDER BY
    c.TABLE_NAME,
    c.ORDINAL_POSITION;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F. KIỂM TRA UNIQUE INDEX PacsSyncStates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- F. CHECK PACS SYNC UNIQUE INDEX --------------------------';

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    i.name AS IndexName,
    i.is_unique AS IsUnique,
    i.is_primary_key AS IsPrimaryKey,
    i.is_disabled AS IsDisabled
FROM sys.indexes i
INNER JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.object_id = i.object_id
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'dbo'
  AND t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
  AND i.name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId';

IF NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.indexes i
    INNER JOIN sys.tables t
        ON t.object_id = i.object_id
    INNER JOIN sys.schemas s
        ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
    WHERE s.name = N'dbo'
      AND t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
      AND i.name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId'
)
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'NOT_EXISTS' AS Status,
        N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId' AS IndexName;
END;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- G. KIỂM TRA DEFAULT CONSTRAINT PacsSyncStates NẾU TABLE TỒN TẠI
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- G. CHECK PACS SYNC DEFAULTS ------------------------------';

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    c.name AS ColumnName,
    dc.name AS ConstraintName,
    dc.definition AS DefaultDefinition
FROM sys.default_constraints dc
INNER JOIN sys.columns c
    ON c.object_id = dc.parent_object_id
   AND c.column_id = dc.parent_column_id
INNER JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.object_id = dc.parent_object_id
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'dbo'
  AND t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
  AND c.name IN
  (
      N'LastChangeSeq',
      N'CreatedOn'
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- H. SUMMARY
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- H. PRECHECK SUMMARY -------------------------------------';

DECLARE @ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount int;

SELECT
    @ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount = COUNT(*)
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
  AND TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
  AND COLUMN_NAME IN
  (
      N'AccessionNumber',
      N'StudyInstanceUID',
      N'OrthancStudyId',
      N'PacsStatus'
  );

DECLARE @PacsTableCount int;

SELECT
    @PacsTableCount = COUNT(*)
FROM sys.tables t
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'dbo'
  AND t.name IN
  (
      N'PacsConfigs',
      N'PacsStudies',
      N'PacsSeries',
      N'PacsInstances',
      N'PacsWorklistItems',
      N'PacsSyncStates'
  );

DECLARE @SyncIndexCount int;

SELECT
    @SyncIndexCount = COUNT(*)
FROM sys.indexes i
INNER JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.object_id = i.object_id
INNER JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
WHERE s.name = N'dbo'
  AND t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
  AND i.name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId'
  AND i.is_unique = 1;

SELECT
    @CurrentDatabase AS CurrentDatabase,
    @ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount AS ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount,
    @PacsTableCount AS PacsTableCount,
    @SyncIndexCount AS SyncUniqueIndexCount,
    CASE
        WHEN @ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount = 0
         AND @PacsTableCount = 0
         AND @SyncIndexCount = 0
            THEN N'CLEAN_BASELINE'
        WHEN @ResultCDHAPacsColumnCount = 4
         AND @PacsTableCount = 6
         AND @SyncIndexCount = 1
            THEN N'PACS_ALREADY_PRESENT'
        ELSE N'PARTIAL_STATE_REVIEW_REQUIRED'
    END AS DatabaseState;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS PRECHECK FINISHED';
PRINT N'============================================================';
</file>

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-01.5-02-MIGRATION.sql">
/* =====================================================================
   FILE:
   PACS-XQ-01.5-02-MIGRATION.sql

   PURPOSE:
   - Tích hợp PACS database schema vào Project A.
   - Shared PACS schema.
   - XQ là consumer đầu tiên, schema KHÔNG phụ thuộc XQ.

   CHANGES:
   1. Add 4 PACS columns to ResultCDHA
   2. Create PacsConfigs
   3. Create PacsStudies
   4. Create PacsSeries
   5. Create PacsInstances
   6. Create PacsWorklistItems
   7. Create PacsSyncStates
   8. Create unique index UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId

   IMPORTANT:
   - Script is rerun-safe.
   - Không tạo FK ngoài baseline Project B.
   - Không tạo module-specific PACS tables.
   - Không hard-code database name.
   ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

DECLARE @CurrentDatabase sysname = DB_NAME();

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS DATABASE MIGRATION';
PRINT N' Database : ' + ISNULL(@CurrentDatabase, N'<NULL>');
PRINT N' Time     : ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(30), SYSDATETIME(), 121);
PRINT N'============================================================';

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SAFETY GUARD
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @CurrentDatabase IN (N'master', N'model', N'msdb', N'tempdb')
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(
        N'PACS MIGRATION: Không được chạy migration trên system database.',
        16,
        1
    );

    RETURN;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(
        N'PACS MIGRATION: Không tìm thấy dbo.ResultCDHA. Dừng migration.',
        16,
        1
    );

    RETURN;
END;

BEGIN TRY

    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    /* ================================================================
       STEP 1
       RESULTCDHA - PACS COLUMNS
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 1: ResultCDHA PACS columns -------------------------';

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'AccessionNumber') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ADD AccessionNumber nvarchar(max) NULL;

        PRINT N'ADDED dbo.ResultCDHA.AccessionNumber';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.ResultCDHA.AccessionNumber - already exists';
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'StudyInstanceUID') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ADD StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(max) NULL;

        PRINT N'ADDED dbo.ResultCDHA.StudyInstanceUID';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.ResultCDHA.StudyInstanceUID - already exists';
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'OrthancStudyId') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ADD OrthancStudyId nvarchar(max) NULL;

        PRINT N'ADDED dbo.ResultCDHA.OrthancStudyId';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.ResultCDHA.OrthancStudyId - already exists';
    END;

    IF COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'PacsStatus') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ADD PacsStatus nvarchar(max) NULL;

        PRINT N'ADDED dbo.ResultCDHA.PacsStatus';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.ResultCDHA.PacsStatus - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 2
       PACS CONFIGS
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 2: PacsConfigs -------------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsConfigs', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsConfigs
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            Code nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,
            Name nvarchar(250) NOT NULL,
            ServerType nvarchar(50) NOT NULL,

            BaseUrl nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,

            ApiUsername nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,
            ApiPassword nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,

            DicomAETitle nvarchar(100) NOT NULL,
            DicomHost nvarchar(250) NOT NULL,
            DicomPort int NULL,

            DicomWebRoot nvarchar(250) NOT NULL,
            OhifViewerUrl nvarchar(500) NOT NULL,

            SyncEnabled bit NOT NULL,
            SyncIntervalSeconds int NOT NULL,

            IsDefault bit NOT NULL,
            IsActive bit NOT NULL,

            LastStatus nvarchar(50) NOT NULL,

            LastApiStatus bit NULL,
            LastStudiesStatus bit NULL,
            LastDicomWebStatus bit NULL,
            LastDicomPortStatus bit NULL,

            LastCheckedAt datetime2 NULL,
            LastError nvarchar(max) NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL,
            CreatedBy bigint NULL,

            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,
            UpdatedBy bigint NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsConfigs
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsConfigs';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsConfigs - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 3
       PACS STUDIES
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 3: PacsStudies -------------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsStudies
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            PatientDbId bigint NULL,
            ResultCDHAId bigint NULL,
            ServiceId bigint NULL,

            PatientId nvarchar(max) NULL,
            PatientName nvarchar(max) NULL,
            PatientBirthDate nvarchar(max) NULL,
            PatientSex nvarchar(max) NULL,

            MaBenhAn nvarchar(max) NULL,

            AccessionNumber nvarchar(max) NULL,

            StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            OrthancStudyId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            StudyDate nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            StudyTime nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            StudyDescription nvarchar(max) NULL,
            RequestedProcedureDescription nvarchar(max) NULL,

            Modality nvarchar(max) NULL,
            ReferringPhysicianName nvarchar(max) NULL,
            InstitutionName nvarchar(max) NULL,

            SeriesCount int NOT NULL,
            InstanceCount int NOT NULL,

            Status nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            RawJson nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL,
            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsStudies
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsStudies';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsStudies - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 4
       PACS SERIES
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 4: PacsSeries --------------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsSeries
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            PacsStudyId bigint NOT NULL,

            OrthancSeriesId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            OrthancParentStudyId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            SeriesInstanceUID nvarchar(max) NULL,
            SeriesNumber nvarchar(max) NULL,
            SeriesDescription nvarchar(max) NULL,

            Modality nvarchar(max) NULL,
            ProtocolName nvarchar(max) NULL,

            InstanceCount int NOT NULL,

            OrthancStatus nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            RawJson nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL,
            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsSeries
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsSeries';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsSeries - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 5
       PACS INSTANCES
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 5: PacsInstances -----------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            PacsStudyId bigint NOT NULL,
            PacsSeriesId bigint NOT NULL,

            OrthancInstanceId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            OrthancParentSeriesId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            SOPInstanceUID nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            InstanceNumber nvarchar(max) NULL,
            ImageIndex nvarchar(max) NULL,

            SopClassUID nvarchar(max) NULL,
            TransferSyntaxUID nvarchar(max) NULL,

            OrthancStatus nvarchar(max) NULL,

            RawJson nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL,
            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsInstances
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsInstances';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsInstances - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 6
       PACS WORKLIST ITEMS
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 6: PacsWorklistItems -------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsWorklistItems', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsWorklistItems
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            ResultCDHAId bigint NOT NULL,
            PatientId bigint NULL,
            ServiceId bigint NULL,

            AccessionNumber nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            PatientCode nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            PatientName nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            PatientBirthDate datetime2 NULL,
            PatientSex nvarchar(max) NULL,

            MaBenhAn nvarchar(max) NULL,

            Seq nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            Sid nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            ServiceCode nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            ServiceName nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            CategoryCode nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            Modality nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            RequestedProcedureId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            RequestedProcedureDescription nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            ScheduledStationAETitle nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,
            ScheduledProcedureStepId nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            ScheduledProcedureStepStartDate datetime2 NULL,
            ScheduledProcedureStepStartTime time NULL,

            ScheduledProcedureStepDescription nvarchar(max) NOT NULL,

            ReferringPhysicianName nvarchar(max) NULL,
            ScheduledPerformingPhysicianName nvarchar(max) NULL,

            StudyDescription nvarchar(max) NULL,
            Diagnosis nvarchar(max) NULL,

            DumpFileName nvarchar(max) NULL,
            DumpFilePath nvarchar(max) NULL,

            WorklistFileName nvarchar(max) NULL,
            WorklistFilePath nvarchar(max) NULL,

            OrthancWorklistId nvarchar(max) NULL,

            OrthancStudyId nvarchar(max) NULL,
            StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(max) NULL,

            Status int NOT NULL,
            ErrorMessage nvarchar(max) NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL,
            CreatedBy bigint NULL,

            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,
            UpdatedBy bigint NULL,

            PublishedOn datetime2 NULL,
            CompletedOn datetime2 NULL,
            CanceledOn datetime2 NULL,

            LastRecoveryCheckedOn datetime2 NULL,
            LastReconciliationCheckedOn datetime2 NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsWorklistItems
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsWorklistItems';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsWorklistItems - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 7
       PACS SYNC STATES
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 7: PacsSyncStates ----------------------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates', N'U') IS NULL
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE dbo.PacsSyncStates
        (
            Id bigint IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL,

            PacsConfigId bigint NOT NULL,

            LastChangeSeq bigint NOT NULL
                CONSTRAINT DF_PacsSyncStates_LastChangeSeq
                DEFAULT (0),

            LastRunAt datetime2 NULL,
            LastSuccessAt datetime2 NULL,

            LastError nvarchar(max) NULL,

            CreatedOn datetime2 NOT NULL
                CONSTRAINT DF_PacsSyncStates_CreatedOn
                DEFAULT (GETDATE()),

            UpdatedOn datetime2 NULL,

            CONSTRAINT PK_PacsSyncStates
                PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id)
        );

        PRINT N'CREATED dbo.PacsSyncStates';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP dbo.PacsSyncStates - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       STEP 8
       PACS SYNC UNIQUE INDEX
       ================================================================ */

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'--- STEP 8: PacsSyncStates unique index ---------------------';

    IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates', N'U') IS NOT NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS
       (
           SELECT 1
           FROM sys.indexes
           WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates')
             AND name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId'
       )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId
            ON dbo.PacsSyncStates(PacsConfigId);

        PRINT N'CREATED UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId';
    END
    ELSE
    BEGIN
        PRINT N'SKIP UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId - already exists';
    END;


    /* ================================================================
       COMMIT
       ================================================================ */

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'============================================================';
    PRINT N' PACS DATABASE MIGRATION COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY';
    PRINT N' Database : ' + DB_NAME();
    PRINT N'============================================================';

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH

    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    END;

    DECLARE @ErrorNumber int;
    DECLARE @ErrorSeverity int;
    DECLARE @ErrorState int;
    DECLARE @ErrorLine int;
    DECLARE @ErrorProcedure nvarchar(128);
    DECLARE @ErrorMessage nvarchar(4000);

    SELECT
        @ErrorNumber = ERROR_NUMBER(),
        @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),
        @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE(),
        @ErrorLine = ERROR_LINE(),
        @ErrorProcedure = ERROR_PROCEDURE(),
        @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE();

    PRINT N'';
    PRINT N'============================================================';
    PRINT N' PACS DATABASE MIGRATION FAILED';
    PRINT N'============================================================';

    SELECT
        @ErrorNumber AS ErrorNumber,
        @ErrorSeverity AS ErrorSeverity,
        @ErrorState AS ErrorState,
        @ErrorProcedure AS ErrorProcedure,
        @ErrorLine AS ErrorLine,
        @ErrorMessage AS ErrorMessage;

    RAISERROR(
        N'PACS DATABASE MIGRATION FAILED: %s',
        16,
        1,
        @ErrorMessage
    );

END CATCH;
</file>

/* =====================================================================
   FILE:
   PACS-XQ-01.5-03-VERIFY.sql

   PURPOSE:
   Kiểm tra database SAU PACS migration.

   EXPECTED:
   - 4 PACS columns trong ResultCDHA
   - 6 PACS tables
   - Schema column đúng
   - 6 Primary Keys
   - Id của 6 PACS tables là IDENTITY
   - Unique index:
       UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId
   - Default:
       PacsSyncStates.LastChangeSeq = 0
       PacsSyncStates.CreatedOn     = GETDATE()
   - Không có physical FK PACS ngoài baseline
   ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @CurrentDatabase sysname = DB_NAME();

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS DATABASE VERIFY';
PRINT N' Database : ' + ISNULL(@CurrentDatabase, N'<NULL>');
PRINT N' Time     : ' + CONVERT(nvarchar(30), SYSDATETIME(), 121);
PRINT N'============================================================';

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- SAFETY
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

IF @CurrentDatabase IN (N'master', N'model', N'msdb', N'tempdb')
BEGIN
    RAISERROR(
        N'PACS VERIFY: Không được chạy trên system database.',
        16,
        1
    );

    RETURN;
END;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A. VERIFY ResultCDHA PACS COLUMNS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- A. VERIFY ResultCDHA PACS COLUMNS -----------------------';

DECLARE @ExpectedResultCDHA TABLE
(
    ColumnName sysname NOT NULL,
    DataType nvarchar(128) NOT NULL,
    MaxLength int NULL,
    IsNullable varchar(3) NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO @ExpectedResultCDHA
(
    ColumnName,
    DataType,
    MaxLength,
    IsNullable
)
VALUES
    (N'AccessionNumber',   N'nvarchar', -1, 'YES'),
    (N'StudyInstanceUID',  N'nvarchar', -1, 'YES'),
    (N'OrthancStudyId',    N'nvarchar', -1, 'YES'),
    (N'PacsStatus',        N'nvarchar', -1, 'YES');

SELECT
    e.ColumnName AS ExpectedColumn,
    e.DataType AS ExpectedType,
    e.MaxLength AS ExpectedMaxLength,
    e.IsNullable AS ExpectedNullable,

    c.COLUMN_NAME AS ActualColumn,
    c.DATA_TYPE AS ActualType,
    c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS ActualMaxLength,
    c.IS_NULLABLE AS ActualNullable,

    CASE
        WHEN c.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'
        WHEN c.DATA_TYPE <> e.DataType
            THEN N'TYPE_MISMATCH'
        WHEN ISNULL(c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, -99999)
             <> ISNULL(e.MaxLength, -99999)
            THEN N'LENGTH_MISMATCH'
        WHEN c.IS_NULLABLE <> e.IsNullable
            THEN N'NULLABILITY_MISMATCH'
        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS VerifyStatus
FROM @ExpectedResultCDHA e
LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
    ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
   AND c.TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
   AND c.COLUMN_NAME = e.ColumnName
ORDER BY e.ColumnName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- B. VERIFY ALL PACS TABLES EXIST
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- B. VERIFY PACS TABLES -----------------------------------';

DECLARE @ExpectedTables TABLE
(
    TableName sysname NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO @ExpectedTables(TableName)
VALUES
    (N'PacsConfigs'),
    (N'PacsStudies'),
    (N'PacsSeries'),
    (N'PacsInstances'),
    (N'PacsWorklistItems'),
    (N'PacsSyncStates');

SELECT
    e.TableName,
    CASE
        WHEN t.object_id IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'
        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS VerifyStatus
FROM @ExpectedTables e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
LEFT JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON s.schema_id = t.schema_id
   AND s.name = N'dbo'
ORDER BY e.TableName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- C. EXPECTED PACS COLUMN SCHEMA
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'--- C. VERIFY PACS COLUMN SCHEMA -----------------------------';

(N'PacsWorklistItems', N'LastRecoveryCheckedOn',               N'datetime2', NULL, 'YES'),
(N'PacsWorklistItems', N'LastReconciliationCheckedOn',         N'datetime2', NULL, 'YES');

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- PacsSyncStates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

INSERT INTO @ExpectedColumns VALUES
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'Id',            N'bigint',    NULL, 'NO'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'PacsConfigId',  N'bigint',    NULL, 'NO'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'LastChangeSeq', N'bigint',    NULL, 'NO'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'LastRunAt',     N'datetime2', NULL, 'YES'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'LastSuccessAt', N'datetime2', NULL, 'YES'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'LastError',     N'nvarchar',  -1,   'YES'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'CreatedOn',     N'datetime2', NULL, 'NO'),
(N'PacsSyncStates', N'UpdatedOn',     N'datetime2', NULL, 'YES');

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- COMPARE EXPECTED VS ACTUAL
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

SELECT
    e.TableName,
    e.ColumnName,

    e.DataType AS ExpectedType,
    e.MaxLength AS ExpectedMaxLength,
    e.IsNullable AS ExpectedNullable,

    c.DATA_TYPE AS ActualType,
    c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH AS ActualMaxLength,
    c.IS_NULLABLE AS ActualNullable,

    CASE
        WHEN c.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'

        WHEN c.DATA_TYPE <> e.DataType
            THEN N'TYPE_MISMATCH'

        WHEN e.DataType IN (N'nvarchar', N'varchar', N'char', N'nchar')
             AND ISNULL(c.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH, -99999)
                 <> ISNULL(e.MaxLength, -99999)
            THEN N'LENGTH_MISMATCH'

        WHEN c.IS_NULLABLE <> e.IsNullable
            THEN N'NULLABILITY_MISMATCH'

        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS VerifyStatus

FROM @ExpectedColumns e

LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
    ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
   AND c.TABLE_NAME = e.TableName
   AND c.COLUMN_NAME = e.ColumnName

ORDER BY
    e.TableName,
    e.ColumnName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- D. VERIFY PRIMARY KEYS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- D. VERIFY PRIMARY KEYS ----------------------------------';

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    kc.name AS PrimaryKeyName,
    CASE
        WHEN kc.object_id IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'
        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS VerifyStatus
FROM @ExpectedTables e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
   AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
LEFT JOIN sys.key_constraints kc
    ON kc.parent_object_id = t.object_id
   AND kc.type = N'PK'
ORDER BY e.TableName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- E. VERIFY IDENTITY COLUMN
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- E. VERIFY IDENTITY --------------------------------------';

SELECT
    e.TableName,
    c.name AS ColumnName,
    c.is_identity AS IsIdentity,
    CASE
        WHEN c.name IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'
        WHEN c.is_identity = 1
            THEN N'PASS'
        ELSE N'NOT_IDENTITY'
    END AS VerifyStatus
FROM @ExpectedTables e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
   AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
LEFT JOIN sys.columns c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
   AND c.name = N'Id'
ORDER BY e.TableName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- F. VERIFY PacsSyncStates UNIQUE INDEX
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- F. VERIFY SYNC UNIQUE INDEX -----------------------------';

SELECT
    t.name AS TableName,
    i.name AS IndexName,
    i.is_unique AS IsUnique,
    i.is_disabled AS IsDisabled,
    CASE
        WHEN i.index_id IS NULL
            THEN N'MISSING'
        WHEN i.is_unique <> 1
            THEN N'NOT_UNIQUE'
        WHEN i.is_disabled = 1
            THEN N'DISABLED'
        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS VerifyStatus
FROM sys.tables t
LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i
    ON i.object_id = t.object_id
   AND i.name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId'
WHERE t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
  AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo';

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- G. VERIFY PacsSyncStates DEFAULTS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- G. VERIFY SYNC DEFAULT CONSTRAINTS ----------------------';

SELECT
    c.name AS ColumnName,
    dc.name AS ConstraintName,
    dc.definition AS DefaultDefinition
FROM sys.tables t
INNER JOIN sys.columns c
    ON c.object_id = t.object_id
LEFT JOIN sys.default_constraints dc
    ON dc.parent_object_id = c.object_id
   AND dc.parent_column_id = c.column_id
WHERE t.name = N'PacsSyncStates'
  AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
  AND c.name IN
  (
      N'LastChangeSeq',
      N'CreatedOn'
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- H. VERIFY NO PACS FOREIGN KEYS
-- Baseline hiện tại dùng logical relationship, không physical FK.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- H. VERIFY PACS FOREIGN KEYS -----------------------------';

SELECT
    fk.name AS ForeignKeyName,
    OBJECT_SCHEMA_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS SchemaName,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) AS ParentTable,
    OBJECT_NAME(fk.referenced_object_id) AS ReferencedTable
FROM sys.foreign_keys fk
WHERE OBJECT_NAME(fk.parent_object_id) IN
(
    N'PacsConfigs',
    N'PacsStudies',
    N'PacsSeries',
    N'PacsInstances',
    N'PacsWorklistItems',
    N'PacsSyncStates'
)
ORDER BY ParentTable, ForeignKeyName;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- I. CURRENT ROW COUNTS
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- I. PACS ROW COUNTS --------------------------------------';

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsConfigs', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsConfigs' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsConfigs;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsStudies' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsStudies;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsSeries' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsSeries;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsInstances' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsInstances;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsWorklistItems', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsWorklistItems' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates', N'U') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    SELECT
        N'PacsSyncStates' AS TableName,
        COUNT_BIG(*) AS [RowCount]
    FROM dbo.PacsSyncStates;
END;

-----------------------------------------------------------------------
-- J. FINAL SUMMARY
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'--- J. FINAL VERIFY SUMMARY ---------------------------------';

DECLARE @MissingResultColumns int;

SELECT
    @MissingResultColumns = COUNT(*)
FROM @ExpectedResultCDHA e
LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
    ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
   AND c.TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
   AND c.COLUMN_NAME = e.ColumnName
WHERE c.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL;

DECLARE @MissingTables int;

SELECT
    @MissingTables = COUNT(*)
FROM @ExpectedTables e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
   AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
WHERE t.object_id IS NULL;

DECLARE @MissingPacsColumns int;

SELECT
    @MissingPacsColumns = COUNT(*)
FROM @ExpectedColumns e
LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS c
    ON c.TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
   AND c.TABLE_NAME = e.TableName
   AND c.COLUMN_NAME = e.ColumnName
WHERE c.COLUMN_NAME IS NULL;

DECLARE @SyncUniqueIndexExists bit = 0;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.indexes i
    WHERE i.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates')
      AND i.name = N'UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId'
      AND i.is_unique = 1
      AND i.is_disabled = 0
)
BEGIN
    SET @SyncUniqueIndexExists = 1;
END;

DECLARE @LastChangeSeqDefaultExists bit = 0;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.default_constraints dc
    INNER JOIN sys.columns c
        ON c.object_id = dc.parent_object_id
       AND c.column_id = dc.parent_column_id
    WHERE dc.parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates')
      AND c.name = N'LastChangeSeq'
)
BEGIN
    SET @LastChangeSeqDefaultExists = 1;
END;

DECLARE @CreatedOnDefaultExists bit = 0;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM sys.default_constraints dc
    INNER JOIN sys.columns c
        ON c.object_id = dc.parent_object_id
       AND c.column_id = dc.parent_column_id
    WHERE dc.parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSyncStates')
      AND c.name = N'CreatedOn'
)
BEGIN
    SET @CreatedOnDefaultExists = 1;
END;

SELECT
    @CurrentDatabase AS CurrentDatabase,

    @MissingResultColumns AS MissingResultCDHAColumns,
    @MissingTables AS MissingPacsTables,
    @MissingPacsColumns AS MissingPacsColumns,

    @SyncUniqueIndexExists AS SyncUniqueIndexExists,
    @LastChangeSeqDefaultExists AS LastChangeSeqDefaultExists,
    @CreatedOnDefaultExists AS CreatedOnDefaultExists,

    CASE
        WHEN @MissingResultColumns = 0
         AND @MissingTables = 0
         AND @MissingPacsColumns = 0
         AND @SyncUniqueIndexExists = 1
         AND @LastChangeSeqDefaultExists = 1
         AND @CreatedOnDefaultExists = 1
            THEN N'PASS'
        ELSE N'FAIL'
    END AS OverallStatus;

PRINT N'';
PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS DATABASE VERIFY FINISHED';
PRINT N'============================================================';
</file>

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-03-04-PRECHECK.sql">
/* ============================================================
   PACS-XQ-03-04 – ACCESSION PRECHECK
   Read-only
   ============================================================ */

SET NOCOUNT ON;

PRINT '=== Existing PACS accession overview ===';

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS TotalResultCDHA,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)), '') IS NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS EmptyAccession,
    SUM(CASE WHEN NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)), '') IS NOT NULL
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HasAccession
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA;

PRINT '=== Duplicate existing accessions ===';

SELECT
    LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)) AS AccessionNumber,
    COUNT(*) AS DuplicateCount
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)), '') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber))
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY DuplicateCount DESC, AccessionNumber;

PRINT '=== Recent XQ candidates with empty accession ===';

SELECT TOP 20
    r.Id AS ResultCDHAId,
    r.PatientId,
    r.ServiceId,
    c.Code AS CategoryCode,
    r.AccessionNumber,
    r.Active,
    r.InsertTime
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA r
LEFT JOIN dbo.Service s
    ON s.Id = r.ServiceId
LEFT JOIN dbo.Category c
    ON c.Id = s.CategoryId
WHERE c.Code = 'XQ'
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.AccessionNumber)), '') IS NULL
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems p
      WHERE p.ResultCDHAId = r.Id
  )
ORDER BY r.Id DESC;
</file>

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-04-02-01-PRECHECK.sql">
/* =====================================================================
 PACS-XQ-04-02-01-PRECHECK.sql
 Project A - Shared Study / Series / Instance Sync
 Purpose:
   - Validate data before narrowing PACS identity columns to nvarchar(64)
   - Validate duplicate identities before unique indexes are created
   - READ ONLY
 ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @CurrentDatabase sysname = DB_NAME();

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PACS-XQ-04-02 PRECHECK';
PRINT N' Database : ' + ISNULL(@CurrentDatabase, N'<NULL>');
PRINT N'============================================================';

IF @CurrentDatabase IN (N'master', N'model', N'msdb', N'tempdb')
BEGIN
    THROW 51000, N'Không chạy PACS-XQ-04-02 trên system database.', 1;
END;

DECLARE @Required TABLE (TableName sysname);
INSERT INTO @Required(TableName)
VALUES
(N'ResultCDHA'),
(N'PacsWorklistItems'),
(N'PacsStudies'),
(N'PacsSeries'),
(N'PacsInstances'),
(N'PacsSyncStates');

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM @Required r
    WHERE OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.' + r.TableName, N'U') IS NULL
)
BEGIN
    SELECT r.TableName AS MissingTable
    FROM @Required r
    WHERE OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.' + r.TableName, N'U') IS NULL;

    THROW 51001, N'Thiếu table bắt buộc cho PACS-XQ-04-02.', 1;
END;

PRINT N'--- A. ROW COUNTS -------------------------------------------';

SELECT N'ResultCDHA' AS TableName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS TotalRows FROM dbo.ResultCDHA
UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems', COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies', COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.PacsStudies
UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSeries', COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.PacsSeries
UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances', COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.PacsInstances
UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSyncStates', COUNT_BIG(*) FROM dbo.PacsSyncStates;

PRINT N'--- B. MAX IDENTITY LENGTHS ---------------------------------';

SELECT
    N'ResultCDHA' AS TableName,
    MAX(LEN(AccessionNumber)) AS MaxAccessionNumber,
    MAX(LEN(StudyInstanceUID)) AS MaxStudyInstanceUID,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancStudyId)) AS MaxOrthancStudyId
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA;

SELECT
    N'PacsWorklistItems' AS TableName,
    MAX(LEN(AccessionNumber)) AS MaxAccessionNumber,
    MAX(LEN(StudyInstanceUID)) AS MaxStudyInstanceUID,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancStudyId)) AS MaxOrthancStudyId
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems;

SELECT
    N'PacsStudies' AS TableName,
    MAX(LEN(AccessionNumber)) AS MaxAccessionNumber,
    MAX(LEN(StudyInstanceUID)) AS MaxStudyInstanceUID,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancStudyId)) AS MaxOrthancStudyId
FROM dbo.PacsStudies;

SELECT
    N'PacsSeries' AS TableName,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancSeriesId)) AS MaxOrthancSeriesId,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancParentStudyId)) AS MaxOrthancParentStudyId,
    MAX(LEN(SeriesInstanceUID)) AS MaxSeriesInstanceUID
FROM dbo.PacsSeries;

SELECT
    N'PacsInstances' AS TableName,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancInstanceId)) AS MaxOrthancInstanceId,
    MAX(LEN(OrthancParentSeriesId)) AS MaxOrthancParentSeriesId,
    MAX(LEN(SOPInstanceUID)) AS MaxSOPInstanceUID,
    MAX(LEN(SopClassUID)) AS MaxSopClassUID,
    MAX(LEN(TransferSyntaxUID)) AS MaxTransferSyntaxUID
FROM dbo.PacsInstances;

PRINT N'--- C. VALUES LONGER THAN 64 --------------------------------';

SELECT N'ResultCDHA.AccessionNumber' AS FieldName, COUNT_BIG(*) AS TooLong
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'ResultCDHA.StudyInstanceUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA WHERE LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'ResultCDHA.OrthancStudyId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA WHERE LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems.AccessionNumber', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems.StudyInstanceUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems WHERE LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems.OrthancStudyId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems WHERE LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsStudies.AccessionNumber', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsStudies WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsStudies.StudyInstanceUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsStudies WHERE LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsStudies.OrthancStudyId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsStudies WHERE LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsSeries.OrthancSeriesId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsSeries WHERE LEN(OrthancSeriesId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsSeries.OrthancParentStudyId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsSeries WHERE LEN(OrthancParentStudyId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsSeries.SeriesInstanceUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsSeries WHERE LEN(SeriesInstanceUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsInstances.OrthancInstanceId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(OrthancInstanceId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsInstances.OrthancParentSeriesId', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(OrthancParentSeriesId) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsInstances.SOPInstanceUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(SOPInstanceUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsInstances.SopClassUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(SopClassUID) > 64
UNION ALL
SELECT N'PacsInstances.TransferSyntaxUID', COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(TransferSyntaxUID) > 64;

PRINT N'--- D. DUPLICATE WORKLIST IDENTITY --------------------------';

SELECT ResultCDHAId, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
GROUP BY ResultCDHAId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT AccessionNumber, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY AccessionNumber
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

PRINT N'--- E. DUPLICATE STUDY IDENTITY -----------------------------';

SELECT StudyInstanceUID, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsStudies
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(StudyInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY StudyInstanceUID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT OrthancStudyId, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsStudies
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancStudyId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY OrthancStudyId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

PRINT N'--- F. DUPLICATE SERIES IDENTITY ----------------------------';

SELECT OrthancSeriesId, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsSeries
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancSeriesId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY OrthancSeriesId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT SeriesInstanceUID, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsSeries
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SeriesInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SeriesInstanceUID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

PRINT N'--- G. DUPLICATE INSTANCE IDENTITY --------------------------';

SELECT OrthancInstanceId, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsInstances
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancInstanceId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY OrthancInstanceId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT SOPInstanceUID, COUNT(*) AS Total
FROM dbo.PacsInstances
WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SOPInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY SOPInstanceUID
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

PRINT N'--- H. CURRENT COLUMN TYPES ---------------------------------';

SELECT
    TABLE_NAME,
    COLUMN_NAME,
    DATA_TYPE,
    CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
    IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
  AND
  (
      (TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsWorklistItems'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsStudies'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsSeries'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'OrthancSeriesId', N'OrthancParentStudyId', N'SeriesInstanceUID'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsInstances'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN
       (
           N'OrthancInstanceId',
           N'OrthancParentSeriesId',
           N'SOPInstanceUID',
           N'SopClassUID',
           N'TransferSyntaxUID'
       ))
  )
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME;

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' PRECHECK COMPLETE';
PRINT N' All TooLong values must be 0.';
PRINT N' All duplicate result sets must return 0 rows.';
PRINT N'============================================================';
</file>

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-04-02-02-MIGRATION.sql">
/* =====================================================================
 PACS-XQ-04-02-02-MIGRATION.sql
 Project A - Shared Study / Series / Instance Sync

 Hardening:
   1. Normalize PACS identity/correlation columns to nvarchar(64)
   2. Add Worklist uniqueness guards already required by Phase 03 contract
   3. Add Study / Series / Instance unique identity indexes
   4. Add lookup indexes used by Phase 04 sync/viewer

 Rerun safe.
 ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

DECLARE @CurrentDatabase sysname = DB_NAME();

IF @CurrentDatabase IN (N'master', N'model', N'msdb', N'tempdb')
BEGIN
    THROW 51100, N'Không chạy PACS-XQ-04-02 trên system database.', 1;
END;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ResultCDHA', N'U') IS NULL
 OR OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsWorklistItems', N'U') IS NULL
 OR OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies', N'U') IS NULL
 OR OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries', N'U') IS NULL
 OR OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances', N'U') IS NULL
BEGIN
    THROW 51101, N'Thiếu table PACS bắt buộc.', 1;
END;

-- Fail fast on oversized values.
IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ResultCDHA WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64 OR LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64 OR LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64 OR LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64 OR LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PacsStudies WHERE LEN(AccessionNumber) > 64 OR LEN(StudyInstanceUID) > 64 OR LEN(OrthancStudyId) > 64)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PacsSeries WHERE LEN(OrthancSeriesId) > 64 OR LEN(OrthancParentStudyId) > 64 OR LEN(SeriesInstanceUID) > 64)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.PacsInstances WHERE LEN(OrthancInstanceId) > 64 OR LEN(OrthancParentSeriesId) > 64 OR LEN(SOPInstanceUID) > 64 OR LEN(SopClassUID) > 64 OR LEN(TransferSyntaxUID) > 64)
BEGIN
    THROW 51102, N'Có PACS identity dài hơn 64 ký tự. Dừng migration để review.', 1;
END;

-- Fail fast on duplicate identities before unique indexes.
IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT ResultCDHAId
    FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
    GROUP BY ResultCDHAId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51103, N'Duplicate PacsWorklistItems.ResultCDHAId.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT AccessionNumber
    FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(AccessionNumber)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY AccessionNumber
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51104, N'Duplicate PacsWorklistItems.AccessionNumber.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT StudyInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsStudies
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(StudyInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY StudyInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51105, N'Duplicate PacsStudies.StudyInstanceUID.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT OrthancStudyId
    FROM dbo.PacsStudies
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancStudyId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OrthancStudyId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51106, N'Duplicate PacsStudies.OrthancStudyId.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT OrthancSeriesId
    FROM dbo.PacsSeries
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancSeriesId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OrthancSeriesId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51107, N'Duplicate PacsSeries.OrthancSeriesId.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT SeriesInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsSeries
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SeriesInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SeriesInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51108, N'Duplicate PacsSeries.SeriesInstanceUID.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT OrthancInstanceId
    FROM dbo.PacsInstances
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(OrthancInstanceId)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY OrthancInstanceId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51109, N'Duplicate PacsInstances.OrthancInstanceId.', 1;
END;

IF EXISTS
(
    SELECT SOPInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsInstances
    WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(SOPInstanceUID)), N'') IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SOPInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
BEGIN
    THROW 51110, N'Duplicate PacsInstances.SOPInstanceUID.', 1;
END;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    PRINT N'--- 1. NORMALIZE IDENTITY COLUMN TYPES ----------------------';

    ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ALTER COLUMN AccessionNumber nvarchar(64) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ALTER COLUMN StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(64) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.ResultCDHA
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancStudyId nvarchar(64) NULL;

    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsWorklistItems
        ALTER COLUMN AccessionNumber nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsWorklistItems
        ALTER COLUMN StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(64) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsWorklistItems
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancStudyId nvarchar(64) NULL;

    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsStudies
        ALTER COLUMN AccessionNumber nvarchar(64) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsStudies
        ALTER COLUMN StudyInstanceUID nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsStudies
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancStudyId nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;

    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsSeries
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancSeriesId nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsSeries
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancParentStudyId nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsSeries
        ALTER COLUMN SeriesInstanceUID nvarchar(64) NULL;

    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancInstanceId nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        ALTER COLUMN OrthancParentSeriesId nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        ALTER COLUMN SOPInstanceUID nvarchar(64) NOT NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        ALTER COLUMN SopClassUID nvarchar(64) NULL;
    ALTER TABLE dbo.PacsInstances
        ALTER COLUMN TransferSyntaxUID nvarchar(64) NULL;

    PRINT N'--- 2. RESULT / WORKLIST LOOKUP + UNIQUE INDEXES ------------';

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ResultCDHA')
          AND name = N'IX_ResultCDHA_AccessionNumber'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_ResultCDHA_AccessionNumber
            ON dbo.ResultCDHA(AccessionNumber)
            WHERE AccessionNumber IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsWorklistItems')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsWorklistItems_ResultCDHAId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsWorklistItems_ResultCDHAId
            ON dbo.PacsWorklistItems(ResultCDHAId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsWorklistItems')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsWorklistItems_AccessionNumber'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsWorklistItems_AccessionNumber
            ON dbo.PacsWorklistItems(AccessionNumber);
    END;

    PRINT N'--- 3. STUDY INDEXES ----------------------------------------';

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies')
          AND name = N'IX_PacsStudies_ResultCDHAId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_PacsStudies_ResultCDHAId
            ON dbo.PacsStudies(ResultCDHAId)
            WHERE ResultCDHAId IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies')
          AND name = N'IX_PacsStudies_AccessionNumber'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_PacsStudies_AccessionNumber
            ON dbo.PacsStudies(AccessionNumber)
            WHERE AccessionNumber IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsStudies_StudyInstanceUID'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsStudies_StudyInstanceUID
            ON dbo.PacsStudies(StudyInstanceUID);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsStudies')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsStudies_OrthancStudyId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsStudies_OrthancStudyId
            ON dbo.PacsStudies(OrthancStudyId);
    END;

    PRINT N'--- 4. SERIES INDEXES ---------------------------------------';

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries')
          AND name = N'IX_PacsSeries_PacsStudyId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_PacsSeries_PacsStudyId
            ON dbo.PacsSeries(PacsStudyId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsSeries_OrthancSeriesId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsSeries_OrthancSeriesId
            ON dbo.PacsSeries(OrthancSeriesId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsSeries')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsSeries_SeriesInstanceUID'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsSeries_SeriesInstanceUID
            ON dbo.PacsSeries(SeriesInstanceUID)
            WHERE SeriesInstanceUID IS NOT NULL;
    END;

    PRINT N'--- 5. INSTANCE INDEXES -------------------------------------';

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances')
          AND name = N'IX_PacsInstances_PacsStudyId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_PacsInstances_PacsStudyId
            ON dbo.PacsInstances(PacsStudyId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances')
          AND name = N'IX_PacsInstances_PacsSeriesId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE INDEX IX_PacsInstances_PacsSeriesId
            ON dbo.PacsInstances(PacsSeriesId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsInstances_OrthancInstanceId'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsInstances_OrthancInstanceId
            ON dbo.PacsInstances(OrthancInstanceId);
    END;

    IF NOT EXISTS
    (
        SELECT 1 FROM sys.indexes
        WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.PacsInstances')
          AND name = N'UX_PacsInstances_SOPInstanceUID'
    )
    BEGIN
        CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_PacsInstances_SOPInstanceUID
            ON dbo.PacsInstances(SOPInstanceUID);
    END;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

    PRINT N'============================================================';
    PRINT N' PACS-XQ-04-02 MIGRATION COMPLETED';
    PRINT N'============================================================';
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @ErrorMessage nvarchar(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE();
    THROW 51199, @ErrorMessage, 1;
END CATCH;

<file path="Database/Pacs/PACS-XQ-04-02-03-VERIFY.sql">
/* =====================================================================
 PACS-XQ-04-02-03-VERIFY.sql
 READ ONLY verification after migration.
 ===================================================================== */

SET NOCOUNT ON;

PRINT N'--- A. COLUMN TYPES -----------------------------------------';

SELECT
    TABLE_NAME,
    COLUMN_NAME,
    DATA_TYPE,
    CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH,
    IS_NULLABLE
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = N'dbo'
  AND
  (
      (TABLE_NAME = N'ResultCDHA'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsWorklistItems'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsStudies'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'AccessionNumber', N'StudyInstanceUID', N'OrthancStudyId'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsSeries'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN (N'OrthancSeriesId', N'OrthancParentStudyId', N'SeriesInstanceUID'))
      OR
      (TABLE_NAME = N'PacsInstances'
       AND COLUMN_NAME IN
       (
           N'OrthancInstanceId',
           N'OrthancParentSeriesId',
           N'SOPInstanceUID',
           N'SopClassUID',
           N'TransferSyntaxUID'
       ))
  )
ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME;

PRINT N'--- B. EXPECTED INDEXES -------------------------------------';

;WITH Expected AS
(
    SELECT N'ResultCDHA' AS TableName, N'IX_ResultCDHA_AccessionNumber' AS IndexName, 0 AS MustBeUnique
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems', N'UX_PacsWorklistItems_ResultCDHAId', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsWorklistItems', N'UX_PacsWorklistItems_AccessionNumber', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies', N'IX_PacsStudies_ResultCDHAId', 0
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies', N'IX_PacsStudies_AccessionNumber', 0
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies', N'UX_PacsStudies_StudyInstanceUID', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsStudies', N'UX_PacsStudies_OrthancStudyId', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSeries', N'IX_PacsSeries_PacsStudyId', 0
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSeries', N'UX_PacsSeries_OrthancSeriesId', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsSeries', N'UX_PacsSeries_SeriesInstanceUID', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances', N'IX_PacsInstances_PacsStudyId', 0
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances', N'IX_PacsInstances_PacsSeriesId', 0
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances', N'UX_PacsInstances_OrthancInstanceId', 1
    UNION ALL SELECT N'PacsInstances', N'UX_PacsInstances_SOPInstanceUID', 1
)
SELECT
    e.TableName,
    e.IndexName,
    e.MustBeUnique,
    CASE WHEN i.index_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS ExistsFlag,
    i.is_unique AS IsUnique,
    i.filter_definition AS FilterDefinition,
    CASE
        WHEN i.index_id IS NULL THEN N'FAIL_MISSING'
        WHEN e.MustBeUnique = 1 AND i.is_unique <> 1 THEN N'FAIL_NOT_UNIQUE'
        ELSE N'PASS'
    END AS Result
FROM Expected e
LEFT JOIN sys.tables t
    ON t.name = e.TableName
   AND SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = N'dbo'
LEFT JOIN sys.indexes i
    ON i.object_id = t.object_id
   AND i.name = e.IndexName
ORDER BY e.TableName, e.IndexName;

PRINT N'--- C. DUPLICATE RECHECK ------------------------------------';

SELECT N'Worklist.ResultCDHAId' AS IdentityName, COUNT(*) AS DuplicateGroups
FROM
(
    SELECT ResultCDHAId
    FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
    GROUP BY ResultCDHAId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Worklist.AccessionNumber', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT AccessionNumber
    FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems
    GROUP BY AccessionNumber
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Study.StudyInstanceUID', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT StudyInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsStudies
    GROUP BY StudyInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Study.OrthancStudyId', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT OrthancStudyId
    FROM dbo.PacsStudies
    GROUP BY OrthancStudyId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Series.OrthancSeriesId', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT OrthancSeriesId
    FROM dbo.PacsSeries
    GROUP BY OrthancSeriesId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Series.SeriesInstanceUID', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT SeriesInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsSeries
    WHERE SeriesInstanceUID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SeriesInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Instance.OrthancInstanceId', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT OrthancInstanceId
    FROM dbo.PacsInstances
    GROUP BY OrthancInstanceId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x

UNION ALL

SELECT N'Instance.SOPInstanceUID', COUNT(*)
FROM
(
    SELECT SOPInstanceUID
    FROM dbo.PacsInstances
    GROUP BY SOPInstanceUID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) x;

PRINT N'--- D. PHASE 03 WORKLIST REGRESSION -------------------------';

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS WorklistRows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PublishedRows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ErrorMessage IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(ErrorMessage)) <> N'' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ErrorRows
FROM dbo.PacsWorklistItems;

SELECT
    r.Id AS ResultCDHAId,
    r.AccessionNumber AS ResultAccession,
    w.Id AS WorklistId,
    w.AccessionNumber AS WorklistAccession
FROM dbo.ResultCDHA r
INNER JOIN dbo.PacsWorklistItems w
    ON w.ResultCDHAId = r.Id
WHERE ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.AccessionNumber)), N'')
   <> ISNULL(LTRIM(RTRIM(w.AccessionNumber)), N'');

PRINT N'============================================================';
PRINT N' VERIFY COMPLETE';
PRINT N' Expected: all index Result=PASS, all DuplicateGroups=0,';
PRINT N' and ResultCDHA/Worklist mismatch query returns 0 rows.';
PRINT N'============================================================';
</file>

using Management.Models.SignServer;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace Management.Interfaces
{
    public interface ISignServerService
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gửi pdfFile + signerCccd (signUserId) tới MySign.
        /// Trả về raw response string từ MySign.
        /// </summary>
        /// Gửi PDF sang MySign. Trả về raw JSON (string). Controller sẽ trích response.data.
        Task<string> SignPdfAsync(
            string signerCccd,
            IFormFile pdfFile,
            SignContext context,
            string? targetTextOverride = null,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default);

        // Trả về URL xem PDF đã ký (không chèn token)
        string GetSignedPdfViewUrl(string signStoreId);
    }

}

        public bool Deleted { get; set; } = false;

<file path="Models/LABContext.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using Management.Models.Pacs;

namespace Management.Models
{
    public partial class LABContext : DbContext
    {
        public LABContext()
        {
        }
        public LABContext(DbContextOptions<LABContext> options) : base(options)
        {
        }

        public virtual DbSet<Hospital> Hospitals { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Location> Locations { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Doctor> Doctors { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Object> Objects { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<User> Users { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Type> Types { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<UserType> UserTypes { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Function> Functions { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<UserFunction> UserFunctions { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PrintSample> PrintSamples { get; set; }      
        public virtual DbSet<Group> Groups { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Category> Categories { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<TestType> TestTypes { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Device> Devices { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Sample> Samples { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Setting> Settings { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Connect> Connects { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Map> Maps { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Service> Services { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<ServiceTest> ServiceTests { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Session> Sessions { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<ResultStandard> ResultStandards { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<TestCode> TestCodes { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<Patient> Patients { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<WorkOrder> WorkOrders { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<ResultXN> ResultXNs { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<ResultCDHA> ResultCDHAs { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<ImageCDHA> ImageCDHAs { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<DigitalSign> DigitalSigns { get; set; }
        // ==================== PACS ====================
        public virtual DbSet<PacsConfig> PacsConfigs { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PacsStudy> PacsStudies { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PacsSeries> PacsSeries { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PacsInstance> PacsInstances { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PacsWorklistItem> PacsWorklistItems { get; set; }
        public virtual DbSet<PacsSyncState> PacsSyncStates { get; set; }

        //protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
        //{
        //    optionsBuilder.UseLazyLoadingProxies();

        //    IConfigurationRoot configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
        //    .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
        //    .AddJsonFile("appsettings.json")
        //    .Build();
        //    optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(configuration.GetConnectionString("LABConnectionString"));           
        //}
        protected override void OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
        {
            optionsBuilder.UseLazyLoadingProxies();

            if (optionsBuilder.IsConfigured)
                return;

            var environmentName =
                Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT")
                ?? Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT")
                ?? "Production";

            var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                .SetBasePath(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory)
                .AddJsonFile(
                    "appsettings.json",
                    optional: false,
                    reloadOnChange: false)
                .AddJsonFile(
                    $"appsettings.{environmentName}.json",
                    optional: true,
                    reloadOnChange: false)
                .AddEnvironmentVariables()
                .Build();

            var connectionString =
                configuration.GetConnectionString("LABConnectionString");

            optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(connectionString);
        }

        //protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        //{
        //}
        protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
        {
            modelBuilder.Entity<PacsSyncState>(entity =>
            {
                entity.ToTable("PacsSyncStates");

                entity.HasKey(x => x.Id);

                entity.HasIndex(x => x.PacsConfigId)
                    .IsUnique()
                    .HasDatabaseName(
                        "UX_PacsSyncStates_PacsConfigId");

                entity.Property(x => x.PacsConfigId)
                    .IsRequired();

                entity.Property(x => x.LastChangeSeq)
                    .IsRequired()
                    .HasDefaultValue(0L);

                entity.Property(x => x.LastRunAt)
                    .HasColumnType("datetime2")
                    .IsRequired(false);

                entity.Property(x => x.LastSuccessAt)
                    .HasColumnType("datetime2")
                    .IsRequired(false);

                entity.Property(x => x.LastError)
                    .HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)")
                    .IsRequired(false);

                entity.Property(x => x.CreatedOn)
                    .HasColumnType("datetime2")
                    .HasDefaultValueSql("GETDATE()");

                entity.Property(x => x.UpdatedOn)
                    .HasColumnType("datetime2")
                    .IsRequired(false);
            });
        }
    }
}
</file>

        [Required]
        [StringLength(50)]
        public string ServerType { get; set; }

        [Required]
        [StringLength(500)]
        public string BaseUrl { get; set; }

        [StringLength(100)]
        public string ApiUsername { get; set; }

        [StringLength(500)]
        public string ApiPassword { get; set; }

        [StringLength(100)]

        [StringLength(250)]

        public int? DicomPort { get; set; }

        [StringLength(250)]
