<file path="Models/Pacs/PacsReconciliationModels.cs">
namespace Management.Models.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Stable status vocabulary for PREPROD-01C Reconciliation.
    /// The actual decision logic is implemented from PREPROD-01C-02 onward.
    /// </summary>
    public static class PacsReconciliationStatuses
    {
        public const string Match = "MATCH";
        public const string MetadataCountMismatch = "METADATA_COUNT_MISMATCH";
        public const string LisMissingData = "LIS_MISSING_DATA";
        public const string LisHasExtraData = "LIS_HAS_EXTRA_DATA";
        public const string CountMismatchComplex = "COUNT_MISMATCH_COMPLEX";
        public const string PacsStudyNotFound = "PACS_STUDY_NOT_FOUND";
        public const string NotStable = "NOT_STABLE";
        public const string IdentityMismatch = "IDENTITY_MISMATCH";
        public const string Error = "ERROR";

        public const string Reconciled = "RECONCILED";
        public const string AlreadyMatched = "ALREADY_MATCHED";
        public const string InvalidWorklistId = "INVALID_WORKLIST_ID";
        public const string WorklistNotFound = "WORKLIST_NOT_FOUND";
        public const string InvalidWorklistStatus = "INVALID_WORKLIST_STATUS";
        public const string OutsideReconciliationWindow = "OUTSIDE_RECONCILIATION_WINDOW";
        public const string MissingOrthancStudyId = "MISSING_ORTHANC_STUDY_ID";
        public const string SyncBusy = "SYNC_BUSY";
        public const string VerifyCountFailed = "VERIFY_COUNT_FAILED";
        public const string VerifyCompletedOnChanged = "VERIFY_COMPLETED_ON_CHANGED";
        public const string ReconcileError = "RECONCILE_ERROR";

        public const string NoCandidates = "NO_CANDIDATES";
        public const string Completed = "COMPLETED";
        public const string CompletedWithErrors = "COMPLETED_WITH_ERRORS";
        public const string BatchBusy = "RECONCILIATION_BATCH_BUSY";
        public const string ConfigInvalid = "RECONCILIATION_CONFIG_INVALID";
        public const string PacsConfigNotFound = "PACS_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND";
        public const string BatchError = "BATCH_ERROR";
    }

    public sealed class PacsReconciliationWorklistRequest
    {
        public long PacsWorklistItemId { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Read-only preview of completed Worklists that may need Reconciliation.
    ///
    /// Candidate contract:
    /// - Worklist Status = 3;
    /// - CreatedOn >= configured StartDate;
    /// - CompletedOn <= Now - MinAgeMinutes;
    /// - OrthancStudyId is present.
    ///
    /// PREPROD-01C-02 will implement the actual read-only classification.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsReconciliationPreviewResult
    {
        public bool Success { get; set; }
        public string? Status { get; set; }
        public string? Message { get; set; }
        public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }

        public DateTime? ReconciliationFrom { get; set; }
        public DateTime? ReconciliationTo { get; set; }
        public int MinAgeMinutes { get; set; }
        public int BatchSize { get; set; }
        public int CandidateCount { get; set; }

        public int MatchCount { get; set; }
        public int MissingDataCount { get; set; }
        public int MetadataMismatchCount { get; set; }
        public int ExtraDataCount { get; set; }
        public int ComplexMismatchCount { get; set; }
        public int PacsStudyNotFoundCount { get; set; }
        public int NotStableCount { get; set; }
        public int IdentityMismatchCount { get; set; }
        public int ErrorCount { get; set; }

        public List<PacsReconciliationPreviewItem> Items { get; set; } = new();
    }

    public sealed class PacsReconciliationPreviewItem
    {
        public long WorklistId { get; set; }
        public long? ResultCDHAId { get; set; }

        public string? AccessionNumber { get; set; }
        public DateTime CreatedOn { get; set; }
        public DateTime? CompletedOn { get; set; }
        public DateTime? LastReconciliationCheckedOn { get; set; }

        public string? WorklistOrthancStudyId { get; set; }
        public string? WorklistStudyInstanceUID { get; set; }

        public long? PacsStudyId { get; set; }
        public string? PacsStudyStatus { get; set; }

        // PacsStudy metadata counts.
        public int? LisRecordedSeriesCount { get; set; }
        public int? LisRecordedInstanceCount { get; set; }

        // Actual child-row counts in LIS.
        public int LisActualSeriesCount { get; set; }
        public int LisActualInstanceCount { get; set; }

        // Current Orthanc identity and hierarchy.
        public string? OrthancAccessionNumber { get; set; }
        public string? OrthancStudyInstanceUID { get; set; }
        public bool? IsStable { get; set; }
        public int OrthancSeriesCount { get; set; }
        public int OrthancInstanceCount { get; set; }

        // Positive means Orthanc currently has more than LIS.
        public int SeriesDelta { get; set; }
        public int InstanceDelta { get; set; }

        public bool CanReconcile { get; set; }
        public string? ReconciliationStatus { get; set; }
        public string? Message { get; set; }
        public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Result contract for manual ReconcileCompletedStudy.
    /// PREPROD-01C-03 will populate it.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsReconciliationManualResult
    {
        public bool Success { get; set; }
        public string? Status { get; set; }
        public string? Message { get; set; }
        public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }

        public long WorklistId { get; set; }
        public long? ResultCDHAId { get; set; }
        public long? PacsStudyId { get; set; }

        public string? AccessionNumber { get; set; }
        public string? OrthancStudyId { get; set; }
        public string? StudyInstanceUID { get; set; }
        public bool? IsStable { get; set; }

        public int? LisRecordedSeriesCountBefore { get; set; }
        public int? LisRecordedInstanceCountBefore { get; set; }
        public int LisSeriesCountBefore { get; set; }
        public int LisInstanceCountBefore { get; set; }

        public int OrthancSeriesCount { get; set; }
        public int OrthancInstanceCount { get; set; }

        public int LisSeriesCountAfter { get; set; }
        public int LisInstanceCountAfter { get; set; }

        public DateTime? CompletedOnBefore { get; set; }
        public DateTime? CompletedOnAfter { get; set; }
        public bool CompletedOnPreserved { get; set; }
    }

    public sealed class PacsReconciliationBatchItem
    {
        public long WorklistId { get; set; }
        public string? AccessionNumber { get; set; }

        public string? PreviewStatus { get; set; }
        public bool CanReconcile { get; set; }

        // NONE / RECONCILE / SKIP / WARNING / ERROR
        public string? Action { get; set; }
        public string? ActionStatus { get; set; }

        public PacsReconciliationManualResult? ReconcileResult { get; set; }
    }

    public sealed class PacsReconciliationBatchResult
    {
        public bool Success { get; set; }
        public string? Status { get; set; }
        public string? Message { get; set; }
        public string? ErrorMessage { get; set; }

        public DateTime? ReconciliationFrom { get; set; }
        public DateTime? ReconciliationTo { get; set; }
        public int MinAgeMinutes { get; set; }
        public int BatchSize { get; set; }
        public int CandidateCount { get; set; }

        public int MatchCount { get; set; }
        public int ReconciledCount { get; set; }
        public int AlreadyMatchedCount { get; set; }
        public int NotStableCount { get; set; }
        public int ExtraDataCount { get; set; }
        public int ComplexMismatchCount { get; set; }
        public int IdentityMismatchCount { get; set; }
        public int PacsStudyNotFoundCount { get; set; }
        public int SyncBusyCount { get; set; }
        public int SkippedCount { get; set; }
        public int ErrorCount { get; set; }

        public List<PacsReconciliationBatchItem> Items { get; set; } = new();
    }
}

using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

namespace Management.Models
{
    [Table("Patient")]
    [Index(nameof(Sid), IsUnique = true)]
    [Index(nameof(Seq), nameof(PatientId), nameof(PatientName), nameof(InsertTime))]
    public class Patient
    {
        
        [Key]
        public long Id { get; set; }
        public string? Seq { get; set; }
        public string? Sid { get; set; }       
        public string? PatientId { get; set; }
        public string? PatientName { get; set; }
        public string? Sex { get; set; }
        public string? Address { get; set; }
        public DateTime? Age { get; set; }
        public bool IsYear { get; set; }
        public string? Diagnostic { get; set; }
        public bool FullResultXN { get; set; }


        public long? UserReturnResultXN { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultXN")]
        public virtual User? UserXN { get; set; }

        public long? UserReturnResultSA { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultSA")]
        public virtual User? UserSA { get; set; }

        public long? UserReturnResultSAT { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultSAT")]
        public virtual User? UserSAT { get; set; }

        public long? UserReturnResultDDT { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultDDT")]
        public virtual User? UserDDT { get; set; }

        public long? UserReturnResultNS { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultNS")]
        public virtual User? UserNS { get; set; }

        public long? UserReturnResultXQ { get; set; } // Bác sĩ trả KQ
        [ForeignKey("UserReturnResultXQ")]
        public virtual User? UserReturnXQ { get; set; }

        public long? UserProcessResultXQ { get; set; } // Kỹ thuật viên chụp, xử lý hình ảnh
        [ForeignKey("UserProcessResultXQ")]
        public virtual User? UserProcessXQ { get; set; }

        public long? UserInsertId { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserInsertId")]
        public virtual User? UserInsert { get; set; }

<file path="Models/ViewModels/CDHA/CdhaProcessViewModel.cs">
using Management.BL;

namespace Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Cấu hình UI dùng chung cho màn hình Process của các module CDHA.
    ///
    /// Lưu ý:
    /// - Không phải Entity Framework entity.
    /// - Không map database.
    /// - Không dùng để SaveChanges().
    /// - Chỉ phục vụ render shared Razor partial.
    /// </summary>
    public class CdhaProcessModuleOptions
    {
        public string ModulePrefix { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string ScreenPrefix { get; set; } = "process";

        public string ModuleCode { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string ModuleName { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        public string PacsTitle { get; set; } = string.Empty;

        /// <summary>
        /// Một số module hiện tại có DOM id khác nhau cho
        /// select người trả/thực hiện kết quả.
        ///
        /// XQ hiện tại:
        /// xq_process_userReturnResultXQ
        /// </summary>
        public string UserReturnResultElementSuffix { get; set; }
            = "userReturnResult";

        public bool EnableSave { get; set; } = true;

        public bool EnablePacs { get; set; }

        public bool EnableDigitalSign { get; set; }

        public bool EnableSampleTemplate { get; set; }

        public bool EnableCancel { get; set; }

        public bool EnableValidPrint { get; set; } = true;

        public bool EnableReturnToWaiting { get; set; }

        public bool EnableDeviceModal { get; set; }

        public bool EnableManualImages { get; set; }

        public bool EnableCamera { get; set; }

        public bool EnableVideo { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Ví dụ:
        /// xq_process
        /// ct_process
        /// mr_process
        /// </summary>
        public string DomPrefix
        {
            get
            {
                return
                    $"{ModulePrefix}_{ScreenPrefix}";
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Sinh DOM id nhưng vẫn giữ đúng contract JS cũ.
        ///
        /// Id("patientId")
        /// => xq_process_patientId
        /// </summary>
        public string Id(string suffix)
        {
            return
                $"{DomPrefix}_{suffix}";
        }

        public string UserReturnResultElementId
        {
            get
            {
                return
                    Id(
                        UserReturnResultElementSuffix
                    );
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// CSS hook riêng của module nếu thực sự cần.
        ///
        /// ModuleClass("process")
        /// => xq-process
        /// </summary>
        public string ModuleClass(string suffix)
        {
            return
                $"{ModulePrefix}-{suffix}";
        }

        public string PacsDefaultSize { get; set; } = "75";

        /// <summary>
        /// Sinh ID thuộc workflow GetSample cũ.
        /// Ví dụ XQ:
        /// GetSampleId("select_device_select")
        /// => xq_getsample_select_device_select
        /// </summary>
        public string GetSampleId(string suffix)
        {
            return $"{ModulePrefix}_getsample_{suffix}";
        }
    }


    /// <summary>
    /// ViewModel chung cho CDHA Process.
    ///
    /// Chỉ là projection của dữ liệu lên UI.
    /// Tuyệt đối không thay thế Patient entity.
    /// </summary>
    public class CdhaProcessViewModel
    {
        public CdhaProcessModuleOptions Options { get; set; }
            = new CdhaProcessModuleOptions();

        public List<Patient> Patients { get; set; }
            = new List<Patient>();

        public List<User> Users { get; set; }
            = new List<User>();

        public List<BenhAnModel> MedicalRecords { get; set; }
            = new List<BenhAnModel>();

        public List<Sample> Samples { get; set; }
            = new List<Sample>();

        public List<Device> Devices { get; set; }
            = new List<Device>();

        public List<ResultCDHA> Results { get; set; }
            = new List<ResultCDHA>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Patient entity thật.
        /// Không clone thành entity generic.
        /// </summary>
        public Patient? PatientInfo { get; set; }

        public long? UserLoginId { get; set; }


        // =====================================================
        // UI PROJECTION ONLY
        // =====================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Với XQ:
        /// Patient.GetSampleTimeXQ
        /// </summary>
        public DateTime? DisplayGetSampleTime { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Với XQ:
        /// Patient.ReturnResultTimeXQ
        /// </summary>
        public DateTime? DisplayReturnResultTime { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Với XQ:
        /// Patient.UserReturnResultXQ
        ///
        /// Nếu DB chưa chọn thì fallback user đang login,
        /// giống behavior UI hiện tại.
        /// </summary>
        public long? SelectedUserReturnResultId { get; set; }

        public string MedicalRecordName { get; set; }
            = string.Empty;


        // =====================================================
        // XQ PROJECTION
        // =====================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Tạo configuration chuẩn cho XQ.
        ///
        /// Sau này CT / MR / MG sẽ có factory tương tự,
        /// nhưng shared Razor không cần biết module nào.
        /// </summary>
        public static CdhaProcessModuleOptions CreateXqOptions()
        {
            return new CdhaProcessModuleOptions
            {
                ModulePrefix =
                    "xq",

                ScreenPrefix =
                    "process",

                ModuleCode =
                    "XQ",

                ModuleName =
                    "X Quang",

                PacsTitle =
                    "XQ PACS Viewer",

                UserReturnResultElementSuffix =
                    "userReturnResultXQ",

                PacsDefaultSize =
                    "75",

                EnableSave =
                    true,

                EnableValidPrint =
                    true,

                EnablePacs =
                    true,

                EnableDigitalSign =
                    true,

                EnableSampleTemplate =
                    true,

                // SHARED-10-06: XQ không có Process_CancelResultt/backend cancel contract.
                // Không render dead button "Bỏ qua" để tránh JS runtime error.
                EnableCancel =
                    false,

                EnableReturnToWaiting =
                    true,

                EnableDeviceModal =
                    true,

                EnableManualImages =
                    false,

                EnableCamera =
                    false,

                EnableVideo =
                    false
            };
        }


        /// <summary>
        /// Projection Patient XQ -> Shared UI.
        ///
        /// Không save database.
        /// Không thay property Patient.
        /// </summary>
        public static CdhaProcessViewModel CreateXqPatientInfo(
            Patient? patient,
            List<User>? users,
            List<BenhAnModel>? medicalRecords,
            long? userLoginId)
        {
            var vm =
                new CdhaProcessViewModel
                {
                    Options =
                        CreateXqOptions(),

                    PatientInfo =
                        patient,

                    Users =
                        users ??
                        new List<User>(),

                    MedicalRecords =
                        medicalRecords ??
                        new List<BenhAnModel>(),

                    UserLoginId =
                        userLoginId
                };


            if (patient == null)
            {
                return vm;
            }


            // =================================================
            // EXPLICIT XQ MAPPING
            //
            // Đây là nơi duy nhất biết XQ dùng field nào
            // trong Patient.
            // =================================================

            vm.DisplayGetSampleTime =
                patient.GetSampleTimeXQ;

            vm.DisplayReturnResultTime =
                patient.ReturnResultTimeXQ
                ?? DateTime.Now;

            vm.SelectedUserReturnResultId =
                patient.UserReturnResultXQ
                ?? userLoginId;


            // =================================================
            // Bệnh án
            // =================================================

            if (
                !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                    patient.BenhAn
                )
            )
            {
                var medicalRecord =
                    vm.MedicalRecords
                        .FirstOrDefault(
                            x =>
                                x.Id ==
                                patient.BenhAn
                        );

                vm.MedicalRecordName =
                    medicalRecord?.Name
                    ?? string.Empty;
            }


            return vm;
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Models/WorkOrder.cs">
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations;
using System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations.Schema;

namespace Management.Models
{
    [Table("WorkOrder")]
    [Index(nameof(PatientId), nameof(InsertTime), nameof(Status))]
    public class WorkOrder
    {
        
        [Key]
        public long Id { get; set; }

        public long? PatientId { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("PatientId")]
        public virtual Patient? Patient { get; set; }

        public long? DeviceId { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("DeviceId")]
        public virtual Device? Device { get; set; }

        public long? UserInsertId { get; set; }
        [ForeignKey("UserInsertId")]
        public virtual User? UserInsert { get; set; }

        public string TestCode { get; set; }
        public string TestCodeIn { get; set; }
        public string TestCodeIn2 { get; set; }
        public DateTime InsertTime { get; set; }
        public int Status { get; set; } // 0 : Đang chờ, 1 : Đang chạy, 2 : Đã có KQ, 3 : Chạy lại
    }
}

<file path="Program.cs">
using Management.BL;
using Management.BL.Services;
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Management.Services.Pacs;
using Management.Interfaces;
using Management.Models;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.Cookies;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
using QuestPDF.Infrastructure;
using System.Net;

var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);

QuestPDF.Settings.License = LicenseType.Community;
QuestPDF.Settings.CheckIfAllTextGlyphsAreAvailable = false;
QuestPDF.Settings.EnableDebugging = true;

// Add services to the container.
builder.Services.AddControllersWithViews();
builder.Services.AddAuthentication(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme).AddCookie();
builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor();
builder.Services.AddSingleton<IHttpContextAccessor, HttpContextAccessor>();
builder.Services.AddDistributedMemoryCache();
builder.Services.AddSession(options =>
{
    options.IdleTimeout = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(480);
});

#region Cau hinh CKS
// HttpClient cho MySign
builder.Services.AddHttpClient("mysign", client =>
{
    client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(60); // dung o file SignServerService.cs khi goi SignPdfAsync (var client = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("mysign");)
});

builder.Services.AddScoped<ISignServerService, SignServerService>();
#endregion Cau hinh CKS

builder.Services.AddDbContext<LABContext>(options => options.UseSqlServer(builder.Configuration.GetConnectionString("LABConnectionString")), ServiceLifetime.Transient);
builder.Services.AddTransient<HospitalBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<UserBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<TypeBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PatientXNBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<GroupBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<DoctorBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<LocationBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ObjectBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<CategoryBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ServiceBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ResultXNBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ServiceTestBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<SettingBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ToolBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ResultCDHABL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PatientCDHABL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<SampleBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<FunctionBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<TestTypeBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PrintSampleBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<DeviceBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<TestCodeBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<MapBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ResultStandardBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<ReportBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<APIBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<APIBL_MHIS>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PushResultHISBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<DigitalSignBL>();

// ============================================================
// PACS CORE
// ============================================================
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsConfigBL>();
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<OrthancClient>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsViewerBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsWorklistBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsStudyBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsChangeSyncBL>();
builder.Services.AddTransient<PacsReliabilityBL>();

builder.Services.Configure<PacsSyncBackgroundOptions>(
    builder.Configuration.GetSection("PacsSyncBackground"));

// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01D
// Recovery configuration used by PacsRecoveryBackgroundService.
// Runtime execution still requires PacsSyncRecovery:Enabled=true.
builder.Services.Configure<PacsSyncRecoveryOptions>(
    builder.Configuration.GetSection("PacsSyncRecovery"));

// Reconciliation configuration used by PacsReconciliationBackgroundService.
// Runtime execution still requires PacsSyncReconciliation:Enabled=true.
builder.Services.Configure<PacsSyncReconciliationOptions>(
    builder.Configuration.GetSection("PacsSyncReconciliation"));

// Keep the three background responsibilities separate:
// 1) /changes checkpoint sync,
// 2) Missing Study Recovery,
// 3) Completed Study Reconciliation.
builder.Services.AddHostedService<PacsSyncBackgroundService>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<PacsRecoveryBackgroundService>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<PacsReconciliationBackgroundService>();
builder.Services.AddHostedService<
    Management.BL.Pacs.PacsIisSmbOneShotHostedService>();
// ======================================================
// PACS / OHIF YARP Reverse Proxy
// ======================================================
builder.Services
    .AddReverseProxy()
    .LoadFromConfig(
        builder.Configuration.GetSection("ReverseProxy")
    );
// ======================================================
// OHIF root asset proxy
//
// OHIF v3.8 có một số JS/CSS/worker/font/image được load
// tại root của host thay vì dưới /ohif.
// Base URL lấy từ cùng YARP destination để không hard-code.
// ======================================================

var ohifProxyBaseUrl =
    builder.Configuration[
        "ReverseProxy:Clusters:ohif-cluster:Destinations:ohif-destination:Address"
    ]
    ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(
        "Không tìm thấy cấu hình ReverseProxy OHIF destination."
    );

builder.Services.AddHttpClient("ohif-proxy", client =>
{
    client.BaseAddress = new Uri(
        ohifProxyBaseUrl,
        UriKind.Absolute
    );

    client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);
});
builder.Services.AddHostedService<MyHostedService>();

builder.Services.AddHostedService<Management.BL.Pacs.PacsIisMwlSyntheticHostedService>();
var app = builder.Build();

if (!app.Environment.IsDevelopment())
{
    app.UseExceptionHandler("/Home/Error");
    app.UseHsts();
}

app.UseHttpsRedirection();
// ======================================================
// Normalize OHIF base path
// /ohif -> /ohif/
// ======================================================

app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    if (context.Request.Path.Equals(
        "/ohif",
        StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
    {
        context.Response.Redirect("/ohif/");
        return;
    }

    await next();
});
// ======================================================
// PACS / OHIF cross-origin headers
//
// Project A hiện activate PACS cho XQ.
// Khi module khác được activate PACS thì bổ sung prefix tương ứng.
// ======================================================

app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    var path = context.Request.Path.Value ?? "";

    var isPacsViewerRelated =
        path.StartsWith(
            "/XQ_Process",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.StartsWith(
            "/ohif",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.StartsWith(
            "/dicom-web",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.StartsWith(
            "/wado",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    if (isPacsViewerRelated)
    {
        context.Response.OnStarting(() =>
        {
            context.Response.Headers[
                "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"
            ] = "same-origin";

            context.Response.Headers[
                "Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy"
            ] = "require-corp";

            context.Response.Headers[
                "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy"
            ] = "cross-origin";

            context.Response.Headers[
                "Permissions-Policy"
            ] = "cross-origin-isolated=*";

            context.Response.Headers.Remove(
                "X-Frame-Options"
            );

            return Task.CompletedTask;
        });
    }

    await next();
});
// ======================================================
// PROXY ROOT ASSETS CỦA OHIF
//
// OHIF v3.8 có thể load:
//   /app.bundle.xxx.js
//   /574.bundle.xxx.js
//   /481.css
//   /index.worker.xxx.worker.js
//   /assets...
//
// Chỉ proxy asset ở ROOT để không ăn nhầm
// JS/CSS của MVC/LIS nằm dưới các path khác.
// ======================================================

app.Use(async (context, next) =>
{
    var path = context.Request.Path.Value ?? "";

    var isOhifRootAsset =
        path.Equals(
            "/app-config.js",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.Equals(
            "/manifest.json",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.Equals(
            "/init-service-worker.js",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.Equals(
            "/service-worker.js",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".js",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".css",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".json",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".png",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".jpg",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".jpeg",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".svg",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".ico",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".wasm",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".map",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".woff",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".woff2",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||

        path.EndsWith(
            ".ttf",
            StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    // Chỉ asset nằm ngay ROOT:
    //
    // /app.bundle.xxx.js   -> proxy
    // /481.css             -> proxy
    //
    // /js/xq.js            -> KHÔNG proxy
    // /css/site.css        -> KHÔNG proxy
    // /XQ_Process/...      -> KHÔNG proxy
    //
    var isRootAsset =
        path.Count(c => c == '/') == 1;

    if (isRootAsset && isOhifRootAsset)
    {
        var clientFactory =
            context.RequestServices
                .GetRequiredService<IHttpClientFactory>();

        var client =
            clientFactory.CreateClient("ohif-proxy");

        var targetPath =
            path + context.Request.QueryString;

        using var requestMessage =
            new HttpRequestMessage(
                HttpMethod.Get,
                targetPath
            );

        using var responseMessage =
            await client.SendAsync(
                requestMessage,
                HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead,
                context.RequestAborted
            );

        context.Response.StatusCode =
            (int)responseMessage.StatusCode;

        foreach (var header in responseMessage.Headers)
        {
            context.Response.Headers[
                header.Key
            ] = header.Value.ToArray();
        }

        foreach (var header in responseMessage.Content.Headers)
        {
            context.Response.Headers[
                header.Key
            ] = header.Value.ToArray();
        }

        // Hop-by-hop headers không được forward.
        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "transfer-encoding");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "connection");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "keep-alive");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "proxy-authenticate");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "proxy-authorization");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "te");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "trailer");

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "upgrade");

        // Giữ isolation headers cho OHIF/MPR/3D.
        context.Response.Headers[
            "Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy"
        ] = "same-origin";

        context.Response.Headers[
            "Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy"
        ] = "require-corp";

        context.Response.Headers[
            "Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy"
        ] = "cross-origin";

        context.Response.Headers[
            "Permissions-Policy"
        ] = "cross-origin-isolated=*";

        context.Response.Headers.Remove(
            "X-Frame-Options");

        await responseMessage.Content.CopyToAsync(
            context.Response.Body,
            context.RequestAborted
        );

        return;
    }

    await next();
});
app.UseStaticFiles();
app.UseSession();
app.UseRouting();
app.UseAuthentication();
app.UseAuthorization();

// ======================================================
// YARP Reverse Proxy
// ======================================================

app.MapReverseProxy();

app.MapControllerRoute(
    name: "default",
    pattern: "{controller=Account}/{action=Login}/{id?}");

app.Run();
</file>

        "ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT": "Development"

<file path="Services/Pacs/OrthancClient.cs">
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Shared REST client giao tiếp với Orthanc.
    ///
    /// Không phụ thuộc module XQ / CT / MRI / MG / SA.
    ///
    /// PacsConfig được truyền vào Configure() để thiết lập:
    /// - Base URL
    /// - Timeout
    /// - Basic Authentication
    ///
    /// Sau Configure(), client được sử dụng cho:
    /// - Study
    /// - Series
    /// - Instance
    /// - Changes
    /// - Recovery lookup
    /// - Preview
    /// </summary>
    public class OrthancClient
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        /*
         * PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01D-05-HOTFIX-04
         *
         * HttpClient.BaseAddress / Timeout cannot be changed after the
         * first request has started. One OrthancClient can be reused by
         * PacsStudyBL for multiple StableStudy items inside one checkpoint
         * batch, so Configure() must be idempotent for the same PACS config.
         */
        private readonly object _configureLock = new();
        private bool _isConfigured;

        public OrthancClient(HttpClient httpClient)
        {
            _httpClient = httpClient;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cấu hình HttpClient theo PACS server đang được sử dụng.
        ///
        /// Contract:
        /// - Lần đầu: cấu hình BaseAddress / Timeout / Basic Auth.
        /// - Gọi lại với CÙNG config: NO-OP.
        /// - Yêu cầu đổi sang config khác trên cùng OrthancClient:
        ///   fail-closed, không mutate HttpClient.
        ///
        /// HttpClient không cho phép thay đổi BaseAddress / Timeout
        /// sau khi request đầu tiên đã bắt đầu.
        /// </summary>
        public void Configure(PacsConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null)
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "PACS config không hợp lệ.");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.BaseUrl))
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "BaseUrl PACS chưa được cấu hình.");
            }

            var desiredBaseAddress =
                new Uri(
                    config.BaseUrl
                        .Trim()
                        .TrimEnd('/'));

            var desiredTimeout =
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

            AuthenticationHeaderValue?
                desiredAuthorization = null;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                config.ApiUsername))
            {
                var rawAuth =
                    $"{config.ApiUsername}:{config.ApiPassword}";

                var token =
                    Convert.ToBase64String(
                        Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(
                            rawAuth));

                desiredAuthorization =
                    new AuthenticationHeaderValue(
                        "Basic",
                        token);
            }

            lock (_configureLock)
            {
                if (_isConfigured)
                {
                    var currentAuthorization =
                        _httpClient
                            .DefaultRequestHeaders
                            .Authorization;

                    var sameBaseAddress =
                        Equals(
                            _httpClient.BaseAddress,
                            desiredBaseAddress);

                    var sameTimeout =
                        _httpClient.Timeout ==
                        desiredTimeout;

                    var sameAuthorization =
                        SameAuthorization(
                            currentAuthorization,
                            desiredAuthorization);

                    if (sameBaseAddress &&
                        sameTimeout &&
                        sameAuthorization)
                    {
                        // Idempotent call for the same PACS config.
                        // Do not mutate HttpClient after its first request.
                        return;
                    }

                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "OrthancClient đã được cấu hình và đã bắt đầu được sử dụng. " +
                        "Không cho phép đổi PACS BaseUrl/Timeout/Authentication " +
                        "trên cùng HttpClient instance.");
                }

                _httpClient.BaseAddress =
                    desiredBaseAddress;

                _httpClient.Timeout =
                    desiredTimeout;

                _httpClient
                    .DefaultRequestHeaders
                    .Clear();

                if (desiredAuthorization != null)
                {
                    _httpClient
                        .DefaultRequestHeaders
                        .Authorization =
                            desiredAuthorization;
                }

                _isConfigured = true;
            }
        }

        private static bool SameAuthorization(
            AuthenticationHeaderValue? current,
            AuthenticationHeaderValue? desired)
        {
            if (current == null &&
                desired == null)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (current == null ||
                desired == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return
                string.Equals(
                    current.Scheme,
                    desired.Scheme,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                &&
                string.Equals(
                    current.Parameter,
                    desired.Parameter,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lấy danh sách toàn bộ Study trong Orthanc.
        ///
        /// GET /studies
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<string> GetStudiesJsonAsync()
        {
            var response =
                await _httpClient.GetAsync(
                    "/studies");

            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            return await response
                .Content
                .ReadAsStringAsync();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Đọc Orthanc change feed.
        ///
        /// GET /changes?since={seq}&limit={limit}
        ///
        /// Đây là API chính cho background PACS sync.
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<string> GetChangesJsonAsync(
            long since = 0,
            int limit = 100,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
        {
            EnsureConfigured();

            if (since < 0)
            {
                since = 0;
            }

            if (limit <= 0)
            {

            using var response =

        }

using Management.Models.Pacs;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;

namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Shared REST client giao tiếp với Orthanc.
    ///
    /// Không phụ thuộc module XQ / CT / MRI / MG / SA.
    ///
    /// PacsConfig được truyền vào Configure() để thiết lập:
    /// - Base URL
    /// - Timeout
    /// - Basic Authentication
    ///
    /// Sau Configure(), client được sử dụng cho:
    /// - Study
    /// - Series
    /// - Instance
    /// - Changes
    /// - Recovery lookup
    /// - Preview
    /// </summary>
    public class OrthancClient
    {
        private readonly HttpClient _httpClient;

        /*
         * PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01D-05-HOTFIX-04
         *
         * HttpClient.BaseAddress / Timeout cannot be changed after the
         * first request has started. One OrthancClient can be reused by
         * PacsStudyBL for multiple StableStudy items inside one checkpoint
         * batch, so Configure() must be idempotent for the same PACS config.
         */
        private readonly object _configureLock = new();
        private bool _isConfigured;

        public OrthancClient(HttpClient httpClient)
        {
            _httpClient = httpClient;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Cấu hình HttpClient theo PACS server đang được sử dụng.
        ///
        /// Contract:
        /// - Lần đầu: cấu hình BaseAddress / Timeout / Basic Auth.
        /// - Gọi lại với CÙNG config: NO-OP.
        /// - Yêu cầu đổi sang config khác trên cùng OrthancClient:
        ///   fail-closed, không mutate HttpClient.
        ///
        /// HttpClient không cho phép thay đổi BaseAddress / Timeout
        /// sau khi request đầu tiên đã bắt đầu.
        /// </summary>
        public void Configure(PacsConfig config)
        {
            if (config == null)
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "PACS config không hợp lệ.");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(config.BaseUrl))
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "BaseUrl PACS chưa được cấu hình.");
            }

            var desiredBaseAddress =
                new Uri(
                    config.BaseUrl
                        .Trim()
                        .TrimEnd('/'));

            var desiredTimeout =
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);

            AuthenticationHeaderValue?
                desiredAuthorization = null;

            if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                config.ApiUsername))
            {
                var rawAuth =
                    $"{config.ApiUsername}:{config.ApiPassword}";

                var token =
                    Convert.ToBase64String(
                        Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(
                            rawAuth));

                desiredAuthorization =
                    new AuthenticationHeaderValue(
                        "Basic",
                        token);
            }

            lock (_configureLock)
            {
                if (_isConfigured)
                {
                    var currentAuthorization =
                        _httpClient
                            .DefaultRequestHeaders
                            .Authorization;

                    var sameBaseAddress =
                        Equals(
                            _httpClient.BaseAddress,
                            desiredBaseAddress);

                    var sameTimeout =
                        _httpClient.Timeout ==
                        desiredTimeout;

                    var sameAuthorization =
                        SameAuthorization(
                            currentAuthorization,
                            desiredAuthorization);

                    if (sameBaseAddress &&
                        sameTimeout &&
                        sameAuthorization)
                    {
                        // Idempotent call for the same PACS config.
                        // Do not mutate HttpClient after its first request.
                        return;
                    }

                    throw new InvalidOperationException(
                        "OrthancClient đã được cấu hình và đã bắt đầu được sử dụng. " +
                        "Không cho phép đổi PACS BaseUrl/Timeout/Authentication " +
                        "trên cùng HttpClient instance.");
                }

                _httpClient.BaseAddress =
                    desiredBaseAddress;

                _httpClient.Timeout =
                    desiredTimeout;

                _httpClient
                    .DefaultRequestHeaders
                    .Clear();

                if (desiredAuthorization != null)
                {
                    _httpClient
                        .DefaultRequestHeaders
                        .Authorization =
                            desiredAuthorization;
                }

                _isConfigured = true;
            }
        }

        private static bool SameAuthorization(
            AuthenticationHeaderValue? current,
            AuthenticationHeaderValue? desired)
        {
            if (current == null &&
                desired == null)
            {
                return true;
            }

            if (current == null ||
                desired == null)
            {
                return false;
            }

            return
                string.Equals(
                    current.Scheme,
                    desired.Scheme,
                    StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                &&
                string.Equals(
                    current.Parameter,
                    desired.Parameter,
                    StringComparison.Ordinal);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lấy danh sách toàn bộ Study trong Orthanc.
        ///
        /// GET /studies
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<string> GetStudiesJsonAsync()
        {
            var response =

                    "/studies");

            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            return await response
                .Content
                .ReadAsStringAsync();
        }

            {

            if (limit > 500)
            {
                limit = 500;
            }

            var url =
                $"/changes?since={since}&limit={limit}";

            using var response =
                await _httpClient.GetAsync(
                    url,

            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            return await response

        }

                accessionNumber))
            {
                return new List<string>();
            }

                accessionNumber.Trim();

            {
                Level = "Study",

                Query =
                    new Dictionary<string, string>
                    {
                        ["AccessionNumber"] =
                            accessionNumber
                    }
            };

            var requestJson =
                JsonSerializer.Serialize(
                    requestBody);

            using var content =
                new StringContent(
                    requestJson,
                    Encoding.UTF8,
                    "application/json");

            using var response =
                await _httpClient.PostAsync(
                    "/tools/find",
                    content,
                    cancellationToken);

            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            var responseJson =
                await response
                    .Content
                    .ReadAsStringAsync();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                responseJson))
            {
                return new List<string>();
            }

            var studyIds =
                JsonSerializer
                    .Deserialize<List<string>>(
                        responseJson)
                ?? new List<string>();

            return studyIds
                .Where(
                    x => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x))
                .Select(
                    x => x.Trim())
                .Distinct(
                    StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
                .ToList();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lấy metadata của một Orthanc Study.
        ///
        /// GET /studies/{studyId}
        /// </summary>
        public async Task<string> GetStudyJsonAsync(

                    "OrthancStudyId không hợp lệ.");
            }

                "/studies/" +

                    orthancStudyId.Trim());

                await _httpClient.GetAsync(

                .Content

        /// </summary>

        {
            EnsureConfigured();

            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
                orthancStudyId))
            {
                throw new Exception(
                    "OrthancStudyId không hợp lệ.");
            }

            var url =
                $"/studies/" +
                $"{Uri.EscapeDataString(orthancStudyId.Trim())}" +
                "/series";

            using var response =
                await _httpClient.GetAsync(
                    url,
                    cancellationToken);

            response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();

            return await response
                .Content
                .ReadAsStringAsync();
        }

        /// Lấy metadata của một Series.
