<file path="Services/Pacs/PacsReconciliationBackgroundService.cs">
using System.Globalization;
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01D-02
    /// Automatic Completed Study Reconciliation scheduler.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsReconciliationBackgroundService
        : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
        private readonly ILogger<PacsReconciliationBackgroundService> _logger;
        private readonly IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncReconciliationOptions>
            _optionsMonitor;

        public PacsReconciliationBackgroundService(
            IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
            ILogger<PacsReconciliationBackgroundService> logger,
            IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncReconciliationOptions> optionsMonitor)
        {
            _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
            _logger = logger;
            _optionsMonitor = optionsMonitor;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
            CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            var startupOptions =
                NormalizeOptions(
                    _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Reconciliation Background START. " +
                "Enabled={Enabled}, StartDate={StartDate}, " +
                "IntervalMinutes={IntervalMinutes}, BatchSize={BatchSize}, " +
                "MinAgeMinutes={MinAgeMinutes}.",
                startupOptions.Enabled,
                startupOptions.StartDate,
                startupOptions.IntervalMinutes,
                startupOptions.BatchSize,
                startupOptions.MinAgeMinutes);

            while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var options =
                    NormalizeOptions(
                        _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

                try
                {
                    if (!options.Enabled)
                    {
                        _logger.LogDebug(
                            "PACS Reconciliation Background switch đang OFF.");
                    }
                    else if (!TryParseStartDate(
                                 options.StartDate,
                                 out _))
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "PACS Reconciliation Background fail-closed: " +
                            "StartDate không hợp lệ. " +
                            "Expected yyyy-MM-dd. Actual={StartDate}.",
                            options.StartDate);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        await RunReconciliationCycleAsync(
                            options,
                            stoppingToken);
                    }
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        ex,
                        "PACS Reconciliation Background unexpected cycle error. " +
                        "Service sẽ retry ở cycle tiếp theo.");
                }

                try
                {
                    await Task.Delay(
                        TimeSpan.FromMinutes(
                            options.IntervalMinutes),
                        stoppingToken);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Reconciliation Background STOP.");
        }

        private async Task RunReconciliationCycleAsync(
            PacsSyncReconciliationOptions options,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await using var scope =
                _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

            var pacsConfigBL =
                scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<PacsConfigBL>();

            var config =
                await pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

            if (config == null ||
                !config.IsActive ||
                !config.IsDefault)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "PACS Reconciliation Background idle: " +
                    "chưa có PACS default active.");

                return;
            }

            if (!config.SyncEnabled)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug(
                    "PACS Reconciliation Background server sync OFF. " +
                    "PacsConfigId={PacsConfigId}, Code={Code}.",
                    config.Id,
                    config.Code);

                return;
            }

            var reliabilityBL =
                scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<PacsReliabilityBL>();

            var startedAt =
                DateTime.Now;

            var result =
                await reliabilityBL
                    .ReconcilePendingAsync(
                        options.BatchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            var elapsedMs =
                (DateTime.Now - startedAt)
                    .TotalMilliseconds;

            if (result.Success)
            {
                if (result.CandidateCount > 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "PACS Reconciliation Background PASS. " +
                        "Candidates={Candidates}, Match={Match}, " +
                        "Reconciled={Reconciled}, AlreadyMatched={AlreadyMatched}, " +
                        "NotStable={NotStable}, ExtraData={ExtraData}, " +
                        "ComplexMismatch={ComplexMismatch}, " +
                        "IdentityMismatch={IdentityMismatch}, " +
                        "PacsStudyNotFound={PacsStudyNotFound}, " +
                        "SyncBusy={SyncBusy}, Skipped={Skipped}, Errors={Errors}, " +
                        "ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                        result.CandidateCount,
                        result.MatchCount,
                        result.ReconciledCount,
                        result.AlreadyMatchedCount,
                        result.NotStableCount,
                        result.ExtraDataCount,
                        result.ComplexMismatchCount,
                        result.IdentityMismatchCount,
                        result.PacsStudyNotFoundCount,
                        result.SyncBusyCount,
                        result.SkippedCount,
                        result.ErrorCount,
                        elapsedMs);
                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogDebug(
                        "PACS Reconciliation Background NO-OP. " +
                        "Candidates=0, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                        elapsedMs);
                }

                return;
            }

            _logger.LogWarning(
                "PACS Reconciliation Background cycle not successful. " +
                "Status={Status}, Candidates={Candidates}, Errors={Errors}, " +
                "Message={Message}, Error={Error}, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                result.Status,
                result.CandidateCount,
                result.ErrorCount,
                result.Message,
                result.ErrorMessage,
                elapsedMs);
        }

        private static bool TryParseStartDate(
            string? value,
            out DateTime startDate)
        {
            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                value?.Trim(),
                "yyyy-MM-dd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out startDate);
        }

        private static PacsSyncReconciliationOptions
            NormalizeOptions(
                PacsSyncReconciliationOptions? source)
        {
            source ??=
                new PacsSyncReconciliationOptions();

            return new PacsSyncReconciliationOptions
            {
                Enabled =
                    source.Enabled,

                StartDate =
                    source.StartDate?.Trim(),

                IntervalMinutes =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.IntervalMinutes,
                        1,
                        1440),

                BatchSize =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.BatchSize,
                        1,
                        500),

                MinAgeMinutes =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.MinAgeMinutes,
                        0,
                        10080)
            };
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Services/Pacs/PacsRecoveryBackgroundService.cs">
using System.Globalization;
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01D-02
    /// Automatic Missing Study Recovery scheduler.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsRecoveryBackgroundService
        : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
        private readonly ILogger<PacsRecoveryBackgroundService> _logger;
        private readonly IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncRecoveryOptions>
            _optionsMonitor;

        public PacsRecoveryBackgroundService(
            IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
            ILogger<PacsRecoveryBackgroundService> logger,
            IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncRecoveryOptions> optionsMonitor)
        {
            _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
            _logger = logger;
            _optionsMonitor = optionsMonitor;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
            CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            var startupOptions =
                NormalizeOptions(
                    _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Recovery Background START. " +
                "Enabled={Enabled}, StartDate={StartDate}, " +
                "IntervalSeconds={IntervalSeconds}, BatchSize={BatchSize}, " +
                "MinAgeMinutes={MinAgeMinutes}.",
                startupOptions.Enabled,
                startupOptions.StartDate,
                startupOptions.IntervalSeconds,
                startupOptions.BatchSize,
                startupOptions.MinAgeMinutes);

            while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var options =
                    NormalizeOptions(
                        _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

                try
                {
                    if (!options.Enabled)
                    {
                        _logger.LogDebug(
                            "PACS Recovery Background switch đang OFF.");
                    }
                    else if (!TryParseStartDate(
                                 options.StartDate,
                                 out _))
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "PACS Recovery Background fail-closed: " +
                            "StartDate không hợp lệ. " +
                            "Expected yyyy-MM-dd. Actual={StartDate}.",
                            options.StartDate);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        await RunRecoveryCycleAsync(
                            options,
                            stoppingToken);
                    }
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    _logger.LogError(
                        ex,
                        "PACS Recovery Background unexpected cycle error. " +
                        "Service sẽ retry ở cycle tiếp theo.");
                }

                try
                {
                    await Task.Delay(
                        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                            options.IntervalSeconds),
                        stoppingToken);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Recovery Background STOP.");
        }

        private async Task RunRecoveryCycleAsync(
            PacsSyncRecoveryOptions options,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            await using var scope =
                _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

            var pacsConfigBL =
                scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<PacsConfigBL>();

            var config =
                await pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

            if (config == null ||
                !config.IsActive ||
                !config.IsDefault)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "PACS Recovery Background idle: " +
                    "chưa có PACS default active.");

                return;
            }

            if (!config.SyncEnabled)
            {
                _logger.LogDebug(
                    "PACS Recovery Background server sync OFF. " +
                    "PacsConfigId={PacsConfigId}, Code={Code}.",
                    config.Id,
                    config.Code);

                return;
            }

            var reliabilityBL =
                scope.ServiceProvider
                    .GetRequiredService<PacsReliabilityBL>();

            var startedAt =
                DateTime.Now;

            var result =
                await reliabilityBL
                    .RecoverPendingAsync(
                        options.BatchSize,
                        cancellationToken);

            var elapsedMs =
                (DateTime.Now - startedAt)
                    .TotalMilliseconds;

            if (result.Success)
            {
                if (result.CandidateCount > 0)
                {
                    _logger.LogInformation(
                        "PACS Recovery Background PASS. " +
                        "Candidates={Candidates}, Recovered={Recovered}, " +
                        "NotFound={NotFound}, NotStable={NotStable}, " +
                        "AlreadyHandled={AlreadyHandled}, Ambiguous={Ambiguous}, " +
                        "IdentityMismatch={IdentityMismatch}, SyncBusy={SyncBusy}, " +
                        "Skipped={Skipped}, Errors={Errors}, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                        result.CandidateCount,
                        result.RecoveredCount,
                        result.NotFoundCount,
                        result.NotStableCount,
                        result.AlreadyHandledCount,
                        result.AmbiguousCount,
                        result.IdentityMismatchCount,
                        result.SyncBusyCount,
                        result.SkippedCount,
                        result.ErrorCount,
                        elapsedMs);
                }
                else
                {
                    _logger.LogDebug(
                        "PACS Recovery Background NO-OP. " +
                        "Candidates=0, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                        elapsedMs);
                }

                return;
            }

            _logger.LogWarning(
                "PACS Recovery Background cycle not successful. " +
                "Status={Status}, Candidates={Candidates}, Errors={Errors}, " +
                "Message={Message}, Error={Error}, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                result.Status,
                result.CandidateCount,
                result.ErrorCount,
                result.Message,
                result.ErrorMessage,
                elapsedMs);
        }

        private static bool TryParseStartDate(
            string? value,
            out DateTime startDate)
        {
            return DateTime.TryParseExact(
                value?.Trim(),
                "yyyy-MM-dd",
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                DateTimeStyles.None,
                out startDate);
        }

        private static PacsSyncRecoveryOptions
            NormalizeOptions(
                PacsSyncRecoveryOptions? source)
        {
            source ??=
                new PacsSyncRecoveryOptions();

            return new PacsSyncRecoveryOptions
            {
                Enabled =
                    source.Enabled,

                StartDate =
                    source.StartDate?.Trim(),

                IntervalSeconds =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.IntervalSeconds,
                        10,
                        3600),

                BatchSize =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.BatchSize,
                        1,
                        500),

                MinAgeMinutes =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.MinAgeMinutes,
                        0,
                        1440)
            };
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Services/Pacs/PacsReliabilityOptions.cs">
namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01B Recovery configuration contract.
    ///
    /// StartDate is deliberately kept as configuration text and will be parsed
    /// fail-closed by PacsReliabilityBL in 01B-02. An empty/invalid StartDate
    /// must never cause a historical full-table recovery scan.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsSyncRecoveryOptions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Reserved for automatic background Recovery in PREPROD-01D.
        /// Manual preview/recovery endpoints are not controlled by this switch.
        /// </summary>
        public bool Enabled { get; set; } = false;

        /// <summary>
        /// yyyy-MM-dd. Required by recovery logic; empty/invalid means fail closed.
        /// </summary>
        public string? StartDate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Reserved background interval for PREPROD-01D.
        /// </summary>
        public int IntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 60;

        /// <summary>
        /// Maximum number of pending Worklists examined per recovery batch.
        /// </summary>
        public int BatchSize { get; set; } = 50;

        /// <summary>
        /// Newly published Worklists must age for this many minutes before they
        /// become Recovery candidates. This prevents Recovery racing normal C-STORE.
        /// </summary>
        public int MinAgeMinutes { get; set; } = 2;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-PREPROD-01C Reconciliation configuration contract.
    ///
    /// Reconciliation only examines Worklists that are already Completed
    /// (Status=3) and compares the LIS hierarchy with the current Orthanc
    /// hierarchy. StartDate is mandatory and will be parsed fail-closed by
    /// PacsReliabilityBL beginning in PREPROD-01C-02.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsSyncReconciliationOptions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Reserved for automatic background Reconciliation in PREPROD-01D.
        /// Manual preview/reconciliation endpoints are not controlled by this switch.
        /// </summary>
        public bool Enabled { get; set; } = false;

        /// <summary>
        /// yyyy-MM-dd. Required by reconciliation logic; empty/invalid means fail closed.
        /// </summary>
        public string? StartDate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Reserved background interval for PREPROD-01D.
        /// </summary>
        public int IntervalMinutes { get; set; } = 10;

        /// <summary>
        /// Maximum number of completed Worklists examined per reconciliation batch.
        /// </summary>
        public int BatchSize { get; set; } = 20;

        /// <summary>
        /// Completed studies must age for this many minutes before they become
        /// Reconciliation candidates. This reduces races with late C-STORE bursts.
        /// </summary>
        public int MinAgeMinutes { get; set; } = 10;
    }

}
</file>

<file path="Services/Pacs/PacsSyncBackgroundService.cs">
using Management.BL.Pacs;
using Management.Models.Pacs;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;

namespace Management.Services.Pacs
{
    public sealed class PacsSyncBackgroundOptions
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Global kill-switch.
        /// Server-level enable/disable vẫn lấy từ PacsConfigs.SyncEnabled.
        /// </summary>
        public bool Enabled { get; set; } = false;

        public int InitialDelaySeconds { get; set; } = 10;

        /// <summary>
        /// Delay dùng khi chưa có default PACS hoặc server-level sync đang tắt.
        /// </summary>
        public int IdlePollSeconds { get; set; } = 15;

        public int Limit { get; set; } = 100;

        public int MaxPages { get; set; } = 10;

        public int MinimumIntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 10;

        public int MaximumIntervalSeconds { get; set; } = 3600;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// PACS-XQ-04-08
    ///
    /// Background consumer của checkpoint pipeline đã PASS ở 04-06/04-07.
    ///
    /// Quy tắc:
    /// - tạo IServiceScope mới cho mỗi cycle;
    /// - không giữ LABContext sống xuyên suốt lifetime của HostedService;
    /// - honor global Enabled + PacsConfigs.SyncEnabled;
    /// - interval lấy từ PacsConfigs.SyncIntervalSeconds;
    /// - lỗi một cycle không làm chết application;
    /// - cancellation shutdown được tôn trọng;
    /// - không tự bootstrap/reset checkpoint;
    /// - không gọi manual-range API;
    /// - checkpoint ownership vẫn nằm trong PacsChangeSyncBL.SyncFromCheckpointAsync().
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class PacsSyncBackgroundService
        : BackgroundService
    {
        private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
        private readonly ILogger<PacsSyncBackgroundService> _logger;
        private readonly IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncBackgroundOptions>
            _optionsMonitor;

        public PacsSyncBackgroundService(
            IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
            ILogger<PacsSyncBackgroundService> logger,
            IOptionsMonitor<PacsSyncBackgroundOptions> optionsMonitor)
        {
            _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
            _logger = logger;
            _optionsMonitor = optionsMonitor;
        }

        protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(
            CancellationToken stoppingToken)
        {
            var startupOptions =
                NormalizeOptions(
                    _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Background START. " +
                "GlobalEnabled={Enabled}, InitialDelay={InitialDelay}s, " +
                "IdlePoll={IdlePoll}s, Limit={Limit}, MaxPages={MaxPages}.",
                startupOptions.Enabled,
                startupOptions.InitialDelaySeconds,
                startupOptions.IdlePollSeconds,
                startupOptions.Limit,
                startupOptions.MaxPages);

            if (startupOptions.InitialDelaySeconds > 0)
            {
                try
                {
                    await Task.Delay(
                        TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
                            startupOptions.InitialDelaySeconds),
                        stoppingToken);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    return;
                }
            }

            while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
            {
                var options =
                    NormalizeOptions(
                        _optionsMonitor.CurrentValue);

                var nextDelaySeconds =
                    options.IdlePollSeconds;

                try
                {
                    if (!options.Enabled)
                    {
                        _logger.LogDebug(
                            "PACS Background global switch đang OFF.");

                        await DelayNextCycleAsync(
                            nextDelaySeconds,
                            stoppingToken);

                        continue;
                    }

                    await using var scope =
                        _scopeFactory.CreateAsyncScope();

                    var pacsConfigBL =
                        scope.ServiceProvider
                            .GetRequiredService<PacsConfigBL>();

                    var config =
                        await pacsConfigBL.GetDefaultAsync();

                    if (config == null)
                    {
                        _logger.LogWarning(
                            "PACS Background: chưa có PACS default active.");

                        await DelayNextCycleAsync(
                            nextDelaySeconds,
                            stoppingToken);

                        continue;
                    }

                    nextDelaySeconds =
                        NormalizeServerInterval(
                            config.SyncIntervalSeconds,
                            options);

                    if (!config.SyncEnabled)
                    {
                        _logger.LogDebug(
                            "PACS Background server sync OFF. " +
                            "PacsConfigId={PacsConfigId}, Code={Code}.",
                            config.Id,
                            config.Code);

                        await DelayNextCycleAsync(
                            Math.Min(
                                nextDelaySeconds,
                                options.IdlePollSeconds),
                            stoppingToken);

                        continue;
                    }

                    var changeSyncBL =
                        scope.ServiceProvider
                            .GetRequiredService<PacsChangeSyncBL>();

                    _logger.LogDebug(
                        "PACS Background cycle START. " +
                        "PacsConfigId={PacsConfigId}, Limit={Limit}, " +
                        "MaxPages={MaxPages}.",
                        config.Id,
                        options.Limit,
                        options.MaxPages);

                    var startedAt =
                        DateTime.Now;

                    var result =
                        await changeSyncBL
                            .SyncFromCheckpointAsync(
                                new PacsSyncCheckpointRequest
                                {
                                    Limit =
                                        options.Limit,
                                    MaxPages =
                                        options.MaxPages
                                },
                                stoppingToken);

                    var elapsedMs =
                        (DateTime.Now - startedAt)
                            .TotalMilliseconds;

                    if (result.Success)
                    {
                        if (result.UniqueStudyCount > 0)
                        {
                            _logger.LogInformation(
                                "PACS Background PASS. " +
                                "Checkpoint {Before}->{After}, " +
                                "Studies={Studies}, Success={Success}, " +
                                "Failed={Failed}, Changes={Changes}, " +
                                "ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                                result.CheckpointBefore,
                                result.CheckpointAfter,
                                result.UniqueStudyCount,
                                result.SuccessStudyCount,
                                result.FailedStudyCount,
                                result.TotalChanges,
                                elapsedMs);
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            _logger.LogDebug(
                                "PACS Background NO-OP. " +
                                "Checkpoint {Before}->{After}, " +
                                "Changes={Changes}, ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                                result.CheckpointBefore,
                                result.CheckpointAfter,
                                result.TotalChanges,
                                elapsedMs);
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        _logger.LogError(
                            "PACS Background cycle FAILED. " +
                            "Checkpoint {Before}->{After}, " +
                            "ErrorCode={ErrorCode}, Error={Error}, " +
                            "ElapsedMs={ElapsedMs:0}.",
                            result.CheckpointBefore,
                            result.CheckpointAfter,
                            result.ErrorCode,
                            result.ErrorMessage ??
                                result.Message,
                            elapsedMs);
                    }
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    /*
                     * Không rethrow.
                     * Một lần Orthanc/network/DB lỗi không được giết application.
                     */
                    _logger.LogError(
                        ex,
                        "PACS Background unexpected cycle error. " +
                        "Service sẽ retry ở cycle tiếp theo.");
                }

                try
                {
                    await DelayNextCycleAsync(
                        nextDelaySeconds,
                        stoppingToken);
                }
                catch (OperationCanceledException)
                    when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
                {
                    break;
                }
            }

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "PACS Background STOP.");
        }

        private static PacsSyncBackgroundOptions
            NormalizeOptions(
                PacsSyncBackgroundOptions? source)
        {
            source ??=
                new PacsSyncBackgroundOptions();

            var minInterval =
                Math.Clamp(
                    source.MinimumIntervalSeconds,
                    5,
                    3600);

            var maxInterval =
                Math.Clamp(
                    source.MaximumIntervalSeconds,
                    minInterval,
                    86400);

            return new PacsSyncBackgroundOptions
            {
                Enabled =
                    source.Enabled,

                InitialDelaySeconds =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.InitialDelaySeconds,
                        0,
                        300),

                IdlePollSeconds =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.IdlePollSeconds,
                        5,
                        300),

                Limit =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.Limit,
                        1,
                        500),

                MaxPages =
                    Math.Clamp(
                        source.MaxPages,
                        1,
                        100),

                MinimumIntervalSeconds =
                    minInterval,

                MaximumIntervalSeconds =
                    maxInterval
            };
        }

        private static int NormalizeServerInterval(
            int configuredSeconds,
            PacsSyncBackgroundOptions options)
        {
            var fallback =
                60;

            var value =
                configuredSeconds > 0
                    ? configuredSeconds
                    : fallback;

            return Math.Clamp(
                value,
                options.MinimumIntervalSeconds,
                options.MaximumIntervalSeconds);
        }

        private static Task DelayNextCycleAsync(
            int seconds,
            CancellationToken cancellationToken)
        {
            return Task.Delay(
                TimeSpan.FromSeconds(seconds),
                cancellationToken);
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="TagHelpers/TestInputTagHelper.cs">
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using System.Text;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.ViewFeatures;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Razor.TagHelpers;

namespace Management.TagHelpers
{
    [HtmlTargetElement("myinput")]
    public class TestInputTagHelper : TagHelper
    {
        public string Id { get; set; }

        public string Name { get; set; }

        public string Type { get; set; }

        public string TitleToolTip { get; set; }

        public string Valid { get; set; }
       
        public override void Process(TagHelperContext context, TagHelperOutput output)
        {
            output.TagName = "input";
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("id", Id);
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("name", Name);
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("type", Type);
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("class", "form-control" + " " + Valid);
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("data-toggle", "tooltip");
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("title", TitleToolTip);
            output.Attributes.SetAttribute("data-placement", "top");
        }          
    }
}

@using Management.BL
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext.Request.Cookies[SessionKeyModel._sessionHospital];
    Layout = "_LayoutAccount";
}
@model User

<div class="login-parent">
    <div class="login-child">
        <form asp-controller="Account" asp-action="ChangedPassword" method="post" id="changedPassword" onsubmit="return ValidateInput('changedPassword')">
            <input asp-for="Code" type="text" hidden />
            <div class="form-outline mb-3">
                <i class="bi bi-key"></i> <label asp-for="Password" class="form-label">Mật khẩu cũ</label>
                <input asp-for="Password" type="password" class="form-control valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mật khẩu cũ là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-outline mb-3">
                <i class="bi bi-key"></i> <label asp-for="Password" class="form-label">Mật khẩu mới</label>
                <input type="password" name="passwordNew1" class="form-control valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mật khẩu mới là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-outline mb-3">
                <i class="bi bi-key"></i> <label asp-for="Password" class="form-label">Nhập lại mật khẩu mới</label>
                <input type="password" name="passwordNew2" class="form-control valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Xác nhận mật khẩu mới là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-outline mb-3">
                @if (ViewData["ChangePassword"] != null)
                {
                    <div class="margin-bottom-10 text-red"> @ViewData["ChangePassword"]</div>                      
                }
                <div class="div-center">
                    <button type="submit" class="btn btn-success margin-right-10">
                        <i class="bi bi-save"></i> Lưu
                    </button>
                    <a class="btn btn btn-danger" asp-controller="Account" asp-action="Logout" data-toggle="collapse" role="button" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapseExample">
                        <i class="bi bi-x-square"></i> Huỷ
                    </a>
                </div>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

@using Management.BL

@model User

<div class="login-parent">

        <form asp-controller="Account" asp-action="Logged" method="post" id="login" onsubmit="return ValidateInput('login')">
            <div class="form-outline mb-4">
                <i class="bi bi-person"></i> <label asp-for="Code" class="form-label">Tên đăng nhập</label>
                <input asp-for="Code" type="text" class="form-control valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên đang nhập là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-outline mb-4">
                <i class="bi bi-key"></i> <label asp-for="Password" class="form-label">Mật khẩu</label>
                <input asp-for="Password" type="password" class="form-control valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mật khẩu là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
            </div>
            <div class="form-outline mb-4">
                @if (ViewData["Login"] != null)
                {
                    <div class="margin-bottom-10 text-red">@ViewData["Login"]</div>
                }
                <div class="div-center">

<file path="Views/DDT_GetSample/_DDT_GetSample_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/DDT_GetSample/_DDT_GetSample_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
    var lstLocation = ViewData["lstLocation"] as List<Location>;
    var lstDoctor = ViewData["lstDoctor"] as List<Doctor>;
    var lstSexModel = ViewData["lstSexModel"] as List<SexModel>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeDDT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeDDT != null) ? DateTime.Parse(patientInfo.GetSampleTimeDDT.ToString()) : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="ddt-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_getsample_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="ddt_getsample_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mã bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="ddt_getsample_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true); GetSID(this.value);" onchange="GetSample_GetSID(this.value)" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="ddt_getsample_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_getsample_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="date" id="ddt_getsample_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Ngày sinh là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="ddt_getsample_sex" name="sex" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giới tính là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstSexModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstSexModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.Sex == item.Id.ToString())
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="ddt_getsample_obj" name="obj" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Đối tượng là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstObject != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstObject)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.ObjectId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="ddt_getsample_type" name="type" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bệnh án là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstBenhAnModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.BenhAn == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">

                @if (lstLocation != null)

    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">

        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">

        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ nhận bệnh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="ddt_getsample_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeDDT.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" />
        </div>

</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="ddt_getsample_diagnostic" class="form-control height-160 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<file path="Views/DDT_GetSample/_DDT_GetSample_Search.cshtml">

<file path="Views/DDT_GetSample/GetSample.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang chờ";
    Layout = "_LayoutDDT";
}

<div class="ddt-container">
    <div class="ddt-left">
        <div class="ddt-left-search">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_DDT_GetSample_Search")
        </div>
        <div id="listPatient" class="ddt-left-list">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_DDT_GetSample_ListPatient")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right">
        <div id="patientInfo" class="ddt-right-info">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_DDT_GetSample_PatientInfo")
        </div>
        <div id="patientService" class="ddt-right-service">
            <div id="ddt-right-service-group" class="ddt-right-service-group">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_DDT_GetSample_GroupButton")
            </div>
            <div id="ddt-right-service-gridview" class="ddt-right-service-gridview">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_DDT_GetSample_ListService")
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/DDT_Process/_DDT_Process_GroupButton.cshtml">
@{
    var lstSampleResult = ViewData["lstSampleResult"] as List<Sample>;
}

<div class="ddt-right-service-group-button">
    <button id="ddt_process_saveresult" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_SaveResult(false)">
        <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
    </button>
    <button id="ddt_process_cancelresult" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_CancelResultt()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-return-left"></i> Bỏ qua
    </button>
    <button id="ddt_process_valid_in" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_ValidPrint()">
        <i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Valid & In
    </button>  
    <button id="ddt_process_getsample" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_GetSample()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Đang chờ
    </button>
</div>
<div class="ddt-right-service-group-button-title-sample"> 
    <div class="title-process">
        MÔ TẢ
    </div>
    <div class="sample">
        <select id="ddt_process_sampleresult" name="ddt_process_sampleresult" class="form-select height-28" onchange="GetSampleForService(this.value)">
            @if (lstSampleResult != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstSampleResult)
                {
                    <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>   
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/DDT_Process/_DDT_Process_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/DDT_Process/_DDT_Process_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="Process_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>     
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content">
                <textarea id="ddt_process_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..."></textarea>
                <script>
                    CKEDITOR.replace("ddt_process_description");
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="ddt_process_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..."></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="ddt_process_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/DDT_Process/_DDT_Process_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<User>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;
    var userLoginId = ViewData["userLoginId"] as long?;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeDDT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeDDT != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeDDT?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeDDT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeDDT != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeDDT : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="ddt-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="ddt_process_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="ddt_process_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="ddt_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ddt_process_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeDDT" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="ddt_process_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeDDT?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="Process_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giờ trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
    </div>
     <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="ddt_process_userReturnResultDDT" name="userReturnResultddt" class="form-select height-28 valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Người trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstUser != null)
                {
                    var isUserReturnResultDDT = false;
                    foreach (var item in lstUser)
                    {
                        if (item.Id == patientInfo?.UserReturnResultDDT)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            isUserReturnResultDDT = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (isUserReturnResultDDT == false && userLoginId != null && userLoginId == item.Id)
                            {
                                <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="ddt-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="ddt_process_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ddt-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="ddt_process_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>
