<file path="Views/NS_ReturnResult/_NS_ReturnResult_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/NS_ReturnResult/_NS_ReturnResult_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="ReturnResult_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div id="image-returnresult" class="image-returnresult">
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content returnresult">
                <textarea id="ns_returnresult_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..." disabled></textarea>
                <script>
                    var editor = CKEDITOR.replace('ns_returnresult_description');
                    editor.on('instanceReady', function (evt) {
                        editor.setReadOnly(true);
                    });
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="ns_returnresult_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="ns_returnresult_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/NS_ReturnResult/_NS_ReturnResult_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeNS = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeNS != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeNS?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeNS = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeNS != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeNS?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
}
<div class="ns-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="ns-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="ns-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeNS" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeNS" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
     <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="ns_returnresult_userReturnResultNS" value="@patientInfo?.UserSA?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="ns-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="ns_returnresult_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="ns-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="ns_returnresult_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Object/_Object_Info.cshtml">
@{
    var obj = ViewData["Object"] as Management.Models.Object;
}

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã đối tượng</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="object-code" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@obj?.Code" onkeyup="Object_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" disabled />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên đối tượng</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="object-name" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@obj?.Name" onkeyup="Object_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">
        @{
            if (obj != null)
            {
                if (obj.Active)
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="object-active" onclick="Object_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                    <label for="object-active">Active</label>
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="object-active" onclick="Object_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="object-active">Active</label>
                }              
            }
            else
            {
                <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="object-active" onclick="Object_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                <label for="object-active">Active</label>
            }
        }       
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Object/_Object_List.cshtml">
@{
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered table-hover">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-checkbox" scope="col"></th>
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">Stt</th>
                <th class="th-id" scope="col">Id</th>
                <th class="th-code" scope="col">Mã</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">Tên</th> 
                <th class="th-active" scope="col">Active</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstObject != null && lstObject.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstObject)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr class="row-service" onclick="Object_CheckedBoxOnRow('@item.Code')">
                            <td class="td-checkbox">
                                <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Code" id="flexCheckChecked">
                            </td>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-id">@item.Id</td>
                            <td class="td-code">@item.Code</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.Name</td>
                            <td class="td-active">@item.Active</td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

                <td class="th-tpnt-patient" scope="col">THU PHÍ</td>
                <td class="th-bhytngt-patient" scope="col">BHYT</td>

<file path="Views/Report_BaoCaoGuiMauXN/Index.cshtml">
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Báo cáo gửi mẫu xét nghiệm";
    Layout = "_LayoutReport";
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<Management.Models.User>;
    var lstHospital = ViewData["lstHospital"] as List<Management.Models.Hospital>;
}

<div class="report-container">
    <div id="report-option-search" class="report-option-search">
        <div class="input1">
            <input type="date" id="report-time-from" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
        </div>
        <div class="input1">
            <input type="date" id="report-time-to" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="input">
        <select id="report-hospital" class="form-select height-28">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn bệnh viện --</option>
            @if (lstHospital != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstHospital)
                {
                    <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
    <div class="report-button">
        <div class="button">
            <button id="report-search" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Report_Search()">
                <i class="bi bi-search"></i> Xem trước
            </button>

                <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> Xuất PDF
            </button>
        </div>

                <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-spreadsheet"></i> Xuất Excel
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="report-result" class="report-result">
        @await Html.PartialAsync("_ReportGuiMauXN")
    </div>
</div>
@await Html.PartialAsync("_Loading")

<file path="Views/Report_BaoCaoThongKe/_Process_Content.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport_Report";
    var lstReportResult = ViewData["lstReportResult"] as List<ReportProcess>;  
    var lstGroup = lstReportResult.GroupBy(p => p.DoctorID);
}
@model Hospital
<div class="result-process">
    <table class="table-result">
        <thead class="thead">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-service" scope="col">DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-count" scope="col">SỐ LƯỢNG</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="tbody">
            @{
                if (lstGroup != null)
                {
                    foreach (var group in lstGroup)
                    {
                        var lstItem = group.ToList();
                        if (lstItem != null)
                        {
                            var sum = lstItem.Sum(p => p.Count);
                            <tr class="tr-content">
                                <td class="td-doctor" colspan="2">@lstItem[0].DoctorName (Tổng @sum)</td>
                            </tr>
                            foreach (var item in lstItem)
                            {
                                <tr class="tr-content">
                                    <td class="td-service">@item.ServiceName</td>
                                    <td class="td-count">@item.Count</td>
                                </tr>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Report_BaoCaoThongKe/_ReportByProcess.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var lstReportResult = ViewData["lstReportResult"] as List<ReportProcess>;
    var lstGroup = lstReportResult.GroupBy(p => p.DoctorID);
}
<div class="table-responsive">
    <table id="table-export-to-excel" class="table table-bordered table-striped table-hover">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-service-process" scope="col">DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-count-process" scope="col">SỐ LƯỢNG</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstGroup != null)
                {
                    foreach (var group in lstGroup)
                    {
                        var lstItem = group.ToList();
                        if(lstItem != null)
                        {
                            var sum = lstItem.Sum(p => p.Count);
                            <tr>
                                <td class="td-doctor-process" colspan="2">@lstItem[0].DoctorName (Tổng @sum)</td>
                            </tr>
                            foreach(var item in lstItem)
                            {
                                <tr>
                                    <td class="td-service-process">@item.ServiceName</td>
                                    <td class="td-count-process">@item.Count</td>
                                </tr>
                            }
                        }                       
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Report_BaoCaoThongKe/_ReportByService.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var lstReportResult = ViewData["lstReportResult"] as List<TotalReportService>;
    double sumBHYT = 0, sumTP = 0, sumBHYTNT = 0, sumTPNT = 0, sumBHYTNGT = 0, sumTPNGT = 0;
    if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
    {
        foreach (var item in lstReportResult)
        {
            sumBHYT += item.TotalBHYT;
            sumBHYTNT += item.TotalBHYT_NoiTru;
            sumBHYTNGT += item.TotalBHYT_NgoaiTru;
            sumTP += item.TotalTP;
            sumTPNT += item.TotalTP_NoiTru;
            sumTPNGT += item.TotalTP_NgoaiTru;
        }
    }
}
<div class="table-responsive">
    <table id="table-export-to-excel" class="table table-bordered table-striped table-hover">

                <th class="th-total" scope="col" colspan="2">TỔNG</th>
                <th class="th-totalnt" scope="col" colspan="2">TỔNG NỘI TRÚ</th>
                <th class="th-totalngt" scope="col" colspan="2">TỔNG NGOẠI TRÚ</th>
            </tr>
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <td class="th-bhyt" scope="col">BHYT</td>
                <td class="th-tp" scope="col">THU PHÍ</td>
                <td class="th-bhytnt" scope="col">BHYT</td>
                <td class="th-tpnt" scope="col">THU PHÍ</td>
                <td class="th-bhytngt" scope="col">BHYT</td>
                <td class="th-tpngt" scope="col">THU PHÍ</td>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstReportResult != null && lstReportResult.Count > 0)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstReportResult)
                    {
                        <tr>
                            <td class="td-stt">@item.STT</td>
                            <td class="td-service">@item.ServiceName</td>
                            <td class="td-bhyt">@item.TotalBHYT</td>
                            <td class="td-tp">@item.TotalTP</td>
                            <td class="td-bhytnt">@item.TotalBHYT_NoiTru</td>
                            <td class="td-tpnt">@item.TotalTP_NoiTru</td>
                            <td class="td-bhytngt">@item.TotalBHYT_NgoaiTru</td>
                            <td class="td-tpngt">@item.TotalTP_NgoaiTru</td>

                    }
                    <tr class="tr-content">
                        <td class="td-stt"></td>
                        <td class="td-service" style="font-weight: bold; text-align: center">Tổng</td>
                        <td class="td-bhyt" style="font-weight: bold">@sumBHYT</td>
                        <td class="td-tp" style="font-weight: bold">@sumTP</td>
                        <td class="td-bhytnt" style="font-weight: bold">@sumBHYTNT</td>
                        <td class="td-tpnt" style="font-weight: bold">@sumTPNT</td>
                        <td class="td-bhytngt" style="font-weight: bold">@sumBHYTNGT</td>
                        <td class="td-tpngt" style="font-weight: bold">@sumTPNGT</td>
                    </tr>
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<file path="Views/Report_BaoCaoThongKe/Index.cshtml">
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Báo cáo thống kê";
    Layout = "_LayoutReport";
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<Management.Models.User>;
    var lstHospital = ViewData["lstHospital"] as List<Management.Models.Hospital>;
}

<div class="report-container">
    <div id="report-option-search" class="report-option-search">
        <div class="input">
            <select id="report-hospital" class="form-select height-28">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn bệnh viện --</option>
                @if (lstHospital != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstHospital)
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="input1">
            <input type="date" id="report-time-from" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
        </div>
        <div class="input1">
            <input type="date" id="report-time-to" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
        </div>
        <div class="input">
            <select id="report-type" class="form-select height-28 valid">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn loại báo cáo --</option>
                <option value="1">Theo dịch vụ</option>
                <option value="2">Theo số ca</option>
                <option value="3">Công thực hiện</option>
                <option value="4">Test Covid</option>
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="input">
            <select id="report-location" class="form-select height-28 valid">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn khoa --</option>
                <option value="XN">Xét nghiệm</option>
                <option value="SA">Siêu âm</option>
                <option value="NS">Nội soi</option>
                <option value="XQ">X-Quang</option>
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="input">
            <select id="report-user" class="form-select height-28 valid">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn người báo cáo --</option>
                @if (lstUser != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstUser)
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="report-button">
        <div class="button">
            <button id="report-search" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Report_Search()">
                <i class="bi bi-search"></i> Xem trước
            </button>
        </div>
         <div class="button">
            <button id="report-pdf" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Report_PDF()">
                <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-pdf"></i> Xuất PDF
            </button>
        </div>
        <div class="button">
            <button id="report-excel" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Report_Excel('xlsx')">
                <i class="bi bi-file-earmark-spreadsheet"></i> Xuất Excel
            </button>          
        </div>
        @*<a asp-action="Full" asp-controller="Report_BaoCaoThongKe">Test Export</a>*@
    </div>
    <div id="report-result" class="report-result">
        @await Html.PartialAsync("_ReportByService")
    </div>
</div>
@await Html.PartialAsync("_Loading")
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_GetSample/_SA_GetSample_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
    var lstService = ViewData["lstService"] as List<Service>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">STT</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-delete" scope="col"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                            <td class="td-delete">
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-red-in-gridview" value="@item.Id" onclick="GetSample_DeleteServiceForPatient(this.value)">x</button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- From thêm dịch vụ cho bệnh nhân -->

        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="sa-right-add-service-for-patient-title">

            <div class="sa-right-add-service-for-patient-service">

                <div class="content">

                        @if (lstService != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var item in lstService)

                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-add-service-for-patient-button">
                <button id="sa-getsample_addserviceforpatient" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="GetSample_AddServiceForPatient()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<!-- From thêm dịch vụ cho bệnh nhân -->

<file path="Views/SA_GetSample/_SA_GetSample_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
    var lstLocation = ViewData["lstLocation"] as List<Location>;
    var lstDoctor = ViewData["lstDoctor"] as List<Doctor>;
    var lstSexModel = ViewData["lstSexModel"] as List<SexModel>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSA = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSA != null) ? DateTime.Parse(patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSA.ToString()) : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="sa-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mã bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true); GetSID(this.value);" onchange="GetSample_GetSID(this.value)" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="date" id="sa_getsample_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Ngày sinh là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sa_getsample_sex" name="sex" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giới tính là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstSexModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstSexModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.Sex == item.Id.ToString())
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sa_getsample_obj" name="obj" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Đối tượng là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstObject != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstObject)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.ObjectId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sa_getsample_type" name="type" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bệnh án là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstBenhAnModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.BenhAn == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <textarea id="sa_getsample_address" class="form-control height-60 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="sa_getsample_location" name="location" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Nơi chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstLocation != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstLocation)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.LocationId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="sa_getsample_doctor" name="doctor" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bác sĩ chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstDoctor != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstDoctor)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.DoctorId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ nhận bệnh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="sa_getsample_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSA.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sa_getsample_diagnostic" class="form-control height-160 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_GetSample/_SA_GetSample_Search.cshtml">
<div class="sa-right-info-title">DANH SÁCH BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div>
    <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_pidorseq" class="form-control height-28" placeholder="Tìm theo PID hoặc SEQ" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sa_getsample_timeSearchFrom" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sa_getsample_timeSearchTo" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />

<file path="Views/SA_GetSample/GetSample.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang chờ";
    Layout = "_LayoutSA";   
}

<div class="sa-container">
    <div class="sa-left">
        <div class="sa-left-search">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_GetSample_Search")
        </div>
        <div id="listPatient" class="sa-left-list">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_GetSample_ListPatient")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right">
        <div id="patientInfo" class="sa-right-info">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_GetSample_PatientInfo")
        </div>
        <div id="patientService" class="sa-right-service">
            <div id="sa-right-service-group" class="sa-right-service-group">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_GetSample_GroupButton")
            </div>
            <div id="sa-right-service-gridview" class="sa-right-service-gridview">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_GetSample_ListService")
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/_SA_Process_GroupButton.cshtml">
@{

<div class="sa-right-service-group-button">

<file path="Views/SA_Process/_SA_Process_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="Process_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="camera">
            <video id="video" class="video" autoplay></video>
        </div>
        <div class="group-button-image">
            <div class="group-button">
                <button id="sa_process_startcamera" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StartCamera()">
                    <i class="bi bi-play-btn"></i> Mở camera
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_snapshot" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-2 margin-4" onclick="SnapShot()" style="display:none" title="Chụp hình">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_deletephoto" class="btn btn-danger margin-top-2 with-2" onclick="DeletePhoto()" value="" style="display:none" title="Xoá hình">
                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_startvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StartVideo()" style="display:none">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video"></i> Ghi video
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_stopvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StopVideo()" style="display:none">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video-fill"></i> Dừng video
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_downloadvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-2 margin-4" onclick="DownloadVideo()" value="" style="display:none" title="Lưu video">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sa_process_deletevideo" class="btn btn-danger margin-top-2 with-2" onclick="DeleteVideo()" style="display:none" title="Xoá video">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video-off"></i>
                </button>                  
                <a id="sa_process_downloadvideo_a" download="test.webm" style="display:none"></a>
            </div>
            <div hidden> <canvas id="canvas" class="canvas"></canvas></div>
            <div id="imageCDHA" class="imageCDHA">
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content">
                <textarea id="sa_process_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..."></textarea>
                <script>
                    CKEDITOR.replace("sa_process_description");
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="sa_process_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..."></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="sa_process_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/_SA_Process_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<User>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;
    var userLoginId = ViewData["userLoginId"] as long?;
    var userInfo = ViewData["userInfo"] as User;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSA = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSA != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeSA?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeSA = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeSA != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeSA : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="sa-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sa_process_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sa_process_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (benhan != null)
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="sa_process_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="sa_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input type="text" id="sa_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_process_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSA" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="sa_process_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeSA?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="Process_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giờ trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="hidden" id="sa_process_userLoginId" value="@ViewData["userLoginId"]" />

            <select id="sa_process_userReturnResultSA" name="userReturnResultSA" class="form-select height-28 valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Người trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstUser != null)
                {
                    var isUserReturnResultSA = false;
                    foreach (var item in lstUser)
                    {
                        if (item.Id == patientInfo?.UserReturnResultSA)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            isUserReturnResultSA = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (isUserReturnResultSA == false && userLoginId != null && userLoginId == item.Id)
                            {
                                <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>CCCD BS</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input id="sa_process_signerCCCD" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sa_process_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sa_process_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/_SA_Process_Search.cshtml">
<div class="sa-right-info-title">DANH SÁCH BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div>
    <input type="text" id="sa_getsample_pidorseq" class="form-control height-28" placeholder="Tìm theo PID hoặc SEQ" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sa_getsample_timeSearchFrom" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sa_getsample_timeSearchTo" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <button id="sa_getsample_refresh" class="btn btn-success btn-blue width-20" onclick="Process_Refresh()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise"></i> Refresh
    </button>
    <button id="sa_getsample_search" class="btn btn-success btn-blue width-20" onclick="Process_Search()">

<file path="Views/SA_Process/Content.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="export-result-sa">
    <div class="image">
        <div class="title">
            HÌNH ẢNH SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            @{
                if (_resultCDHA != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null)
                {
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        count++;
                        <img class="image-item" src="@item.ImagePath" />
                        if (count == 2) break;
                    }
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="des-res-sug">
        <div class="title">
            MÔ TẢ KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="des">
            <div class="des-title">Mô tả:</div>
            <div class="des-content">@Html.Raw(@_resultCDHA?.Description)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="res">
            <div class="res-title">Kết luận:</div>
            <div class="res-content">@_resultCDHA?.Result</div>
        </div>
        <div class="sug">
            <div class="sug-title">Đề nghị:</div>
            <div class="sug-content">@_resultCDHA?.Suggest</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeSA : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserSA?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="signature-page-sa">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                BÁC SĨ THỰC HIỆN
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/Header.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var age = _resultCDHA?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-sa">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-sa">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_Process/Process.cshtml">
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang thực hiện";
    Layout = "_LayoutSA";   
    var lstDevice = ViewData["lstDevice"] as List<Device>;
}

<div class="sa-container">
    <div class="sa-left">
        <div class="sa-left-search">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_Process_Search")
        </div>
        <div id="process_listPatient" class="sa-left-list">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_Process_ListPatient")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right">
        <div id="process_patientInfo" class="sa-right-info">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_Process_PatientInfo")
        </div>
        <div id="process_patientService" class="sa-right-service">
            <div id="process_sa-right-service-group" class="sa-right-service-group">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_Process_GroupButton")
            </div>
            <div id="process_sa-right-service-gridview" class="sa-right-service-gridview">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_Process_ListService")
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@await Html.PartialAsync("_Loading")

<!-- From chọn Device -->
<div class="modal" id="addDeviceForm" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="sa-right-select-device-title">
                <div class="title">CHỌN THIẾT BỊ</div>
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-select-device">
                <div class="title">Thiết bị</div>
                <div class="content">
                    <select id="sa_getsample_select_device_select" name="sa_getsample_select_device_select" class="form-select height-28">
                        <option value=""></option>
                        @if (lstDevice != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var item in lstDevice)
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-select-device-button">
                <button id="sa_getsample_select_device_button" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="Process_SelectDevice()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<!-- From chọn Device -->
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/_SA_ReturnResult_GroupButton.cshtml">
<div class="sa-right-service-group-button">
    <button id="sa_returnresult_print" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="ReturnResult_Print()">
        <i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Print

    <button id="sa_returnresult_invalid" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="ReturnResult_Invalid()">

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/_SA_ReturnResult_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/_SA_ReturnResult_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="ReturnResult_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div id="image-returnresult" class="image-returnresult">
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content returnresult">
                <textarea id="sa_returnresult_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..." disabled></textarea>
                <script>
                    var editor = CKEDITOR.replace('sa_returnresult_description');
                    editor.on('instanceReady', function (evt) {
                        editor.setReadOnly(true);
                    });
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="sa_returnresult_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="sa_returnresult_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/_SA_ReturnResult_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSA = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSA != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeSA?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeSA = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeSA != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeSA?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
}
<div class="sa-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSA" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeSA" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
     <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sa_returnresult_userReturnResultSA" value="@patientInfo?.UserSA?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sa-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sa_returnresult_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sa-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sa_returnresult_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
