<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/Content.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="export-result-sa">
    <div class="image">
        <div class="title">
            HÌNH ẢNH SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            @{
                if (_resultCDHA != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null)
                {
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        count++;
                        <img class="image-item" src="@item.ImagePath" />
                        if (count == 2) break;
                    }
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="des-res-sug">
        <div class="title">
            MÔ TẢ KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="des">
            <div class="des-title">Mô tả:</div>
            <div class="des-content">@Html.Raw(@_resultCDHA?.Description)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="res">
            <div class="res-title">Kết luận:</div>
            <div class="res-content">@_resultCDHA?.Result</div>
        </div>
        <div class="sug">
            <div class="sug-title">Đề nghị:</div>
            <div class="sug-content">@_resultCDHA?.Suggest</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeSA : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserSA?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="signature-page-sa">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                BÁC SĨ THỰC HIỆN
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/Header.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var age = _resultCDHA?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-sa">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-sa">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_ReturnResult/ReturnResult.cshtml">
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang thực hiện";
    Layout = "_LayoutSA";   
}

<div class="sa-container">
    <div class="sa-left">

            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_ReturnResult_PatientInfo")

            <div id="returnresult_sa-right-service-gridview" class="sa-right-service-gridview">

</div>
@await Html.PartialAsync("_Loading")
</file>

<div class="sat-right-service-group-button">

    </button>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_GetSample/_SA_TIM_GetSample_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_GetSample/_SA_TIM_GetSample_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
    var lstService = ViewData["lstService"] as List<Service>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">STT</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-delete" scope="col"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                            <td class="td-delete">
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-red-in-gridview" value="@item.Id" onclick="GetSample_DeleteServiceForPatient(this.value)">x</button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- From thêm dịch vụ cho bệnh nhân -->
<div class="modal" id="addServiceForm" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="sat-right-add-service-for-patient-title">
                <div class="title">THÊM DỊCH VỤ</div>
                <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-add-service-for-patient-service">
                <div class="title">Dịch vụ</div>
                <div class="content">
                    <select id="sat_getsample_service" name="service" class="form-select height-28">
                        @if (lstService != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var item in lstService)
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-add-service-for-patient-button">
                <button id="sat-getsample_addserviceforpatient" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="GetSample_AddServiceForPatient()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<!-- From thêm dịch vụ cho bệnh nhân -->
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_GetSample/_SA_TIM_GetSample_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
    var lstLocation = ViewData["lstLocation"] as List<Location>;
    var lstDoctor = ViewData["lstDoctor"] as List<Doctor>;
    var lstSexModel = ViewData["lstSexModel"] as List<SexModel>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSAT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSAT != null) ? DateTime.Parse(patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSAT.ToString()) : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="sat-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mã bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true); GetSID(this.value);" onchange="GetSample_GetSID(this.value)" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="date" id="sat_getsample_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Ngày sinh là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sat_getsample_sex" name="sex" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giới tính là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstSexModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstSexModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.Sex == item.Id.ToString())
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sat_getsample_obj" name="obj" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Đối tượng là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstObject != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstObject)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.ObjectId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="sat_getsample_type" name="type" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bệnh án là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstBenhAnModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.BenhAn == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <textarea id="sat_getsample_address" class="form-control height-60 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="sat_getsample_location" name="location" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Nơi chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstLocation != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstLocation)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.LocationId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="sat_getsample_doctor" name="doctor" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bác sĩ chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstDoctor != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstDoctor)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.DoctorId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ nhận bệnh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="sat_getsample_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSAT.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sat_getsample_diagnostic" class="form-control height-160 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_GetSample/GetSample.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang chờ";
    Layout = "_LayoutSAT";   
    var lstDevice = ViewData["lstDevice"] as List<Device>;
    var deviceId = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext.Request.Cookies[SessionKeyModel._sessionDeviceSA];
}

<div class="sat-container">
    <div class="sat-left">
        <div class="sat-left-search">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_GetSample_Search")
        </div>
        <div id="listPatient" class="sat-left-list">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_GetSample_ListPatient")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right">
        <div id="patientInfo" class="sat-right-info">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_GetSample_PatientInfo")
        </div>
        <div id="patientService" class="sat-right-service">
            <div id="sat-right-service-group" class="sat-right-service-group">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_GetSample_GroupButton")
            </div>
            <div id="sat-right-service-gridview" class="sat-right-service-gridview">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_GetSample_ListService")
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

@{
    if (lstDevice != null && string.IsNullOrEmpty(deviceId))
    {
        <!-- From chọn Device -->
        <div class="modal" id="addDeviceForm" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
            <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
                <div class="modal-content">
                    <div class="sat-right-select-device-title">
                        <div class="title">CHỌN THIẾT BỊ</div>
                        <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
                    </div>
                    <div class="sat-right-select-device">
                        <div class="title">Thiết bị</div>
                        <div class="content">
                            <select id="sat_getsample_select_device_select" name="sat_getsample_select_device_select" class="form-select height-28">
                                @if (lstDevice != null)
                                {
                                    foreach (var item in lstDevice)
                                    {
                                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                                    }
                                }
                            </select>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="sat-right-select-device-button">
                        <button id="sat_getsample_select_device_button" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="GetSample_SelectDevice()">
                            <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- From chọn Device -->
    }
}
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/_SA_TIM_Process_GroupButton.cshtml">
@{
    var lstSampleResult = ViewData["lstSampleResult"] as List<Sample>;
}

<div class="sat-right-service-group-button">
    <button id="sat_process_saveresult" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_SaveResult(false)">
        <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
    </button>
    <button id="sat_process_cancelresult" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_CancelResultt()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-return-left"></i> Bỏ qua
    </button>
    <button id="sat_process_valid_in" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_ValidPrint()">
        <i class="bi bi-printer"></i> Valid & In
    </button>  
    <button id="sat_process_getsample" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" onclick="Process_GetSample()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i> Đang chờ
    </button>
    <button id="sat_process_signpdf"
            type="button"
            class="btn btn-warning btn-md"
            onclick="Process_SignPdf()">
        <i class="fa fa-certificate"></i> In & Ký số
    </button>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-service-group-button-title-sample"> 
    <div class="title-process">
        MÔ TẢ
    </div>
    <div class="sample">
        <select id="sat_process_sampleresult" name="sat_process_sampleresult" class="form-select height-28" onchange="GetSampleForService(this.value)">
            @if (lstSampleResult != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstSampleResult)
                {
                    <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                }

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/_SA_TIM_Process_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/_SA_TIM_Process_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="Process_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="camera">
            <video id="video" class="video" autoplay></video>
        </div>
        <div class="group-button-image">
            <div class="group-button">
                <button id="sat_process_startcamera" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StartCamera()">
                    <i class="bi bi-play-btn"></i> Mở camera
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_snapshot" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-2 margin-4" onclick="SnapShot()" style="display:none" title="Chụp hình">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_deletephoto" class="btn btn-danger margin-top-2 with-2" onclick="DeletePhoto()" value="" style="display:none" title="Xoá hình">
                    <i class="bi bi-trash"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_startvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StartVideo()" style="display:none">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video"></i> Ghi video
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_stopvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-1" onclick="StopVideo()" style="display:none">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video-fill"></i> Dừng video
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_downloadvideo" class="btn btn-success margin-top-2 with-2 margin-4" onclick="DownloadVideo()" value="" style="display:none" title="Lưu video">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i>
                </button>
                <button id="sat_process_deletevideo" class="btn btn-danger margin-top-2 with-2" onclick="DeleteVideo()" style="display:none" title="Xoá video">
                    <i class="bi bi-camera-video-off"></i>
                </button>
                <a id="sat_process_downloadvideo_a" download="test.webm" style="display:none"></a>
            </div>
            <div hidden> <canvas id="canvas" class="canvas"></canvas></div>
            <div id="imageCDHA" class="imageCDHA">
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content">
                <textarea id="sat_process_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..."></textarea>
                <script>
                    CKEDITOR.replace("sat_process_description");
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="sat_process_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..."></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="sat_process_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..."></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    @*Siêu âm tim*@
    <div class="sieu-am-tim">

        @* THỂ TRỌNG *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset-thetrong">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">THỂ TRỌNG &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>
            <div class="row-thetrong">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chiều cao</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chieucao" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">cm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Cân nặng</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_cannang" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">kg</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BSA</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_bsa" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">m2</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">BMI</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_bmi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* TM *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">TM &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>
            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM chủ (AO)</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dmchu" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ trái (LA)</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_nhitrai" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Thất phải</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_thatphai" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*3*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">IVSd</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_ivsd" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">IVSs</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_ivss" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*4*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVIDd</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_lvidd" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">LVIDs</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_lvids" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*5*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWd</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_lvpwd" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">LVPWs</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_lvpws" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*6*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">RVDd</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_rvdd" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mm</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">LVEDV</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_lvedv" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">ml</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*7*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">FS</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_fs" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">%</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">EF</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_ef" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">%</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_vantoctoida_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">m/s</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">E/A</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_ea_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chenhaptoida_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_gdmean_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*3*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Độ hở van</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dohovan_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Loại hở</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_loaiho_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*4*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van 2 lá</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_hepvanhaila_haila" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_vantoctoida_bala" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">m/s</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chenhaptoida_bala" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp TB</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chenhaptb_bala" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*3*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_hovan_bala" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">PAPs</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_paps_bala" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_vantoctoida_dongmachphoi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">m/s</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachphoi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_gdmean_dongmachphoi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*3*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPm</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_papm_dongmachphoi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">PAPd</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_papd_dongmachphoi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_vantoctoida_dongmachchu" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">m/s</div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa</div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachchu" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                    <div class="unit">mmHg</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van ĐM chủ</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_hovandmchu_dongmachchu" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child-01">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van ĐM chủ</div>
                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_hepvandmchu_dongmachchu" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @*KHÔNG CÓ TIÊU ĐỀ *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child-02">
                    <div class="label-02">Dòng qua vách liên nhĩ</div>
                    <div class="input-02">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dongquavachliennhi" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child-02">
                    <div class="label-02">Dòng qua vách liên thất</div>
                    <div class="input-02">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dongquavachlienthat" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>

            @*3*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child-02">
                    <div class="label-02">Dòng bất thường khác</div>
                    <div class="input-02">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dongbatthuongkhac" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </fieldset>

        @* 2D *@
        <fieldset class="reset-fieldset-legend fieldset">
            <legend class="reset-fieldset-legend legend">2D &nbsp;&nbsp;</legend>

            @*1*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">

                        <input type="text" id="sat_tuthetim_2d" value="SOLITUS LEVOCARDIA" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />

                </div>
                <div class="child-01">

                    <div class="input-01">
                        <input type="text" id="sat_dmphoi_2d" value="Bình thường" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />

            @*2*@
            <div class="row">
                <div class="child">

                        <input type="text" id="sat_mangngoaitim_2d" value="Không dịch" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " />

                <div class="child-01">

            @*3*@

            @*4*@

                <div class="child-01">

            @*5*@

                <div class="child-01">

            @*6*@
