<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/_SA_TIM_Process_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<User>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;
    var userLoginId = ViewData["userLoginId"] as long?;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSAT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSAT != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeSAT?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeSAT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeSAT != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeSAT : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="sat-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sat_process_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sat_process_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (benhan != null)
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="sat_process_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="sat_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input type="text" id="sat_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_process_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSAT" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="sat_process_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeSAT?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="Process_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giờ trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="hidden" id="sat_process_userLoginId" value="@ViewData["userLoginId"]" />
            <select id="sat_process_userReturnResultSAT" name="userReturnResultSAT" class="form-select height-28 valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Người trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstUser != null)
                {
                    var isUserReturnResultSAT = false;
                    foreach (var item in lstUser)
                    {
                        if (item.Id == patientInfo?.UserReturnResultSAT)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            isUserReturnResultSAT = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (isUserReturnResultSAT == false && userLoginId != null && userLoginId == item.Id)
                            {
                                <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>CCCD BS</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input id="sat_process_signerCCCD" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sat_process_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sat_process_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/_SA_TIM_Process_Search.cshtml">
<div class="sat-right-info-title">DANH SÁCH BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div>
    <input type="text" id="sat_getsample_pidorseq" class="form-control height-28" placeholder="Tìm theo PID hoặc SEQ" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sat_getsample_timeSearchFrom" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sat_getsample_timeSearchTo" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <button id="sat_getsample_refresh" class="btn btn-success btn-blue width-20" onclick="Process_Refresh()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise"></i> Refresh
    </button>
    <button id="sat_getsample_search" class="btn btn-success btn-blue width-20" onclick="Process_Search()">
        <i class="bi bi-search"></i> Tìm kiếm
    </button>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/Content.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var sieuamtimModel = ViewData["SieuAmTimModel"] as SieuAmTimModel;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeSAT : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserSAT?.Name : string.Empty;
    var age = _resultCDHA?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-sat">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM TIM
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-sat">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
<div class="export-result-sat">
    <div class="image">
        <div class="title">
            HÌNH ẢNH SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            @{
                if (_resultCDHA != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null)
                {
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        count++;
                        if (count <= 2)
                        {
                            <img class="image-item" src="@item.ImagePath" />
                        }                       
                    }
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    @*Siêu âm tim*@
    <div class="sieu-am-tim">

        @* THỂ TRỌNG *@
        <div class="fieldset-thetrong">
            <div class="row-thetrong">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chiều cao : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chieucao</label> &nbsp;cm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Cân nặng : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_cannang</label> &nbsp;kg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BSA : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result"> @sieuamtimModel?.sat_bsa</label> &nbsp;m2
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BMI : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_bmi</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* TM *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">TM</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM chủ (AO) : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmchu</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ trái (LA) : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_nhitrai</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">IVSd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ivsd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVIDd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvidd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpwd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">RVDd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_rvdd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">FS : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_fs</label> &nbsp;%
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*Right*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Thất phải : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_thatphai</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">IVSs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ivss</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVIDs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvids</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpws</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpws</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVEDV : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvedv</label> &nbsp;ml
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">EF : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ef</label> &nbsp;%
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_haila</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_haila</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Độ hở van : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dohovan_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van 2 lá : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hepvanhaila_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">E/A : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ea_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_gdmean_haila</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Loại hở : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_loaiho_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_bala</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_bala</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hovan_bala</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child"></div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp TB : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptb_bala</label>&nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_paps_bala</label>&nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @*  DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title"> DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPm : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_papm_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_gdmean_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_papd_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>


        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all margin-top-80">
            <div class="row-title"> DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_dongmachchu</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van ĐM chủ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hovandmchu_dongmachchu</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachchu</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van ĐM chủ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hepvandmchu_dongmachchu</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>


        @* *KHÔNG CÓ TIÊU ĐỀ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-width-100">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng qua vách liên nhĩ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dongquavachliennhi</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng qua vách liên thất : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dongquavachlienthat</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng bất thường khác : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dongbatthuongkhac</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* 2D *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title"> 2D</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Tư thế tim (Situs) : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_tuthetim_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Màng ngoài tim : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_mangngoaitim_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ trái : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_nhitrai_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ phải : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_nhiphai_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Tĩnh mạch : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_tinhmach_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM chủ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmchu_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Van ĐMP : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vandmp_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM phổi : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmphoi_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM vành : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmvanh_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Xoang vành : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_xoangvanh_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Van hai lá : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vanhaila_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Van ba lá : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vanbala_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Van ĐMC : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vandmc_2d</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="des-res-sug">
        <div class="title">
            MÔ TẢ KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="des">
            <div class="des-title">Mô tả:</div>
            <div class="des-content">@Html.Raw(@_resultCDHA?.Description)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="res">
            <div class="res-title">Kết luận:</div>
            <div class="res-content">@_resultCDHA?.Result</div>
        </div>
        <div class="sug">
            <div class="sug-title">Đề nghị:</div>
            <div class="sug-content">@_resultCDHA?.Suggest</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="signature-page-sat">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                BÁC SĨ THỰC HIỆN
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_Process/Process.cshtml">
@{
    ViewData["Title"] = "Đang thực hiện";
    Layout = "_LayoutSAT";   
    var lstDevice = ViewData["lstDevice"] as List<Device>;
}

<div class="sat-container">
    <div class="sat-left">
        <div class="sat-left-search">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_Process_Search")
        </div>
        <div id="process_listPatient" class="sat-left-list">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_Process_ListPatient")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right">
        <div id="process_patientInfo" class="sat-right-info">
            @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_Process_PatientInfo")
        </div>
        <div id="process_patientService" class="sat-right-service">
            <div id="process_sat-right-service-group" class="sat-right-service-group">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_Process_GroupButton")
            </div>
            <div id="process_sat-right-service-gridview" class="sat-right-service-gridview">
                @await Html.PartialAsync("_SA_TIM_Process_ListService")
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
@await Html.PartialAsync("_Loading")
<!-- From chọn Device -->
<div class="modal" id="addDeviceForm" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="sat-right-select-device-title">
                <div class="title">CHỌN THIẾT BỊ</div>
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-select-device">
                <div class="title">Thiết bị</div>
                <div class="content">
                    <select id="sat_getsample_select_device_select" name="sat_getsample_select_device_select" class="form-select height-28">
                        <option value=""></option>
                        @if (lstDevice != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var item in lstDevice)
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-select-device-button">
                <button id="sat_getsample_select_device_button" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="Process_SelectDevice()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<!-- From chọn Device -->
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/_SA_TIM_ReturnResult_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/_SA_TIM_ReturnResult_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="ReturnResult_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div id="image-returnresult" class="image-returnresult">
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">

            <div class="content returnresult">
                <textarea id="sat_returnresult_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..." disabled></textarea>
                <script>
                    var editor = CKEDITOR.replace('sat_returnresult_description');

        <div class="result-suggest">

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/_SA_TIM_ReturnResult_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeSAT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeSAT != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeSAT?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeSAT = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeSAT != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeSAT?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var userReturnResultId = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.UserReturnResultSAT != null) ? patientInfo?.UserReturnResultSAT : 0;
}
<div class="sat-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeSAT" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeSAT" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
     <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="hidden" id="sat_returnresult_signerCCCD" />
            <input type="hidden" id="sat_returnresult_userReturnResultSAT_Id" value="@userReturnResultId" />
            <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_userReturnResultSAT" value="@patientInfo?.UserSAT?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="sat-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sat_returnresult_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="sat_returnresult_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/_SA_TIM_ReturnResult_Search.cshtml">
<div class="sat-right-info-title">DANH SÁCH BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div>
    <input type="text" id="sat_returnresult_pidorseq" class="form-control height-28" placeholder="Tìm theo PID hoặc SEQ" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sat_returnresult_timeSearchFrom" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <input type="date" id="sat_returnresult_timeSearchTo" class="form-control height-28" value="@DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd")" />
</div>
<div class="div-margin-top-5">
    <button id="sat_returnresult_refresh" class="btn btn-success btn-blue width-20" onclick="ReturnResult_Refresh()">
        <i class="bi bi-arrow-clockwise"></i> Refresh
    </button>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/Content.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var sieuamtimModel = ViewData["SieuAmTimModel"] as SieuAmTimModel;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeSAT : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserSAT?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-sat">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM TIM
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-sat">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
<div class="export-result-sat">
    <div class="image">
        <div class="title">
            HÌNH ẢNH SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            @{
                if (_resultCDHA != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null)
                {
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        count++;
                        if (count <= 2)
                        {
                            <img class="image-item" src="@item.ImagePath" />
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    @*Siêu âm tim*@
    <div class="sieu-am-tim">

        @* THỂ TRỌNG *@
        <div class="fieldset-thetrong">
            <div class="row-thetrong">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chiều cao : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chieucao</label> &nbsp;cm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Cân nặng : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_cannang</label> &nbsp;kg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BSA : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result"> @sieuamtimModel?.sat_bsa</label> &nbsp;m2
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BMI : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_bmi</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* TM *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">TM</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">ĐM chủ (AO) : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmchu</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ trái (LA) : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_nhitrai</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">IVSd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ivsd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVIDd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvidd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpwd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">RVDd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_rvdd</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">FS : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_fs</label> &nbsp;%
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @*Right*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Thất phải : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_thatphai</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">IVSs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ivss</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVIDs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvids</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpws</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVPWs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvpws</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">LVEDV : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_lvedv</label> &nbsp;ml
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">EF : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ef</label> &nbsp;%
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_haila</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_haila</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Độ hở van : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dohovan_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van 2 lá : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hepvanhaila_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">E/A : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_ea_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_gdmean_haila</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Loại hở : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_loaiho_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN BA LÁ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_bala</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_bala</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hovan_bala</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child"></div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp TB : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptb_bala</label>&nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPs : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_paps_bala</label>&nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @*  DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title"> DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH PHỔI</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPm : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_papm_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Gd mean : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_gdmean_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">PAPd : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_papd_dongmachphoi</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>


        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all" style="margin-top: 70px">
            <div class="row-title"> DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN ĐỘNG MẠCH CHỦ</div>

            @*Left*@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Vận tốc tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_dongmachchu</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hở van ĐM chủ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hovandmchu_dongmachchu</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            @* Right *@
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chênh áp tối đa : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_dongmachchu</label> &nbsp;mmHg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van ĐM chủ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_hepvandmchu_dongmachchu</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>


        @* *KHÔNG CÓ TIÊU ĐỀ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-left">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng qua vách liên nhĩ : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dongquavachliennhi</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng qua vách liên thất : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dongquavachlienthat</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Dòng bất thường khác : </div>

<file path="Views/SA_TIM_ReturnResult/Print01.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var sieuamtimModel = ViewData["SieuAmTimModel"] as SieuAmTimModel;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeSAT : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserSAT?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-sat">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ SIÊU ÂM TIM
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-sat">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
<div class="export-result-sat">
    <div class="image">
        <div class="title">
            HÌNH ẢNH SIÊU ÂM
        </div>
        <div class="content">
            @{
                if (_resultCDHA != null && _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs != null)
                {
                    int count = 0;
                    foreach (var item in _resultCDHA.ImageCDHAs)
                    {
                        count++;
                        if (count <= 2)
                        {
                            <img class="image-item" src="@item.ImagePath" />
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>

    @*Siêu âm tim*@
    <div class="sieu-am-tim">

        @* THỂ TRỌNG *@
        <div class="fieldset-thetrong">
            <div class="row-thetrong">
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Chiều cao : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chieucao</label> &nbsp;cm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Cân nặng : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_cannang</label> &nbsp;kg
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BSA : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result"> @sieuamtimModel?.sat_bsa</label> &nbsp;m2
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">BMI : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_bmi</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* TM *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">TM</div>

            @*Left*@

                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dmchu</label> &nbsp;mm
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Nhĩ trái (LA) : </div>

                </div>
                <div class="child">

                <div class="child">

                <div class="child">

                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        @* DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ *@
        <div class="fieldset-all">
            <div class="row-title">DOPPLER - DÒNG QUA VAN HAI LÁ</div>

                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_vantoctoida_haila</label> &nbsp;m/s
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">

                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_chenhaptoida_haila</label> &nbsp;mmHg

                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Độ hở van : </div>
                    <div class="input">
                        <label class="result">@sieuamtimModel?.sat_dohovan_haila</label>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="child">
                    <div class="label">Hẹp van 2 lá : </div>
                    <div class="input">

<file path="Views/Sample/_Sample_Info.cshtml">
@{
    var sample = ViewData["Sample"] as Sample;
    var lstCategory = ViewData["lstCategory"] as List<Category>;
}

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã mẫu kết quả</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="sample-code" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@sample?.Code" onkeyup="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" disabled />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên mẫu kết quả</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="sample-name" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@sample?.Name" onkeyup="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mô tả</div>
    <div id="div-sample-description" class="div-input">
        <textarea id="sample-description" class="form-control pading-left-5 pading-right-5 textarea-desscription" onkeyup="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">@sample?.Description</textarea>
        <script>
            var ck = CKEDITOR.replace("sample-description", { height: '240px' });
            ck.on('change', function () {
                Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false);
            });
        </script>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-input">
        <textarea id="sample-result" class="form-control height-2 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" placeholder="Kết luận ...">@sample?.Result</textarea>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-input">
        <textarea id="sample-suggest" class="form-control height-2 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" placeholder="Đề nghị ...">@sample?.Suggest</textarea>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="child-01">
        <select required id="sample-category" name="category" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
            @if (lstCategory != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstCategory)
                {
                    if (sample?.CategorieId == item?.Id)
                    {
                        <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
    <div class="child-02">
        @{
            if (sample != null)
            {
                if (sample.Active)
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="sample-active" onclick="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                    <label for="sample-active">Active</label>
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="sample-active" onclick="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="sample-active">Active</label>
                }
            }
            else
            {
                <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="sample-active" onclick="Sample_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                <label for="sample-active">Active</label>
            }
        }
    </div>
</div>
</file>
