<file path="Views/Search/_Search_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Search_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Search_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Search/_Search_ListService.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var lstSearch = ViewData["lstSearch"] as List<Search>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">STT</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-status" scope="col">TRẠNG THÁI</th>
                <th class="th-print" scope="col"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstSearch != null && lstSearch.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstSearch)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.ServiceName</td>

                            @{
                                if (@item.Status == "Wait")
                                {
                                    <td class="td-status">@item.Status</td>
                                    <td class="td-print"></td>
                                }
                                else if (@item.Status == "Process")
                                {
                                    <td class="td-status">@item.Status</td>
                                    <td class="td-print"></td>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <td class="td-status" style="color: #198754">@item.Status </td>
                                    <td class="td-print">
                                        <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-success btn-blue-in-gridview" value="@item.KeyResultForHis" onclick="Search_Print(this.value)">
                                            <i class="bi bi-printer"></i>
                                        </button>
                                    </td>
                                }
                            }
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Search/_Search_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeNS = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeNS != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeNS?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeNS = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeNS != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeNS : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="search-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="search-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="search_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="search_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input02">
                <input type="text" id="search_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input03">
                <input type="text" id="search_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="search_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="search_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="search_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="search_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="search_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="search_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="search_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="search-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-label01">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input01 pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="search_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-label01">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="search-right-info-div-combo-2-input01 pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="search_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<file path="Views/Service/_Service_Info.cshtml">
@{
    var service = ViewData["Service"] as Service;
    var lstCategory = ViewData["lstCategory"] as List<Category>;
    var lstPrintSample = ViewData["lstPrintSample"] as List<PrintSample>;
}

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã dịch vụ</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="service-code" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@service?.Code" onkeyup="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" disabled />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên dịch vụ</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="service-name" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@service?.Name" onkeyup="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Danh mục</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <select required id="service-category" name="category" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
            @if (lstCategory != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstCategory)
                {
                    if (service?.CategoryId == item?.Id)
                    {
                        <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mẫu in</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <select required id="service-printsample" name="printsample" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
            @if (lstPrintSample != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstPrintSample)
                {
                    if (service?.PrintSampleId == item?.Id)
                    {
                        <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Thứ tự in</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="number" id="service-printorder" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@service?.PrintOrder" onkeyup="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>


<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">
        @{
            if (service != null)
            {
                if (service.ProcessType)
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-processtype" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                    <label for="service-processtype">Process type</label>
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-processtype" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="service-processtype">Process type</label>
                }

                if (service.Active)
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-active" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                    <label for="service-active">Active</label>
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-active" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="service-active">Active</label>
                }              
            }
            else
            {
                <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-processtype" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                <label for="service-processtype">Process type</label>
                <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="service-processtype" onclick="Service_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                <label for="service-processtype">Active</label>
            }
        }       
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Settup/Index.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@using Management.Models
@using Newtonsoft.Json
@inject IHttpContextAccessor HttpContextAccessor
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutSettup";
    ViewData["Title"] = "Cấu hình";
    var _lstUserFunction = ViewData["lstUserFunction"] as List<UserFunction>;
}

<div class="main-parent">
    <div class="main-child-settup">
        @{
            if (_lstUserFunction != null && _lstUserFunction.Count > 0)
            {
                var toUser = "ToUser";
                var imageUser = "User.png";
                var titleUser = "NGƯỜI DÙNG";

                var toHospital = "ToHospital";
                var imageHospital = "Hospital.png";
                var titleHospital = "BỆNH VIỆN";

                var toLocation = "ToLocation";
                var imageLocation = "Location.png";
                var titleLocation = "KHOA PHÒNG";

                var toDoctor = "ToDoctor";
                var imageDoctor = "Doctor.png";
                var titleDoctor = "BÁC SĨ";

                var toObject = "ToObject";
                var imageObject = "Object.png";
                var titleObject = "ĐỐI TƯỢNG";

                var toTestType = "ToTestType";
                var imageTestType = "TestType.png";
                var titleTestType = "LOẠI MẪU";

                var toCategory = "ToCategory";
                var imageCategory = "Category.png";
                var titleCategory = "DANH MỤC";

                var toService = "ToService";
                var imageService = "Service.png";
                var titleService = "DỊCH VỤ";

                var toTestCode = "ToTestCode";
                var imageTestCode = "TestCode.png";
                var titleTestCode = "MÃ XN";

                var toServiceTest = "ToServiceTest";
                var imageServiceTest = "ServiceTest.png";
                var titleServiceTest = "DV & MÃ XN";

                var toDevice = "ToDevice";
                var imageDevice = "Device.png";
                var titleDevice = "THIẾT BỊ";

                var toMap = "ToMap";
                var imageMap = "Map.png";
                var titleMap = "MÃ XN MÁY";

                var toSample = "ToSample";
                var imageSample = "Sample.png";
                var titleSample = "MẪU KẾT QUẢ";

                var toManageData = "ToManageData";
                var imageManageData = "ManageData.png";
                var titleManageData = "DỮ LIỆU";

                var toManageConfigSystem = "ToManageConfigSystem";
                var imageManageConfigSystem = "ManageConfigSystem.png";
                var titleManageConfigSystem = "HỆ THỐNG";

                foreach (var item in _lstUserFunction)
                {
                    if (item.Function.Code == "User")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toUser">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageUser" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleUser</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Hospital")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toHospital">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageHospital" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleHospital</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Location")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toLocation">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageLocation" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleLocation</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Object")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toObject">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageObject" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleObject</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Doctor")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toDoctor">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageDoctor" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleDoctor</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "TestType")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toTestType">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageTestType" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleTestType</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Category")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toCategory">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageCategory" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleCategory</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Service")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toService">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageService" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleService</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "TestCode")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toTestCode">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageTestCode" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleTestCode</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "ServiceTest")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toServiceTest">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageServiceTest" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleServiceTest</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Device")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toDevice">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageDevice" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleDevice</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Map")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toMap">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageMap" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleMap</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "Sample")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toSample">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageSample" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleSample</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "ManageData")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toManageData">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageManageData" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleManageData</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                    else if (item.Function.Code == "ManageConfigSystem")
                    {
                        <div class="main-card-settup">
                            <a asp-controller="Settup" asp-action="@toManageConfigSystem">
                                <img class="card-img-top" src="~/images/logo/@imageManageConfigSystem" alt="Card image cap">
                            </a>
                            <div class="main-card-body-settup">
                                <h5 class="main-card-title-settup">@titleManageConfigSystem</h5>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </div>
</div>

<file path="Views/Shared/_LayoutAccount.cshtml">
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>@ViewData["Title"]</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="~/lib/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" />
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="~/css/xn.css" asp-append-version="true" />

<file path="Views/Shared/_LayoutSA.cshtml">

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />

                                    <a id="1" class="nav-link text-white bg-dark hover @(ViewContext.RouteData.Values["controller"]?.ToString() == "SA_GetSample" ? "active" : "")" asp-controller="SA_GetSample" asp-action="GetSample">

                                    </a>
                                </li>
                                <li class="nav-item">
                                    <a id="3" class="nav-link text-white bg-dark hover @(ViewContext.RouteData.Values["controller"]?.ToString() == "SA_ReturnResult" ? "active" : "")" asp-controller="SA_ReturnResult" asp-action="ReturnResult">
                                        Đã xong <span id="countReturnResult" class="badge badge-success">@ViewData["countReturnResult"]</span>
                                    </a>
                                </li>
                            </ul>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </nav>
            </div>
            <div class="menu-right">
                <div class="dropdown menu-right-width menu-right-margin-padding">
                    <button class="btn btn-secondary dropdown-toggle menu-right-width menu-right-bg" type="button" id="dropdownMenuButton2" data-bs-toggle="dropdown" aria-expanded="false">
                        <i class="bi bi-person"></i>
                        @{
                            var userName = HttpContextAccessor.HttpContext?.User?.Claims?.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Type == "UserName")?.Value;

                            ;
                        }

                    <ul class="dropdown-menu menu-right-width menu-right-height-64" aria-labelledby="dropdownMenuButton2">
                        <li>
                            <a class="dropdown-item menu-right-width menu-right-height-20" asp-controller="Account" asp-action="ChangePassword">
                                <i class="bi bi-key"></i> Đổi mật khẩu
                            </a>
                        </li>
                        <li>
                            <a class="dropdown-item menu-right-width menu-right-height-20" asp-controller="Account" asp-action="Logout">
                                <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-left"></i> Đăng xuất
                            </a>
                        </li>
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </header>
    <div class="container-fluid">
        <main role="main" class="pb-3 renderBody">
            @RenderBody()
        </main>
    </div>

    <script src="~/lib/jquery/dist/jquery.min.js"></script>

    <script src="~/lib/ckeditor/ckeditor.js"></script>
    @await RenderSectionAsync("Scripts", required: false)
</body>
</html>

<file path="Views/Shared/_PacsDock.cshtml">
@{
    /*
        Shared PACS Dock

        ViewData:
        - PacsModulePrefix : "xq" | "ct" | "mri" | "mg"
        - PacsScreenPrefix : "process" | "returnresult"
        - PacsTitle
        - PacsDefaultSize  : "60" | "75" | "90"

        Không chứa API theo module.
        JS dùng shared /PacsViewer/*.
    */

    var modulePrefix =
        (ViewData["PacsModulePrefix"] as string
        ?? ViewData["ModulePrefix"] as string
        ?? string.Empty)
        .Trim()
        .ToLowerInvariant();

    var screenPrefix =
        (ViewData["PacsScreenPrefix"] as string
        ?? string.Empty)
        .Trim()
        .ToLowerInvariant();

    var pacsTitle =
        (ViewData["PacsTitle"] as string
        ?? "XEM ẢNH PACS")
        .Trim();

    var defaultSize =
        (ViewData["PacsDefaultSize"]?.ToString()
        ?? "75")
        .Trim();

    if (defaultSize != "60" &&
        defaultSize != "75" &&
        defaultSize != "90")
    {
        defaultSize = "75";
    }
}

<aside id="pacs_dock"
       class="pacs-dock"
       data-module="@modulePrefix"
       data-screen="@screenPrefix"
       data-default-size="@defaultSize"
       aria-label="PACS Viewer"
       aria-hidden="true">

    <header class="pacs-dock-header">

        <div class="pacs-dock-heading">

            <button type="button"
                    id="pacs_back_to_result"
                    class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-dock-btn-icon pacs-mobile-action"
                    title="Quay lại kết quả"
                    aria-label="Quay lại kết quả">
                <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            </button>

            <div class="pacs-dock-title-wrap">

                <div id="pacs_title"
                     class="pacs-dock-title">
                    @pacsTitle
                </div>

                <div id="pacs_subtitle"
                     class="pacs-dock-subtitle"
                     aria-live="polite">
                </div>

            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="pacs-dock-actions">

            <div class="pacs-dock-size-actions"
                 role="group"
                 aria-label="Kích thước vùng PACS">

                <button type="button"
                        class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-size-btn"
                        data-pacs-size="60"
                        title="PACS 60%">
                    60
                </button>

                <button type="button"
                        class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-size-btn"
                        data-pacs-size="75"
                        title="PACS 75%">
                    75
                </button>

                <button type="button"
                        class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-size-btn"
                        data-pacs-size="90"
                        title="PACS 90%">
                    90
                </button>

            </div>

            <button type="button"
                    id="pacs_fullscreen"
                    class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-dock-btn-icon"
                    title="Toàn màn hình"
                    aria-label="Toàn màn hình PACS">
                <i class="bi bi-arrows-fullscreen"></i>
            </button>

            <button type="button"
                    id="pacs_open_new_tab"
                    class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-dock-btn-icon"
                    title="Mở PACS ở tab mới"
                    aria-label="Mở PACS ở tab mới">
                <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i>
            </button>

            <button type="button"
                    id="pacs_close"
                    class="pacs-dock-btn pacs-dock-btn-icon pacs-dock-btn-close"
                    title="Đóng PACS"
                    aria-label="Đóng PACS">
                <i class="bi bi-x-lg"></i>
            </button>

        </div>

    </header>

    <div class="pacs-dock-body">

        <div id="pacs_loading"
             class="pacs-dock-loading"
             role="status"
             aria-live="polite">

            <div class="pacs-dock-loading-content">

                <div class="spinner-border spinner-border-sm"
                     role="presentation">
                </div>

                <span>Đang tải ảnh PACS...</span>

            </div>

        </div>

        <iframe id="pacs_iframe"
                class="pacs-dock-iframe"
                src="about:blank"
                title="PACS OHIF Viewer"
                allow="fullscreen; clipboard-read; clipboard-write"
                allowfullscreen
                referrerpolicy="no-referrer-when-downgrade">
        </iframe>

    </div>

    <footer id="pacs_mobile_footer"
            class="pacs-mobile-footer"
            aria-hidden="true">

        <button type="button"
                id="pacs_mobile_back"
                class="pacs-mobile-footer-btn">
            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            <span>Kết quả</span>
        </button>

        <button type="button"
                id="pacs_mobile_fullscreen"
                class="pacs-mobile-footer-btn">
            <i class="bi bi-arrows-fullscreen"></i>
            <span>Toàn màn hình</span>
        </button>

        <button type="button"
                id="pacs_mobile_new_tab"
                class="pacs-mobile-footer-btn">
            <i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i>
            <span>Tab mới</span>
        </button>

    </footer>

</aside>
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessActionBar.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@model CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var options =
        Model.Options;

    var modulePrefix =
        options.ModulePrefix;
}


<div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-service-group-button") cdha-process-action-bar">

    @if (options.EnableSave)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("saveresult")"
                class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                data-cdha-action="save"
                onclick="Process_SaveResult()">

            <i class="bi bi-download"></i>
            Lưu

        </button>
    }


    @if (options.EnablePacs)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("view_pacs")"
                type="button"
                class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                data-cdha-action="view-pacs"
                onclick="Process_ViewPacs()"
                title="Xem ảnh DICOM trên PACS">

            <i class="bi bi-image"></i>
            Xem ảnh PACS

        </button>
    }


    @if (options.EnableCancel)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("cancelresult")"
                class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                data-cdha-action="cancel"
                onclick="Process_CancelResultt()">

            <i class="bi bi-arrow-return-left"></i>
            Bỏ qua

        </button>
    }


    @if (options.EnableValidPrint)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("valid_in")"
                class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                data-cdha-action="valid-print"
                onclick="Process_ValidPrint()">

            <i class="bi bi-printer"></i>
            Valid & In

        </button>
    }


    @if (options.EnableReturnToWaiting)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("getsample")"
                class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                data-cdha-action="return-waiting"
                onclick="Process_GetSample()">

            <i class="bi bi-arrow-left"></i>
            Đang chờ

        </button>
    }


    @if (options.EnableDigitalSign)
    {
        <button id="@options.Id("signpdf")"
                type="button"
                class="btn btn-warning btn-md"
                data-cdha-action="digital-sign"
                onclick="Process_SignPdf()">

            <i class="fa fa-certificate"></i>
            In & Ký số

        </button>
    }

</div>


<div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-service-group-button-title-sample") cdha-process-template-bar">

    <div class="title-process cdha-process-template-title">
        MÔ TẢ
    </div>


    @if (options.EnableSampleTemplate)
    {
        <div class="sample cdha-process-template-select">

            <select id="@options.Id("sampleresult")"
                    name="@options.Id("sampleresult")"
                    class="form-select height-28"
                    data-cdha-role="sample-template"
                    onchange="GetSampleForService(this.value)">

                @foreach (var item in Model.Samples)
                {
                    <option value="@item.Id">
                        @item.Name
                    </option>
                }

            </select>

        </div>
    }

</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessDeviceModal.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@model CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var options =
        Model.Options;

    var modulePrefix =
        options.ModulePrefix;

    var selectId =
        options.GetSampleId(
            "select_device_select"
        );

    var buttonId =
        options.GetSampleId(
            "select_device_button"
        );
}

@if (options.EnableDeviceModal)
{
    <div class="modal"
         id="addDeviceForm"
         data-bs-backdrop="static"
         data-bs-keyboard="false"
         tabindex="-1"
         role="dialog"
         aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel"
         aria-hidden="true">

        <div class="modal-dialog"
             role="document">

            <div class="modal-content">

                <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-select-device-title") cdha-process-device-title">

                    <div class="title">
                        CHỌN THIẾT BỊ
                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-select-device") cdha-process-device-content">

                    <div class="title">
                        Thiết bị
                    </div>

                    <div class="content">

                        <select id="@selectId"
                                name="@selectId"
                                class="form-select height-28">

                            <option value=""></option>

                            @foreach (var item in Model.Devices)
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">
                                    @item.Name
                                </option>
                            }

                        </select>

                    </div>

                </div>


                <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-select-device-button") cdha-process-device-actions">

                    <button id="@buttonId"
                            type="button"
                            class="btn btn-success btn-blue"
                            data-bs-dismiss="modal"
                            onclick="Process_SelectDevice()">

                        <i class="bi bi-download"></i>
                        Lưu

                    </button>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>
}
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessPatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@model CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var options =
        Model.Options;

    var patient =
        Model.PatientInfo;

    var age =
        patient?.Age?
            .ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")
        ?? string.Empty;

    var getSampleTime =
        Model.DisplayGetSampleTime?
            .ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")
        ?? string.Empty;

    var returnResultTime =
        Model.DisplayReturnResultTime
        ?? DateTime.Now;

    var selectedUserId =
        Model.SelectedUserReturnResultId;

    // Giữ class XQ hiện tại để CSS cũ vẫn hoạt động.
    // Đồng thời thêm semantic shared class để SHARED-08
    // chuyển sang responsive CSS mà không sửa markup lần nữa.
    var moduleClass =
        options.ModulePrefix;
}

<div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-title") cdha-process-info-title">
    THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN
</div>


@* ============================================================
   COLUMN 1
   Giữ đúng thứ tự UI XQ hiện tại
   ============================================================ *@

<div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-1") cdha-process-info-col cdha-process-info-col-1">

    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("id")"
                   hidden
                   value="@patient?.Id" />

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("patientId")"
                   value="@patient?.PatientId"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input cdha-process-seq-sid">

            <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1") cdha-process-seq">

                <input type="text"
                       id="@options.Id("seq")"
                       value="@patient?.Seq"
                       class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                       disabled />

            </div>

            <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2") cdha-process-sid">

                <input type="text"
                       id="@options.Id("sid")"
                       value="@patient?.Sid"
                       class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none"
                       disabled />

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("patientName")"
                   value="@patient?.PatientName"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4") cdha-process-pair-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object") cdha-process-pair-label">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-input") cdha-process-pair-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("age")"
                   value="@age"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan") cdha-process-pair-label pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-input") cdha-process-pair-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("sex")"
                   value="@patient?.Sex"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4") cdha-process-pair-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object") cdha-process-pair-label">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-input") cdha-process-pair-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("obj")"
                   value="@patient?.Object?.Name"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan") cdha-process-pair-label pading-left-5">
            <label>Bệnh án</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-4-input") cdha-process-pair-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("type")"
                   value="@Model.MedicalRecordName"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>

</div>


@* ============================================================
   COLUMN 2
   ============================================================ *@

<div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-2") cdha-process-info-col cdha-process-info-col-2 pading-left-10">

    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("location")"
                   value="@patient?.Location?.Name"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("doctor")"
                   value="@patient?.Doctor?.Name"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="text"
                   id="@options.Id("getSampleTime")"
                   value="@getSampleTime"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5"
                   disabled />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="datetime-local"
                   id="@options.Id("returnResultTime")"
                   value="@returnResultTime.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid"
                   data-toggle="tooltip"
                   title="Giờ trả kết quả là bắt buộc"
                   data-placement="top" />

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>BS thực hiện</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input type="hidden"
                   id="@options.Id("userLoginId")"
                   value="@Model.UserLoginId" />

            <select id="@options.UserReturnResultElementId"
                    name="@options.UserReturnResultElementSuffix"
                    class="form-select height-28 valid"
                    data-toggle="tooltip"
                    title="Người trả kết quả là bắt buộc"
                    data-placement="top">

                @foreach (var user in Model.Users)
                {
                    if (
                    selectedUserId.HasValue &&
                    user.Id == selectedUserId.Value
                    )
                    {
                        <option selected
                                value="@user.Id">
                            @user.Name
                        </option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@user.Id">
                            @user.Name
                        </option>
                    }
                }

            </select>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>CCCD BS</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input">

            <input id="@options.Id("signerCCCD")"
                   class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" />

        </div>

    </div>

</div>


@* ============================================================
   COLUMN 3
   ============================================================ *@

<div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-3") cdha-process-info-col cdha-process-info-col-3 pading-left-10">

    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input pading-left-10">

            <textarea id="@options.Id("address")"
                      class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                      disabled>@patient?.Address</textarea>

        </div>

    </div>


    <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2") cdha-process-field-row div-margin-top-5">

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-label") cdha-process-field-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>

        <div class="@($"{moduleClass}-right-info-div-combo-2-input") cdha-process-field-input pading-left-10">

            <textarea id="@options.Id("diagnostic")"
                      class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                      disabled>@patient?.Diagnostic</textarea>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessPatientList.cshtml">
@model Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA.CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var patients =
        Model.Patients
        ?? new List<Patient>();
}

<div class="list-group list-group-flush cdha-process-patient-list">

    @foreach (var patient in patients)
    {
        var patientName =
        patient.PatientName
        ?? string.Empty;

        var age =
        patient.Age?
        .ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")
        ?? string.Empty;

        <a href="#"
           class="list-group-item list-group-item-action cdha-process-patient-item"
           data-patient-db-id="@patient.Id"
           onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">

            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">

                <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">
                    @patient.PatientId
                </div>

                <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">
                    @age
                </div>

                <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                    @patient.Sex
                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="list-group-item-name">
                @patientName.ToUpper()
            </div>

        </a>
    }

</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessShell.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@model CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var options =
        Model.Options;

    var modulePrefix =
        options.ModulePrefix;

    var pacsSize =
        options.PacsDefaultSize;

    if (
        pacsSize != "60" &&
        pacsSize != "75" &&
        pacsSize != "90"
    )
    {
        pacsSize =
            "75";
    }


    var serviceGroupId =
        $"process_{modulePrefix}-right-service-group";

    var serviceGridId =
        $"process_{modulePrefix}-right-service-gridview";
}


<div id="pacs_shell"
     class="pacs-shell pacs-size-@pacsSize cdha-process-shell @options.ModuleClass("process-shell")"
     data-cdha-module="@modulePrefix"
     data-cdha-screen="@options.ScreenPrefix">

    <div id="pacs_main"
         class="pacs-main cdha-process-main">


        <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-container") cdha-process-container">


            @* =================================================
               LEFT
               Search + Patient List
               ================================================= *@

            <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-left") cdha-process-left">

                <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-left-search") cdha-process-search">

                    @await Html.PartialAsync(
                    "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessSearch.cshtml",
                                        Model
                                        )

                </div>

                <div id="process_listPatient"
                     class="@($"{modulePrefix}-left-list") cdha-process-patient-list-host">

                    @await Html.PartialAsync(
                                        "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessPatientList.cshtml",
                                        Model
                                        )

                </div>

            </div>

            @* Backdrop PHẢI nằm ngoài LEFT *@
            <div class="cdha-process-patient-backdrop"
                 data-cdha-role="patient-backdrop">
            </div>

            @* =================================================
               RIGHT
               Patient Info + ActionBar + Workspace
               ================================================= *@

            <div class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right") cdha-process-right">

                <button type="button"
                        class="cdha-process-patient-toggle"
                        data-cdha-action="toggle-patient-list"
                        aria-label="Mở danh sách bệnh nhân">

                    <i class="bi bi-list"></i>

                    Danh sách bệnh nhân

                </button>

                <div id="process_patientInfo"
                     class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-info") cdha-process-patient-info-host">

                    @await Html.PartialAsync(
                                        "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessPatientInfo.cshtml",
                                        Model
                                        )

                </div>


                <div id="process_patientService"
                     class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-service") cdha-process-service-host">


                    <div id="@serviceGroupId"
                         class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-service-group") cdha-process-action-host">

                        @await Html.PartialAsync(
                                                "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessActionBar.cshtml",
                                                Model
                                                )

                    </div>


                    <div id="@serviceGridId"
                         class="@($"{modulePrefix}-right-service-gridview") cdha-process-workspace-host">

                        @await Html.PartialAsync(
                                                "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessWorkspace.cshtml",
                                                Model
                                                )

                    </div>


                </div>


            </div>


        </div>


    </div>


    @if (options.EnablePacs)
        {
    @await Html.PartialAsync(
        "~/Views/Shared/_PacsDock.cshtml"
        )
        }

</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessWorkspace.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@model CdhaProcessViewModel

@{
    var options =
        Model.Options;

    var modulePrefix =
        options.ModulePrefix;

    var descriptionId =
        options.Id("description");

    var resultId =
        options.Id("result");

    var suggestId =
        options.Id("suggest");

    var moduleMediaClass =
        options.ModuleClass(
            "process-pacs-media"
        );
}

<div class="table-responsive cdha-process-workspace">

    @* =========================================================
       LEFT
       Service List + PACS Media
       ========================================================= *@

    <div class="left cdha-process-workspace-left">

        <div class="list-service cdha-process-service-list">

            <div class="table-responsive">

                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">

                    <tbody class="tbody-service">

                        @foreach (var item in Model.Results)
                        {
                            var checkboxId =
                            options.Id(
                            $"service_{item.Id}"
                            );

                            <tr class="row-service cdha-process-service-row"
                                data-result-cdha-id="@item.Id"
                                onclick="Process_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">

                                <td class="td-check">

                                    <input id="@checkboxId"
                                           class="form-check-input"
                                           type="checkbox"
                                           value="@item.Id"
                                           data-cdha-role="service-checkbox" />

                                </td>

                                <td class="td-name">
                                    @item.Service?.Name
                                </td>

                            </tr>
                        }

                    </tbody>

                </table>

            </div>

        </div>


        @if (options.EnablePacs)
        {
            <div class="contain-hinh @moduleMediaClass cdha-process-media">

                @await Html.PartialAsync(
                "~/Views/Shared/_PacsMediaPanel.cshtml"
                        )

        </div>
                }

    </div>


    @* =========================================================
   RIGHT
   Description / Result / Suggest
   ========================================================= *@

    <div class="right cdha-process-workspace-right">

        <div class="desscription cdha-process-description cdha-process-editor-card">

            <div class="cdha-process-editor-title">
                MÔ TẢ CHI TIẾT
            </div>

            <div class="content cdha-process-description-content">

                <textarea id="@descriptionId"
                          class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                          placeholder="Mô tả ..."></textarea>

                <script>
                    CKEDITOR.replace(
                        '@descriptionId'
                    );
                </script>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="result-suggest cdha-process-result-suggest">

            <div class="result cdha-process-result cdha-process-editor-card">

                <div class="cdha-process-editor-title">
                    KẾT LUẬN
                </div>

                <textarea id="@resultId"
                          class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                          placeholder="Kết luận ..."></textarea>

            </div>


            <div class="suggest cdha-process-suggest cdha-process-editor-card">

                <div class="cdha-process-editor-title">
                    ĐỀ NGHỊ
                </div>

                <textarea id="@suggestId"
                          class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5"
                          placeholder="Đề nghị ..."></textarea>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>

</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/TestCode/_TestCode_Info.cshtml">
@{
    var testCode = ViewData["TestCode"] as TestCode;
    var lstTestType = ViewData["lstTestType"] as List<TestType>;
    var lstCategory = ViewData["lstCategory"] as List<Category>;
}

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã XN</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-code" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@testCode?.Code" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" disabled />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên XN</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-name" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@testCode?.Name" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">CSBT Nam</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-normalrangem" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.NormalRangeM" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">CSBT Nữ</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-normalrangef" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.NormalRangeF" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">CSBT</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-normalresult" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.NormalResult" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Giới hạn thấp</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="number" id="testcode-lowerlimit" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.LowerLimit" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Giới hạn cao</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="number" id="testcode-higherlimit" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.HigherLimit" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Đơn vị</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-unit" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.Unit" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Thứ tự in</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="number" id="testcode-printorder" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.PrintOrder" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã BHYT</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-codebhyt" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.CodeBHYT" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>


<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên BHYT</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="testcode-namebhyt" class="form-control height-28" value="@testCode?.NameBHYT" onkeyup="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Loại mẫu</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <select required id="testcode-testtype" name="category" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
            @if (lstTestType != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstTestType)
                {
                    if (testCode?.TestTypeId == item?.Id)
                    {
                        <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Danh mục</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <select required id="testcode-category" name="category" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
            <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
            @if (lstCategory != null)
            {
                foreach (var item in lstCategory)
                {
                    if (testCode?.CategoryId == item?.Id)
                    {
                        <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                    }
                }
            }
        </select>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">&nbsp;</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <div class="div-input-child">
            @{
                if (testCode != null)
                {
                    if (testCode.IsTestHead)
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istesthead" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                        <label for="testcode-istesthead">Test Header</label>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istesthead" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                        <label for="testcode-istesthead">Test Header</label>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istesthead" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="testcode-istesthead">Test Header</label>
                }
            }
        </div>
        <div class="div-input-child">
            @{
                if (testCode != null)
                {
                    if (testCode.IsTestChild)
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istestchild" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                        <label for="testcode-istestchild">Test Child</label>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istestchild" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                        <label for="testcode-istestchild">Test Child</label>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-istestchild" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="testcode-istestchild">Test Child</label>
                }
            }
        </div>
        <div class="div-input-child">
            @{
                if (testCode != null)
                {
                    if (testCode.Active)
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-active" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)" checked>
                        <label for="testcode-active">Active</label>
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-active" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                        <label for="testcode-active">Active</label>
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" id="testcode-active" onclick="TestCode_HideButton(true, false, true, false)">
                    <label for="testcode-active">Active</label>
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/TestCode/_TestCode_List.cshtml">
@{
    var lstTestCode = ViewData["lstTestCode"] as List<TestCode>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered table-striped table-hover">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-checkbox" scope="col"></th>
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">Stt</th>
                <th class="th-id" scope="col">Id</th>
                <th class="th-code" scope="col">Mã</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">Tên</th> 
                <th class="th-active" scope="col">Active</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstTestCode != null && lstTestCode.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstTestCode)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr class="row-service" onclick="TestCode_CheckedBoxOnRow('@item.Id')">
                            <td class="td-checkbox">
                                <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                            </td>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-id">@item.Id</td>
                            <td class="td-code">@item.Code</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.Name</td>
                            <td class="td-active">@item.Active</td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<div class="settup-container">

        <div class="settup-left-title-search">
            <div class="title">
                DANH SÁCH LOẠI MẪU
