<file path="Views/User/_User_Function.cshtml">
@{
    var lstFunction = ViewData["lstFunction"] as List<Function>;
    var user = ViewData["User"] as User;
}
<div class="modal" id="addFunction" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="user-function-title">
                <div class="title">PHÂN QUYỀN NGƯỜI DÙNG</div>
                <button type="button" class="btn-close" data-bs-dismiss="modal" aria-label="Close"></button>
            </div>
            <div class="user-function-content">
                @{
                    if (lstFunction != null && lstFunction.Count > 0)
                    {
                        var count = 0;
                        foreach (var item in lstFunction)
                        {
                            count++;
                            
                            if (user != null)
                            {
                                if(count == 9)
                                {
                                    <hr class="hr"/>
                                }
                                var userFunction = user.UserFunctions.Where(p => p.FunctionId == item.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                                if (userFunction != null)
                                {
                                    <div class="row-function">
                                        <input id="@item.Id" class="form-check-input function" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" checked>
                                        <label for="@item.Id">@item.Name</label>
                                    </div>
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    <div class="row-function">
                                        <input id="@item.Id" class="form-check-input function" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id">
                                        <label for="@item.Id">@item.Name</label>
                                    </div>
                                }
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="row-function">
                                    <input id="@item.Id" class="form-check-input function" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id">
                                    <label for="@item.Id">@item.Name</label>
                                </div>
                            }

                        }
                    }
                }
            </div>
            <div class="user-function-button">
                <button id="user-function" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="User_SaveUserFunction()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/User/_User_Info.cshtml">
@{
    var user = ViewData["User"] as User;
    var lstType = ViewData["lstType"] as List<Management.Models.Type>;
}

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã người dùng</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="user-code" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@user?.Code" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" disabled />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Tên người dùng</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="user-name" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@user?.Name" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mật khẩu</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="password" id="user-pass" class="form-control height-28 valid" value="@user?.Password" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã BHYT</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="user-mabhyt" class="form-control height-28" value="@user?.MaBHYT" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" />
    </div>
</div>
<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">CCCD</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="user-cccd" class="form-control height-28" value="@user?.Cccd" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" />
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Mã His</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        <input type="text" id="user-his-employeeid" class="form-control height-28" value="@user?.HisEmployeeId" onkeyup="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" />
    </div>
</div>
<hr />
<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">Khoa phòng</div>
    <div class="div-input">
        @{
            if (lstType != null)
            {
                var index = 1000;
                foreach (var item in lstType)
                {
                    index++;
                    if(user != null)
                    {
                        var userType = user.UserTypes.Where(p => p.TypeId == item.Id).FirstOrDefault();
                        if (userType != null)
                        {
                            <div class="div-input-child-20">
                                <input id="@index" class="form-check-input type" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" checked>
                                <label for="@index">@item.Name</label>
                            </div>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <div class="div-input-child-20">
                                <input id="@index" class="form-check-input type" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)">
                                <label for="@index">@item.Name</label>
                            </div>
                        }
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <div class="div-input-child-20">
                            <input id="@index" class="form-check-input type" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)">
                            <label for="@index">@item.Name</label>
                        </div>
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    </div>
</div>

<div class="div-lable-input">
    <div class="div-lable">
        @{
            if (user != null)
            {
                if (user.Active)
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="user-active" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)" checked>
                    <label for="user-active">Active</label>
                }
                else
                {
                    <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="user-active" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)">
                    <label for="user-active">Active</label>
                }
            }
            else
            {
                <input class="form-check-input valid" type="checkbox" id="user-active" onclick="User_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true)">
                <label for="user-active">Active</label>
            }
        }
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/User/_User_List.cshtml">
@{
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<User>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered table-hover">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-checkbox" scope="col"></th>
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">Stt</th>
                <th class="th-id" scope="col">Id</th>
                <th class="th-code" scope="col">Mã</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">Tên</th>
                <th class="th-code" scope="col">Mã BHYT</th>
                <th class="th-cccd" scope="col">Cccd</th>
                <th class="th-cccd" scope="col">Mã His</th>
                <th class="th-active" scope="col">Active</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstUser != null && lstUser.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;

                }

        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<file path="Views/XN_GetSample/_XN_GetSample_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_GetSample/_XN_GetSample_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultXNs = ViewData["lstResultXNs"] as List<ResultXN>;
    var lstCategory = ViewData["lstCategory"] as List<Category>;
    var lstService = ViewData["lstService"] as List<Service>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">STT</th>
                <th class="th-code" scope="col">MÃ XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-delete" scope="col"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultXNs != null && lstresultXNs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstresultXNs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        if (index % 2 != 0)
                        {
                            <tr class="tr-content">
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-code">@item.TestCode.Code</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item.TestCode.IsTestChild == true)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-name-getsample">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-name-getsample">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-delete">
                                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-red-in-gridview" value="@item.Id" onclick="GetSample_DeleteServiceForPatient(this.value)">x</button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <tr>
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-code">@item.TestCode.Code</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item.TestCode.IsTestChild == true)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-name-getsample">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-name-getsample">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-delete">
                                    <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-red-in-gridview" value="@item.Id" onclick="GetSample_DeleteServiceForPatient(this.value)">x</button>
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<file path="Views/XN_GetSample/_XN_GetSample_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
    var lstLocation = ViewData["lstLocation"] as List<Location>;
    var lstDoctor = ViewData["lstDoctor"] as List<Doctor>;
    var lstSexModel = ViewData["lstSexModel"] as List<SexModel>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;
    var lstHospital = ViewData["lstHospital"] as List<Hospital>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeXN = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXN != null) ? DateTime.Parse(patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXN.ToString()) : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="xn-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="xn-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_getsample_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="xn_getsample_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mã bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="xn_getsample_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true); GetSID(this.value);" onchange="GetSample_GetSID(this.value)" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="xn_getsample_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_getsample_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="date" id="xn_getsample_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Ngày sinh là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="xn_getsample_sex" name="sex" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giới tính là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstSexModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstSexModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.Sex == item.Id.ToString())
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {

<file path="Views/XN_Process/_XN_Process_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        @{
                            if (patient.FullResultXN)
                            {
                                <div class="list-group-item-name" style="color:#dc3545"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                            }
                        }
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="Process_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        @{
                            if (patient.FullResultXN)
                            {
                                <div class="list-group-item-name" style="color:#dc3545"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                            }
                        }
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_Process/_XN_Process_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultXNs = ViewData["lstResultXNs"] as List<ResultXN>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col"></th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-result" scope="col">KẾT QUẢ</th>
                <th class="th-defaultvalue" scope="col">CHỈ SỐ BÌNH THƯỜNG</th>
                <th class="th-unit" scope="col">ĐƠN VỊ</th>
                <th class="th-validPrint" scope="col">VALID & IN</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultXNs != null && lstresultXNs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    var idResult = string.Empty;
                    var result_posneg = string.Empty;
                    var tabInddex = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstresultXNs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        tabInddex++;
                        idResult = "result" + index;
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.PosNeg + " (" + item.Result + ")";
                        }
                        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.Result;
                        }
                        else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.PosNeg;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            result_posneg = string.Empty;
                        }

                        if (index % 2 != 0)
                        {
                            <tr class="tr-content process-row-result">
                                <td class="td-id" hidden>@item.Id</td>
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-name-process">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item?.Status == 0)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:dimgrey" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:black" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 1)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:blue" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:blue" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:red" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:red" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-defaultvalue">@item.TestCode.NormalResult</td>
                                <td class="td-unit">@item.TestCode.Unit</td>
                                <td class="td-validPrint">
                                    @{
                                        if (item.ValidPrint)
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" checked id="flexCheckDefault">
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" id="flexCheckDefault">
                                        }
                                    }
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <tr class="process-row-result">
                                <td class="td-id" hidden>@item.Id</td>
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-name-process">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item?.Status == 0)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:dimgrey" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:black" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 1)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:blue" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:blue" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                        <td class="td-result">
                                            <div class="status">
                                                <button style="color:red" class="btn-status" onclick="Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(this, this.value, @index)" value="@item?.Status"><i class="bi bi-square-fill"></i></button>
                                            </div>
                                            <div class="result">
                                                <input tabindex="@tabInddex" style="color:red" id="@idResult" type="text" class="form-control input-result" value="@result_posneg" />
                                            </div>
                                        </td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-defaultvalue">@item.TestCode.NormalResult</td>
                                <td class="td-unit">@item.TestCode.Unit</td>
                                <td class="td-validPrint">
                                    @{
                                        if (item.ValidPrint)
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" checked id="flexCheckDefault">
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" id="flexCheckDefault">
                                        }
                                    }
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_Process/_XN_Process_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstUser = ViewData["lstUser"] as List<User>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;
    var userLoginId = ViewData["userLoginId"] as long?;
    var userInfo = ViewData["userInfo"] as User;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeXN = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXN != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeXN?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeXN = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeXN != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeXN : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="xn-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="xn-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="xn_process_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="xn_process_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if (benhan != null)
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="xn_process_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        <input type="text" id="xn_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                    <input type="text" id="xn_process_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xn-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">

            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ lấy mẫu</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeXN" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="xn_process_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeXN?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="Process_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giờ trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Người trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="hidden" id="xn_process_userLoginId" value="@ViewData["userLoginId"]" />
            <select id="xn_process_userReturnResultXN" name="userReturnResultXN" class="form-select height-28 valid" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Người trả kết quả là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstUser != null)
                {
                    var isUserReturnResultXN = false;
                    foreach (var item in lstUser)
                    {
                        if (item.Id == patientInfo?.UserReturnResultXN)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            isUserReturnResultXN = true;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            if (isUserReturnResultXN == false && userLoginId != null && userLoginId == item.Id)
                            {
                                <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>CCCD BS</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input id="xn_process_signerCCCD" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xn-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="xn_process_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" style="height: 60px" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="xn_process_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" style="height: 60px" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Bệnh viện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <input type="text" id="xn_process_hospital" value="@patientInfo?.Hospital?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<file path="Views/XN_Process/Content.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _lstResultXN = ViewData["ListResultXN"] as List<ResultXN>;
    var _groupResultByCategory = _lstResultXN.GroupBy(p => p.Service.CategoryId);
}
@model Hospital
<div class="result-xn">
    <table class="table-result">
        <thead class="thead">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-result" scope="col">KẾT QUẢ</th>
                <th class="th-normalresult" scope="col">CHỈ SỐ BÌNH THƯỜNG</th>
                <th class="th-unit" scope="col">ĐƠN VỊ</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="tbody">
            @{
                if (_groupResultByCategory != null)
                {
                    foreach (var _group in _groupResultByCategory)
                    {
                        var _results = _group.ToList();
                        if (_results != null)
                        {
                                <tr class="tr-category">
                                    <td class="td-category" colspan="4">@_results[0].Service?.Category?.Name.ToUpper()</td>
                                </tr>
                            foreach (var _result in _results)
                            {
                                    <tr class="tr-content">
                                        @if (_result.TestCode.IsTestChild)
                                    {
                                        if (_result?.Status == 1 || _result?.Status == 2)
                                        {
                                                <td class="td-name bold">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; @_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                                <td class="td-name">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; @_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-name">@_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                    }
                                        @if (_result?.Status == 1 || _result?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-result bold">@_result?.Result</td>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-result">@_result?.Result</td>
                                    }
                                        <td class="td-normalresult">@_result?.TestCode?.NormalResult</td>
                                        <td class="td-unit">@_result?.TestCode?.Unit</td>
                                    </tr>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_Process/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _lstResultXN = ViewData["ListResultXN"] as List<ResultXN>;

    var _printTime = (_lstResultXN != null && _lstResultXN.Count > 0) ? _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeXN : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_lstResultXN != null && _lstResultXN.Count > 0) ? _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.UserXN?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="signature-page-xn">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>

                KHOA XÉT NGHIỆM
            </div>

                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_ReturnResult/_XN_ReturnResult_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultXNs = ViewData["lstResultXNs"] as List<ResultXN>;
}
<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col"></th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-result" scope="col">KẾT QUẢ</th>
                <th class="th-defaultvalue" scope="col">CHỈ SỐ BÌNH THƯỜNG</th>
                <th class="th-unit" scope="col">ĐƠN VỊ</th>
                <th class="th-validPrint" scope="col">VALID & IN</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultXNs != null && lstresultXNs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    var idResult = string.Empty;
                    var result_posneg = string.Empty;

                    foreach (var item in lstresultXNs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        idResult = "result" + index;
                        if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.PosNeg + " (" + item.Result + ")";
                        }
                        else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.Result;
                        }
                        else if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Result) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.PosNeg))
                        {
                            result_posneg = item.PosNeg;
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            result_posneg = string.Empty;
                        }

                        if (index % 2 != 0)
                        {
                            <tr class="tr-content process-row-result">
                                <td class="td-id" hidden>@item.Id</td>
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-name-process">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item?.Status == 0)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:black" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 1)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:blue" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:red" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-defaultvalue">@item.TestCode.NormalResult</td>
                                <td class="td-unit">@item.TestCode.Unit</td>
                                <td class="td-validPrint">
                                    @{
                                        if (item.ValidPrint)
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" checked id="flexCheckDefault" disabled>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" id="flexCheckDefault" disabled>
                                        }
                                    }
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <tr class="process-row-result">
                                <td class="td-id" hidden>@item.Id</td>
                                <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                                <td class="td-name-process">@item.TestCode.Name</td>
                                @{
                                    if (item?.Status == 0)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:black" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 1)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:blue" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                    else if (item?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                        <td style="color:red" class="td-result-returnresult">@result_posneg</td>
                                    }
                                }
                                <td class="td-defaultvalue">@item.TestCode.NormalResult</td>
                                <td class="td-unit">@item.TestCode.Unit</td>
                                <td class="td-validPrint">
                                    @{
                                        if (item.ValidPrint)
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" checked id="flexCheckDefault" disabled>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                            <input class="form-check-input validPrint" type="checkbox" value="@item.ValidPrint" id="flexCheckDefault" disabled>
                                        }
                                    }
                                </td>
                            </tr>
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_ReturnResult/_XN_ReturnResult_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeXN = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXN != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeXN?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeXN = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeXN != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeXN?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
}
<div class="xn-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="xn-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xn-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xn_returnresult_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />

<file path="Views/XN_ReturnResult/Content.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _lstResultXN = ViewData["ListResultXN"] as List<ResultXN>;
    var _groupResultByCategory = _lstResultXN.GroupBy(p => p.Service.CategoryId);
}
@model Hospital
<div class="result-xn">
    <table class="table-result">
        <thead class="thead">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN XÉT NGHIỆM</th>
                <th class="th-result" scope="col">KẾT QUẢ</th>
                <th class="th-normalresult" scope="col">CHỈ SỐ BÌNH THƯỜNG</th>
                <th class="th-unit" scope="col">ĐƠN VỊ</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="tbody">
            @{
                if (_groupResultByCategory != null)
                {
                    foreach (var _group in _groupResultByCategory)
                    {
                        var _results = _group.ToList();
                        if (_results != null)
                        {
                                <tr class="tr-category">
                                    <td class="td-category" colspan="4">@_results[0].Service?.Category?.Name.ToUpper()</td>
                                </tr>
                            foreach (var _result in _results)
                            {
                                    <tr class="tr-content">
                                        @if (_result.TestCode.IsTestChild)
                                    {
                                        if (_result?.Status == 1 || _result?.Status == 2)
                                        {
                                                <td class="td-name bold">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; @_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                        }
                                        else
                                        {
                                                <td class="td-name">&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; @_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                        }
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-name">@_result?.TestCode?.Name</td>
                                    }
                                        @if (_result?.Status == 1 || _result?.Status == 2)
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-result bold">@_result?.Result</td>
                                    }
                                    else
                                    {
                                            <td class="td-result">@_result?.Result</td>
                                    }
                                        <td class="td-normalresult">@_result?.TestCode?.NormalResult</td>
                                        <td class="td-unit">@_result?.TestCode?.Unit</td>
                                    </tr>
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
    </table>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_ReturnResult/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _lstResultXN = ViewData["ListResultXN"] as List<ResultXN>;
    var _groupResultByCategory = _lstResultXN.GroupBy(p => p.Service.CategoryId);
    var _printTime = (_lstResultXN != null && _lstResultXN.Count > 0) ? _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeXN : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_lstResultXN != null && _lstResultXN.Count > 0) ? _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.UserXN?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="signature-page-xn">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                KHOA XÉT NGHIỆM
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XN_ReturnResult/Header.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _lstResultXN = ViewData["ListResultXN"] as List<ResultXN>;
    var _groupResultByCategory = _lstResultXN.GroupBy(p => p.Service.CategoryId);
    var age = _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-xn">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            <div class="hospital-info-title-text">
                KẾT QUẢ XÉT NGHIỆM
            </div>
            <div class="hospital-info-title-time">
                <div class="hospital-info-title-time-getsampletime">
                    Giờ lấy mẫu : @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.GetSampleTimeXN?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")
                </div>
                <div class="hospital-info-title-time-returnresulttime">
                    Giờ trả KQ &nbsp;&nbsp;: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeXN?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm")
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-xn">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_lstResultXN[0]?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_GetSample/_XQ_GetSample_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="GetSample_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_GetSample/_XQ_GetSample_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
    var lstService = ViewData["lstService"] as List<Service>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <table class="table table-bordered">
        <thead class="sticky-top">
            <tr class="tr-title">
                <th class="th-number" scope="col">STT</th>
                <th class="th-name" scope="col">TÊN DỊCH VỤ</th>
                <th class="th-delete" scope="col"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody id="tbody-gridview-service">
            @{
                if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                {
                    var index = 0;
                    foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                    {
                        index++;
                        <tr>
                            <td class="td-number">@index</td>
                            <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                            <td class="td-delete">
                                <button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-danger btn-red-in-gridview" value="@item.Id" onclick="GetSample_DeleteServiceForPatient(this.value)">x</button>
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    }
                }
            }
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- From thêm dịch vụ cho bệnh nhân -->
<div class="modal" id="addServiceForm" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false" tabindex="-1" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="staticBackdropLabel" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="modal-dialog" role="document">
        <div class="modal-content">
            <div class="xq-right-add-service-for-patient-title">
                <div class="title">THÊM DỊCH VỤ</div>

            </div>
            <div class="xq-right-add-service-for-patient-service">
                <div class="title">Dịch vụ</div>
                <div class="content">
                    <select id="xq_getsample_service" name="service" class="form-select height-28">
                        @if (lstService != null)
                        {
                            foreach (var item in lstService)
                            {
                                <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                            }
                        }
                    </select>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="xq-right-add-service-for-patient-button">
                <button id="xq-getsample_addserviceforpatient" class="btn btn-success btn-blue" data-bs-dismiss="modal" onclick="GetSample_AddServiceForPatient()">
                    <i class="bi bi-download"></i> Lưu
                </button>

</div>

<file path="Views/XQ_GetSample/_XQ_GetSample_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstObject = ViewData["lstObject"] as List<Management.Models.Object>;
    var lstLocation = ViewData["lstLocation"] as List<Location>;
    var lstDoctor = ViewData["lstDoctor"] as List<Doctor>;
    var lstSexModel = ViewData["lstSexModel"] as List<SexModel>;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeXQ = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXQ != null) ? DateTime.Parse(patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXQ.ToString()) : DateTime.Now;
}
<div class="xq-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_getsample_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="xq_getsample_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Mã bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="xq_getsample_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true); GetSID(this.value);" onchange="GetSample_GetSID(this.value)" autocomplete="off" />
            </div>
            <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="xq_getsample_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_getsample_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 valid" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Tên bệnh nhân là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" autocomplete="off" />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="date" id="xq_getsample_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Ngày sinh là bắt buộc" data-placement="top" />
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="xq_getsample_sex" name="sex" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Giới tính là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstSexModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstSexModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.Sex == item.Id.ToString())
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="xq_getsample_obj" name="obj" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Đối tượng là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstObject != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstObject)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.ObjectId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <select required id="xq_getsample_type" name="type" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bệnh án là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                <option value="" disabled selected>-- Chọn --</option>
                @if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstBenhAnModel)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.BenhAn == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <textarea id="xq_getsample_address" class="form-control height-60 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="xq_getsample_location" name="location" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Nơi chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstLocation != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstLocation)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.LocationId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <select id="xq_getsample_doctor" name="doctor" class="form-select height-28 valid" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" data-toggle="tooltip" title="Bác sĩ chỉ định là bắt buộc" data-placement="top">
                @if (lstDoctor != null)
                {
                    foreach (var item in lstDoctor)
                    {
                        if (patientInfo?.DoctorId == item.Id)
                        {
                            <option selected value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            <option value="@item.Id">@item.Name</option>
                        }
                    }
                }
            </select>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ nhận bệnh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="datetime-local" id="xq_getsample_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeXQ.ToString("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm")" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" onchange="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)" />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="xq_getsample_diagnostic" class="form-control height-160 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" onkeyup="GetSample_HideButton(true, false, true, false, true, true)">@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<file path="Views/XQ_Process/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeXQ : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;

        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
