            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                BÁC SĨ TRẢ KẾT QUẢ
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_Process/Header.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var age = _resultCDHA?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-xq">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ X-QUANG
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-xq">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_Process/Process.cshtml">
@using Management.Models
@using Management.Models.ViewModels.CDHA

@{
    ViewData["Title"] =
        "Đang thực hiện";

    Layout =
        "_LayoutXQ";


    var patients =
        ViewData["lstPatient"]
            as List<Patient>
        ?? new List<Patient>();


    var samples =
        ViewData["lstSampleResult"]
            as List<Sample>
        ?? new List<Sample>();


    var devices =
        ViewData["lstDevice"]
            as List<Device>
        ?? new List<Device>();


    var options =
        CdhaProcessViewModel
            .CreateXqOptions();


    var model =
        new CdhaProcessViewModel
        {
            Options =
                options,

            Patients =
                patients,

            Samples =
                samples,

            Devices =
                devices
        };


    // =====================================================
    // Shared PACS Dock configuration
    // =====================================================

    ViewData["PacsModulePrefix"] =
        options.ModulePrefix;

    ViewData["PacsScreenPrefix"] =
        options.ScreenPrefix;

    ViewData["PacsTitle"] =
        options.PacsTitle;

    ViewData["PacsDefaultSize"] =
        options.PacsDefaultSize;
}


@await Html.PartialAsync(
"~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessShell.cshtml",
    model
)


@await Html.PartialAsync(
    "_Loading"
)


@await Html.PartialAsync(
    "~/Views/Shared/CDHA/Process/_ProcessDeviceModal.cshtml",
    model
)
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/_XQ_ReturnResult_ListPatient.cshtml">
@{
    var lstPatient = ViewData["lstPatient"] as List<Patient>;
}
<div class="list-group list-group-flush">
    @{
        if (lstPatient != null || lstPatient.Count > 0)
        {
            var index = 1;
            foreach (var patient in lstPatient)
            {
                index++;
                if (index % 2 == 0)
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
                else
                {
                    <a href="#" class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" onclick="ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(@patient.Id)">
                        <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex">
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid">@patient.PatientId</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age">@patient.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy")</div>
                            <div class="list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex">
                                @{
                                    @patient.Sex
                                }
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="list-group-item-name"> @patient.PatientName.ToUpper()</div>
                    </a>
                }
            }
        }
    }
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/_XQ_ReturnResult_ListService.cshtml">
@{
    var lstresultCDHAs = ViewData["lstresultCDHAs"] as List<ResultCDHA>;
}

<div class="table-responsive">
    <div class="left">
        <div class="list-service">
            <div class="table-responsive">
                <table class="table table-hover table-bordered">
                    <tbody class="tbody-service">
                        @{
                            if (lstresultCDHAs != null && lstresultCDHAs.Count > 0)
                            {
                                var index = 0;
                                foreach (var item in lstresultCDHAs)
                                {
                                    index++;
                                    <tr id="start-camera" class="row-service" onclick="ReturnResult_CheckedBoxOnRow(@item.Id)">
                                        <td class="td-check">
                                            <input class="form-check-input" type="checkbox" value="@item.Id" id="flexCheckChecked">
                                        </td>
                                        <td class="td-name">@item.Service.Name</td>
                                    </tr>
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    </tbody>
                </table>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="right">
        <div class="desscription">
            <div class="content returnresult">
                <textarea id="xq_returnresult_description" class="form-control textarea-desscription pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Mô tả ..." disabled></textarea>
                <script>
                    var editor = CKEDITOR.replace('xq_returnresult_description');
                    editor.on('instanceReady', function (evt) {
                        editor.setReadOnly(true);
                    });
                </script>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="result-suggest">
            <div class="result">
                <textarea id="xq_returnresult_result" class="form-control textarea-result pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Kết luận ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
            <div class="suggest">
                <textarea id="xq_returnresult_suggest" class="form-control textarea-suggest pading-left-5 pading-right-5" placeholder="Đề nghị ..." disabled></textarea>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/_XQ_ReturnResult_PatientInfo.cshtml">
@using Management.BL
@{
    var patientInfo = ViewData["patientInfo"] as Patient;
    var lstBenhAnModel = ViewData["lstBenhAnModel"] as List<BenhAnModel>;

    var age = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.Age != null) ? patientInfo?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : string.Empty;
    var getSampleTimeXQ = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.GetSampleTimeXQ != null) ? patientInfo?.GetSampleTimeXQ?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
    var returnResultTimeXQ = (patientInfo != null && patientInfo.ReturnResultTimeXQ != null) ? patientInfo?.ReturnResultTimeXQ?.ToString("dd/MM/yyy HH:mm") : string.Empty;
}
<div class="xq-right-info-title">THÔNG TIN BỆNH NHÂN</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-1">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_id" hidden value="@patientInfo?.Id" />
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_patientId" value="@patientInfo?.PatientId" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Mã bệnh phẩm</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input1">
                <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_seq" value="@patientInfo?.Seq" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
            </div>
            <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2">
                <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_sid" value="@patientInfo?.Sid" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 border-left-none" disabled />
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Tên bệnh nhân</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_patientName" value="@patientInfo?.PatientName" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5 " disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Ngày sinh</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_age" value="@age" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 " disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label>Giới tính</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_sex" value="@patientInfo?.Sex" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-age-object">
            <label>Đối tượng</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_obj" value="@patientInfo?.Object.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan pading-left-5">
            <label> Bệnh án</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-4-input">
            @{
                if (lstBenhAnModel != null)
                {
                    var benhan = lstBenhAnModel.Where(p => p.Id == patientInfo?.BenhAn).FirstOrDefault();
                    if(benhan != null)
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_type" value="@benhan.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                    else
                    {
                            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                    }
                }
                else
                {
                        <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_type" value="" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
                }
            }
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-2 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Nơi chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_location" value="@patientInfo?.Location?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS chỉ định</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_doctor" value="@patientInfo?.Doctor?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ thực hiện</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_getSampleTime" value="@getSampleTimeXQ" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Giờ trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_returnResultTime" value="@returnResultTimeXQ" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
     <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>BS trả KQ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input">
            <input type="text" id="xq_returnresult_userReturnResultXQ" value="@patientInfo?.UserReturnXQ?.Name" class="form-control height-28 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled />
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="xq-right-info-div-3 pading-left-10">
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Địa chỉ</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="xq_returnresult_address" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Address</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2 div-margin-top-5">
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-label">
            <label>Chẩn đoán</label>
        </div>
        <div class="xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input pading-left-10">
            <textarea id="xq_returnresult_diagnostic" class="form-control height-30 pading-left-5 pading-right-5" disabled>@patientInfo?.Diagnostic</textarea>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/_XQ_ReturnResult_Search.cshtml">

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/Content.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="export-result-xq">
    <div class="des-res-sug">
        <div class="title">
            MÔ TẢ KẾT QUẢ
        </div>
        <div class="des">
            <div class="des-title">Mô tả:</div>
            <div class="des-content">@Html.Raw(@_resultCDHA?.Description)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="res">
            <div class="res-title">Kết luận:</div>
            <div class="res-content">@_resultCDHA?.Result</div>
        </div>
        <div class="sug">
            <div class="sug-title">Đề nghị:</div>
            <div class="sug-content">@_resultCDHA?.Suggest</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/Footer.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var _printTime = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.ReturnResultTimeXQ : DateTime.Now;
    var _printTimeString = "Ngày " + _printTime?.Day.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " tháng " + _printTime?.Month.ToString().PadLeft(2, '0') + " năm " + _printTime?.Year;
    var _userReturnResult = (_resultCDHA != null) ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.UserReturnXQ?.Name : string.Empty;
}
@model Hospital
<div class="signature-page-xq">
    <div class="signature">
        <div class="signature-left">
        </div>
        <div class="signature-right">
            <div class="signature-right-time">
                @_printTimeString
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-title">
                BÁC SĨ TRẢ KẾT QUẢ
            </div>
            <div class="signature-right-user">
                @_userReturnResult
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    @*<div class="page">
        Trang 1/1
    </div>*@
</div>
</file>

<file path="Views/XQ_ReturnResult/Header.cshtml">
@{
    Layout = "_LayoutExport";
    var _resultCDHA = ViewData["ResultCDHA"] as ResultCDHA;
    var age = _resultCDHA?.Patient?.IsYear == false ? _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("dd/MM/yyyy") : _resultCDHA?.Patient?.Age?.ToString("yyyy");
}
@model Hospital
<div class="hospital-xq">
    <div class="hospital-logo">
        <img class="image" src="~/images/logo/logo.png" />
    </div>
    <div class="hospital-info">
        <div class="hospital-info-name">
            @Model.Name.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-address">
            @Model.Address
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-phonemail">
            @Model.Phone @Model.Email @Model.Website
        </div>
        <div class="hospital-info-title">
            PHIẾU KẾT QUẢ X-QUANG
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
<div class="patient-xq">
    <div class="name-sex-age">
        <div class="name">
            <div class="label1">Họ tên</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.PatientName.ToUpper()
        </div>
        <div class="sex">
            <div class="label2">Giới tính</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sex
        </div>
        <div class="age">
            <div class="label2">Năm sinh</div>: @age
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="sid-obj">
        <div class="sid">
            <div class="label1">Mã bệnh phẩm</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Sid
        </div>
        <div class="obj">
            <div class="label2">Đối tượng</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Object?.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="address">
        <div class="label1">Địa chỉ</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient?.Address
    </div>
    <div class="doctor-location">
        <div class="doctor">
            <div class="label1">Bác sĩ chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Doctor.Name
        </div>
        <div class="location">
            <div class="label2">Nơi chỉ định</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Location.Name
        </div>
    </div>
    <div class="diagnostic">
        <div class="label1">Chẩn đoán</div>: @_resultCDHA?.Patient.Diagnostic
    </div>
</div>
</file>

<file path="wwwroot/css/cdha/cdha-process.css">
/* ============================================================
   PACS-CDHA-UI-SHARED-08
   Shared responsive layout for CDHA Process screens

   IMPORTANT
   - No module-specific xq/ct/mr/mg selectors here.
   - Legacy module CSS remains loaded during migration.
   - These semantic selectors override legacy float/fixed widths.
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   1. RIS CONTAINER
   pacs-main changes width whenever PACS 60/75/90 changes.
   Container queries therefore react to ACTUAL RIS width.
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-main {
    min-width: 0;
    container-type: inline-size;
    container-name: cdha-ris;
}


.cdha-process-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100dvh - 60px);
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 250px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 5px;
    margin: 0;
    padding-top: 5px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}


.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .cdha-process-container {
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   2. LEFT - SEARCH + PATIENT LIST
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-left {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding-right: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-search {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    float: none;
}


.cdha-process-patient-list-host {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    float: none;
    overflow: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-patient-list {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    margin-top: 5px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}


.cdha-process-patient-item {
    min-width: 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   3. RIGHT
   This becomes a SECOND container.

   PatientInfo and Workspace react to actual width available
   after Patient List and PACS have taken their space.
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-right {
    width: auto;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    float: none;
    padding-left: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    container-type: inline-size;
    container-name: cdha-content;
}


/* ============================================================
   4. PATIENT INFO
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-patient-info-host {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    float: none;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 1fr) minmax(300px, 1fr) minmax(250px, .85fr);
    gap: 5px 10px;
}


.cdha-process-info-title {
    width: 100%;
    height: 28px;
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 5px;
    line-height: normal;
}


.cdha-process-info-col {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none;
    padding-left: 0;
}


.cdha-process-field-row {
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    float: none;
}


.cdha-process-field-label {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none;
    line-height: normal;
}


.cdha-process-field-input {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none;
}


    .cdha-process-field-input > input,
    .cdha-process-field-input > select,
    .cdha-process-field-input > textarea {
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
    }


.cdha-process-seq-sid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
}


.cdha-process-seq,
.cdha-process-sid {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none;
}


.cdha-process-pair-row {
    width: 100%;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) 70px minmax(0, 1fr);
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    float: none;
}


.cdha-process-pair-label,
.cdha-process-pair-input {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none;
    line-height: normal;
}


/* ============================================================
   5. SERVICE HOST
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-service-host {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
}


/* ============================================================
   6. ACTION BAR
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-action-host {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 5px;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
}


.cdha-process-action-bar {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 0 1 auto;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 3px;
}


    .cdha-process-action-bar .btn {
        width: auto;
        min-width: 92px;
        height: 28px;
        padding: 0 8px;
        flex: 0 1 auto;
        white-space: nowrap;
    }


.cdha-process-template-bar {
    width: auto;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 240px;
    flex: 1 1 260px;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
}


.cdha-process-template-title {
    width: auto;
    min-width: 92px;
    height: 28px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    float: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 7px;
}


.cdha-process-template-select {
    width: auto;
    height: 28px;
    min-width: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    float: none;
    padding-left: 5px;
}


    .cdha-process-template-select select {
        width: 100%;
    }


    .cdha-process-template-select .select2-container {
        width: 100% !important;
    }


/* ============================================================
   7. WORKSPACE
   Service + PACS thumbnail | Result Editor
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    float: none;
    overflow: hidden;
}


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        padding: 0;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(300px, 38%) minmax(420px, 1fr);
        gap: 7px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }


        /* ============================================================
   8. WORKSPACE LEFT
   ============================================================ */

        .cdha-process-workspace-host
        .cdha-process-workspace
        .cdha-process-workspace-left {
            width: auto !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            min-width: 0;
            min-height: 0;
            float: none !important;
            display: grid;
            grid-template-rows: minmax(90px, 35%) minmax(150px, 1fr);
            gap: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
        }


.cdha-process-service-list {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: none !important;
    float: none !important;
    margin: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}


    .cdha-process-service-list > .table-responsive {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto !important;
        min-height: 0;
        float: none !important;
        padding: 0;
        overflow: visible;
    }


.cdha-process-service-row {
    cursor: pointer;
}


    .cdha-process-service-row.active {
        background-color: #e8f2ff;
        box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #3f78b8;
    }


.cdha-process-media {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: none !important;
    float: none !important;
    overflow: auto !important;
}


    .cdha-process-media .pacs-media-panel {
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
    }


    .cdha-process-media .pacs-thumbnail-list {
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 118px;
        overflow-x: auto;
    }


/* ============================================================
   9. WORKSPACE RIGHT
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host
.cdha-process-workspace
.cdha-process-workspace-right {
    width: auto !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;
    float: none !important;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-rows: minmax(220px, 1fr) auto;
    gap: 6px;
    overflow: hidden;
}


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace
    .cdha-process-workspace-right
    .cdha-process-description {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        min-width: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        float: none !important;
        padding-left: 0 !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        overflow: hidden;
    }


.cdha-process-description .content {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    min-height: 220px;
}


/* CKEditor responsive */

.cdha-process-description .cke {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}


.cdha-process-description .cke_inner {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}


.cdha-process-description .cke_contents {
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 180px;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
}


/* ============================================================
   10. RESULT + SUGGEST
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host
.cdha-process-result-suggest {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-width: 0;
    float: none !important;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-result-suggest
    .cdha-process-result,
    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-result-suggest
    .cdha-process-suggest {
        width: auto !important;
        height: auto !important;
        min-width: 0;
        float: none !important;
    }


.cdha-process-result textarea,
.cdha-process-suggest textarea {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 105px;
    resize: vertical;
}


/* ============================================================
   11. RIS WIDTH
   React when PACS 60 / 75 / 90 changes pacs-main width.
   ============================================================ */


/*
   RIS <= 1100
   Slightly narrower patient sidebar.
*/
@container cdha-ris (max-width: 1100px) {

    .cdha-process-container {
        grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}


/*
   RIS <= 900 AND PACS OPEN

   At this width the patient sidebar consumes too much useful
   result space, so hide it while PACS is open.

   Closing PACS restores it automatically because pacs-main
   becomes wide again.
*/
@container cdha-ris (max-width: 900px) {

    .pacs-shell.has-pacs-open
    .cdha-process-container {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .pacs-shell.has-pacs-open
    .cdha-process-left {
        display: none;
    }
}


/*
   Small screen with PACS CLOSED.

   Do not permanently hide the patient list.
   Stack it above result UI instead.
*/
@container cdha-ris (max-width: 680px) {

    .pacs-shell:not(.has-pacs-open)
    .cdha-process-container {
        height: auto;
        min-height: calc(100dvh - 60px);
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        overflow-y: auto;
    }


    .pacs-shell:not(.has-pacs-open)
    .cdha-process-left {
        display: flex;
        height: 280px;
        min-height: 240px;
        max-height: 320px;
    }


    .pacs-shell:not(.has-pacs-open)
    .cdha-process-right {
        min-height: 650px;
    }
}


/* ============================================================
   12. RIGHT CONTENT WIDTH
   This query uses ACTUAL width of the XQ content panel.
   ============================================================ */


/*
   CONTENT <= 1050
   Patient Info: 2 columns.
   Workspace: service/PACS above editor.
*/
@container cdha-content (max-width: 1050px) {

    .cdha-process-patient-info-host {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(280px, 1fr) minmax(280px, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-info-col-3 {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
        gap: 6px;
    }


    .cdha-process-workspace-host {
        overflow-y: auto;
    }


        .cdha-process-workspace-host
        .cdha-process-workspace {
            height: auto;
            grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
            overflow: visible;
        }


            .cdha-process-workspace-host
            .cdha-process-workspace
            .cdha-process-workspace-left {
                height: auto !important;
                min-height: 260px;
                grid-template-rows: auto minmax(145px, auto);
                overflow: visible;
            }


    .cdha-process-service-list {
        max-height: 125px !important;
    }


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace
    .cdha-process-workspace-right {
        height: auto !important;
        min-height: 390px;
        grid-template-rows: minmax(230px, auto) auto;
        overflow: visible;
    }
}


/*
   CONTENT <= 640
   Patient Info: 1 column.
*/
@container cdha-content (max-width: 640px) {

    .cdha-process-patient-info-host {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-info-col-3 {
        grid-column: auto;
        display: block;
    }


        .cdha-process-info-col-3
        .cdha-process-field-row + .cdha-process-field-row {
            margin-top: 5px;
        }


    .cdha-process-action-host {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-action-bar {
        width: 100%;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax(0, 1fr) );
    }


        .cdha-process-action-bar .btn {
            width: 100%;
            min-width: 0;
        }


    .cdha-process-template-bar {
        width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
    }


    .cdha-process-result-suggest {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}


/*
   CONTENT <= 480
   Very narrow form.
*/
@container cdha-content (max-width: 480px) {

    .cdha-process-field-row {
        grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-pair-row {
        grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-info-title {
        font-size: 12px;
    }


    .cdha-process-template-bar {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-template-title {
        width: 100%;
    }


    .cdha-process-template-select {
        width: 100%;
        padding-left: 0;
        padding-top: 4px;
    }
}


/* ============================================================
   13. DEVICE MODAL
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-device-title,
.cdha-process-device-content,
.cdha-process-device-actions {
    min-width: 0;
}


    .cdha-process-device-content select {
        width: 100%;
    }


/* ============================================================
   14. SAFETY
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-shell *,
.cdha-process-shell *::before,
.cdha-process-shell *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}
/* ============================================================
   PACS-CDHA-UI-SHARED-08-HOTFIX-01
   Demo v2 parity:
   - Patient info fields fill available columns
   - Uniform input/select sizes
   - Action bar and template bar on separate rows
   - Service list and PACS thumbnails stay together
   - Remove excessive empty space
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   1. PATIENT INFO - 3 BALANCED COLUMNS
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-patient-info-host {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
    column-gap: 10px;
    row-gap: 5px;
}


/*
   Legacy XQ CSS still has:
   max-width: 19rem
   on .xq-right-info-div-combo-2-input.

   Kill that restriction here.
*/
.cdha-process-info-col,
.cdha-process-field-row,
.cdha-process-field-input,
.cdha-process-pair-row,
.cdha-process-pair-input,
.cdha-process-seq,
.cdha-process-sid {
    min-width: 0;
    max-width: none !important;
}


.cdha-process-info-col {
    width: 100% !important;
    padding-left: 0 !important;
    float: none !important;
}


/* ============================================================
   2. NORMAL FIELD
   label | input
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-field-row {
    grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}


.cdha-process-field-label {
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    padding: 0;
    white-space: nowrap;
    float: none !important;
    line-height: 30px;
}


.cdha-process-field-input {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    padding: 0;
    float: none !important;
}


    .cdha-process-field-input > input,
    .cdha-process-field-input > select {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
        height: 30px !important;
        min-height: 30px;
        padding-top: 2px;
        padding-bottom: 2px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }


/* ============================================================
   3. PATIENT CODE / SID
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-seq-sid {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(100px, 32%) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 0;
}


.cdha-process-seq,
.cdha-process-sid {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: none !important;
}


    .cdha-process-seq input,
    .cdha-process-sid input {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
        height: 30px !important;
    }


/* ============================================================
   4. DOB / SEX + OBJECT / MEDICAL RECORD
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-pair-row {
    grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(0, 1fr) 72px minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 6px;
}


.cdha-process-pair-label {
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
    float: none !important;
    line-height: 30px;
}


.cdha-process-pair-input {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    float: none !important;
}


    .cdha-process-pair-input input,
    .cdha-process-pair-input select {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
        height: 30px !important;
    }


/* ============================================================
   5. ADDRESS / DIAGNOSIS
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-info-col-3 {
    min-width: 0;
}


    .cdha-process-info-col-3
    .cdha-process-field-input {
        padding-left: 0 !important;
    }


    .cdha-process-info-col-3 textarea {
        width: 100% !important;
        max-width: none !important;
        height: 58px !important;
        min-height: 58px;
        resize: none;
        padding: 6px 8px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }


/* ============================================================
   6. SELECT2 - DOCTOR
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-patient-info-host
.select2-container {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: none !important;
}


    .cdha-process-patient-info-host
    .select2-container
    .select2-selection--single {
        height: 30px !important;
        min-height: 30px;
    }


        .cdha-process-patient-info-host
        .select2-container
        .select2-selection--single
        .select2-selection__rendered {
            line-height: 28px !important;
        }


        .cdha-process-patient-info-host
        .select2-container
        .select2-selection--single
        .select2-selection__arrow {
            height: 28px !important;
        }


/* ============================================================
   7. PATIENT INFO TITLE
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-info-title {
    height: 30px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding: 0 7px;
    line-height: 30px;
}


/* ============================================================
   8. ACTION AREA
   Demo:
       [Buttons]
       [MÔ TẢ                  Sample dropdown]
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-action-host {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 5px;
    align-items: stretch;
}


.cdha-process-action-bar {
    width: 100% !important;
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 4px;
}


    .cdha-process-action-bar .btn {
        width: auto !important;
        min-width: 86px;
        height: 31px;
        padding: 0 10px;
    }


/* Full second row */

.cdha-process-template-bar {
    width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(220px, 28%);
    gap: 0;
    float: none !important;
}


.cdha-process-template-title {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 32px;
    margin: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 8px;
    background: #dce0e0;
    font-weight: 700;
}


.cdha-process-template-select {
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 32px;
    padding: 0;
    float: none !important;
}


    .cdha-process-template-select select {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: 32px;
    }


    .cdha-process-template-select
    .select2-container {
        width: 100% !important;
    }


/* ============================================================
   9. WORKSPACE
   Demo desktop:
       Service + PACS  |  Editor
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host
.cdha-process-workspace {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(330px, 38%) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 7px;
}


    /* ============================================================
   10. LEFT WORKSPACE
   IMPORTANT:
   Service list must NOT consume 35% of viewport height.
   PACS media starts immediately after service list.
   ============================================================ */

    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace
    .cdha-process-workspace-left {
        display: flex !important;
        flex-direction: column;
        justify-content: flex-start;
        align-items: stretch;
        gap: 7px;
        height: 100% !important;
        overflow: hidden;
    }


/* service only takes what it actually needs */

.cdha-process-service-list {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: 132px !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}


    .cdha-process-service-list > .table-responsive {
        width: 100% !important;
        height: auto !important;
        min-height: 0;
        margin: 0;
        overflow: visible;
    }


    .cdha-process-service-list table {
        width: 100%;
        margin-bottom: 0;
    }


/* PACS starts immediately after services */

.cdha-process-media {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 160px;
    max-height: none !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
}


    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-thumbnail-section {
        margin: 0;
    }


    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-thumbnail-list {
        min-height: 140px;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
    }


    /* Manual image is not part of XQ Process target */
    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-manual-image-section {
        display: none;
    }


/* ============================================================
   11. RIGHT WORKSPACE
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host
.cdha-process-workspace
.cdha-process-workspace-right {
    grid-template-rows: minmax(250px, 1fr) 116px;
    gap: 7px;
}


/* CKEditor */

.cdha-process-description {
    padding: 0 !important;
}


    .cdha-process-description
    .content {
        min-height: 250px;
    }


    .cdha-process-description
    .cke {
        width: 100% !important;
        min-width: 0;
    }


    .cdha-process-description
    .cke_contents {
        min-height: 195px;
    }


/* ============================================================
   12. RESULT / SUGGEST
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-result-suggest {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 7px;
}


.cdha-process-result,
.cdha-process-suggest {
    padding: 0 !important;
}


    .cdha-process-result textarea,
    .cdha-process-suggest textarea {
        height: 116px !important;
        min-height: 116px;
        padding: 8px;
        resize: none;
    }


/* ============================================================
   13. RESPONSIVE <= 1050px CONTENT WIDTH
   ============================================================ */

@container cdha-content (max-width: 1050px) {

    .cdha-process-patient-info-host {
        grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax(0, 1fr) );
    }


    .cdha-process-info-col-3 {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax(0, 1fr) );
        gap: 7px;
    }


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
        height: auto;
    }


        .cdha-process-workspace-host
        .cdha-process-workspace
        .cdha-process-workspace-left {
            height: auto !important;
            overflow: visible;
        }


    .cdha-process-media {
        min-height: 150px;
    }
}


/* ============================================================
   14. RESPONSIVE <= 640px
   ============================================================ */

@container cdha-content (max-width: 640px) {

    .cdha-process-patient-info-host {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-info-col-3 {
        grid-column: auto;
        display: block;
    }


    .cdha-process-template-bar {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-template-title,
    .cdha-process-template-select {
        width: 100% !important;
    }


    .cdha-process-action-bar {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat( 2, minmax(0, 1fr) );
    }


        .cdha-process-action-bar .btn {
            width: 100% !important;
            min-width: 0;
        }


    .cdha-process-result-suggest {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}


/* ============================================================
   15. EXTRA NARROW
   ============================================================ */

@container cdha-content (max-width: 480px) {

    .cdha-process-field-row {
        grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
    }


    .cdha-process-pair-row {
        grid-template-columns: 82px minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}
/* ============================================================
   PACS-CDHA-UI-SHARED-08-HOTFIX-02
   - Remove document horizontal overflow
   - Normalize workspace sizing
   - Editor headers: Description / Result / Suggest
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   1. HARD WIDTH SAFETY
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-shell {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-main {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.cdha-process-left,
.cdha-process-right,
.cdha-process-patient-info-host,
.cdha-process-service-host,
.cdha-process-action-host,
.cdha-process-workspace-host,
.cdha-process-workspace,
.cdha-process-workspace-left,
.cdha-process-workspace-right,
.cdha-process-description,
.cdha-process-result-suggest,
.cdha-process-result,
.cdha-process-suggest {
    min-width: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


/* ============================================================
   2. PREVENT LEGACY WIDTH FROM ESCAPING GRID
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-shell input,
.cdha-process-shell select,
.cdha-process-shell textarea,
.cdha-process-shell table,
.cdha-process-shell .form-control,
.cdha-process-shell .form-select,
.cdha-process-shell .select2-container,
.cdha-process-shell .cke,
.cdha-process-shell .cke_inner {
    max-width: 100% !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.cdha-process-shell table {
    width: 100% !important;
}


.cdha-process-service-list table {
    table-layout: fixed;
}


.cdha-process-service-list .td-name {
    width: auto !important;
    max-width: none !important;
    white-space: normal;
    overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}


/* ============================================================
   3. WORKSPACE WIDTH
   Desktop target close to Demo v2
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-workspace-host
.cdha-process-workspace {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(320px, 36%) minmax(0, 1fr);
    overflow-x: hidden;
}


    /* Never allow legacy LEFT=400px / RIGHT=calc(...) to win */

    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace
    .cdha-process-workspace-left {
        width: auto !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
    }


    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace
    .cdha-process-workspace-right {
        width: auto !important;
        max-width: 100% !important;
    }


/* ============================================================
   4. CKEDITOR WIDTH
   CKEditor is a frequent offender for document overflow.
   Humanity survived tables. It can survive this too.
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-description {
    overflow: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-description-content {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-description .cke {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
}


.cdha-process-description .cke_inner,
.cdha-process-description .cke_top,
.cdha-process-description .cke_contents,
.cdha-process-description .cke_bottom {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.cdha-process-description .cke_top {
    white-space: normal;
}


/* ============================================================
   5. EDITOR CARD / HEADER
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-editor-card {
    min-width: 0;
    border: 1px solid #cfd5db;
    background: #fff;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


.cdha-process-editor-title {
    width: 100%;
    height: 32px;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 0 8px;
    background: #e9ecef;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #cfd5db;
    color: #111;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 32px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}


/* Description already has editor frame below title */

.cdha-process-description-content {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   6. RESULT / SUGGEST WITH HEADER
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-result-suggest {
    width: 100% !important;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.3fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
    gap: 7px;
    overflow: hidden;
}


.cdha-process-result,
.cdha-process-suggest {
    width: 100% !important;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0 !important;
    overflow: hidden;
}


    .cdha-process-result textarea,
    .cdha-process-suggest textarea {
        width: 100% !important;
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        height: 90px !important;
        min-height: 90px;
        border: 0;
        border-radius: 0;
        resize: none;
        padding: 8px;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }


/* ============================================================
   7. PACS MEDIA
   Thumbnail horizontal scroll is local only.
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-media {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden !important;
}


    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-media-panel,
    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-thumbnail-section {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
    }


    .cdha-process-media
    .pacs-thumbnail-list {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 100%;
        min-width: 0;
        overflow-x: auto;
        overflow-y: hidden;
    }


/* ============================================================
   8. PATIENT INFO SAFETY
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-info-col,
.cdha-process-field-row,
.cdha-process-field-input,
.cdha-process-pair-row,
.cdha-process-pair-input,
.cdha-process-seq-sid,
.cdha-process-seq,
.cdha-process-sid {
    max-width: 100% !important;
    min-width: 0;
}


/* ============================================================
   9. NARROW CONTENT
   ============================================================ */

@container cdha-content (max-width: 1050px) {

    .cdha-process-workspace-host
    .cdha-process-workspace {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}


@container cdha-content (max-width: 640px) {

    .cdha-process-result-suggest {
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    }
}
/* ============================================================
   DOCUMENT LEVEL SAFETY FOR CDHA PROCESS

   Không dùng width:100vw vì scrollbar dọc cũng được tính vào 100vw
   và có thể tự tạo overflow ngang.
   ============================================================ */

html,
body {
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ============================================================
   PACS-CDHA-UI-SHARED-09
   Shared UI behavior
   ============================================================ */


/* ============================================================
   PATIENT ACTIVE
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-patient-item.active {
    background: #e7f1ff;
    border-color: #b7d3f5;
    box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 #3f78b8;
}


    .cdha-process-patient-item.active
    .list-group-item-name {
        color: #0d4f98;
    }


/* ============================================================
   PATIENT DRAWER BUTTON
   Hidden on normal desktop
   ============================================================ */

.cdha-process-patient-toggle {
    display: none;
    width: max-content;
    min-height: 30px;
    margin: 0 0 5px 0;
    padding: 0 9px;
    border: 1px solid #8ca9ca;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: #eef5ff;
    color: #23588f;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
}


/* backdrop normally disabled */

.cdha-process-patient-backdrop {
    display: none;
}


/* ============================================================
   NARROW RIS
   ============================================================ */

@container cdha-ris (max-width: 900px) {

    .cdha-process-patient-toggle {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 5px;
    }
    /*
       Existing SHARED-08 hides left panel
       while PACS is open.
    */
    .pacs-shell.has-pacs-open
    .cdha-process-left {
        display: none;
    }
    /*
       User explicitly asks to open it.
    */
    .cdha-process-container.patient-drawer-open
    .cdha-process-left {
        display: flex !important;
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        z-index: 2100;
        width: min( 290px, 88% );
        height: 100%;
        min-height: 0;
        padding: 5px;
        background: #fff;
        border-right: 1px solid #bfc8d2;
        box-shadow: 7px 0 24px rgba( 0, 0, 0, .18 );
    }


    .cdha-process-container.patient-drawer-open
    .cdha-process-patient-backdrop {
        display: block;
        position: absolute;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2000;
        background: rgba( 0, 0, 0, .22 );
    }
}


/* prevent background movement on very small layout */

body.cdha-patient-drawer-open {
    overscroll-behavior: none;
}
</file>

<file path="wwwroot/css/ns.css">
html {
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

html {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}



/****************************************************** CKEditor */
.cke_chrome {
    border: 1px solid #808080 !important;
}


/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}
/******************************************************** Thẻ DIV canh giữa => Bỏ phần tử nào vào trong cũng tự động canh giữa*/
.div-center {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.div-margin-top-5 {
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
}


/******************************************************** Thẻ Input trong form*/
.form-control {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    color: black;
}

    .form-control:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }

.form-select {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0.4rem;
}

    .form-select:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }


/******************************************************** Margin */
.margin-right-10 {
    margin-right: 0.625rem;
}

.margin-right-5 {
    margin-right: 0.312rem;
}

.margin-bottom-10 {
    margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.margin-left-100 {
    margin-left: 100px;
}

.margin-top-2 {
    margin-top: 5px;
}

.margin-right-2 {
    margin-right: 4px;
}

/********************************************************Pading */
.pading-left-5 {
    padding-left: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-right-5 {
    padding-right: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-left-10 {
    padding-left: 0.624rem;
}

.pading-right-2 {
    padding-right: 0.125rem;
}

.pading-unset {
    padding: unset;
}

/******************************************************** Text color*/
.text-red {
    color: red;
}

/******************************************************** Width - Height*/
.width-20 {
    width: 7.53rem;
}

.width-97 {
    width: 6.01rem;
}

.width-95 {
    width: 5.95rem;
}

.width-100 {
    width: 100%;
}

.height-100 {
    height: 100% !important;
}

.height-28 {
    height: 1.75rem;
}

.height-60 {
    height: 3.8rem;
}

.height-160 {
    height: 10rem;
}

.height-30 {
    height: 4.85rem;
}


/******************************************************** Border */
.border-red {
    border-color: red;
}

.border-left-none {
    border-left: unset !important;
}

.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
}


/******************************************************** Account */
.account {
    font-size: 0.938rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.234rem;
    background-image: url("/images/Background.jpg");
    /*background-color: #ffffff;*/
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}


/******************************************************** From Login*/
.login-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.login-child {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    min-width: 25rem;
    min-height: 16.875rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.313rem 1.25rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.938rem 0.5rem #808080;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang left*/
.menu-left {
    float: left;
    flex-grow: 100;
}

.menu-left-height {
    height: 2.5rem;
}

.menu-left-color {
    color: white;
}

.hover:hover {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
}

.badge-success {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #28a745;
}

.badge-danger {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #dc3545;
}
/********************************************************* Menu ngang right*/
.menu-right {
    min-height: 2.5rem;
    min-width: 14.375rem;
    float: left;
    background-color: #337ab7;
    color: white;
}

.menu-right-bg {
    background-color: #337ab7;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
}

.menu-right-width {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
}

.menu-right-height-64 {
    min-height: 4rem;
}

.menu-right-height-20 {
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

    .menu-right-height-20:hover {
        background-color: #337ab7;
        color: white;
    }

.menu-right-bg:hover {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.menu-right-bg:focus {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

/********************************************************* Format cho RenderBody */
.renderBody {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: black;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
}

    .renderBody .form-control {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .form-select {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .btn-blue {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        background-color: #337ab7;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-color: #337ab7;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:hover {
            background-color: #1e65a3;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #1e65a3;
        }

    .renderBody .btn-red {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-red:hover {
            background-color: #dc3545;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-red:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #dc3545;
        }

/********************************************************* Main */
.main-bg {
    background-color: #666;
}

.main-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.main-child {
    min-width: 49.375rem;
    min-height: 35rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    margin-top: 1.875rem;
}

.main-card {
    background-color: #666;
    width: 11rem;
    float: left;
    margin: 1.25rem 2.188rem 0rem 2.188rem;
    border: none;
}

.main-card-body {
    color: white;
    text-align: center;
}

.main-card-title {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: normal;
    padding-top: 0.625rem;
}

/********************************************************** Xét Nghiệm */

.ns-container {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 0.625rem;
}




/********************************** XN Left */
.ns-left {
    width: 15.625rem;
    height: 100%;
    float: left;
    padding-right: 0.313rem;
}

.ns-left-search {
    width: 100%;
    height: 10rem;
    float: left;
}

.ns-left-list {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 13.563rem); /* = Chiều cao màn hình (100vh) - Chiều cao sa-left-search (130px) - Chiều cao menu-left-height (50px)*/
    float: left;
}

    .ns-left-list .list-group-item-secondary {
        background-color: #eef0f0;
    }

.list-group {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
    max-height: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 0.625rem;
    overflow: scroll;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.list-group-item {
    padding: 0rem 0.313rem 0.313rem 0.313rem;
    color: black;
}

.list-group-item-action {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(197, 197, 197);
}

    .list-group-item-action:hover {
        background-color: #ced4da;
        color: black;
    }

    .list-group-item-action:focus {
        background-color: #ced4da;
        color: black;

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex {

}

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age {

}

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex {

    text-align: right;
}

.list-group-item-name {
    width: 100%;
    float: left;
    color: #15428b;
    font-weight: bold;
}


/********************************** XN Right */
.ns-right {
    width: calc(100% - 15.625rem);
    height: 100%;
    float: left;
    padding-left: 0.313rem;
}

/********************************** Thông tin bệnh nhân*/
.ns-right-info {
    width: 100%;

}

    float: left;
}

.ns-right-info-div-combo-2 {

}

.ns-right-info-div-combo-4-input {

/************************************** Chỉ định xét nghiệm */

.ns-right-service {

}

.ns-right-service-group {

    width: 400px;

    .ns-right-service-group-button .btn {

    /********************************************************************* Process */
    .ns-right-service-gridview .table-responsive .left {

        .ns-right-service-gridview .table-responsive .left .list-service {
