<file path="wwwroot/css/pacs/pacs-dock.css">
/* =========================================================
   PACS DOCK - SHARED RESPONSIVE UI
   Dùng chung cho CT / XQ / MRI / MG
   và có thể tái sử dụng cho Process / ReturnResult.

   Cấu trúc layout kỳ vọng ở view:
   <div class="pacs-shell" id="pacs_shell">
       <main class="pacs-main">
           ... RIS / Result UI ...
       </main>

       @await Html.PartialAsync("_PacsDock")
   </div>

   JS sẽ toggle:
   - .has-pacs-open trên .pacs-shell
   - .is-open trên .pacs-dock
   - .pacs-mobile-open trên <body> khi mobile/tablet dọc
   - .pacs-size-60 / 75 / 90 trên .pacs-shell
   ========================================================= */


/* =========================================================
   1. SHELL CHUNG
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-shell {
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 0;
}

/*
   Khi PACS chưa mở, giữ hành vi layout cũ của màn hình RIS.
   Chỉ khóa chiều cao/scroll khi thật sự mở dock.
*/
.pacs-shell:not(.has-pacs-open) {
    height: auto;
    overflow: visible;
}

.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open {
    height: calc(100vh - 50px);
    height: calc(100dvh - 50px);
    overflow: hidden;
}

.pacs-main {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    transition:
        flex-basis .18s ease,
        width .18s ease;
}

.pacs-shell:not(.has-pacs-open) .pacs-main {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    overflow: visible;
}

.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .pacs-main {
    height: 100%;
    overflow: auto;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}


/* =========================================================
   2. PACS DOCK
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock {
    display: none;
    flex: 0 0 50vw;
    min-width: 360px;
    max-width: 75vw;
    height: 100%;
    min-height: 0;

    background: #0f172a;
    color: #fff;

    overflow: hidden;
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);

    position: relative;
}

.pacs-dock.is-open {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}


/* =========================================================
   3. KÍCH THƯỚC PACS TRÊN DESKTOP
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-shell.pacs-size-60 .pacs-dock {
    flex-basis: 40vw;
    max-width: 60vw;
}

.pacs-shell.pacs-size-75 .pacs-dock {
    flex-basis: 50vw;
    max-width: 75vw;
}

.pacs-shell.pacs-size-90 .pacs-dock {
    flex-basis: 65vw;
    max-width: 90vw;
}


/* =========================================================
   4. HEADER
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock-header {
    min-height: 52px;
    flex: 0 0 auto;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 8px;

    padding: 6px 8px;

    background: #111827;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);

    position: relative;
    z-index: 5;
}

.pacs-dock-heading {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}

.pacs-dock-title-wrap {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
}

.pacs-dock-title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 18px;

    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pacs-dock-subtitle {
    margin-top: 1px;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 15px;

    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .72);

    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}


/* =========================================================
   5. ACTION BUTTONS
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock-actions {
    flex: 0 0 auto;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
}

.pacs-dock-size-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
}

.pacs-dock-btn {
    min-width: 38px;
    min-height: 38px;

    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 4px;

    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .22);
    border-radius: 5px;

    padding: 5px 8px;

    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08);
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 18px;

    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.pacs-dock-btn:hover,
.pacs-dock-btn:focus-visible,
.pacs-dock-btn.active {
    background: rgba(59, 130, 246, .90);
    border-color: rgba(96, 165, 250, 1);
    color: #fff;
}

.pacs-dock-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .9);
    outline-offset: 1px;
}

.pacs-dock-btn-icon {
    width: 40px;
    padding-left: 6px;
    padding-right: 6px;
}

.pacs-dock-btn-close {
    background: rgba(220, 38, 38, .90);
    border-color: rgba(248, 113, 113, 1);
}

.pacs-dock-btn-close:hover,
.pacs-dock-btn-close:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(185, 28, 28, 1);
}

.pacs-mobile-action {
    display: none;
}


/* =========================================================
   6. BODY / IFRAME
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock-body {
    position: relative;

    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    min-width: 0;

    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.pacs-dock-iframe {
    display: block;

    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 0;

    border: 0;
    background: #000;

    touch-action: auto;
}


/* =========================================================
   7. LOADING
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock-loading {
    display: none;

    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 10;

    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    padding: 16px;

    background: rgba(15, 23, 42, .88);
    color: #fff;
}

.pacs-dock-loading.show {
    display: flex;
}

.pacs-dock-loading-content {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;

    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 20px;
}


/* =========================================================
   8. MOBILE FOOTER
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-mobile-footer {
    display: none;

    flex: 0 0 auto;

    background: #111827;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);

    padding:
        6px
        max(6px, env(safe-area-inset-right))
        max(6px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom))
        max(6px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
}

.pacs-mobile-footer-btn {
    flex: 1 1 0;

    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 46px;

    display: inline-flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2px;

    border: 0;
    border-radius: 6px;

    padding: 4px 6px;

    background: transparent;
    color: #fff;

    font-size: 11px;
    line-height: 14px;

    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.pacs-mobile-footer-btn i {
    font-size: 17px;
    line-height: 20px;
}

.pacs-mobile-footer-btn:active,
.pacs-mobile-footer-btn:focus-visible {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .12);
}



/* =========================================================
   8B. TƯƠNG THÍCH LAYOUT RIS HIỆN TẠI
   Tránh overflow khi vùng RIS bị thu hẹp bởi PACS dock.
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-main .ct-container,
.pacs-main .xq-container,
.pacs-main .mri-container,
.pacs-main .mg-container {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
}

.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .ct-container,
.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .xq-container,
.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .mri-container,
.pacs-shell.has-pacs-open .mg-container {
    height: 100%;
}

.pacs-main .ct-right,
.pacs-main .xq-right,
.pacs-main .mri-right,
.pacs-main .mg-right,
.pacs-main .ct-right-info,
.pacs-main .xq-right-info,
.pacs-main .mri-right-info,
.pacs-main .mg-right-info,
.pacs-main .ct-right-service,
.pacs-main .xq-right-service,
.pacs-main .mri-right-service,
.pacs-main .mg-right-service {
    min-width: 0;
}

/* =========================================================
   9. TABLET LANDSCAPE
   Giữ split-screen để bác sĩ vừa xem ảnh vừa đối chiếu kết quả.
   ========================================================= */

@media
    (min-width: 769px)
    and (max-width: 1199px)
    and (orientation: landscape) {

    .pacs-shell {
        height: calc(100vh - 50px);
        height: calc(100dvh - 50px);
    }

    .pacs-main {
        flex: 1 1 42%;
        min-width: 320px;
    }

    .pacs-dock {
        flex: 1 1 58%;
        width: auto;
        min-width: 420px;
        max-width: none;
    }

    .pacs-shell.pacs-size-60 .pacs-dock {
        flex-basis: 52%;
        max-width: none;
    }

    .pacs-shell.pacs-size-75 .pacs-dock {
        flex-basis: 60%;
        max-width: none;
    }

    .pacs-shell.pacs-size-90 .pacs-dock {
        flex-basis: 68%;
        max-width: none;
    }

    .pacs-dock-btn {
        min-width: 42px;
        min-height: 42px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-btn-icon {
        width: 42px;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   10. TABLET PORTRAIT
   PACS chuyển gần full-screen.
   ========================================================= */

@media
    (min-width: 769px)
    and (max-width: 1199px)
    and (orientation: portrait) {

    .pacs-shell {
        display: block;
        height: auto;
        min-height: calc(100vh - 50px);
        min-height: calc(100dvh - 50px);
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .pacs-main {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;
        min-height: calc(100vh - 50px);
        min-height: calc(100dvh - 50px);
        overflow: visible;
    }

    .pacs-dock.is-open {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2050;

        width: 100vw;
        max-width: none;
        min-width: 0;

        height: 100vh;
        height: 100dvh;

        border-left: 0;
    }

    .pacs-dock-header {
        min-height: 54px;

        padding:
            max(6px, env(safe-area-inset-top))
            max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-right))
            6px
            max(8px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    }

    .pacs-mobile-action {
        display: inline-flex;
    }

    .pacs-dock-size-actions {
        display: none;
    }

    .pacs-mobile-footer {
        display: flex;
    }

    body.pacs-mobile-open {
        overflow: hidden !important;
        overscroll-behavior: none;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   11. MOBILE
   Luôn ưu tiên PACS full-screen, kể cả landscape.
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 768px) {

    .pacs-shell {
        display: block;

        width: 100%;
        height: auto;

        min-height: calc(100vh - 50px);
        min-height: calc(100dvh - 50px);

        overflow: visible;
    }

    .pacs-main {
        width: 100%;
        height: auto;

        min-height: calc(100vh - 50px);
        min-height: calc(100dvh - 50px);

        overflow: visible;
    }

    .pacs-dock.is-open {
        position: fixed;
        inset: 0;
        z-index: 2050;

        width: 100vw;
        max-width: none;
        min-width: 0;

        height: 100vh;
        height: 100dvh;

        border-left: 0;
    }

    .pacs-dock-header {
        min-height: 50px;

        gap: 4px;

        padding:
            max(5px, env(safe-area-inset-top))
            max(5px, env(safe-area-inset-right))
            5px
            max(5px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    }

    .pacs-dock-heading {
        gap: 4px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-title {
        font-size: 12px;
        line-height: 16px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-subtitle {
        font-size: 10px;
        line-height: 13px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-actions {
        gap: 3px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-size-actions {
        display: none;
    }

    .pacs-mobile-action {
        display: inline-flex;
    }

    .pacs-dock-btn {
        min-width: 44px;
        min-height: 44px;

        padding: 5px;
    }

    .pacs-dock-btn-icon {
        width: 44px;
    }

    /* Footer giữ các thao tác quan trọng trong vùng dễ chạm bằng ngón cái. */
    .pacs-mobile-footer {
        display: flex;
    }

    .pacs-dock-body {
        min-height: 0;
    }

    body.pacs-mobile-open {
        overflow: hidden !important;
        overscroll-behavior: none;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   12. TOUCH DEVICES
   Tăng vùng bấm mà không phụ thuộc hoàn toàn vào width.
   ========================================================= */

@media (pointer: coarse) {

    .pacs-dock-btn {
        min-height: 44px;
    }

    .pacs-mobile-footer-btn {
        min-height: 48px;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   13. FULLSCREEN API
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-dock:fullscreen,
.pacs-dock:-webkit-full-screen {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

    width: 100vw;
    max-width: none;
    min-width: 0;

    height: 100vh;
    height: 100dvh;

    border: 0;

    background: #000;
}

.pacs-dock:fullscreen .pacs-dock-body,
.pacs-dock:-webkit-full-screen .pacs-dock-body {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
}


/* =========================================================
   14. ACCESSIBILITY / REDUCED MOTION
   ========================================================= */

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    .pacs-main {
        transition: none;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   15. SHARED PACS THUMBNAIL / MEDIA PANEL
   Dùng cho ReturnResult hiện tại và Process sau khi refactor.
   ========================================================= */

.pacs-media-panel {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-section,
.pacs-manual-image-section {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    border: 1px solid #c8cdd2;
    background: #f8f9fa;
}

.pacs-media-section-header {
    min-height: 30px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 5px 8px;
    background: #e9ecef;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #c8cdd2;
    color: #1f2937;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 18px;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-list {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 6px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    padding: 6px;
    background: #fff;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
    overscroll-behavior-x: contain;
    scroll-snap-type: x proximity;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-item {
    flex: 0 0 145px;
    width: 145px;
    min-width: 145px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 0;
    border: 1px solid #cfd4da;
    border-radius: 3px;
    background: #fff;
    color: #111827;
    text-align: left;
    cursor: pointer;
    overflow: hidden;
    scroll-snap-align: start;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-item:hover,
.pacs-thumbnail-item:focus-visible,
.pacs-thumbnail-item.active {
    border-color: #3b82f6;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(59, 130, 246, .18);
}

.pacs-thumbnail-item:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid #2563eb;
    outline-offset: 1px;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-image-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    height: 88px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: #000;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-image {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
    background: #000;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-info {
    display: block;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 5px 6px 6px;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-title {
    display: block;
    min-width: 0;
    color: #1d4ed8;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 15px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-meta {
    display: block;
    margin-top: 1px;
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 10px;
    line-height: 14px;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.pacs-thumbnail-loading,
.pacs-thumbnail-empty,
.pacs-manual-image-empty {
    min-height: 54px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 7px;
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px;
    color: #6b7280;
    font-size: 12px;
    font-style: italic;
    text-align: center;
}

.pacs-manual-image-list {
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    min-height: 72px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 6px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    padding: 6px;
    background: #fff;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.pacs-manual-image-list .hinh {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
}

@media (pointer: coarse) {
    .pacs-thumbnail-item {
        flex-basis: 150px;
        width: 150px;
        min-width: 150px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-image-wrap {
        height: 92px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .pacs-media-section-header {
        min-height: 34px;
        font-size: 12px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-list {
        gap: 7px;
        padding: 7px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-item {
        flex-basis: 132px;
        width: 132px;
        min-width: 132px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-image-wrap {
        height: 84px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-title {
        font-size: 11px;
    }

    .pacs-thumbnail-meta {
        font-size: 10px;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="wwwroot/css/report.css">
html {
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

html {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}



/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}


/******************************************************** Thẻ Input trong form*/
.form-control {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    color: black;
    height: 26px;
}

    .form-control:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }

.form-select {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0.4rem;
}

    .form-select:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang left*/
.menu-left {
    float: left;
    flex-grow: 100;
}

.menu-left-height {
    height: 2.5rem;
}

.menu-left-color {
    color: white;
}

.hover:hover {

}

/********************************************************* Menu ngang right*/

}

.menu-right-bg:focus {

/********************************************************* Format cho RenderBody */
.renderBody {
    font-size: 0.875rem;

    .renderBody .form-control {

<file path="wwwroot/css/sa.css">
html {
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

html {
    position: relative;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}


/****************************************************** CKEditor */
.cke_chrome {
    border: 1px solid #808080 !important;
}


/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}
/******************************************************** Thẻ DIV canh giữa => Bỏ phần tử nào vào trong cũng tự động canh giữa*/
.div-center {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

.modal-content-child {

/********************************************************************************************** Export Result */

.hospital-sa { /***************************************************** Hospital */
    width: 100%;

}

        .hospital-sa .hospital-info .hospital-info-phonemail {

        .hospital-sa .hospital-info .hospital-info-title {

.patient-sa { /***************************************************** Patient */
    float: left;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150px;
    font-size: 22px;

}

    .patient-sa .label1 {
        width: 135px;

    }

    .patient-sa .label2 {
        width: 115px;
        height: 100%;

    .patient-sa .name-sex-age {
        width: 100%;
        height: 30px;

    }

        .patient-sa .name-sex-age .name {
            width: 500px;
            height: 100%;

        }

        .patient-sa .name-sex-age .sex {
            width: 220px;

            float: left;
        }

        .patient-sa .name-sex-age .age {

    .patient-sa .sid-obj {
        width: 100%;
        height: 30px;

        .patient-sa .sid-obj .sid {
            width: 500px;

            float: left;
        }

        .patient-sa .sid-obj .obj {

            float: left;
        }

    .patient-sa .address {
        width: 100%;

        float: left;
    }

    .patient-sa .doctor-location {
        width: 100%;
        height: 30px;
        float: left;
    }

        .patient-sa .doctor-location .doctor {
            width: 500px;
            height: 100%;
            float: left;
        }

        .patient-sa .doctor-location .location {

    .patient-sa .diagnostic {

        float: left;

.export-result-sa { /***************************************************** Result */
    width: 100%;
    float: left;
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 23px;
    font-family: 'Times New Roman';
}

    /* Hình ảnh */
    .export-result-sa .image {
        width: 100%;

    }

        .export-result-sa .image .title {
            width: 100%;

        .export-result-sa .image .content {
            width: 100%;

            .export-result-sa .image .content .image-item {
                width: 450px;

                margin-right: 10px;
            }

    /*Description - Result - Suggest*/
    .export-result-sa .des-res-sug {
        width: 100%;
        float: left;
        font-family: 'Times New Roman';
        margin-top: 30px;
    }

        .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .title {
            width: 100%;
            height: 25px;

        }

        .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .des {

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .des .des-title {

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .des .des-content {

        .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .res {
            width: 100%;

        }

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .res .res-title {
                width: 100%;
                float: left;
                font-weight: bold;

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .res .res-content {

        .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .sug {
            width: 100%;

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .sug .sug-title {

            .export-result-sa .des-res-sug .sug .sug-content {

.signature-page-sa { /***************************************************** Chữ ký */
    width: 100%;

}

<file path="wwwroot/css/sat.css">
html {
    font-size: 18px;
    position: relative;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 16px;
    }
}

.reset-fieldset-legend {
    all: initial;
    font-family: Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
    font-size: 13px;
}

.legend {
    font-weight: bold;
    color: #15428b;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}



/****************************************************** CKEditor */
.cke_chrome {
    border: 1px solid #808080 !important;
}


/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}
/******************************************************** Thẻ DIV canh giữa => Bỏ phần tử nào vào trong cũng tự động canh giữa*/
.div-center {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.div-margin-top-5 {
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
}


/******************************************************** Thẻ Input trong form*/
.form-control {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    color: black;
}

    .form-control:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }

.form-select {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0.4rem;
}

    .form-select:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }


/******************************************************** Margin */
.margin-right-10 {
    margin-right: 0.625rem;
}

.margin-right-5 {
    margin-right: 0.312rem;
}

.margin-bottom-10 {
    margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.margin-left-100 {
    margin-left: 100px;
}

.margin-top-2 {
    margin-top: 5px;
}

.margin-right-2 {
    margin-right: 4px;
}

.margin-top-80 {
    margin-top: 90px;
}
/********************************************************Pading */
.pading-left-5 {
    padding-left: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-right-5 {
    padding-right: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-left-10 {
    padding-left: 0.624rem;
}

.pading-right-2 {
    padding-right: 0.125rem;
}

.pading-unset {
    padding: unset;
}

/******************************************************** Text color*/
.text-red {
    color: red;
}

/******************************************************** Width - Height*/
.width-20 {
    width: 7.53rem;
}

.width-97 {
    width: 6.01rem;
}

.width-95 {
    width: 5.95rem;
}

.width-100 {
    width: 100%;
}

.height-100 {
    height: 100% !important;
}

.height-28 {
    height: 1.75rem;
}

.height-60 {
    height: 3.8rem;
}

.height-160 {
    height: 10rem;
}

.height-30 {
    height: 4.85rem;
}


/******************************************************** Border */
.border-red {
    border-color: red;
}

.border-left-none {
    border-left: unset !important;
}

.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
}


/******************************************************** Account */
.account {
    font-size: 0.938rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.234rem;
    background-image: url("/images/Background.jpg");
    /*background-color: #ffffff;*/
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}


/******************************************************** From Login*/
.login-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.login-child {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    min-width: 25rem;
    min-height: 16.875rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.313rem 1.25rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.938rem 0.5rem #808080;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang left*/
.menu-left {
    float: left;
    flex-grow: 100;
}

.menu-left-height {
    height: 2.5rem;
}

.menu-left-color {
    color: white;
}

.hover:hover {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
}

.badge-success {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #28a745;
}

.badge-danger {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #dc3545;
}
/********************************************************* Menu ngang right*/
.menu-right {
    min-height: 2.5rem;
    min-width: 14.375rem;
    float: left;
    background-color: #337ab7;
    color: white;
}

.menu-right-bg {
    background-color: #337ab7;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
}

.menu-right-width {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
}

.menu-right-height-64 {
    min-height: 4rem;
}

.menu-right-height-20 {
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

    .menu-right-height-20:hover {
        background-color: #337ab7;
        color: white;
    }

.menu-right-bg:hover {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.menu-right-bg:focus {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

/********************************************************* Format cho RenderBody */
.renderBody {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: black;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
}

    .renderBody .form-control {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .form-select {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .btn-blue {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        background-color: #337ab7;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-color: #337ab7;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:hover {
            background-color: #1e65a3;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #1e65a3;
        }

    .renderBody .btn-red {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-red:hover {
            background-color: #dc3545;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-red:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #dc3545;
        }

/********************************************************* Main */
.main-bg {
    background-color: #666;
}

.main-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.main-child {
    min-width: 49.375rem;
    min-height: 35rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    margin-top: 1.875rem;
}

.main-card {
    background-color: #666;
    width: 11rem;
    float: left;
    margin: 1.25rem 2.188rem 0rem 2.188rem;
    border: none;
}

.main-card-body {
    color: white;
    text-align: center;
}

.main-card-title {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    font-weight: normal;
    padding-top: 0.625rem;
}

/********************************************************** Xét Nghiệm */

.sat-container {
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 0.625rem;
}




/********************************** XN Left */
.sat-left {
    width: 15.625rem;
    height: 100%;
    float: left;
    padding-right: 0.313rem;
}

.sat-left-search {
    width: 100%;
    height: 10rem;
    float: left;
}

.sat-left-list {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 13.563rem); /* = Chiều cao màn hình (100vh) - Chiều cao sa-left-search (130px) - Chiều cao menu-left-height (50px)*/
    float: left;
}

    .sat-left-list .list-group-item-secondary {
        background-color: #eef0f0;
    }

.list-group {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
    max-height: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 0.625rem;
    overflow: scroll;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}

.list-group-item {
    padding: 0rem 0.313rem 0.313rem 0.313rem;
    color: black;
}

.list-group-item-action {
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(197, 197, 197);
}

    .list-group-item-action:hover {
        background-color: #ced4da;
        color: black;
    }

    .list-group-item-action:focus {
        background-color: #ced4da;
        color: black;
    }

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex {
    width: 100%;

}

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex-pid {
    width: 40%;
    float: left;
}

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex-age {

    float: left;
    text-align: center;
}

.list-group-item-pid-age-sex-sex {
    width: 20%;
    float: left;
    text-align: right;
}

.list-group-item-name {
    width: 100%;
    float: left;
    color: #15428b;
    font-weight: bold;
}


/********************************** XN Right */
.sat-right {
    width: calc(100% - 15.625rem);
    height: 100%;
    float: left;
    padding-left: 0.313rem;
}

/********************************** Thông tin bệnh nhân*/
.sat-right-info {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;

    margin-bottom: .3rem;
}

.sat-right-info-title {
    width: 100%;

    float: left;

    float: left;

.sat-right-info-div-combo-2-input-input2 {

.sat-right-info-div-combo-4 {

}

}

.sat-right-info-div-combo-4-label-sex-benhan {
    width: 17%;

}

.sat-right-info-div-combo-4-input {
    width: 29%;

}


/************************************** Chỉ định xét nghiệm */

.sat-right-service {
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100% - 12.5rem);
    float: left;
}

.sat-right-service-group {
    width: 100%;
    /*height: 1.75rem;*/
    float: left;
    margin-bottom: 0.313rem;
}

.sat-right-service-group-button {
    width: 400px;
    height: 100%;
    float: left;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 0.2rem;
}

    .sat-right-service-group-button .btn {

.sat-right-service-group-button-title-sample {
    width: calc(100% - 400px);

}


    .sat-right-service-group-button-title-sample .title-process {
        width: 97px;

        float: left;

    .sat-right-service-group-button-title-sample .title-returnresult {

        font-weight: bold;
        background-color: #dce0e0;
        color: black;

    }

    .sat-right-service-group-button-title-sample .sample {

.sat-right-service-group-category-label {

.sat-right-service-group-service {

}

.sat-right-service-group-service-label {

.sat-right-service-gridview {

    /********************************************************************* Get sample */
    .sat-right-service-gridview .table-responsive {
        padding: 0px;

/******************************************************** Border */
.border-red {
    border-color: red;
}

.border-left-none {
    border-left: unset !important;
}

.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
}


/******************************************************** Account */
.account {
    font-size: 0.938rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.234rem;
    background-image: url("/images/logo/Background.jpg");
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}


/******************************************************** From Login*/
.login-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.login-child {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    min-width: 25rem;
    min-height: 16.875rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.313rem 1.25rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.938rem 0.5rem #1e65a3;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang left*/
.menu-left {
    float: left;
    flex-grow: 100;
}

.menu-left-height {
    height: 2.5rem;
}

.menu-left-color {
    color: white;
}

.hover:hover {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
}

.badge-success {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #28a745;
}

.badge-danger {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #dc3545;
}
/********************************************************* Menu ngang right*/
.menu-right {
    min-height: 2.5rem;
    min-width: 14.375rem;
    float: left;
    background-color: #337ab7;
    color: white;
}

.menu-right-bg {
    background-color: #337ab7;
    border: none;
    padding: 0.5rem 0rem 0.5rem 0.5rem;
}

.menu-right-width {
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
}

.menu-right-height-64 {
    min-height: 4rem;
}

.menu-right-height-20 {
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

    .menu-right-height-20:hover {
        background-color: #337ab7;
        color: white;
    }

.menu-right-bg:hover {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

.menu-right-bg:focus {
    background-color: #1e65a3;
    box-shadow: none;
}

/********************************************************* Format cho RenderBody */
.renderBody {
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    color: black;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
}

    .renderBody .form-control {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .form-select {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .renderBody .btn-blue {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        background-color: #337ab7;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-color: #337ab7;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:hover {
            background-color: #1e65a3;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-blue:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #1e65a3;
        }

    .renderBody .btn-red {
        font-size: 0.875rem;
        height: 1.75rem;
        line-height: 0.875rem;
        border-radius: unset;
    }

        .renderBody .btn-red:hover {
            background-color: #dc3545;
        }

        .renderBody .btn-red:focus {
            box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #dc3545;
        }

/********************************************************* Main */
.main-bg {
    background-image: url("/images/logo/Background_01.jpg");
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}

.main-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.main-child-settup {
    min-width: 76rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 45%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    margin-left: 4rem;
    margin-top: 3rem;
}

.main-card-settup {
    width: 7rem;
    float: left;
    margin: 1.25rem 2.188rem 0rem 2.188rem;

}

.main-card-body-settup {

}

.main-card-title-settup {
    font-size: 1rem;

}

}

<file path="wwwroot/css/xn.css">
html {
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

html {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}


/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}
/******************************************************** Thẻ DIV canh giữa => Bỏ phần tử nào vào trong cũng tự động canh giữa*/
.div-center {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.div-margin-top-5 {
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
}


/******************************************************** Thẻ Input trong form*/
.form-control {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    color: black;
}

    .form-control:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }

.form-select {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0.4rem;
}

    .form-select:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }


/******************************************************** Margin */
.margin-right-10 {
    margin-right: 0.625rem;
}

.margin-right-5 {
    margin-right: 0.312rem;
}

.margin-bottom-10 {
    margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.margin-left-100 {
    margin-left: 100px;
}

/********************************************************Pading */
.pading-left-5 {
    padding-left: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-right-5 {
    padding-right: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-left-10 {
    padding-left: 0.624rem;
}

.pading-right-2 {
    padding-right: 0.125rem;
}

.pading-unset {
    padding: unset;
}
/******************************************************** Text color*/
.text-red {
    color: red;
}

/******************************************************** Width - Height*/
.width-20 {
    width: 7.53rem;
}

.width-97 {
    width: 6.01rem;
}

.width-95 {
    width: 5.95rem;
}

.width-100 {
    width: 100%;
}

.height-100 {
    height: 100% !important;
}

.height-28 {
    height: 1.75rem;
}

.height-60 {
    height: 3.8rem;
}

.height-160 {
    height: 10rem;
}

.height-30 {
    height: 4.85rem;
}


/******************************************************** Border */
.border-red {
    border-color: red;
}

.border-left-none {
    border-left: unset !important;
}

.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
}


/******************************************************** Account */
.account {
    font-size: 0.938rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.234rem;
    background-image: url("/images/logo/Background_01.jpg");
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}


/******************************************************** From Login*/
.login-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.login-child {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    min-width: 25rem;
    min-height: 16.875rem;
    padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.313rem 1.25rem;
    position: absolute;
    top: 40%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.5rem 0.3rem #1e65a3;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    font-family: Arial,"Helvetica Neue",Helvetica,sans-serif;
    font-size: 14px;
}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang left*/
.menu-left {
    float: left;
    flex-grow: 100;
}

.menu-left-height {
    height: 2.5rem;
}

.menu-left-color {
    color: white;
}

.hover:hover {
    background-color: white !important;
    color: black !important;
}

.badge-success {
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #28a745;
}

<file path="wwwroot/css/xq.css">
html {
    font-size: 12px;
}

@media (min-width: 768px) {
    html {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

html {
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100%;
}

.table {
    color: black !important;
}


/****************************************************** CKEditor */
.cke_chrome {
    border: 1px solid #808080 !important;
}


/******************************************************* Select Option*/
select:required:invalid {
    color: gray;
}

option[value=""][disabled] {
    display: none;
}

option {
    color: black;
}

/******************************************************** Select 2 */
.select2-results__option {
    height: 28px;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.select2-search__field {
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
}

.select2-container--default .select2-selection--single {
    border-radius: unset !important;
    border-color: #808080 !important;
    padding: 0rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0rem !important;
}

    .select2-container--default .select2-selection--single:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7 !important;
    }

.select2-container--default .select2-search--dropdown .select2-search__field:focus {
    border: unset;
}

.select2-selection__arrow {
    right: 11px !important;
}

.select2-selection__rendered {
    color: black !important;
}
/******************************************************** Thẻ DIV canh giữa => Bỏ phần tử nào vào trong cũng tự động canh giữa*/
.div-center {
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.div-margin-top-5 {
    margin-top: 0.313rem;
}


/******************************************************** Thẻ Input trong form*/
.form-control {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    color: black;
}

    .form-control:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }

.form-select {
    border-color: #808080;
    border-radius: unset;
    padding: 0.1rem 0.3rem 0.1rem 0.4rem;
}

    .form-select:focus {
        box-shadow: 0rem 0rem 0.063rem 0.063rem #337ab7;
    }


/******************************************************** Margin */
.margin-right-10 {
    margin-right: 0.625rem;
}

.margin-right-5 {
    margin-right: 0.312rem;
}

.margin-bottom-10 {
    margin-bottom: 0.9rem;
}

.margin-left-100 {
    margin-left: 100px;
}

.margin-top-2 {
    margin-top: 5px;
}

.margin-right-2 {
    margin-right: 4px;
}

/********************************************************Pading */
.pading-left-5 {
    padding-left: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-right-5 {
    padding-right: 0.312rem;
}

.pading-left-10 {
    padding-left: 0.624rem;
}

.pading-right-2 {
    padding-right: 0.125rem;
}

.pading-unset {
    padding: unset;
}

/******************************************************** Text color*/
.text-red {
    color: red;
}

/******************************************************** Width - Height*/
.width-20 {
    width: 7.53rem;
}

.width-97 {
    width: 6.01rem;
}

.width-95 {
    width: 5.95rem;
}

.width-100 {
    width: 100%;
}

.height-100 {
    height: 100% !important;
}

.height-28 {
    height: 1.75rem;
}

.height-60 {
    height: 3.8rem;
}

.height-160 {
    height: 10rem;
}

.height-30 {
    height: 4.85rem;
}


/******************************************************** Border */
.border-red {
    border-color: red;
}

.border-left-none {
    border-left: unset !important;
}

.bold {
    font-weight: bold;
}


/******************************************************** Account */
.account {
    font-size: 0.938rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.234rem;
    background-image: url("/images/Background.jpg");
    /*background-color: #ffffff;*/
    background-position: center;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-size: cover;
}


/******************************************************** From Login*/
.login-parent {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.login-child {
    background-color: #ffffff;
    min-width: 25rem;

    padding: 1.25rem 1.25rem 0.313rem 1.25rem;

    left: 50%;

}


/********************************************************* Menu ngang*/
.menu {
    width: 100%;

}

/********************************************************* Format cho RenderBody */
.renderBody {

<file path="wwwroot/js/cdha/cdha-process.js">
(function (window, $) {

    'use strict';

    if (!$) {
        return;
    }


    var selectors = {
        shell:
            '.cdha-process-shell',

        container:
            '.cdha-process-container',

        patientItem:
            '.cdha-process-patient-item',

        patientToggle:
            '[data-cdha-action="toggle-patient-list"]',

        patientBackdrop:
            '[data-cdha-role="patient-backdrop"]'
    };


    function getContainer() {
        return $(
            selectors.container
        ).first();
    }


    function closePatientDrawer() {

        var $container =
            getContainer();

        if (!$container.length) {
            return;
        }

        $container.removeClass(
            'patient-drawer-open'
        );

        $('body').removeClass(
            'cdha-patient-drawer-open'
        );
    }


    function openPatientDrawer() {

        var $container =
            getContainer();

        if (!$container.length) {
            return;
        }

        $container.addClass(
            'patient-drawer-open'
        );

        $('body').addClass(
            'cdha-patient-drawer-open'
        );
    }


    function togglePatientDrawer() {

        var $container =
            getContainer();

        if (!$container.length) {
            return;
        }

        if (
            $container.hasClass(
                'patient-drawer-open'
            )
        ) {
            closePatientDrawer();
        }
        else {
            openPatientDrawer();
        }
    }


    function setActivePatient(
        $item
    ) {

        if (
            !$item ||
            !$item.length
        ) {
            return;
        }

        $(
            selectors.patientItem
        ).removeClass(
            'active'
        );

        $item.addClass(
            'active'
        );
    }


    function getCurrentPatientId() {

        var $shell =
            $(selectors.shell).first();

        if (!$shell.length) {
            return '';
        }

        var modulePrefix =
            String(
                $shell.attr(
                    'data-cdha-module'
                ) || ''
            )
                .trim();

        var screenPrefix =
            String(
                $shell.attr(
                    'data-cdha-screen'
                ) || 'process'
            )
                .trim();

        if (!modulePrefix) {
            return '';
        }

        var selector =
            '#' +
            modulePrefix +
            '_' +
            screenPrefix +
            '_id';

        return String(
            $(selector).val() || ''
        ).trim();
    }


    function syncActivePatient() {

        var patientId =
            getCurrentPatientId();

        if (!patientId) {
            return;
        }

        $(
            selectors.patientItem
        ).each(function () {

            var $item =
                $(this);

            var itemId =
                String(
                    $item.attr(
                        'data-patient-db-id'
                    ) || ''
                )
                    .trim();

            $item.toggleClass(
                'active',
                itemId === patientId
            );
        });
    }


    function bindEvents() {

        $(document)
            .off(
                'click.cdhaPatientToggle',
                selectors.patientToggle
            )
            .on(
                'click.cdhaPatientToggle',
                selectors.patientToggle,
                function (e) {

                    e.preventDefault();

                    togglePatientDrawer();
                }
            );


        $(document)
            .off(
                'click.cdhaPatientBackdrop',
                selectors.patientBackdrop
            )
            .on(
                'click.cdhaPatientBackdrop',
                selectors.patientBackdrop,
                function (e) {

                    e.preventDefault();

                    closePatientDrawer();
                }
            );


        $(document)
            .off(
                'click.cdhaPatientItem',
                selectors.patientItem
            )
            .on(
                'click.cdhaPatientItem',
                selectors.patientItem,
                function () {

                    setActivePatient(
                        $(this)
                    );

                    closePatientDrawer();
                }
            );


        $(document)
            .off(
                'keydown.cdhaPatientDrawer'
            )
            .on(
                'keydown.cdhaPatientDrawer',
                function (e) {

                    if (
                        e.key === 'Escape'
                    ) {
                        closePatientDrawer();
                    }
                }
            );
    }


    function observePatientList() {

        var host =
            document.getElementById(
                'process_listPatient'
            );

        if (!host) {
            return;
        }

        var observer =
            new MutationObserver(
                function () {

                    syncActivePatient();
                }
            );

        observer.observe(
            host,
            {
                childList:
                    true,

                subtree:
                    true
            }
        );
    }


    function init() {

        bindEvents();

        observePatientList();

        syncActivePatient();
    }


    $(init);


    window.CdhaProcessUi = {
        openPatientDrawer:
            openPatientDrawer,

        closePatientDrawer:
            closePatientDrawer,

        syncActivePatient:
            syncActivePatient
    };

})(
    window,
    window.jQuery
);
</file>

<file path="wwwroot/js/data.js">
function ValidateInput(id) {
    var flag = true;
    $("#" + id).find(".valid").each(function (i, e) {
        var value = $(e).val();
        if (value === "" || !value) {
            if (flag) {
                $(e).focus();
            }
            flag = false;
        }
    })
    return flag;
}

// ****************************************************************************** Data

function ResultStandard_CheckedBoxOnRow(id) {
    $(".row-resultstandard").each(function () {
        $(this).find(".form-check-input").each(function () {
            var value = $(this).val();
            if (value == id) {
                $(this).prop("checked", true);
            }
            else {
                $(this).prop("checked", false);
            }
        })

    })
}

function ResultStandard_Search() {
    var from = $("#resultstandard-from").val();
    var to = $("#resultstandard-to").val();
    var deviceid = $("#resultstandard-device").val();
    var seq = $("#resultstandard-seq").val();
    
    $.ajax({
        url: "/Data_ResultStandard/Search?" + "from=" + from + "&to=" + to + "&deviceid=" + deviceid + "&seq=" + seq,
        type: "GET",
        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            $("#resultstandard-data-left-list").html(result);
        },
        error: function () {
            $("#resultstandard-data-left-list").empty();
        }
    });
}

function ResultStandard_UpdateStatus() {
    var from = $("#resultstandard-from").val();
    var to = $("#resultstandard-to").val();
    var seq = $("#resultstandard-seq").val();
    var status = $("#resultstandard-status").val();

    if (seq == "" || !seq || status == "" || !status) {
        alert("Vui lòng nhập Seq và Status cần cập nhật !");
    }
    else {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/Data_ResultStandard/UpdateStatus?from=" + from + "&to=" + to + "&seq=" + seq + "&status=" + status,
            dataType: "text",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                if (result == 'True') {
                    ResultStandard_Search();
                }
                else {
                    alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
            }
        });
    }
}

// ****************************************************************************** Push result HIS
function PushResultHIS_Search() {
    var from = $("#pushresulthis-from").val();
    var to = $("#pushresulthis-to").val();
    var patientid = $("#pushresulthis-patientid").val();

    $.ajax({
        url: "/Data_PushResultHIS/Search?" + "from=" + from + "&to=" + to + "&patientid=" + patientid,
        type: "GET",
        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            $("#pushresulthis-data-left-list").html(result);
        },
        error: function () {
            $("#pushresulthis-data-left-list").empty();
        }
    });
}

function PushResultHIS_UpdatePush() {
    var from = $("#pushresulthis-from").val();
    var to = $("#pushresulthis-to").val();
    var patientid = $("#pushresulthis-patientid").val();
    var push = $("#pushresulthis-push").val();

    if (push == "" || !push) {
        alert("Vui lòng nhập push (0 hoặc 1) !");
    }
    else {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/Data_PushResultHIS/UpdatePush?from=" + from + "&to=" + to + "&patientid=" + patientid + "&push=" + push,
            dataType: "text",
            type: "POST",
            success: function (result) {
                if (result == 'True') {
                    PushResultHIS_Search();
                }
                else {
                    alert("Cập nhật Push không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("Cập nhật Push không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
            }
        });
    }
}

function PushResultHIS_Push() {
    var from = $("#pushresulthis-from").val();
    var to = $("#pushresulthis-to").val();
    var patientid = $("#pushresulthis-patientid").val();

    $.ajax({
        url: "/Data_PushResultHIS/Push?from=" + from + "&to=" + to + "&patientid=" + patientid,
        dataType: "text",
        type: "POST",
        success: function (result) {
            if (result == 'True') {
                PushResultHIS_Search();
            }
            else {
                alert("Đẩy kết quả không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
            }
        },
        error: function () {
            alert("Đẩy kết quả không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
        }
    });
}

function GetSample_ValidateInput(id) {
    var flag = true;
    $("#" + id).find(".valid").each(function (i, e) {
        var value = $(e).val();
        if (value === "" || !value) {
            if (flag) {
                if (e.id === "ddt_getsample_location") {
                    $('#ddt_getsample_location').select2('focus');
                }
                else if (e.id === "ddt_getsample_doctor") {
                    $('#ddt_getsample_doctor').select2('focus');
                }
                else if (e.id === "ddt_getsample_userReturnResultDDT") {
                    $('#ddt_getsample_userReturnResultDDT').select2('focus');
                }
                else {
                    $(e).focus();
                }
            }
            flag = false;
        }
    })
    return flag;
}

        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            var date = new Date();
            var today = date.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + date.getDate()).slice(-2);
            $("#listPatient").html(result);
            $("#ddt_getsample_timeSearchFrom").val(today);
            $("#ddt_getsample_timeSearchTo").val(today);

    }

    if (_save == 1) {
        $("#ddt_getsample_savepatient").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ddt_getsample_savepatient").show();
    }

    if (_delete == 1) {
        $("#ddt_getsample_deletepatient").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ddt_getsample_deletepatient").show();
    }

    if (_cancel == 1) {
        $("#ddt_getsample_cancelpatient").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ddt_getsample_cancelpatient").show();
    }

    if (_addservice == 1) {
        $("#ddt_getsample_addService").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ddt_getsample_addService").show();
    }

    if (_getsample == 1) {
        $("#ddt_getsample_processresult").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ddt_getsample_processresult").show();
    }
}

function Process_ValidateInput(id) {
    var flag = true;
    $("#" + id).find(".valid").each(function (i, e) {
        var value = $(e).val();
        if (value === "" || !value) {
            if (flag) {
                if (e.id === "ddt_process_userReturnResultDDT") {
                    $('#ddt_process_userReturnResultDDT').select2('focus');
                }
                else {
                    $(e).focus();
                }
            }
            flag = false;
        }
    })
    return flag;
}

function Process_SaveResult() {
    var patientId = $('#ddt_process_id').val();
    if (patientId === "") {
        alert("Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân!");
    }
    else {
        var validate = Process_ValidateInput('process_patientInfo');
        if (validate) {

            // Lấy ServiceId
            var resultCDHAId = "";
            $(".row-service").each(function () {
                $(this).find(".form-check-input").each(function () {
                    var isChecked = $(this).is(':checked');
                    if (isChecked) {
                        resultCDHAId = $(this).val();
                    }
                })
            })

            if (resultCDHAId === "") {
                alert("Vui lòng chọn dịch vụ!");
            }
            else {
                var returnResultTime = $('#ddt_process_returnResultTime').val();
                var userReturnResult = $('#ddt_process_userReturnResultDDT').val();
                var description = CKEDITOR.instances['ddt_process_description'].getData();
                var result = $('#ddt_process_result').val();
                var suggest = $('#ddt_process_suggest').val();

                var data = {
                    patientId: patientId,
                    resultCDHAId: resultCDHAId,
                    returnResultTime: returnResultTime,
                    userReturnResult: userReturnResult,
                    description: description,
                    result: result,
                    suggest: suggest
                };

                $.ajax({
                    url: "/DDT_Process/SaveResult/",
                    data: JSON.stringify(data),
                    contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                    dataType: "text",
                    type: "POST",
                    success: function (result) {
                        if (result == 'True') {
                        }
                        else {
                            alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                        }
                    },
                    error: function () {
                        alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                    }
                });
                return true;
            }          
        }
        else {
            return false
        }
    }
}

function Process_SelectDevice() {
    var deviceId = $('#ddt_getsample_select_device_select').val();
    if (deviceId === "") {
        alert("Vui lòng chọn thiết bị !")
    }
    else {
        $.ajax({
            url: "/DDT_Process/SelectDevice?deviceId=" + deviceId,
            type: 'GET',
            dataType: 'text',
            success: function (result) {
                if (result === 'False') {
                    alert("Không thể chọn thiết bị. Kiểm tra lại !");
                }
                else {
                    Process_ValidPrint();
                }
            },
            error: function () {
                alert("Không thể chọn thiết bị. Kiểm tra lại !");
            }
        });
    }
}


function Process_ValidPrint() {
    $.ajax({
        url: "/DDT_Process/Check_SelectDevice/",
        type: 'GET',
        dataType: 'text',
        success: function (result) {
            if (result === "False") {
                $('#addDeviceForm').modal('show');
            }
            else {
                var patientId = $('#ddt_process_id').val();
                if (patientId === "") {
                    alert("Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân!");
                }
                else {
                    var validate = Process_ValidateInput('process_patientInfo');
                    if (validate) {

                        // Lấy ServiceId
                        var resultCDHAId = "";
                        $(".row-service").each(function () {
                            $(this).find(".form-check-input").each(function () {
                                var isChecked = $(this).is(':checked');
                                if (isChecked) {
                                    resultCDHAId = $(this).val();
                                }
                            })
                        })

                        if (resultCDHAId === "") {
                            alert("Vui lòng chọn dịch vụ!");
                        }
                        else {
                            $('#showWaitting').modal('show');
                            var returnResultTime = $('#ddt_process_returnResultTime').val();
                            var userReturnResult = $('#ddt_process_userReturnResultDDT').val();
                            var description = CKEDITOR.instances['ddt_process_description'].getData();
                            var result = $('#ddt_process_result').val();
                            var suggest = $('#ddt_process_suggest').val();

                            var data = {
                                patientId: patientId,
                                resultCDHAId: resultCDHAId,
                                returnResultTime: returnResultTime,
                                userReturnResult: userReturnResult,
                                description: description,
                                result: result,
                                suggest: suggest
                            };

                            $.ajax({
                                url: "/DDT_Process/ValidPrint/",
                                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                                dataType: "text",
                                type: "POST",
                                success: function (response) {
                                    $('#showWaitting').modal('hide');
                                    if (response === "") {
                                        alert("Valid & In không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                                    }
                                    else {
                                        Process_Refresh();
                                        Process_Get_Count();
                                        var byteCharacters = atob(response);
                                        var byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length);
                                        for (var i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
                                            byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i);
                                        }
                                        var byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
                                        var file = new Blob([byteArray], { type: 'application/pdf;base64' });
                                        var fileURL = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                                        window.open(fileURL);
                                    }
                                },
                                error: function () {
                                    $('#showWaitting').modal('hide');
                                    alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                                }
                            });
                            return true;
                        }
                    }
                    else {
                        return false
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    });
}

function Process_SetStatus_ClickButtonStatus(btn, value, index) {
    var idResult = "result" + index;
    var result = document.getElementById(idResult);
    if (value === '0') {
        btn.style.color = 'blue';
        result.style.color = 'blue';
        btn.value = 1;
    }
    if (value === '1') {
        btn.style.color = 'red';
        btn.value = 2;
        result.style.color = 'red';
    }
    if (value === '2') {
        btn.style.color = 'dimgrey';
        btn.value = 0;
        result.style.color = 'black';
    }
}

        success: function (response) {
            $.each(response, function (key, value) {

    $('#ddt_returnresult_location').val('');
    $('#ddt_returnresult_doctor').val('');
    $('#ddt_returnresult_userReturnResultDDT').val('');
    $('#ddt_returnresult_address').val('');
    $('#ddt_returnresult_diagnostic').val('');
    $('#tbody-gridview-service').empty();
}

function ReturnResult_GetPatientInfo(id) {
    $.ajax({
        url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/GetPatientInfo?id=" + id,
        type: "GET",
        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            $("#returnresult_patientInfo").html(result);
            ReturnResult_GetListServiceForPatient(id);
        },
        error: function () {
            $("#returnresult_patientInfo").empty();
            $('#tbody-gridview-service').empty();
        }
    });
}

function ReturnResult_GetListServiceForPatient(id) {
    $.ajax({
        url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/GetServiceForPatient?patientId=" + id,
        type: "GET",
        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            $("#returnresult_ddt-right-service-gridview").html(result);
        },
        error: function () {
            $('#tbody-gridview-service').empty();
        }
    });
}

function ReturnResult_Invalid() {
    var id = $('#ddt_returnresult_id').val();
    if (id === "") {
        alert("Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân!");
    }
    else {
        if (confirm('Bạn muốn InValid kết quả của bệnh nhân ?')) {
            $.ajax({
                url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/Invalid?id= " + id,
                type: 'POST',
                dataType: 'text',
                success: function (result) {
                    if (result === 'True') {
                        ReturnResult_Refresh();
                        ReturnResult_Get_Count();
                    }
                    else {
                        alert("Không thể Invalid. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    alert("Không thể Invalid. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

function ReturnResult_Get_Count() {
    $.ajax({
        url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/Get_Count/",
        type: 'GET',
        dataType: 'text',
        success: function (result) {
            var arrayResult = result.split(';');
            document.getElementById("countGetSample").innerHTML = arrayResult[0];
            document.getElementById("countProcess").innerHTML = arrayResult[1];
            document.getElementById("countReturnResult").innerHTML = arrayResult[2];
        }
    });
}

function ReturnResult_Print() {
    var patientId = $('#ddt_returnresult_id').val();
    if (patientId === "") {
        alert("Vui lòng chọn bệnh nhân!");
    }
    else {
        // Lấy ServiceId
        var resultCDHAId = "";
        $(".row-service").each(function () {
            $(this).find(".form-check-input").each(function () {
                var isChecked = $(this).is(':checked');
                if (isChecked) {
                    resultCDHAId = $(this).val();
                }
            })
        })

        if (resultCDHAId === "") {
            alert("Vui lòng chọn dịch vụ!");
        }
        else {
            $('#showWaitting').modal('show');
            $.ajax({
                url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/Print?resultCDHAId=" + resultCDHAId,
                dataType: "text",
                type: "GET",
                success: function (response) {
                    $('#showWaitting').modal('hide');
                    if (response === "") {
                        alert("In không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                    }
                    else {
                        var byteCharacters = atob(response);
                        var byteNumbers = new Array(byteCharacters.length);
                        for (var i = 0; i < byteCharacters.length; i++) {
                            byteNumbers[i] = byteCharacters.charCodeAt(i);
                        }
                        var byteArray = new Uint8Array(byteNumbers);
                        var file = new Blob([byteArray], { type: 'application/pdf;base64' });
                        var fileURL = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                        window.open(fileURL);
                    }
                },
                error: function () {
                    $('#showWaitting').modal('hide');
                    alert("In không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");
                }
            });
        }
    }
}

function ReturnResult_CheckedBoxOnRow(id) {
    $(".row-service").each(function () { // Lấy value trên từng Row
        $(this).find(".form-check-input").each(function () {
            var value = $(this).val();
            if (value == id) {
                $(this).prop("checked", true);
                ReturnResult_LoadImageForService(id);
            }
            else {
                $(this).prop("checked", false);
            }
        })

    })
}

function ReturnResult_LoadImageForService(id) {
    CKEDITOR.instances["ddt_returnresult_description"].setData("");
    $("#ddt_returnresult_result").val("");
    $("#ddt_returnresult_suggest").val("");
    $.ajax({
        url: "/DDT_ReturnResult/Get_Description_Result_Suggest_ForService?id=" + id,
        type: 'GET',
        dataType: 'json',
        success: function (response) {
            $.each(response, function (key, value) {
                CKEDITOR.instances["ddt_returnresult_description"].setData(value.description);
                $("#ddt_returnresult_result").val(value.result);
                $("#ddt_returnresult_suggest").val(value.suggest);
            });
        }
    });
}

// Kiểm tra nhập liệu trên form => Trường nào có class = valid thì sẽ kiểm tra rỗng và bắt nhập
function GetSample_ValidateInput(id) {
    var flag = true;
    $("#" + id).find(".valid").each(function (i, e) {
        var value = $(e).val();
        if (value === "" || !value) {
            if (flag) {
                if (e.id === "ns_getsample_location") {
                    $('#ns_getsample_location').select2('focus');
                }
                else if (e.id === "ns_getsample_doctor") {
                    $('#ns_getsample_doctor').select2('focus');
                }
                else if (e.id === "ns_getsample_userReturnResultNS") {
                    $('#ns_getsample_userReturnResultNS').select2('focus');
                }
                else {
                    $(e).focus();
                }
            }
            flag = false;
        }
    })
    return flag;
}

            var today = date.getFullYear() + "-" + ("0" + (date.getMonth() + 1)).slice(-2) + "-" + ("0" + date.getDate()).slice(-2);

function GetSample_HideButton(_new, _save, _delete, _cancel, _addservice, _getsample) {
    if (_new == 1) {
        $("#ns_getsample_newpatient").hide();
    }
    else {

    }

    if (_save == 1) {
        $("#ns_getsample_savepatient").hide();

    }

    if (_delete == 1) {

    }

    if (_cancel == 1) {

    }
    else {

    }

    if (_addservice == 1) {
        $("#ns_getsample_addService").hide();
    }
    else {
        $("#ns_getsample_addService").show();
    }

    if (_getsample == 1) {

        var seq = $('#ns_getsample_seq').val();

            type: 'POST',
            dataType: 'text',
            success: function (result) {
                if (result == "") {
                    alert("Lưu không thành công. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại!");

        });
    }
}

function Process_GetPatientInfo(id) {
    $.ajax({
        url: "/NS_Process/GetPatientInfo?id=" + id,
        type: "GET",
        dataType: "html",
        cache: false,
        success: function (result) {
            $("#process_patientInfo").html(result);
            Process_SetSelect2_03();
            // Auto-chọn bác sĩ = user đang login (nếu chưa có giá trị)
            var loginId = $("#ns_process_userLoginId").val();
            var $sel = $("#ns_process_userReturnResultNS");
            if (loginId && (!$sel.val() || $sel.val() === "")) {
                $sel.val(loginId).trigger("change");
            }

            // Gắn handler đổi bác sĩ
            $(document)
                .off("change", "#ns_process_userReturnResultNS")
                .on("change", "#ns_process_userReturnResultNS", Process_Load_SelectedDoctorInfo);
            // Lần đầu nếu có sẵn value thì cũng load info
            Process_Load_SelectedDoctorInfo();

            Process_GetListServiceForPatient(id);

        error: function () {
            $("#process_patientInfo").empty();
            $('#tbody-gridview-service').empty();
